title: 半導體製程工藝
summary: 以 20 個模組、520 個學習步驟，拆解晶圓製作、元件、微影、薄膜、蝕刻、互連、量測與製程整合。
summaryEn: Twenty modules and 520 learning steps explore wafers, devices, lithography, films, etch, interconnects, metrology and integration.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學拆解；模組編號是學習順序，製程分支與實際前後關係另有說明。520 步不代表任何廠商的完整量產配方或固定製程數。所有步驟使用明確標示的代表照片；重複使用照片不等於每步專屬實拍。操作為原創概念模擬與工程推理，實驗資料需自行提供或查閱來源。
scopeEn: Educational subdivisions based on public principles. Module numbers describe learning order; process branches and actual dependencies are identified separately. The 520 steps are not a proprietary manufacturing recipe or universal process count. Every step has a labeled representative photograph; reused images are not step-specific process photography. Activities use original concept simulations and engineering reasoning; measured data must be supplied or obtained from sources.

stages.title: 製程整合與來料品質
stages.description: 建立能連結材料、座標、量測與元件路線的來料證據。26 個操作包含剖面建模與真實量測方法的判讀。
stages.descriptionEn: Build incoming evidence connecting material, coordinates, metrology and device routes. The 26 operations combine cross-section modeling with interpretation of real measurement methods.
stages.route: 教育模組；替代技術依步驟明示為分支，不代表同一片晶圓必須全部依序加工。
stages.routeEn: Educational module; alternatives are labeled as branches and are not mandatory sequential operations on one wafer.

steps.title: 建立 CMOS 剖面層序
steps.objective: 閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
steps.objectiveEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：將基板、隔離、井區、閘極與接觸層拖入剖面，標出導電及絕緣區域。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
steps.checkEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.

knowledge.textEn: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. Corresponding operation: Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 量測數字只有在量測位置、參考面、單位與方法一致時才可比較；示範驗收界線由課程情境提供，不是通用產業規格。 本步特別排查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements are comparable only with consistent locations, reference planes, units and methods. Exercise acceptance limits are scenario inputs, not universal industry specifications. Specifically examine: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes.

閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
optionsEn: Diameter variation is reported separately from the notch rather than from one direction alone.
Roughness is accompanied by scan area and background-removal method.
A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.
quiz.explanation: 本步驗收的是：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。 其他選項雖可能是有效工程檢查，但不能取代本步證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This operation is accepted against: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. The other options may be valid engineering checks but do not replace this evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Isolation quality depends on geometry, material continuity and local fields. A passing top-view opening does not establish acceptable deep fill, corners or electrical behavior. Specifically examine: Local coating breakthrough at topographic steps.

knowledge.textEn: Isolation quality depends on geometry, material continuity and local fields. A passing top-view opening does not establish acceptable deep fill, corners or electrical behavior. Specifically examine: One recess height imposed on different devices.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「控制隔離表面回蝕」這一步的完成？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports completion of "Control isolation recess"?
options: 墊氧化層的位置及緩衝作用與閘極氧化層區分。
去膠沒有被誤判為硬遮罩圖案消失。
回蝕目標明確標路線，未對所有元件使用同一高度。
optionsEn: Pad-oxide location and buffering function are distinguished from gate oxide.
Resist removal is not confused with removal of the hard-mask pattern.
The recess target is route-specific rather than shared blindly across device types.
quiz.explanation: 本步驗收的是：回蝕目標明確標路線，未對所有元件使用同一高度。 其他選項雖可能是有效工程檢查，但不能取代本步證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This operation is accepted against: The recess target is route-specific rather than shared blindly across device types. The other options may be valid engineering checks but do not replace this evidence.

steps.title: 量測隔離邊緣漏電
steps.objective: 邊緣主導與面積主導漏電的解釋符合結構尺度。
steps.objectiveEn: Perimeter-dominated and area-dominated leakage interpretations match structural scaling.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：比較示意隔離測試結構的電流曲線，將邊緣長度與面積正規化分開。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Compare leakage curves from isolation test structures and distinguish perimeter normalization from area normalization.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：邊緣主導與面積主導漏電的解釋符合結構尺度。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: Perimeter-dominated and area-dominated leakage interpretations match structural scaling.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：面積與周長正規化混用。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Area and perimeter normalization mixed. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 邊緣主導與面積主導漏電的解釋符合結構尺度。
steps.checkEn: Perimeter-dominated and area-dominated leakage interpretations match structural scaling.

knowledge.textEn: Isolation quality depends on geometry, material continuity and local fields. A passing top-view opening does not establish acceptable deep fill, corners or electrical behavior. Specifically examine: Area and perimeter normalization mixed.

steps.title: 交接隔離後表面
steps.objective: 交接包含主動區有效尺寸與隔離邊界，而不只填充完成。
steps.objectiveEn: Handoff includes active dimensions and isolation boundaries, not merely fill completion.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：疊合隔離深度、表面高度與缺陷圖，確認下一層微影的輸入。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Overlay isolation depth, surface height and defect maps to establish inputs for the next lithography level.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：交接包含主動區有效尺寸與隔離邊界，而不只填充完成。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: Handoff includes active dimensions and isolation boundaries, not merely fill completion.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：隔離完成但表面高度仍不合需求。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Isolation complete but surface height remains unsuitable. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 交接包含主動區有效尺寸與隔離邊界，而不只填充完成。

stages.title: 井區、通道植入與退火
stages.titleEn: Well and channel implantation and annealing
stages.description: 以濃度剖面、損傷圖與電性地圖區分植入、活化及擴散；通道調整列為傳統平面元件分支。
stages.descriptionEn: Use concentration profiles, damage maps and electrical maps to distinguish implantation, activation and diffusion; channel adjustment is a conventional planar-device branch.
stages.route: 教育模組；替代技術依步驟明示為分支，不代表同一片晶圓必須全部依序加工。
stages.routeEn: Educational module; alternatives are labeled as branches and are not mandatory sequential operations on one wafer.

steps.title: 標示 n 井與 p 井
steps.objective: 井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。
steps.objectiveEn: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：在 CMOS 截面把 PMOS 與 NMOS 所需井區配對，追蹤接面極性。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Match PMOS and NMOS devices to their wells in a CMOS section and track junction polarity.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：井區型態或本體偏壓極性錯誤。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Wrong well type or body-bias polarity. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。
steps.checkEn: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing.

knowledge.title: 本步的可檢核證據
knowledge.text: 井區型態與元件本體電位安排一致。 對應操作：在 CMOS 截面把 PMOS 與 NMOS 所需井區配對，追蹤接面極性。
knowledge.textEn: Well type is consistent with device-body biasing. Corresponding operation: Match PMOS and NMOS devices to their wells in a CMOS section and track junction polarity.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 植入面劑量、深度分布、化學濃度與活性載子濃度是不同量。退火可能修復損傷並活化摻雜，也會改變擴散剖面。 本步特別排查：井區型態或本體偏壓極性錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Implanted areal dose, depth distribution, chemical concentration and active-carrier concentration are different quantities. Annealing can repair damage and activate dopants while also changing diffusion profiles. Specifically examine: Wrong well type or body-bias polarity.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「標示 n 井與 p 井」這一步的完成？

steps.title: 配置深井隔離分支
steps.objective: 深井形成的隔離路徑可在剖面連續追蹤。
steps.objectiveEn: The isolation path created by the deep well can be followed continuously in the section.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：在三重井示意加入深井，畫出隔離邊界及基板耦合路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Add a deep well to a triple-well model and draw isolation boundaries and substrate-coupling paths.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：深井形成的隔離路徑可在剖面連續追蹤。

steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Deep-well boundaries fail to form continuous isolation. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 深井形成的隔離路徑可在剖面連續追蹤。

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 介電堆疊的幾何厚度與電性等效厚度不同。光學、電容及漏電各自對材料的不同特性敏感，不能互相完全替代。 本步特別排查：傳統氧化與高 k 路線混接。

knowledge.textEn: Rotation correction is verified from the full-wafer vector pattern. Corresponding operation: Compare opposing residual directions at wafer edges and adjust a small-angle rotation model.

knowledge.title: 機制與診斷邊界
knowledge.text: 解析度、焦深、劑量、套刻與隨機缺陷是不同的成像限制。校正平均偏差不能自動消除局部或隨機尾端缺陷。 本步特別排查：旋轉錯誤被平移勉強補償。
knowledge.textEn: Resolution, depth of focus, dose, overlay and stochastic defects impose different imaging limits. Correcting a mean bias does not automatically eliminate local or stochastic-tail defects. Specifically examine: Rotation error forced into translation correction.

steps.title: 校正倍率誤差
steps.objective: 倍率項與平移項未互相代替。
steps.objectiveEn: Magnification terms are not substituted for translation terms.
steps.instruction: 依示意模型，以自行準備或從參考來源取得的圖、量測資料或試算表進行：辨識隨位置半徑放大的殘差，比較 等向 與分軸倍率模型。
steps.instructionEn: Use schematic models and diagrams, measurement data or worksheets you supply or obtain from referenced sources. Identify residuals growing with position and compare isotropic with axis-dependent scaling models.
steps.observation: 保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：倍率項與平移項未互相代替。
steps.observationEn: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: Magnification terms are not substituted for translation terms.
steps.failure: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：倍率項與平移項互相代償。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
steps.failureEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Magnification and translation compensate incorrectly. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
steps.check: 倍率項與平移項未互相代替。

knowledge.textEn: Resolution, depth of focus, dose, overlay and stochastic defects impose different imaging limits. Correcting a mean bias does not automatically eliminate local or stochastic-tail defects. Specifically examine: Mean CD hides stochastic tail defects.

optionsEn: The pattern is traceable to the correct revision and exposure tone.
Corrected residuals no longer contain a common global translation.

quiz.explanation: 本步驗收的是：平均線寬相同不能排除尾端缺陷風險。 其他選項雖可能是有效工程檢查，但不能取代本步證據。

steps.objective: 完成「延伸接面剖面建模」的證據判讀，辨識『比較淺接面濃度剖面與通道邊界』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate model extension-junction profiles by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare shallow dopant profiles with the channel boundary.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較淺接面濃度剖面與通道邊界。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare shallow dopant profiles with the channel boundary. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: peak concentration alone hides deep tails. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Peak concentration alone hides deep tails. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

Here the concrete task is: Compare shallow dopant profiles with the channel boundary. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「凹槽接近目標形狀且間隔層完整」。但底部尖角可能集中應力或缺陷；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Recess shape meets the target while spacers remain intact. However, sharp bottom corners may concentrate stress or defects; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「源汲極凹槽幾何」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for measure source/drain recess geometry?
options: 凹槽接近目標形狀且間隔層完整
空間電性變化可與熱場交叉檢查
非目標元件均落在阻擋區內
optionsEn: Recess shape meets the target while spacers remain intact
Spatial electrical variation can be cross-checked against the thermal field
All non-target devices lie inside blocked regions
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「在截面圖量取凹槽深度與側壁形狀」，因此直接證據是「凹槽接近目標形狀且間隔層完整」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：底部尖角可能集中應力或缺陷。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to measure recess depth and sidewalls in cross sections; the direct criterion is: Recess shape meets the target while spacers remain intact. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Sharp bottom corners may concentrate stress or defects.

steps.title: 外延前界面清潔判讀
steps.objective: 完成「外延前界面清潔判讀」的證據判讀，辨識『比較表面氧化與碳污染分析結果』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate assess the pre-epitaxy interface by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare surface oxide and carbon-contamination results.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較表面氧化與碳污染分析結果。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare surface oxide and carbon-contamination results. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：外延界面具有可追溯的潔淨證據。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: the epitaxial interface has traceable cleanliness evidence. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：殘氧會破壞外延起始一致性。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: residual oxygen disrupts consistent epitaxial nucleation. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「外延界面具有可追溯的潔淨證據」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「殘氧會破壞外延起始一致性」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: The epitaxial interface has traceable cleanliness evidence. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Residual oxygen disrupts consistent epitaxial nucleation. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.title: 外延前界面清潔判讀的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of assess the pre-epitaxy interface
knowledge.text: 佈植劑量、深度分佈、晶格損傷與電性活化是不同變量；外延與佈植屬可替代或組合的整合分支。 本題具體操作為「比較表面氧化與碳污染分析結果」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Implanted dose, depth distribution, lattice damage and electrical activation are different variables; epitaxy and implantation are alternative or combined integration branches. Here the concrete task is: Compare surface oxide and carbon-contamination results. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 外延前界面清潔判讀的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for assess the pre-epitaxy interface
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「外延界面具有可追溯的潔淨證據」。但殘氧會破壞外延起始一致性；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: The epitaxial interface has traceable cleanliness evidence. However, residual oxygen disrupts consistent epitaxial nucleation; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「外延前界面清潔判讀」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for assess the pre-epitaxy interface?
options: 目標質荷比峰與鄰峰可分離
外延界面具有可追溯的潔淨證據
活化與損傷修復均有驗證指標
optionsEn: The target mass-to-charge peak is resolved from neighbors
The epitaxial interface has traceable cleanliness evidence
Both activation and damage recovery have validation metrics
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比較表面氧化與碳污染分析結果」，因此直接證據是「外延界面具有可追溯的潔淨證據」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：殘氧會破壞外延起始一致性。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to compare surface oxide and carbon-contamination results; the direct criterion is: The epitaxial interface has traceable cleanliness evidence. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Residual oxygen disrupts consistent epitaxial nucleation.

knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「目標區金屬連續且厚度分佈可追溯」。但孤島成膜會形成不均勻矽化物；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Metal is continuous with traceable thickness variation. However, island growth produces nonuniform silicide; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「金屬前驅薄膜連續性」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for inspect precursor-metal continuity?
options: 等待與轉移條件可解釋界面變化
目標區金屬連續且厚度分佈可追溯
粗糙度未造成接觸層覆蓋中斷
optionsEn: Queue and transfer conditions explain interface evolution
Metal is continuous with traceable thickness variation
Roughness does not disrupt contact-layer coverage
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「檢視反應前金屬覆蓋的截面與表面圖」，因此直接證據是「目標區金屬連續且厚度分佈可追溯」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：孤島成膜會形成不均勻矽化物。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to inspect pre-reaction metal coverage in sections and maps; the direct criterion is: Metal is continuous with traceable thickness variation. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Island growth produces nonuniform silicide.

steps.title: 自對準反應區辨認
steps.objective: 完成「自對準反應區辨認」的證據判讀，辨識『標示金屬在矽與介電層上的不同去向』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate identify self-aligned reaction regions by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: map metal behavior over silicon and dielectric regions.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，標示金屬在矽與介電層上的不同去向。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, map metal behavior over silicon and dielectric regions. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：矽化物僅在指定矽接觸區形成。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: silicide forms only at intended silicon contacts. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：未反應金屬殘留可能跨接間隔層。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: unreacted metal residue may bridge spacers. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「矽化物僅在指定矽接觸區形成」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「未反應金屬殘留可能跨接間隔層」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Silicide forms only at intended silicon contacts. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Unreacted metal residue may bridge spacers. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.text: 接觸電阻包含界面與導體貢獻；矽化物、阻障層及塞孔材料依整合路線選擇，不能視為每個節點都使用的固定堆疊。 本題具體操作為「標示金屬在矽與介電層上的不同去向」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Contact resistance includes interface and conductor contributions; silicides, barriers and plug materials depend on the integration route rather than a universal stack. Here the concrete task is: Map metal behavior over silicon and dielectric regions. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.textEn: Contact resistance includes interface and conductor contributions; silicides, barriers and plug materials depend on the integration route rather than a universal stack. knowledge.text: 接觸電阻包含界面與導體貢獻；矽化物、阻障層及塞孔材料依整合路線選擇，不能視為每個節點都使用的固定堆疊。 本題具體操作為「由分段鏈電阻定位高阻接觸群」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Contact resistance includes interface and conductor contributions; silicides, barriers and plug materials depend on the integration route rather than a universal stack. Here the concrete task is: Use segmented chain resistance to locate high-resistance groups. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 接觸鏈失效定位的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for locate contact-chain failures
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「異常可縮小至可再檢測的接觸區」。但整條鏈的總值不能指出單一故障位置；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: The anomaly is localized to a reviewable contact region. However, total chain resistance cannot identify one failed contact; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「接觸鏈失效定位」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for locate contact-chain failures?
options: 殘金屬清除且有效矽化物未明顯流失
最差方向仍保留題定落點重疊
異常可縮小至可再檢測的接觸區
optionsEn: Residual metal is removed while useful silicide remains
The worst direction preserves the required landing overlap
The anomaly is localized to a reviewable contact region
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「由分段鏈電阻定位高阻接觸群」，因此直接證據是「異常可縮小至可再檢測的接觸區」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：整條鏈的總值不能指出單一故障位置。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to use segmented chain resistance to locate high-resistance groups; the direct criterion is: The anomaly is localized to a reviewable contact region. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Total chain resistance cannot identify one failed contact.

steps.routeNote: 教育順序；實際晶圓依選定製程分支、核准規格及合格設備行程執行。
steps.routeNoteEn: Educational ordering; actual wafers follow selected integration branches, approved specifications and qualified equipment travelers.
steps.photoNote: 本步代表性真實照片（同模組可能共用）。可觀察探針台的定位與量測硬體；照片不包含待測電路的 I-V 曲線、測試條件或良率。
steps.photoNoteEn: Representative real photograph for this step (may be shared within the module). Observe probe-station positioning and measurement hardware; no DUT I–V curves, test conditions or yield data are shown.

steps.title: 接觸整合分支放行
steps.objective: 完成「接觸整合分支放行」的證據判讀，辨識『整合界面、塞孔形貌與電阻尾端證據』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate release a contact integration branch by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: combine interface, plug morphology and resistance-tail evidence.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，整合界面、塞孔形貌與電阻尾端證據。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, combine interface, plug morphology and resistance-tail evidence. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：材料分支的形貌與電性結論一致。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: morphological and electrical conclusions agree for the material branch. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：低平均值不能取代缺陷尾端審查。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: a low mean cannot replace tail-defect review. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「材料分支的形貌與電性結論一致」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「低平均值不能取代缺陷尾端審查」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Morphological and electrical conclusions agree for the material branch. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: A low mean cannot replace tail-defect review. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

stages.title: 層間介電膜與化學機械平坦化
stages.description: 介電膜必須同時提供隔離、機械支撐與可加工性；CMP 的去除速率與圖形密度、膜材及接觸狀態相互耦合。 本模組以示意模型、截面判讀及量測資料完成教學任務；此順序為學習編排，不是可直接執行的晶圓製造行程。
stages.descriptionEn: Dielectrics provide isolation, mechanical support and process compatibility; CMP removal couples material, pattern density and pad contact. Exercises use models, cross sections and measurement datasets. The ordering is pedagogical, not an executable wafer traveler.

steps.title: 層間介電膜間隙映射
steps.objective: 完成「層間介電膜間隙映射」的證據判讀，辨識『量取導體間空間與待填充的深寬比』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate map interlayer dielectric gaps by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: measure conductor spacing and gap aspect ratios.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，量取導體間空間與待填充的深寬比。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, measure conductor spacing and gap aspect ratios. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：最狹窄區與最深區皆列入填充評估。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: both narrowest and deepest regions enter the fill assessment. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：只檢查開闊區會漏掉窄縫風險。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: checking open areas misses narrow-gap risks. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「最狹窄區與最深區皆列入填充評估」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「只檢查開闊區會漏掉窄縫風險」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Both narrowest and deepest regions enter the fill assessment. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Checking open areas misses narrow-gap risks. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

steps.title: 介電膜沉積共形性

steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：覆蓋差異能由多位置截面重現。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。

steps.failure: 診斷提醒：平均膜厚不反映側壁薄弱點。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。

knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「調整方向與局部殘膜變化一致」。但盲目加壓可能把中央問題轉移至邊緣；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Adjustment direction agrees with local residual-film changes. However, blind pressure increases can move the problem to the edge; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「載具分區壓力響應」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for assess carrier-zone response?
options: 開口閉合前內部空間已充分填充
調整方向與局部殘膜變化一致
顆粒減少未增加薄弱膜損傷
optionsEn: Interior filling precedes closure of the opening
Adjustment direction agrees with local residual-film changes
Particles decrease without added fragile-film damage
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比較各區調整後的殘膜徑向分佈」，因此直接證據是「調整方向與局部殘膜變化一致」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：盲目加壓可能把中央問題轉移至邊緣。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to compare radial residual films after zone adjustments; the direct criterion is: Adjustment direction agrees with local residual-film changes. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Blind pressure increases can move the problem to the edge.

steps.title: 晶圓邊緣研磨效應
steps.objective: 完成「晶圓邊緣研磨效應」的證據判讀，辨識『量測邊緣排除區內外的殘膜變化』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate inspect cmp edge effects by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: measure residual films across the edge-exclusion boundary.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，量測邊緣排除區內外的殘膜變化。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, measure residual films across the edge-exclusion boundary. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：邊緣模型與可用晶粒範圍相符。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: the edge model matches the usable die region. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：省略邊緣資料會低估實際不均勻度。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: omitting edge data understates nonuniformity. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「邊緣模型與可用晶粒範圍相符」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「省略邊緣資料會低估實際不均勻度」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: The edge model matches the usable die region. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Omitting edge data understates nonuniformity. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of inspect cmp edge effects
knowledge.text: 介電膜必須同時提供隔離、機械支撐與可加工性；CMP 的去除速率與圖形密度、膜材及接觸狀態相互耦合。 本題具體操作為「量測邊緣排除區內外的殘膜變化」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Dielectrics provide isolation, mechanical support and process compatibility; CMP removal couples material, pattern density and pad contact. Here the concrete task is: Measure residual films across the edge-exclusion boundary. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 平坦化後膜厚閉合的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of close the post-cmp thickness balance
knowledge.text: 介電膜必須同時提供隔離、機械支撐與可加工性；CMP 的去除速率與圖形密度、膜材及接觸狀態相互耦合。 本題具體操作為「對照初始膜厚、去除量與最終殘膜」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Dielectrics provide isolation, mechanical support and process compatibility; CMP removal couples material, pattern density and pad contact. Here the concrete task is: Compare initial film, removed amount and final residual film. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「可接受孔徑區與焦距變動範圍相容」。但單一最佳焦點不代表可量產窗口；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。

steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, inspect post-develop bottom scum and opening dimensions. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：孔底實際開放且邊緣未過度流失。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: the bottom is open without excessive edge loss. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：表面開孔可能仍被薄殘膜封住。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。

steps.check: 提交一項能支持「孔底實際開放且邊緣未過度流失」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「表面開孔可能仍被薄殘膜封住」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: The bottom is open without excessive edge loss. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: An apparent opening may retain a thin blocking film. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

steps.title: 圖形轉移偏差回饋

Here the concrete task is: Separate exposure, hardmask and dielectric-etch biases. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

stages.title: 金屬阻障、填充與多層連接
stages.titleEn: Metal barriers, filling and multilayer connections
stages.description: 細互連的有效導體截面受阻障與襯層占比影響；成核、填充、退火與研磨需以導通、隔離及可靠度共同驗證。 本模組以示意模型、截面判讀及量測資料完成教學任務；此順序為學習編排，不是可直接執行的晶圓製造行程。
stages.descriptionEn: Barrier and liner fractions reduce the conducting cross-section of narrow wires; nucleation, filling, annealing and polishing require joint electrical and reliability checks. Exercises use models, cross sections and measurement datasets. The ordering is pedagogical, not an executable wafer traveler.

knowledge.text: 細互連的有效導體截面受阻障與襯層占比影響；成核、填充、退火與研磨需以導通、隔離及可靠度共同驗證。 本題具體操作為「關聯晶粒尺度、線寬與電阻變化」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Barrier and liner fractions reduce the conducting cross-section of narrow wires; nucleation, filling, annealing and polishing require joint electrical and reliability checks. Here the concrete task is: Relate grain size, linewidth and resistance changes. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 金屬晶粒與散射的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for assess metal grains and scattering
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「電阻解釋同時考慮尺寸與微結構」。但只用塊材電阻率會低估細線效應；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Resistance interpretation includes size and microstructure. However, bulk resistivity alone understates narrow-line effects; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「金屬晶粒與散射」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for assess metal grains and scattering?
options: 候選材料具有界面及擴散的證據鏈
電阻解釋同時考慮尺寸與微結構
高電流區與幾何收縮位置一致
optionsEn: Candidate materials have interface and diffusion evidence
Resistance interpretation includes size and microstructure
High-current regions match geometric constrictions
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「關聯晶粒尺度、線寬與電阻變化」，因此直接證據是「電阻解釋同時考慮尺寸與微結構」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：只用塊材電阻率會低估細線效應。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to relate grain size, linewidth and resistance changes; the direct criterion is: Resistance interpretation includes size and microstructure. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Bulk resistivity alone understates narrow-line effects.

steps.title: 填充空洞三維抽樣
steps.titleEn: Sample fill voids in three dimensions
steps.objective: 完成「填充空洞三維抽樣」的證據判讀，辨識『比較多方位截面與電性異常區』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate sample fill voids in three dimensions by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare sections from multiple orientations with electrical anomalies.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較多方位截面與電性異常區。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare sections from multiple orientations with electrical anomalies. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：空洞位置與可能導通瓶頸相對應。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: void locations match potential conduction bottlenecks. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：單張良好截面不足以排除空洞。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: one good section does not exclude voids. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「空洞位置與可能導通瓶頸相對應」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「單張良好截面不足以排除空洞」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Void locations match potential conduction bottlenecks. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: One good section does not exclude voids. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of model coarse backgrinding removal
knowledge.text: 鈍化保護與薄化支撐要一起設計；晶圓厚度、殘餘損傷、翹曲與後續封裝介面是不同放行項。 本題具體操作為「追蹤主要厚度去除與表面損傷層」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Passivation protection and thinning support are designed together; thickness, residual damage, bow and packaging interfaces require separate acceptance evidence. Here the concrete task is: Track bulk thickness removal and surface-damage layers. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 粗研磨去除模型的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for model coarse backgrinding removal
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「粗磨去除量為後續細磨保留餘裕」。但追求快速去除可能留下過深損傷；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Coarse removal leaves allowance for fine grinding. However, fast removal can leave excessively deep damage; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「粗研磨去除模型」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for model coarse backgrinding removal?
options: 粗磨去除量為後續細磨保留餘裕
搬運支點不產生非預期局部彎曲
連續阻隔路徑覆蓋需保護區
optionsEn: Coarse removal leaves allowance for fine grinding
Support points avoid unintended local bending
A continuous barrier covers protected regions
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「追蹤主要厚度去除與表面損傷層」，因此直接證據是「粗磨去除量為後續細磨保留餘裕」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：追求快速去除可能留下過深損傷。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to track bulk thickness removal and surface-damage layers; the direct criterion is: Coarse removal leaves allowance for fine grinding. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Fast removal can leave excessively deep damage.

steps.title: 細研磨表面精化
steps.objective: 完成「細研磨表面精化」的證據判讀，辨識『比較粗細研磨後的粗糙度與損傷深度』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate assess fine-grinding refinement by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare roughness and damage depth after coarse and fine grinding.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較粗細研磨後的粗糙度與損傷深度。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare roughness and damage depth after coarse and fine grinding. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：表面改善有粗糙度與損傷的雙重證據。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: both roughness and damage measurements support improvement. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：表面光滑不保證次表面無裂紋。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: a smooth surface does not exclude subsurface cracks. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「表面改善有粗糙度與損傷的雙重證據」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「表面光滑不保證次表面無裂紋」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Both roughness and damage measurements support improvement. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: A smooth surface does not exclude subsurface cracks. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Total stack thickness includes adhesive variation. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.text: 缺陷檢查回答哪裡有異常，量測回答物理量是多少；統計管制需先確認量測系統及穩定基線，管制界限不等同設計規格。 本題具體操作為「把散射亮點與表面粒子位置比對」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Inspection locates anomalies while metrology estimates physical quantities; statistical control requires a qualified measurement system and stable baseline, and control limits are not specifications. Here the concrete task is: Match scattering spots to surface-particle locations. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 暗場散射缺陷檢出的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for detect dark-field scattering defects
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「檢出靈敏度與背景散射一同評估」。但表面粗糙度可能被分類成顆粒；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Detection sensitivity is assessed with background scatter. However, surface roughness can be classified as particles; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「暗場散射缺陷檢出」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for detect dark-field scattering defects?
options: 持續小偏移可與單點雜訊區分
偏差與參考值不確定度一同記錄
檢出靈敏度與背景散射一同評估
optionsEn: Persistent small shifts are distinguished from isolated noise
Bias is recorded together with reference uncertainty
Detection sensitivity is assessed with background scatter
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「把散射亮點與表面粒子位置比對」，因此直接證據是「檢出靈敏度與背景散射一同評估」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：表面粗糙度可能被分類成顆粒。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to match scattering spots to surface-particle locations; the direct criterion is: Detection sensitivity is assessed with background scatter. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Surface roughness can be classified as particles.

steps.title: 電子束電壓對比

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate interpret e-beam voltage contrast by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare contrast from floating and grounded structures.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較浮接與接地結構的對比圖。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare contrast from floating and grounded structures. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：對比異常具有合理的電連通解釋。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: contrast anomalies have a plausible connectivity explanation. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：充電狀態不同也可能改變亮度。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: different charging states can change brightness. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「對比異常具有合理的電連通解釋」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「充電狀態不同也可能改變亮度」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Contrast anomalies have a plausible connectivity explanation. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Different charging states can change brightness. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.text: 電性量測必須控制接觸、漏電、溫度與儀器限制；PCM 結構用於辨識製程參數，晶粒功能測試則回答產品是否完成指定功能。 本題具體操作為「比較針痕位置與焊墊開口邊界」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Electrical tests control contact quality, leakage, temperature and instrument limits; PCM structures identify process parameters while functional tests evaluate product behavior. Here the concrete task is: Compare probe marks with pad-opening boundaries. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 探針焊墊接觸區的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for inspect probe-to-pad landing
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「針痕留在允許區且未穿出保護邊界」。但邊緣落針可能造成不穩定接觸或剝膜；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Probe marks stay within the permitted pad region. However, edge landing can cause unstable contact or delamination; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「探針焊墊接觸區」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for inspect probe-to-pad landing?
options: 針痕留在允許區且未穿出保護邊界
引線貢獻與幾何修正分別處理
關斷電流高於可辨識下限並有背景扣查
optionsEn: Probe marks stay within the permitted pad region
Lead contribution and geometry correction are treated separately
Off-current is measurable with background verification
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比較針痕位置與焊墊開口邊界」，因此直接證據是「針痕留在允許區且未穿出保護邊界」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：邊緣落針可能造成不穩定接觸或剝膜。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to compare probe marks with pad-opening boundaries; the direct criterion is: Probe marks stay within the permitted pad region. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Edge landing can cause unstable contact or delamination.

steps.title: 探針平面度
steps.objective: 完成「探針平面度」的證據判讀，辨識『檢視多針接觸先後與針痕深淺』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate assess probe coplanarity by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: inspect contact timing and mark depth across probes.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，檢視多針接觸先後與針痕深淺。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, inspect contact timing and mark depth across probes. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：所有必要端點具相容接觸條件。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: all required terminals have compatible contact conditions. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：部分針未接觸會製造假開路。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: uncontacted probes produce false opens. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「所有必要端點具相容接觸條件」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「部分針未接觸會製造假開路」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: All required terminals have compatible contact conditions. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Uncontacted probes produce false opens. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate test via-chain continuity by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: use segmented chains to localize interlevel connection anomalies.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，以分段鏈結果定位跨層連接異常。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, use segmented chains to localize interlevel connection anomalies. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：高阻段可與幾何或缺陷區相互對照。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: high-resistance segments map to geometry or defect regions. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：整體通過不能排除接近失效的尾端。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: overall passing can hide near-failure tails. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「高阻段可與幾何或缺陷區相互對照」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「整體通過不能排除接近失效的尾端」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: High-resistance segments map to geometry or defect regions. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Overall passing can hide near-failure tails. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.title: 導通孔鏈電性的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of test via-chain continuity
knowledge.text: 電性量測必須控制接觸、漏電、溫度與儀器限制；PCM 結構用於辨識製程參數，晶粒功能測試則回答產品是否完成指定功能。 本題具體操作為「以分段鏈結果定位跨層連接異常」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Electrical tests control contact quality, leakage, temperature and instrument limits; PCM structures identify process parameters while functional tests evaluate product behavior. Here the concrete task is: Use segmented chains to localize interlevel connection anomalies. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 導通孔鏈電性的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for test via-chain continuity
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「高阻段可與幾何或缺陷區相互對照」。但整體通過不能排除接近失效的尾端；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: High-resistance segments map to geometry or defect regions. However, overall passing can hide near-failure tails; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「導通孔鏈電性」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for test via-chain continuity?
options: 高阻段可與幾何或缺陷區相互對照
所有測試落點皆對應正確晶粒
背景漏電小於要辨識的元件訊號
optionsEn: High-resistance segments map to geometry or defect regions
Every test landing maps to the intended die
Background leakage is below the device signal of interest
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「以分段鏈結果定位跨層連接異常」，因此直接證據是「高阻段可與幾何或缺陷區相互對照」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：整體通過不能排除接近失效的尾端。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to use segmented chains to localize interlevel connection anomalies; the direct criterion is: High-resistance segments map to geometry or defect regions. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Overall passing can hide near-failure tails.

steps.title: 互連電遷移

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate assess interconnect electromigration by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: relate resistance evolution, current direction and void location.

steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：失效位置支持材料遷移的物理解釋。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: failure location supports a material-transport explanation. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：自熱造成的可逆電阻上升不等同失效。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。

steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Failure location supports a material-transport explanation. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Reversible self-heating resistance is not failure. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Interfaces lack unintended protrusions or recesses. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Different material rates can produce serrated sidewalls. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.textEn: This module compares alternative or combinable architectures: FinFETs, GAA and backside power do not occur together in every flow. Learning order is not a wafer traveler. Here the concrete task is: Compare matched devices before and after backside processing. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 背面製程對前端影響的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for assess backside-process impact on devices
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「差分檢查涵蓋閾值、漏電及導通」。但平均不變仍可能有局部尾端劣化；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Paired checks include threshold, leakage and conduction. However, an unchanged mean can hide local tail degradation; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「背面製程對前端影響」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for assess backside-process impact on devices?
options: 隔離留在凹槽而源汲極成長面開放
差分檢查涵蓋閾值、漏電及導通
每根鰭皆對有效電流提供可解釋貢獻
optionsEn: Isolation remains in recesses while growth surfaces are exposed
Paired checks include threshold, leakage and conduction
Each fin makes an explainable contribution to effective current
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比較背面加工前後同一批元件電性」，因此直接證據是「差分檢查涵蓋閾值、漏電及導通」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：平均不變仍可能有局部尾端劣化。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to compare matched devices before and after backside processing; the direct criterion is: Paired checks include threshold, leakage and conduction. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: An unchanged mean can hide local tail degradation.

steps.title: 製程路線與結構證據交接

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate handoff route and structural evidence by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: bind selected branches, sections and material labels to one revision.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，把選用分支、剖面及材料標記綁定同一版本。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, bind selected branches, sections and material labels to one revision. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：交接圖與實際分支沒有互斥結構混搭。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: handoff diagrams do not mix mutually exclusive structures. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：漂亮總圖可能包含未製作的分支。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: a polished overview may include unbuilt branches. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「交接圖與實際分支沒有互斥結構混搭」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「漂亮總圖可能包含未製作的分支」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Handoff diagrams do not mix mutually exclusive structures. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: A polished overview may include unbuilt branches. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

options: 節點標籤代表技術世代，應以公開 PPA 與結構資料比較。
動態功耗與切換電容、電壓平方和頻率相關，漏電另有不同來源。
增加閘極對通道的包覆可改善靜電控制，但也提高製程整合複雜度。
optionsEn: Node labels identify technology generations; comparisons need public PPA and structural data.
Dynamic power depends on switched capacitance, voltage squared and frequency; leakage has separate origins.
Greater gate enclosure improves electrostatic control but increases integration complexity.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光」與「8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field" and "Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「0.55 NA 變形投影光學」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把 NA 從 0.33 提高到 0.55，光罩端的光錐也跟著變寬。EUV 光罩是反射式，入射錐與反射錐不能重疊，而且必須落在光罩多層膜的角度接受範圍內；以光罩上約 6° 的主光線角計算，若仍用等向 4× 縮小，光錐半角會超過 6°，入射與反射光互相干涉。ASML 的 EXE 平台因此採用變形光學：垂直掃描方向（x，沿狹縫）縮小 4×，掃描方向（y）縮小 8×，掃描方向的光罩端光錐減半。代價是標準 6 吋光罩的 104 × 132 mm 圖案區在晶圓上只剩 26 × 16.5 mm，即半場，每片晶圓曝光次數加倍，大晶粒需要拼接，光罩資料也必須在 y 方向拉長 2 倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「0.55 NA 變形投影光學」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Raising NA from 0.33 to 0.55 widens the cone of light at the reticle as well. The EUV reticle is reflective, so the incident and reflected cones must not overlap and must stay within the angular acceptance of the mask multilayer; with a chief-ray angle of about 6° on the mask, keeping an isotropic 4× reduction would push the cone half-angle beyond 6° and the incident and reflected light would collide. ASML's EXE platform therefore uses anamorphic optics: 4× reduction across the scan (x, along the slit) and 8× in the scan direction (y), halving the mask-side cone in y. The price is that the 104 × 132 mm pattern area of a standard 6-inch mask covers only 26 × 16.5 mm on the wafer, a half field, so each wafer needs twice as many exposures, large dies must be stitched, and mask data are stretched 2× in y. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mask-side NA = NA/M: NXE has 0.33/4 = 0.0825 (4.7°), a cone from 1.3° to 10.7°; 0.55/4 = 0.1375 (7.9°) exceeds the 6° chief-ray angle and the cone crosses the normal (−1.9° to 13.9°); with 8× in y it is 0.0688 (3.9°), back to 2.1° to 9.9°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「0.55 NA 變形投影光學」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光
knowledge.titleEn: High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field
knowledge.text: 把 NA 從 0.33 提高到 0.55，光罩端的光錐也跟著變寬。EUV 光罩是反射式，入射錐與反射錐不能重疊，而且必須落在光罩多層膜的角度接受範圍內；以光罩上約 6° 的主光線角計算，若仍用等向 4× 縮小，光錐半角會超過 6°，入射與反射光互相干涉。
