The EUV reticle is reflective, so the incident and reflected cones must not overlap and must stay within the angular acceptance of the mask multilayer; with a chief-ray angle of about 6° on the mask, keeping an isotropic 4× reduction would push the cone half-angle beyond 6° and the incident and reflected light would collide.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field" is correct?
options: High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。
把 NA 從 0.33 提高到 0.55，光罩端的光錐也跟著變寬。
光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。
optionsEn: High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE.
Raising NA from 0.33 to 0.55 widens the cone of light at the reticle as well.
Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed.
quiz.explanation: 把 NA 從 0.33 提高到 0.55，光罩端的光錐也跟著變寬。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising NA from 0.33 to 0.55 widens the cone of light at the reticle as well. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「0.55 NA 變形投影光學」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光罩端 NA = NA/M：NXE 為 0.33/4 = 0.0825（4.7°），光錐在 1.3° 到 10.7° 之間；0.55/4 = 0.1375（7.9°）超過 6° 主光線角，光錐跨越法線（−1.9° 到 13.9°）；y 方向 8× 時 0.0688（3.9°），光錐回到 2.1° 到 9.9°。場大小：x = 104/4 = 26 mm、y = 132/8 = 16.5 mm，面積 429 mm² 對 858 mm²；300 mm 晶圓含部分場約由 96 場增為約 186 場。k₁ = 0.33 時 CD = 0.33 × 13.5/0.55 ≈ 8.1 nm，而 λ/NA² 景深由 124 nm 降到 44.6 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mask-side NA = NA/M: NXE has 0.33/4 = 0.0825 (4.7°), a cone from 1.3° to 10.7°; 0.55/4 = 0.1375 (7.9°) exceeds the 6° chief-ray angle and the cone crosses the normal (−1.9° to 13.9°); with 8× in y it is 0.0688 (3.9°), back to 2.1° to 9.9°. Field size: x = 104/4 = 26 mm and y = 132/8 = 16.5 mm, 429 mm² against 858 mm²; a 300 mm wafer goes from about 96 to about 186 fields including partials. With k₁ = 0.33, CD = 0.33 × 13.5/0.55 ≈ 8.1 nm, while the λ/NA² depth of focus falls from 124 nm to 44.6 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以含 x 與 y 兩種方向線距的測試光罩曝光，確認晶圓上兩方向的 CD 與圖案位置一致，儘管光罩上的尺寸相差 2 倍；量測場尺寸與兩個半場交界處的拼接套刻；做焦距—劑量矩陣，比較實測景深與 44.6 nm 等級的預測；再量不同節距與方向的最佳焦距差，評估光罩三維陰影效應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Expose a test reticle with line-space patterns in both x and y and confirm that wafer CD and placement match in both orientations even though the mask features differ by 2×; measure field dimensions and the stitching overlay where two half fields meet; run a focus–exposure matrix and compare the measured depth of focus with the 44.6 nm-scale prediction; then measure best-focus differences across pitch and orientation to assess mask 3D shadowing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Mask-side NA = NA/M: NXE has 0.33/4 = 0.0825 (4.7°), a cone from 1.3° to 10.7°; 0.55/4 = 0.1375 (7.9°) exceeds the 6° chief-ray angle and the cone crosses the normal (−1.9° to 13.9°); with 8× in y it is 0.0688 (3.9°), back to 2.1° to 9.9°. Field size: x = 104/4 = 26 mm and y = 132/8 = 16.5 mm, 429 mm² against 858 mm²; a 300 mm wafer goes from about 96 to about 186 fields including partials. With k₁ = 0.33, CD = 0.33 × 13.5/0.55 ≈ 8.1 nm, while the λ/NA² depth of focus falls from 124 nm to 44.6 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field", which statement holds?
options: 集光鏡反射率慢慢下降只影響光源亮度，不影響每小時晶圓數。
晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。
optionsEn: A slowly falling collector reflectance only dims the source and does not affect wafers per hour.
Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally.
Mask-side NA = NA/M: NXE has 0.33/4 = 0.0825 (4.7°), a cone from 1.3° to 10.7°.
quiz.explanationEn: Mask-side NA = NA/M: NXE has 0.33/4 = 0.0825 (4.7°), a cone from 1.3° to 10.7°; 0.55/4 = 0.1375 (7.9°) exceeds the 6° chief-ray angle and the cone crosses the normal (−1.9° to 13.9°); with 8× in y it is 0.0688 (3.9°), back to 2.1° to 9.9°. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「0.55 NA 變形投影光學」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以含 x 與 y 兩種方向線距的測試光罩曝光，確認晶圓上兩方向的 CD 與圖案位置一致，儘管光罩上的尺寸相差 2 倍；量測場尺寸與兩個半場交界處的拼接套刻；做焦距—劑量矩陣，比較實測景深與 44.6 nm 等級的預測；再量不同節距與方向的最佳焦距差，評估光罩三維陰影效應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Expose a test reticle with line-space patterns in both x and y and confirm that wafer CD and placement match in both orientations even though the mask features differ by 2×; measure field dimensions and the stitching overlay where two half fields meet; run a focus–exposure matrix and compare the measured depth of focus with the 44.6 nm-scale prediction; then measure best-focus differences across pitch and orientation to assess mask 3D shadowing. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：超過 26 × 16.5 mm 的晶粒必須拆成兩個半場，交界處的套刻與 CD 不連續會讓跨越邊界的導線斷開或變細；若光罩資料的 y 方向縮放處理錯誤，整片圖案失真；光罩三維陰影造成與方向有關的影像位移，表現為無法用單一焦距修正的系統套刻。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A die larger than 26 × 16.5 mm must be split into two half fields, and overlay or CD discontinuity at the seam can open or neck lines that cross it; mishandled y scaling in the mask data distorts the whole pattern; mask 3D shadowing shifts images depending on orientation, showing up as systematic overlay that no single focus setting can correct.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以含 x 與 y 兩種方向線距的測試光罩曝光，確認晶圓上兩方向的 CD 與圖案位置一致，儘管光罩上的尺寸相差 2 倍；量測場尺寸與兩個半場交界處的拼接套刻；做焦距—劑量矩陣，比較實測景深與 44.6 nm 等級的預測；再量不同節距與方向的最佳焦距差，評估光罩三維陰影效應。
knowledge.textEn: Expose a test reticle with line-space patterns in both x and y and confirm that wafer CD and placement match in both orientations even though the mask features differ by 2×; measure field dimensions and the stitching overlay where two half fields meet; run a focus–exposure matrix and compare the measured depth of focus with the 44.6 nm-scale prediction; then measure best-focus differences across pitch and orientation to assess mask 3D shadowing.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field"?
options: 以含 x 與 y 兩種方向線距的測試光罩曝光，確認晶圓上兩方向的 CD 與圖案位置一致，儘管光罩上的尺寸相差 2 倍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。
optionsEn: Expose a test reticle with line-space patterns in both x and y and confirm that wafer CD and placement match in both orientations even though the mask features differ by 2×.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals.
quiz.explanation: 以含 x 與 y 兩種方向線距的測試光罩曝光，確認晶圓上兩方向的 CD 與圖案位置一致，儘管光罩上的尺寸相差 2 倍；量測場尺寸與兩個半場交界處的拼接套刻；做焦距—劑量矩陣，比較實測景深與 44.6 nm 等級的預測；再量不同節距與方向的最佳焦距差，評估光罩三維陰影效應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Expose a test reticle with line-space patterns in both x and y and confirm that wafer CD and placement match in both orientations even though the mask features differ by 2×; measure field dimensions and the stitching overlay where two half fields meet; run a focus–exposure matrix and compare the measured depth of focus with the 44.6 nm-scale prediction; then measure best-focus differences across pitch and orientation to assess mask 3D shadowing. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「0.55 NA 變形投影光學」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 超過 26 × 16.5 mm 的晶粒必須拆成兩個半場，交界處的套刻與 CD 不連續會讓跨越邊界的導線斷開或變細；若光罩資料的 y 方向縮放處理錯誤，整片圖案失真；光罩三維陰影造成與方向有關的影像位移，表現為無法用單一焦距修正的系統套刻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A die larger than 26 × 16.5 mm must be split into two half fields, and overlay or CD discontinuity at the seam can open or neck lines that cross it; mishandled y scaling in the mask data distorts the whole pattern; mask 3D shadowing shifts images depending on orientation, showing up as systematic overlay that no single focus setting can correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是標準 6 吋光罩的 104 × 132 mm 圖案區在晶圓上只剩 26 × 16.5 mm，即半場，每片晶圓曝光次數加倍，大晶粒需要拼接，光罩資料也必須在 y 方向拉長 2 倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is that the 104 × 132 mm pattern area of a standard 6-inch mask covers only 26 × 16.5 mm on the wafer, a half field, so each wafer needs twice as many exposures, large dies must be stitched, and mask data are stretched 2× in y.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 超過 26 × 16.5 mm 的晶粒必須拆成兩個半場，交界處的套刻與 CD 不連續會讓跨越邊界的導線斷開或變細；若光罩資料的 y 方向縮放處理錯誤，整片圖案失真；光罩三維陰影造成與方向有關的影像位移，表現為無法用單一焦距修正的系統套刻。
knowledge.textEn: A die larger than 26 × 16.5 mm must be split into two half fields, and overlay or CD discontinuity at the seam can open or neck lines that cross it; mishandled y scaling in the mask data distorts the whole pattern; mask 3D shadowing shifts images depending on orientation, showing up as systematic overlay that no single focus setting can correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
超過 26 × 16.5 mm 的晶粒必須拆成兩個半場，交界處的套刻與 CD 不連續會讓跨越邊界的導線斷開或變細。
光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A die larger than 26 × 16.5 mm must be split into two half fields, and overlay or CD discontinuity at the seam can open or neck lines that cross it.
Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed.
quiz.explanation: 超過 26 × 16.5 mm 的晶粒必須拆成兩個半場，交界處的套刻與 CD 不連續會讓跨越邊界的導線斷開或變細；若光罩資料的 y 方向縮放處理錯誤，整片圖案失真；光罩三維陰影造成與方向有關的影像位移，表現為無法用單一焦距修正的系統套刻。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A die larger than 26 × 16.5 mm must be split into two half fields, and overlay or CD discontinuity at the seam can open or neck lines that cross it; mishandled y scaling in the mask data distorts the whole pattern; mask 3D shadowing shifts images depending on orientation, showing up as systematic overlay that no single focus setting can correct. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光罩台與晶圓台同步」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掃描曝光時光罩與晶圓反向運動，速度比等於掃描方向的縮小倍率：NXE 為 4，EXE 為 8。同樣的晶圓掃描速度下，EXE 的光罩台要跑 NXE 的兩倍快，而且曝光場數加倍，加減速時間必須更短；ASML 公開的數字是 EXE 光罩台 32 g（NXE 的四倍）、晶圓台 8 g。8× 倍率也有好處：光罩在掃描方向的位置誤差到晶圓上縮小 8 倍，垂直方向縮小 4 倍。代價是慣性力：真空中的光罩靠靜電夾盤的摩擦力固定，加速度越大越容易微滑，而光罩滑移會直接變成影像位移。同步誤差的移動平均（MA）與移動標準差（MSD）以晶圓座標、在狹縫曝光窗內計算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光罩台與晶圓台同步」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During a scan the reticle and wafer move in opposite directions with a speed ratio equal to the scan-direction reduction: 4 for NXE and 8 for EXE. For the same wafer scan speed the EXE reticle stage must run twice as fast as NXE's, and with twice as many fields the ramps must be shorter; ASML publishes 32 g for the EXE reticle stage, four times NXE, and 8 g for the wafer stage. The 8× ratio also helps: reticle position errors in the scan direction shrink 8× at the wafer and cross-scan errors 4×. The price is inertial force: in vacuum the reticle is held by friction on an electrostatic clamp, higher acceleration invites micro-slip, and any reticle slip becomes image displacement. Moving-average (MA) and moving-standard-deviation (MSD) synchronisation errors are computed in wafer coordinates over the slit exposure window. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：晶圓 0.4 m/s 時光罩 3.2 m/s；以 32 g（313.8 m/s²）加速需 10.2 ms、16.3 mm，同步加速段晶圓只需 32/8 = 4 g；若光罩台只有 8 g，則需 40.8 ms。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At a wafer speed of 0.4 m/s the reticle runs 3.2 m/s; at 32 g (313.8 m/s²) the ramp takes 10.2 ms and 16.3 mm, during which the wafer needs only 32/8 = 4 g, whereas an 8 g reticle stage would need 40.8 ms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光罩台與晶圓台同步」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學
knowledge.text: 掃描曝光時光罩與晶圓反向運動，速度比等於掃描方向的縮小倍率：NXE 為 4，EXE 為 8。同樣的晶圓掃描速度下，EXE 的光罩台要跑 NXE 的兩倍快，而且曝光場數加倍，加減速時間必須更短；ASML 公開的數字是 EXE 光罩台 32 g（NXE 的四倍）、晶圓台 8 g。
knowledge.textEn: During a scan the reticle and wafer move in opposite directions with a speed ratio equal to the scan-direction reduction: 4 for NXE and 8 for EXE. For the same wafer scan speed the EXE reticle stage must run twice as fast as NXE's, and with twice as many fields the ramps must be shorter; ASML publishes 32 g for the EXE reticle stage, four times NXE, and 8 g for the wafer stage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification" is correct?
options: 光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。
護膜只是透明保護層，對產能沒有影響。
掃描曝光時光罩與晶圓反向運動，速度比等於掃描方向的縮小倍率：NXE 為 4，EXE 為 8。
optionsEn: Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed.
A pellicle is just a transparent cover with no effect on throughput.
During a scan the reticle and wafer move in opposite directions with a speed ratio equal to the scan-direction reduction: 4 for NXE and 8 for EXE.
quiz.explanation: 掃描曝光時光罩與晶圓反向運動，速度比等於掃描方向的縮小倍率：NXE 為 4，EXE 為 8。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During a scan the reticle and wafer move in opposite directions with a speed ratio equal to the scan-direction reduction: 4 for NXE and 8 for EXE. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光罩台與晶圓台同步」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：晶圓 0.4 m/s 時光罩 3.2 m/s；以 32 g（313.8 m/s²）加速需 10.2 ms、16.3 mm，同步加速段晶圓只需 32/8 = 4 g；若光罩台只有 8 g，則需 40.8 ms。光罩 152 × 152 × 6.35 mm、密度 2210 kg/m³，質量 0.324 kg，慣性力 0.324 × 313.8 ≈ 102 N；摩擦係數 0.25 時夾持正向力至少 407 N，安全係數 2 取 814 N；靜電壓力 ½ε₀E² 在 E ≈ 10⁸ V/m 時約 44 kPa，以 40 kPa 計需約 0.020 m² 夾持面積。光罩端 4 nm 的 MA 在晶圓掃描方向只剩 0.5 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At a wafer speed of 0.4 m/s the reticle runs 3.2 m/s; at 32 g (313.8 m/s²) the ramp takes 10.2 ms and 16.3 mm, during which the wafer needs only 32/8 = 4 g, whereas an 8 g reticle stage would need 40.8 ms. A 152 × 152 × 6.35 mm mask at 2210 kg/m³ weighs 0.324 kg, so the inertial force is 0.324 × 313.8 ≈ 102 N; with friction coefficient 0.25 the clamp normal force must be at least 407 N, 814 N with a safety factor of 2; electrostatic pressure ½ε₀E² is about 44 kPa at E ≈ 10⁸ V/m, so at 40 kPa about 0.020 m² of clamp area is needed. A 4 nm reticle MA becomes only 0.5 nm at the wafer in the scan direction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以載台編碼器在不同掃描速度與加速度下記錄同步誤差，計算 MA 與 MSD 並與預算比較；在大量加減速循環前後，以光罩對準感測器重複量測光罩基準標記位置，確認累積滑移低於允收值；同時記錄馬達電流與光罩台溫度，因為馬達發熱與力的平方成正比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record synchronisation error from stage encoders at several scan speeds and accelerations, compute MA and MSD and compare with the budget; measure reticle fiducial positions with the reticle alignment sensors before and after many acceleration cycles to confirm that accumulated slip stays below allowance; log motor current and reticle-stage temperature at the same time, because motor heating scales with the square of force.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 晶圓 0.4 m/s 時光罩 3.2 m/s；以 32 g（313.8 m/s²）加速需 10.2 ms、16.3 mm，同步加速段晶圓只需 32/8 = 4 g；若光罩台只有 8 g，則需 40.8 ms。光罩 152 × 152 × 6.35 mm、密度 2210 kg/m³，質量 0.324 kg，慣性力 0.324 × 313.8 ≈ 102 N；摩擦係數 0.25 時夾持正向力至少 407 N，安全係數 2 取 814 N；靜電壓力 ½ε₀E² 在 E ≈ 10⁸ V/m 時約 44 kPa，以 40 kPa 計需約 0.020 m² 夾持面積。光罩端 4 nm 的 MA 在晶圓掃描方向只剩 0.5 nm。
knowledge.textEn: At a wafer speed of 0.4 m/s the reticle runs 3.2 m/s; at 32 g (313.8 m/s²) the ramp takes 10.2 ms and 16.3 mm, during which the wafer needs only 32/8 = 4 g, whereas an 8 g reticle stage would need 40.8 ms. A 152 × 152 × 6.35 mm mask at 2210 kg/m³ weighs 0.324 kg, so the inertial force is 0.324 × 313.8 ≈ 102 N; with friction coefficient 0.25 the clamp normal force must be at least 407 N, 814 N with a safety factor of 2; electrostatic pressure ½ε₀E² is about 44 kPa at E ≈ 10⁸ V/m, so at 40 kPa about 0.020 m² of clamp area is needed. A 4 nm reticle MA becomes only 0.5 nm at the wafer in the scan direction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification", which statement holds?
options: 晶圓 0.4 m/s 時光罩 3.2 m/s。
水平感測器量到的就是光阻表面真實高度，與下層膜無關。
模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。
optionsEn: At a wafer speed of 0.4 m/s the reticle runs 3.2 m/s.
The level sensor reads the true resist height regardless of the underlying film stack.
More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals.
quiz.explanation: 晶圓 0.4 m/s 時光罩 3.2 m/s；以 32 g（313.8 m/s²）加速需 10.2 ms、16.3 mm，同步加速段晶圓只需 32/8 = 4 g；若光罩台只有 8 g，則需 40.8 ms。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At a wafer speed of 0.4 m/s the reticle runs 3.2 m/s; at 32 g (313.8 m/s²) the ramp takes 10.2 ms and 16.3 mm, during which the wafer needs only 32/8 = 4 g, whereas an 8 g reticle stage would need 40.8 ms. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光罩台與晶圓台同步」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以載台編碼器在不同掃描速度與加速度下記錄同步誤差，計算 MA 與 MSD 並與預算比較；在大量加減速循環前後，以光罩對準感測器重複量測光罩基準標記位置，確認累積滑移低於允收值；同時記錄馬達電流與光罩台溫度，因為馬達發熱與力的平方成正比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record synchronisation error from stage encoders at several scan speeds and accelerations, compute MA and MSD and compare with the budget; measure reticle fiducial positions with the reticle alignment sensors before and after many acceleration cycles to confirm that accumulated slip stays below allowance; log motor current and reticle-stage temperature at the same time, because motor heating scales with the square of force. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光罩每數千次掃描微滑零點幾奈米，累積成場內套刻漂移，晶圓間的對準無法完全抓到；夾盤凸點上的顆粒降低接觸面積與摩擦力，同時造成局部變形；32 g 下馬達發熱提高光罩台溫度，使量測框架漂移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A reticle that slips a fraction of a nanometre every few thousand scans accumulates intra-field overlay drift that wafer-to-wafer alignment cannot fully capture; particles on clamp burls reduce contact area and friction while locally deforming the mask; motor heating at 32 g warms the reticle stage and drifts the metrology frame.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以載台編碼器在不同掃描速度與加速度下記錄同步誤差，計算 MA 與 MSD 並與預算比較；在大量加減速循環前後，以光罩對準感測器重複量測光罩基準標記位置，確認累積滑移低於允收值；同時記錄馬達電流與光罩台溫度，因為馬達發熱與力的平方成正比。
knowledge.textEn: Record synchronisation error from stage encoders at several scan speeds and accelerations, compute MA and MSD and compare with the budget; measure reticle fiducial positions with the reticle alignment sensors before and after many acceleration cycles to confirm that accumulated slip stays below allowance; log motor current and reticle-stage temperature at the same time, because motor heating scales with the square of force.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Record synchronisation error from stage encoders at several scan speeds and accelerations, compute MA and MSD and compare with the budget.
Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour.

steps.title: 8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光罩台與晶圓台同步」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 光罩每數千次掃描微滑零點幾奈米，累積成場內套刻漂移，晶圓間的對準無法完全抓到；夾盤凸點上的顆粒降低接觸面積與摩擦力，同時造成局部變形；32 g 下馬達發熱提高光罩台溫度，使量測框架漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A reticle that slips a fraction of a nanometre every few thousand scans accumulates intra-field overlay drift that wafer-to-wafer alignment cannot fully capture; particles on clamp burls reduce contact area and friction while locally deforming the mask; motor heating at 32 g warms the reticle stage and drifts the metrology frame. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同步誤差的移動平均（MA）與移動標準差（MSD）以晶圓座標、在狹縫曝光窗內計算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moving-average (MA) and moving-standard-deviation (MSD) synchronisation errors are computed in wafer coordinates over the slit exposure window.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「EUV 護膜穿透率、熱負載與光罩缺陷」與「集光鏡壽命：錫沉積與氫自由基清潔」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "EUV pellicle transmission, heat load and reticle defectivity" and "Collector lifetime: tin deposition and hydrogen-radical cleaning": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: EUV 護膜穿透率、熱負載與光罩缺陷：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: EUV pellicle transmission, heat load and reticle defectivity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「EUV 護膜與光罩正面」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “EUV pellicle and reticle front side” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 護膜是一張只有數十奈米厚的自撐薄膜，裝在光罩前方數毫米處；落在護膜上的顆粒嚴重離焦而不成像，但若直接落在光罩上，會在每個場的每顆晶粒重複印出。EUV 下薄膜本身會吸收，而且光線來回穿過兩次，所以單程穿透率 T 對產能的影響是 T²；吸收的功率在真空中只能靠輻射散熱，光源功率越高薄膜溫度可達數百 °C。ASML 公開的第一代護膜約 50 nm 厚、單程損失約 10%，後續的矽化物、碳奈米管等材料在穿透率、強度與熱穩定性之間取捨。數微米以上的顆粒仍不能留在護膜上，抽真空與破真空時的壓差也是薄膜破裂的風險。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「EUV 護膜與光罩正面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pellicle is a free-standing membrane only tens of nanometres thick mounted a few millimetres in front of the reticle; particles landing on it are far out of focus and do not print, whereas a particle on the mask itself repeats in every die of every field. In EUV the membrane absorbs and the light crosses it twice, so a single-pass transmission T costs throughput as T²; the absorbed power can leave only by radiation in vacuum, and at higher source powers the film reaches several hundred °C. ASML's published first-generation pellicle was about 50 nm thick with roughly 10% single-pass loss, and later silicide and carbon-nanotube materials trade transmission, strength and thermal stability. Particles larger than a few micrometres must still be kept off the film, and pressure differences during pump-down and venting are a rupture risk. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “EUV pellicle and reticle front side”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：T = 0.90 時雙程 0.81，曝光受限下產能損失 19%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With T = 0.90 the double pass is 0.81, a 19% throughput loss when exposure-limited.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「護膜只是透明保護層，對產能沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A pellicle is just a transparent cover with no effect on throughput." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「EUV 護膜與光罩正面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “EUV pellicle and reticle front side”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: EUV 護膜穿透率、熱負載與光罩缺陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: EUV pellicle transmission, heat load and reticle defectivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「EUV 護膜與光罩正面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “EUV pellicle and reticle front side” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T = 0.90 時雙程 0.81，曝光受限下產能損失 19%。熱負載：20 W EUV 照在 104 × 8 mm 狹縫區（8.32 cm²），第一程吸收 2.0 W，經光罩 0.65 反射後第二程吸收 1.17 W，共 3.17 W、3.8 kW/m²；雙面輻射 q = 2εσT⁴，ε = 0.3 時 T ≈ 578 K（305 °C），功率加倍升到約 415 °C。顆粒陰影：間距 2.5 mm、光罩端 NA 0.0825，模糊直徑 2h·NA ≈ 0.41 mm，10 µm 顆粒只遮掉 (10/412)² ≈ 6×10⁻⁴。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With T = 0.90 the double pass is 0.81, a 19% throughput loss when exposure-limited. Heat load: 20 W of EUV on a 104 × 8 mm slit area (8.32 cm²) deposits 2.0 W on the first pass and, after 0.65 mask reflectance, 1.17 W on the second, 3.17 W or 3.8 kW/m²; two-sided radiation q = 2εσT⁴ with ε = 0.3 gives T ≈ 578 K (305 °C), about 415 °C if power doubles. Particle shadow: at 2.5 mm standoff and mask-side NA 0.0825 the blur is 2h·NA ≈ 0.41 mm, so a 10 µm particle blocks only (10/412)² ≈ 6×10⁻⁴. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前以 13.5 nm 反射／穿透量測確認單程穿透率與均勻性；上機後比較有無護膜時晶圓端的劑量感測器讀值，並以紅外熱像追蹤曝光中的薄膜溫度；定期以散射式檢測檢查護膜顆粒，並在固定晶圓數後檢查光罩正面新增顆粒；最後以晶粒對晶粒比對找出重複性缺陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before mounting confirm single-pass transmission and uniformity by 13.5 nm reflectometry and transmission measurement; on the tool compare wafer-level dose-sensor readings with and without the pellicle and track film temperature during exposure by infrared imaging; inspect the pellicle for particles with scatter-based inspection and check the reticle front side for adders after fixed wafer counts; finally search for repeating defects by die-to-die comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "EUV pellicle transmission, heat load and reticle defectivity", which statement holds?

steps.title: EUV 護膜穿透率、熱負載與光罩缺陷：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: EUV pellicle transmission, heat load and reticle defectivity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「EUV 護膜與光罩正面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。

steps.instruction: 安裝前以 13.5 nm 反射／穿透量測確認單程穿透率與均勻性；上機後比較有無護膜時晶圓端的劑量感測器讀值，並以紅外熱像追蹤曝光中的薄膜溫度；定期以散射式檢測檢查護膜顆粒，並在固定晶圓數後檢查光罩正面新增顆粒；最後以晶粒對晶粒比對找出重複性缺陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 集光鏡壽命：錫沉積與氫自由基清潔：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Collector lifetime: tin deposition and hydrogen-radical cleaning: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「集光鏡與氫氣緩衝」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Collector mirror and hydrogen buffer” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集光鏡是一面大型橢球 Mo/Si 多層膜反射鏡，距錫電漿僅數百毫米，把電漿成像到中間焦點。每一發脈衝都噴出錫離子、中性原子與微小碎屑；約百帕的氫氣緩衝層讓離子減速，EUV 光子與電漿則產生氫自由基，把沉積的錫蝕刻成可揮發的 SnH₄，由氣流帶到真空泵。集光鏡反射率由沉積與蝕刻的平衡決定：SnH₄ 若在熱表面分解會把錫再沉積回去，氫滲入多層膜則可能起泡。壽命以每十億發（gigapulse）的相對反射率損失追蹤，光源以提高驅動雷射功率或掃描機延長曝光來維持劑量，最後排定更換。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「集光鏡與氫氣緩衝」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The collector is a large ellipsoidal Mo/Si multilayer mirror only a few hundred millimetres from the tin plasma, imaging the plasma onto the intermediate focus. Every pulse throws out tin ions, neutral atoms and fine debris; a hydrogen buffer of order a hundred pascals slows the ions, while EUV photons and the plasma create hydrogen radicals that etch deposited tin into volatile SnH₄, which the gas flow carries to the pumps. Collector reflectance is set by the balance of deposition and etching: SnH₄ that decomposes on hot surfaces puts tin back, and hydrogen penetrating the multilayer can raise blisters. Lifetime is tracked as relative reflectance loss per gigapulse, the source holds dose by raising drive-laser power or the scanner by lengthening exposure, and a replacement is eventually scheduled. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Collector mirror and hydrogen buffer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：50 kHz 時 1 Gpulse = 20 000 s ≈ 5.6 h，每天 4.32 Gpulse。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 50 kHz one gigapulse is 20 000 s ≈ 5.6 h, or 4.32 Gpulse per day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集光鏡反射率慢慢下降只影響光源亮度，不影響每小時晶圓數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slowly falling collector reflectance only dims the source and does not affect wafers per hour." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「集光鏡與氫氣緩衝」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Collector mirror and hydrogen buffer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 集光鏡壽命：錫沉積與氫自由基清潔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Collector lifetime: tin deposition and hydrogen-radical cleaning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集光鏡與氫氣緩衝」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Collector mirror and hydrogen buffer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：50 kHz 時 1 Gpulse = 20 000 s ≈ 5.6 h，每天 4.32 Gpulse。教學假設衰減 0.04%/Gpulse，每天 0.17%；允許損失 15% 時可用 375 Gpulse，約 87 天。曝光受限時每小時晶圓數與反射率成正比，損失 15% 而不補償就少 15% 產能；若要維持產能，中間焦點功率需提高到 1/0.85 ≈ 1.18 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 50 kHz one gigapulse is 20 000 s ≈ 5.6 h, or 4.32 Gpulse per day. With an assumed loss of 0.04% per Gpulse, reflectance falls 0.17% per day; a 15% allowance lasts 375 Gpulse, about 87 days. When exposure-limited, wafers per hour scale with reflectance, so an uncompensated 15% loss costs 15% throughput, and keeping throughput requires intermediate-focus power raised to 1/0.85 ≈ 1.18 times. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光源內的能量感測器量中間焦點功率，除以驅動雷射能量得到轉換效率乘集光鏡反射率的趨勢，並與掃描機劑量感測器交叉比對；以中間焦點遠場影像看反射率的空間分佈，找出不均勻沉積；以殘氣分析追蹤 SnH₄ 與水氣分壓；把每 Gpulse 的衰減斜率記錄成維修預測的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure intermediate-focus power with in-source energy sensors and divide by drive-laser energy to trend conversion efficiency times collector reflectance, cross-checking with the scanner dose sensor; use far-field images of the intermediate focus to map reflectance spatially and reveal uneven deposition; follow SnH₄ and water partial pressures by residual-gas analysis; log the per-gigapulse decay slope as the basis for maintenance forecasting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 以光源內的能量感測器量中間焦點功率，除以驅動雷射能量得到轉換效率乘集光鏡反射率的趨勢，並與掃描機劑量感測器交叉比對；以中間焦點遠場影像看反射率的空間分佈，找出不均勻沉積；以殘氣分析追蹤 SnH₄ 與水氣分壓；把每 Gpulse 的衰減斜率記錄成維修預測的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure intermediate-focus power with in-source energy sensors and divide by drive-laser energy to trend conversion efficiency times collector reflectance, cross-checking with the scanner dose sensor; use far-field images of the intermediate focus to map reflectance spatially and reveal uneven deposition; follow SnH₄ and water partial pressures by residual-gas analysis; log the per-gigapulse decay slope as the basis for maintenance forecasting. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：錫在集光鏡周邊再沉積，使光瞳填充不均，照明均勻度與成像隨之改變；覆蓋層因氫起泡造成不可逆的反射率損失；若只看劑量是否合格而不追蹤衰減斜率，某天會突然需要更換集光鏡，造成數天停機。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Tin redeposited around the collector periphery fills the pupil unevenly, changing illumination uniformity and imaging; hydrogen blistering of the cap causes irreversible reflectance loss; watching only whether dose passes, without trending the decay slope, leads to a sudden collector swap and days of downtime.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集光鏡壽命：錫沉積與氫自由基清潔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure intermediate-focus power with in-source energy sensors and divide by drive-laser energy to trend conversion efficiency times collector reflectance, cross-checking with the scanner dose sensor; use far-field images of the intermediate focus to map reflectance spatially and reveal uneven deposition; follow SnH₄ and water partial pressures by residual-gas analysis; log the per-gigapulse decay slope as the basis for maintenance forecasting. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 集光鏡壽命：錫沉積與氫自由基清潔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Collector lifetime: tin deposition and hydrogen-radical cleaning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集光鏡與氫氣緩衝」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Collector mirror and hydrogen buffer” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 錫在集光鏡周邊再沉積，使光瞳填充不均，照明均勻度與成像隨之改變；覆蓋層因氫起泡造成不可逆的反射率損失；若只看劑量是否合格而不追蹤衰減斜率，某天會突然需要更換集光鏡，造成數天停機。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Tin redeposited around the collector periphery fills the pupil unevenly, changing illumination uniformity and imaging; hydrogen blistering of the cap causes irreversible reflectance loss; watching only whether dose passes, without trending the decay slope, leads to a sudden collector swap and days of downtime. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壽命以每十億發（gigapulse）的相對反射率損失追蹤，光源以提高驅動雷射功率或掃描機延長曝光來維持劑量，最後排定更換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lifetime is tracked as relative reflectance loss per gigapulse, the source holds dose by raising drive-laser power or the scanner by lengthening exposure, and a replacement is eventually scheduled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集光鏡反射率慢慢下降只影響光源亮度，不影響每小時晶圓數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A slowly falling collector reflectance only dims the source and does not affect wafers per hour." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集光鏡壽命：錫沉積與氫自由基清潔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

水平感測器量到的就是光阻表面真實高度，與下層膜無關。

Tin redeposited around the collector periphery fills the pupil unevenly, changing illumination uniformity and imaging.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「焦面與對準標記的量測物理」與「晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors" and "Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 焦面與對準標記的量測物理：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「水平感測器與對準感測器」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level sensor and alignment sensor” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙載台掃描機在量測側先量晶圓：水平感測器以掠射角把光柵圖樣投到晶圓上，反射像的橫移正比於高度，逐場繪出地形與晶圓不平度，曝光時載台沿此焦面追蹤。因為光從多層透明膜反射，量到的「表觀高度」與膜層結構有關，這種製程相依偏差要用氣壓式量規或選擇波長、偏振來校正。對準感測器量繞射光柵標記的位置：±1 階干涉的相位就是位置；化學機械研磨或蝕刻使標記不對稱時，誤差隨波長改變，因此用多波長量測並比較色間差異來偵測不對稱。0.55 NA 的景深只剩約 45 nm，焦距預算縮到數奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「水平感測器與對準感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On the measure side of a dual-stage scanner the wafer is mapped first: the level sensor projects a grating pattern onto the wafer at grazing incidence, and the lateral shift of the reflected image is proportional to height, so each field's topography and wafer unflatness are mapped for the stage to follow during exposure. Because the light reflects from a stack of transparent films, the apparent height depends on the stack, and this process dependency is calibrated with an air gauge or by choice of wavelength and polarisation. The alignment sensor locates diffraction-grating marks, where the phase of the ±1-order interference is the position; marks made asymmetric by CMP or etch give wavelength-dependent errors, so multi-wavelength readings and colour-to-colour differences expose asymmetry. At 0.55 NA the depth of focus is only about 45 nm and the focus budget shrinks to a few nanometres. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Level sensor and alignment sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三角量測：入射角 θ 時反射光橫移 Δ = 2h·sinθ，θ = 80° 得 Δ ≈ 1.97h，1 nm 高度只移 1.97 nm，須靠大面積光柵平均才能解析次奈米。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Triangulation: at incidence θ the reflected beam shifts Δ = 2h·sinθ, so θ = 80° gives Δ ≈ 1.97h and 1 nm of height moves the beam only 1.97 nm, resolvable at sub-nanometre level only by averaging over a large grating.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水平感測器量到的就是光阻表面真實高度，與下層膜無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The level sensor reads the true resist height regardless of the underlying film stack." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「水平感測器與對準感測器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Level sensor and alignment sensor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors

Because the light reflects from a stack of transparent films, the apparent height depends on the stack, and this process dependency is calibrated with an air gauge or by choice of wavelength and polarisation.

optionsEn: The level sensor reads the true resist height regardless of the underlying film stack.
Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally.

steps.title: 焦面與對準標記的量測物理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水平感測器與對準感測器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level sensor and alignment sensor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三角量測：入射角 θ 時反射光橫移 Δ = 2h·sinθ，θ = 80° 得 Δ ≈ 1.97h，1 nm 高度只移 1.97 nm，須靠大面積光柵平均才能解析次奈米。景深 λ/NA²：0.33 NA 為 124 nm、0.55 NA 為 44.6 nm。對準：±1 階干涉 x = P·φ/(4π)，P = 1.6 µm 時 10 mrad 相位雜訊為 1.27 nm；標記不對稱額外造成 0.02 rad 相位，位置誤差 2.5 nm，與整個產品套刻預算同級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Triangulation: at incidence θ the reflected beam shifts Δ = 2h·sinθ, so θ = 80° gives Δ ≈ 1.97h and 1 nm of height moves the beam only 1.97 nm, resolvable at sub-nanometre level only by averaging over a large grating. Depth of focus λ/NA² is 124 nm at 0.33 NA and 44.6 nm at 0.55 NA. Alignment: ±1-order interference gives x = P·φ/(4π), so with P = 1.6 µm a 10 mrad phase noise is 1.27 nm; mark asymmetry adding 0.02 rad of phase gives a 2.5 nm position error, the same size as the whole on-product overlay budget. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同膜層的產品晶圓上比較水平感測器與氣壓式量規讀值，建立每種膜層的製程修正；以焦距敏感標記或焦距—劑量矩陣量出實際最佳焦距圖，與水平感測器圖比較；對準方面，用多個波長量同一組標記，色間偏差超過門檻即標記為不對稱，再把預測套刻與曝光後套刻量測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare level-sensor and air-gauge readings on product wafers with different stacks to build a process correction per stack; measure the true best-focus map with focus-sensitive targets or a focus–exposure matrix and compare with the level-sensor map; for alignment read the same marks at several wavelengths, flag marks whose colour-to-colour deviation exceeds a threshold as asymmetric, and compare predicted overlay with post-exposure overlay metrology.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Depth of focus λ/NA² is 124 nm at 0.33 NA and 44.6 nm at 0.55 NA.
