knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「焦面與對準標記的量測物理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors", which statement holds?
options: 三角量測：入射角 θ 時反射光橫移 Δ = 2h·sinθ，θ = 80° 得 Δ ≈ 1.97h，1 nm 高度只移 1.97 nm，須靠大面積光柵平均才能解析次奈米。
光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。
光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。
optionsEn: Triangulation: at incidence θ the reflected beam shifts Δ = 2h·sinθ, so θ = 80° gives Δ ≈ 1.97h and 1 nm of height moves the beam only 1.97 nm, resolvable at sub-nanometre level only by averaging over a large grating.
Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour.
Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed.
quiz.explanation: 三角量測：入射角 θ 時反射光橫移 Δ = 2h·sinθ，θ = 80° 得 Δ ≈ 1.97h，1 nm 高度只移 1.97 nm，須靠大面積光柵平均才能解析次奈米。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Triangulation: at incidence θ the reflected beam shifts Δ = 2h·sinθ, so θ = 80° gives Δ ≈ 1.97h and 1 nm of height moves the beam only 1.97 nm, resolvable at sub-nanometre level only by averaging over a large grating. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焦面與對準標記的量測物理：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「水平感測器與對準感測器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Level sensor and alignment sensor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在不同膜層的產品晶圓上比較水平感測器與氣壓式量規讀值，建立每種膜層的製程修正；以焦距敏感標記或焦距—劑量矩陣量出實際最佳焦距圖，與水平感測器圖比較；對準方面，用多個波長量同一組標記，色間偏差超過門檻即標記為不對稱，再把預測套刻與曝光後套刻量測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare level-sensor and air-gauge readings on product wafers with different stacks to build a process correction per stack; measure the true best-focus map with focus-sensitive targets or a focus–exposure matrix and compare with the level-sensor map; for alignment read the same marks at several wavelengths, flag marks whose colour-to-colour deviation exceeds a threshold as asymmetric, and compare predicted overlay with post-exposure overlay metrology. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：新膜層的製程相依偏差未校正，晶圓邊緣或特定區域焦距偏數十奈米，造成 CD 變異與缺陷；對準到不對稱的標記，整片晶圓帶有數奈米的系統偏移，看起來卻像隨機套刻雜訊。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An uncalibrated process dependency on a new stack shifts focus by tens of nanometres at the wafer edge or in particular regions, causing CD variation and defects; aligning to asymmetric marks gives the whole wafer a systematic offset of a few nanometres that looks like random overlay noise.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同膜層的產品晶圓上比較水平感測器與氣壓式量規讀值，建立每種膜層的製程修正；以焦距敏感標記或焦距—劑量矩陣量出實際最佳焦距圖，與水平感測器圖比較；對準方面，用多個波長量同一組標記，色間偏差超過門檻即標記為不對稱，再把預測套刻與曝光後套刻量測比對。
knowledge.textEn: Compare level-sensor and air-gauge readings on product wafers with different stacks to build a process correction per stack; measure the true best-focus map with focus-sensitive targets or a focus–exposure matrix and compare with the level-sensor map; for alignment read the same marks at several wavelengths, flag marks whose colour-to-colour deviation exceeds a threshold as asymmetric, and compare predicted overlay with post-exposure overlay metrology.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「焦面與對準標記的量測物理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在不同膜層的產品晶圓上比較水平感測器與氣壓式量規讀值，建立每種膜層的製程修正。
護膜只是透明保護層，對產能沒有影響。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare level-sensor and air-gauge readings on product wafers with different stacks to build a process correction per stack.
A pellicle is just a transparent cover with no effect on throughput.
quiz.explanation: 在不同膜層的產品晶圓上比較水平感測器與氣壓式量規讀值，建立每種膜層的製程修正；以焦距敏感標記或焦距—劑量矩陣量出實際最佳焦距圖，與水平感測器圖比較；對準方面，用多個波長量同一組標記，色間偏差超過門檻即標記為不對稱，再把預測套刻與曝光後套刻量測比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare level-sensor and air-gauge readings on product wafers with different stacks to build a process correction per stack; measure the true best-focus map with focus-sensitive targets or a focus–exposure matrix and compare with the level-sensor map; for alignment read the same marks at several wavelengths, flag marks whose colour-to-colour deviation exceeds a threshold as asymmetric, and compare predicted overlay with post-exposure overlay metrology. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 焦面與對準標記的量測物理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水平感測器與對準感測器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Level sensor and alignment sensor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 新膜層的製程相依偏差未校正，晶圓邊緣或特定區域焦距偏數十奈米，造成 CD 變異與缺陷；對準到不對稱的標記，整片晶圓帶有數奈米的系統偏移，看起來卻像隨機套刻雜訊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An uncalibrated process dependency on a new stack shifts focus by tens of nanometres at the wafer edge or in particular regions, causing CD variation and defects; aligning to asymmetric marks gives the whole wafer a systematic offset of a few nanometres that looks like random overlay noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：0.55 NA 的景深只剩約 45 nm，焦距預算縮到數奈米。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At 0.55 NA the depth of focus is only about 45 nm and the focus budget shrinks to a few nanometres.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水平感測器量到的就是光阻表面真實高度，與下層膜無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The level sensor reads the true resist height regardless of the underlying film stack." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 新膜層的製程相依偏差未校正，晶圓邊緣或特定區域焦距偏數十奈米，造成 CD 變異與缺陷；對準到不對稱的標記，整片晶圓帶有數奈米的系統偏移，看起來卻像隨機套刻雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: An uncalibrated process dependency on a new stack shifts focus by tens of nanometres at the wafer edge or in particular regions, causing CD variation and defects; aligning to asymmetric marks gives the whole wafer a systematic offset of a few nanometres that looks like random overlay noise.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「焦面與對準標記的量測物理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。
新膜層的製程相依偏差未校正，晶圓邊緣或特定區域焦距偏數十奈米，造成 CD 變異與缺陷；對準到不對稱的標記，整片晶圓帶有數奈米的系統偏移，看起來卻像隨機套刻雜訊。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally.
An uncalibrated process dependency on a new stack shifts focus by tens of nanometres at the wafer edge or in particular regions, causing CD variation and defects.
quiz.explanation: 新膜層的製程相依偏差未校正，晶圓邊緣或特定區域焦距偏數十奈米，造成 CD 變異與缺陷；對準到不對稱的標記，整片晶圓帶有數奈米的系統偏移，看起來卻像隨機套刻雜訊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An uncalibrated process dependency on a new stack shifts focus by tens of nanometres at the wafer edge or in particular regions, causing CD variation and defects; aligning to asymmetric marks gives the whole wafer a systematic offset of a few nanometres that looks like random overlay noise. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: EUV 晶圓在真空中由靜電夾盤固定，夾盤表面是數千個微小凸點，以減少接觸面積、降低顆粒造成的局部變形，熱量經由凸點與背面氣體傳到台面。每次曝光把劑量能量與吸收的帶外紅外線留在該場，局部升溫使晶圓想要膨脹；凸點的摩擦力先抵抗，當剪力超過摩擦力時晶圓局部滑移，形成與曝光順序有關的場間變形。晶圓上機前的溫度必須與台面差在毫開爾文等級，台面以水循環控溫，並以前饋的晶圓加熱模型預測每場膨脹、調整倍率與平移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An EUV wafer is held in vacuum by an electrostatic clamp whose surface consists of thousands of small burls, reducing contact area and particle-induced deformation, and heat leaves through the burls and backside gas into the table. Each exposure leaves its dose energy plus absorbed out-of-band infrared in that field, and the local temperature rise makes the wafer want to expand; burl friction resists at first, but once shear exceeds friction the wafer slips locally, producing field-to-field distortion that depends on exposure order. The wafer must arrive within millikelvins of the table temperature, the table is water-conditioned, and a feedforward wafer-heating model predicts expansion per field to adjust magnification and translation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：50 mJ/cm² 乘半場 26 × 16.5 mm 得每場 0.2145 J；若絕熱地留在場下方 775 µm 厚的矽（2330 kg/m³、c = 700 J/kg·K，質量 0.775 g），ΔT ≈ 0.40 K；自由膨脹在 26 mm 上為 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm，是套刻預算的十倍，凸點夾持與熱傳導必須壓掉九成以上。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 50 mJ/cm² over a 26 × 16.5 mm half field is 0.2145 J per field; held adiabatically in the 775 µm of silicon under the field (2330 kg/m³, c = 700 J/kg·K, mass 0.775 g) it gives ΔT ≈ 0.40 K, and free expansion across 26 mm is 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm, ten times the overlay budget, so burl clamping and conduction must suppress more than 90%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控
knowledge.titleEn: Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control
knowledge.text: EUV 晶圓在真空中由靜電夾盤固定，夾盤表面是數千個微小凸點，以減少接觸面積、降低顆粒造成的局部變形，熱量經由凸點與背面氣體傳到台面。每次曝光把劑量能量與吸收的帶外紅外線留在該場，局部升溫使晶圓想要膨脹；凸點的摩擦力先抵抗，當剪力超過摩擦力時晶圓局部滑移，形成與曝光順序有關的場間變形。
knowledge.textEn: An EUV wafer is held in vacuum by an electrostatic clamp whose surface consists of thousands of small burls, reducing contact area and particle-induced deformation, and heat leaves through the burls and backside gas into the table. Each exposure leaves its dose energy plus absorbed out-of-band infrared in that field, and the local temperature rise makes the wafer want to expand; burl friction resists at first, but once shear exceeds friction the wafer slips locally, producing field-to-field distortion that depends on exposure order.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control" is correct?
options: EUV 晶圓在真空中由靜電夾盤固定，夾盤表面是數千個微小凸點，以減少接觸面積、降低顆粒造成的局部變形，熱量經由凸點與背面氣體傳到台面。
晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。
模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。
optionsEn: An EUV wafer is held in vacuum by an electrostatic clamp whose surface consists of thousands of small burls, reducing contact area and particle-induced deformation, and heat leaves through the burls and backside gas into the table.
Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally.
More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals.
quiz.explanation: EUV 晶圓在真空中由靜電夾盤固定，夾盤表面是數千個微小凸點，以減少接觸面積、降低顆粒造成的局部變形，熱量經由凸點與背面氣體傳到台面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An EUV wafer is held in vacuum by an electrostatic clamp whose surface consists of thousands of small burls, reducing contact area and particle-induced deformation, and heat leaves through the burls and backside gas into the table. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：50 mJ/cm² 乘半場 26 × 16.5 mm 得每場 0.2145 J；若絕熱地留在場下方 775 µm 厚的矽（2330 kg/m³、c = 700 J/kg·K，質量 0.775 g），ΔT ≈ 0.40 K；自由膨脹在 26 mm 上為 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm，是套刻預算的十倍，凸點夾持與熱傳導必須壓掉九成以上。晶圓上機溫差 10 mK 時，半徑 150 mm 處膨脹 150 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.01 K = 3.9 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 50 mJ/cm² over a 26 × 16.5 mm half field is 0.2145 J per field; held adiabatically in the 775 µm of silicon under the field (2330 kg/m³, c = 700 J/kg·K, mass 0.775 g) it gives ΔT ≈ 0.40 K, and free expansion across 26 mm is 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm, ten times the overlay budget, so burl clamping and conduction must suppress more than 90%. A 10 mK loading offset expands the wafer at 150 mm radius by 150 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.01 K = 3.9 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以高劑量與低劑量曝光同一佈局，量出與曝光順序相關的套刻圖，與晶圓加熱模型的預測比較；以台面溫度感測器追蹤每片晶圓的升溫曲線；夾持前後各量一次晶圓形狀與對準標記，分離夾持變形；定期量夾盤平坦度圖，檢查凸點磨耗或污染。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Expose the same layout at high and low dose, measure the overlay pattern correlated with exposure order and compare it with the wafer-heating model; follow each wafer's temperature rise with table sensors; measure wafer shape and alignment marks before and after clamping to separate clamp-induced distortion; map clamp flatness periodically to check for burl wear or contamination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 50 mJ/cm² 乘半場 26 × 16.5 mm 得每場 0.2145 J；若絕熱地留在場下方 775 µm 厚的矽（2330 kg/m³、c = 700 J/kg·K，質量 0.775 g），ΔT ≈ 0.40 K；自由膨脹在 26 mm 上為 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm，是套刻預算的十倍，凸點夾持與熱傳導必須壓掉九成以上。晶圓上機溫差 10 mK 時，半徑 150 mm 處膨脹 150 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.01 K = 3.9 nm。
knowledge.textEn: 50 mJ/cm² over a 26 × 16.5 mm half field is 0.2145 J per field; held adiabatically in the 775 µm of silicon under the field (2330 kg/m³, c = 700 J/kg·K, mass 0.775 g) it gives ΔT ≈ 0.40 K, and free expansion across 26 mm is 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm, ten times the overlay budget, so burl clamping and conduction must suppress more than 90%. A 10 mK loading offset expands the wafer at 150 mm radius by 150 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.01 K = 3.9 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control", which statement holds?
options: High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。
50 mJ/cm² 乘半場 26 × 16.5 mm 得每場 0.2145 J。
護膜只是透明保護層，對產能沒有影響。
optionsEn: High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE.
50 mJ/cm² over a 26 × 16.5 mm half field is 0.2145 J per field.
A pellicle is just a transparent cover with no effect on throughput.
quiz.explanation: 50 mJ/cm² 乘半場 26 × 16.5 mm 得每場 0.2145 J；若絕熱地留在場下方 775 µm 厚的矽（2330 kg/m³、c = 700 J/kg·K，質量 0.775 g），ΔT ≈ 0.40 K；自由膨脹在 26 mm 上為 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm，是套刻預算的十倍，凸點夾持與熱傳導必須壓掉九成以上。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 50 mJ/cm² over a 26 × 16.5 mm half field is 0.2145 J per field; held adiabatically in the 775 µm of silicon under the field (2330 kg/m³, c = 700 J/kg·K, mass 0.775 g) it gives ΔT ≈ 0.40 K, and free expansion across 26 mm is 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm, ten times the overlay budget, so burl clamping and conduction must suppress more than 90%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以高劑量與低劑量曝光同一佈局，量出與曝光順序相關的套刻圖，與晶圓加熱模型的預測比較；以台面溫度感測器追蹤每片晶圓的升溫曲線；夾持前後各量一次晶圓形狀與對準標記，分離夾持變形；定期量夾盤平坦度圖，檢查凸點磨耗或污染。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Expose the same layout at high and low dose, measure the overlay pattern correlated with exposure order and compare it with the wafer-heating model; follow each wafer's temperature rise with table sensors; measure wafer shape and alignment marks before and after clamping to separate clamp-induced distortion; map clamp flatness periodically to check for burl wear or contamination. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：凸點磨耗或沾上顆粒，局部高度突起造成焦距熱點，摩擦力也改變，使晶圓加熱模型失效，晶圓邊緣套刻變差；高翹曲晶圓（例如多層堆疊記憶體）無法完全吸平，夾持本身就引入數奈米變形。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Worn or particle-contaminated burls create local height bumps that become focus hot spots and change friction so the wafer-heating model no longer holds and edge overlay degrades; highly warped wafers such as deep-stack memory cannot be fully flattened, so clamping itself introduces nanometres of distortion.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以高劑量與低劑量曝光同一佈局，量出與曝光順序相關的套刻圖，與晶圓加熱模型的預測比較；以台面溫度感測器追蹤每片晶圓的升溫曲線；夾持前後各量一次晶圓形狀與對準標記，分離夾持變形；定期量夾盤平坦度圖，檢查凸點磨耗或污染。
knowledge.textEn: Expose the same layout at high and low dose, measure the overlay pattern correlated with exposure order and compare it with the wafer-heating model; follow each wafer's temperature rise with table sensors; measure wafer shape and alignment marks before and after clamping to separate clamp-induced distortion; map clamp flatness periodically to check for burl wear or contamination.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
集光鏡反射率慢慢下降只影響光源亮度，不影響每小時晶圓數。
以高劑量與低劑量曝光同一佈局，量出與曝光順序相關的套刻圖，與晶圓加熱模型的預測比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A slowly falling collector reflectance only dims the source and does not affect wafers per hour.
Expose the same layout at high and low dose, measure the overlay pattern correlated with exposure order and compare it with the wafer-heating model.
quiz.explanation: 以高劑量與低劑量曝光同一佈局，量出與曝光順序相關的套刻圖，與晶圓加熱模型的預測比較；以台面溫度感測器追蹤每片晶圓的升溫曲線；夾持前後各量一次晶圓形狀與對準標記，分離夾持變形；定期量夾盤平坦度圖，檢查凸點磨耗或污染。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Expose the same layout at high and low dose, measure the overlay pattern correlated with exposure order and compare it with the wafer-heating model; follow each wafer's temperature rise with table sensors; measure wafer shape and alignment marks before and after clamping to separate clamp-induced distortion; map clamp flatness periodically to check for burl wear or contamination. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 凸點磨耗或沾上顆粒，局部高度突起造成焦距熱點，摩擦力也改變，使晶圓加熱模型失效，晶圓邊緣套刻變差；高翹曲晶圓（例如多層堆疊記憶體）無法完全吸平，夾持本身就引入數奈米變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Worn or particle-contaminated burls create local height bumps that become focus hot spots and change friction so the wafer-heating model no longer holds and edge overlay degrades; highly warped wafers such as deep-stack memory cannot be fully flattened, so clamping itself introduces nanometres of distortion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：晶圓上機前的溫度必須與台面差在毫開爾文等級，台面以水循環控溫，並以前饋的晶圓加熱模型預測每場膨脹、調整倍率與平移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The wafer must arrive within millikelvins of the table temperature, the table is water-conditioned, and a feedforward wafer-heating model predicts expansion per field to adjust magnification and translation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 凸點磨耗或沾上顆粒，局部高度突起造成焦距熱點，摩擦力也改變，使晶圓加熱模型失效，晶圓邊緣套刻變差；高翹曲晶圓（例如多層堆疊記憶體）無法完全吸平，夾持本身就引入數奈米變形。
knowledge.textEn: Worn or particle-contaminated burls create local height bumps that become focus hot spots and change friction so the wafer-heating model no longer holds and edge overlay degrades; highly warped wafers such as deep-stack memory cannot be fully flattened, so clamping itself introduces nanometres of distortion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 凸點磨耗或沾上顆粒，局部高度突起造成焦距熱點，摩擦力也改變，使晶圓加熱模型失效，晶圓邊緣套刻變差。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。
optionsEn: Worn or particle-contaminated burls create local height bumps that become focus hot spots and change friction so the wafer-heating model no longer holds and edge overlay degrades.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals.
quiz.explanation: 凸點磨耗或沾上顆粒，局部高度突起造成焦距熱點，摩擦力也改變，使晶圓加熱模型失效，晶圓邊緣套刻變差；高翹曲晶圓（例如多層堆疊記憶體）無法完全吸平，夾持本身就引入數奈米變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Worn or particle-contaminated burls create local height bumps that become focus hot spots and change friction so the wafer-heating model no longer holds and edge overlay degrades; highly warped wafers such as deep-stack memory cannot be fully flattened, so clamping itself introduces nanometres of distortion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正」與「每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure" and "System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「套刻量測與逐場修正」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 套刻誤差可拆成：晶圓層級（場間）的平移、旋轉、倍率與非正交（六參數線性模型）及高階多項式；場內的倍率、旋轉與非對稱項（十參數模型）以及鏡頭與光罩特徵；還有無法修正的隨機殘差。以繞射式套刻標記量測後，先進製程控制把修正量回饋給掃描機致動器：載台負責平移與旋轉，鏡頭與光罩台負責倍率；逐曝光修正（CPE）讓每一場都有自己的一組小修正。參數越多能吃掉越多系統特徵，但也會把量測雜訊擬合進去，參數數與取樣點數共同決定雜訊放大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「套刻量測與逐場修正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay error splits into wafer-level (inter-field) translation, rotation, magnification and non-orthogonality, the six-parameter linear model, plus higher-order polynomials; intra-field magnification, rotation and asymmetric terms, the ten-parameter model, plus lens and reticle signatures; and a non-correctable random residual. After measurement on diffraction-based overlay targets, advanced process control feeds corrections to scanner actuators: the stage handles translation and rotation and the lens and reticle stage handle magnification, while corrections per exposure (CPE) give every field its own small set. More parameters absorb more systematic signature but also fit measurement noise, and the parameter count together with sampling density sets noise amplification. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學分解（3σ）：晶圓線性 2.5 nm、晶圓高階 1.8 nm、場內 1.5 nm、隨機 1.2 nm，總計 √13.18 = 3.63 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching decomposition (3σ): wafer linear 2.5 nm, wafer higher-order 1.8 nm, intra-field 1.5 nm and random 1.2 nm, total √13.18 = 3.63 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「套刻量測與逐場修正」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正
knowledge.titleEn: Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure
knowledge.text: 套刻誤差可拆成：晶圓層級（場間）的平移、旋轉、倍率與非正交（六參數線性模型）及高階多項式；場內的倍率、旋轉與非對稱項（十參數模型）以及鏡頭與光罩特徵；還有無法修正的隨機殘差。以繞射式套刻標記量測後，先進製程控制把修正量回饋給掃描機致動器：載台負責平移與旋轉，鏡頭與光罩台負責倍率；逐曝光修正（CPE）讓每一場都有自己的一組小修正。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay error splits into wafer-level (inter-field) translation, rotation, magnification and non-orthogonality, the six-parameter linear model, plus higher-order polynomials; intra-field magnification, rotation and asymmetric terms, the ten-parameter model, plus lens and reticle signatures; and a non-correctable random residual. After measurement on diffraction-based overlay targets, advanced process control feeds corrections to scanner actuators: the stage handles translation and rotation and the lens and reticle stage handle magnification, while corrections per exposure (CPE) give every field its own small set.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure" is correct?
options: 模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。
套刻誤差可拆成：晶圓層級（場間）的平移、旋轉、倍率與非正交（六參數線性模型）及高階多項式。
光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。
optionsEn: More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals.
Overlay error splits into wafer-level (inter-field) translation, rotation, magnification and non-orthogonality, the six-parameter linear model, plus higher-order polynomials.
Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour.
quiz.explanation: 套刻誤差可拆成：晶圓層級（場間）的平移、旋轉、倍率與非正交（六參數線性模型）及高階多項式；場內的倍率、旋轉與非對稱項（十參數模型）以及鏡頭與光罩特徵；還有無法修正的隨機殘差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Overlay error splits into wafer-level (inter-field) translation, rotation, magnification and non-orthogonality, the six-parameter linear model, plus higher-order polynomials; intra-field magnification, rotation and asymmetric terms, the ten-parameter model, plus lens and reticle signatures; and a non-correctable random residual. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「套刻量測與逐場修正」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學分解（3σ）：晶圓線性 2.5 nm、晶圓高階 1.8 nm、場內 1.5 nm、隨機 1.2 nm，總計 √13.18 = 3.63 nm。去除線性後 2.63 nm；CPE 吃掉高階與場內 80% 變異後為 √(0.2×1.8² + 0.2×1.5² + 1.2²) = 1.59 nm。雜訊代價：量測雜訊 0.3 nm、p = 300 參數、n = 600 點時加入約 0.3·√(p/n) = 0.21 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching decomposition (3σ): wafer linear 2.5 nm, wafer higher-order 1.8 nm, intra-field 1.5 nm and random 1.2 nm, total √13.18 = 3.63 nm. Removing the linear part leaves 2.63 nm; CPE capturing 80% of higher-order and intra-field variance leaves √(0.2×1.8² + 0.2×1.5² + 1.2²) = 1.59 nm. Noise cost: with 0.3 nm measurement noise, p = 300 parameters and n = 600 points, about 0.3·√(p/n) = 0.21 nm is added. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在監控晶圓上做高密度套刻取樣，以保留點交叉驗證選擇模型階數，確認殘差接近量測雜訊而非更低；把修正量套用到下一批後再量，比較預測與實際；並定期量測多台掃描機之間的匹配套刻，確認修正在機台間可轉移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample overlay densely on monitor wafers and choose model order by cross-validation on held-out points, confirming that residuals approach measurement noise rather than fall below it; apply the corrections to the next lot, re-measure and compare prediction with result; measure matched-machine overlay between scanners periodically to confirm that corrections transfer across tools.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學分解（3σ）：晶圓線性 2.5 nm、晶圓高階 1.8 nm、場內 1.5 nm、隨機 1.2 nm，總計 √13.18 = 3.63 nm。去除線性後 2.63 nm；CPE 吃掉高階與場內 80% 變異後為 √(0.2×1.8² + 0.2×1.5² + 1.2²) = 1.59 nm。雜訊代價：量測雜訊 0.3 nm、p = 300 參數、n = 600 點時加入約 0.3·√(p/n) = 0.21 nm。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching decomposition (3σ): wafer linear 2.5 nm, wafer higher-order 1.8 nm, intra-field 1.5 nm and random 1.2 nm, total √13.18 = 3.63 nm. Removing the linear part leaves 2.63 nm; CPE capturing 80% of higher-order and intra-field variance leaves √(0.2×1.8² + 0.2×1.5² + 1.2²) = 1.59 nm. Noise cost: with 0.3 nm measurement noise, p = 300 parameters and n = 600 points, about 0.3·√(p/n) = 0.21 nm is added.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure", which statement holds?
options: 光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。
集光鏡反射率慢慢下降只影響光源亮度，不影響每小時晶圓數。
教學分解（3σ）：晶圓線性 2.5 nm、晶圓高階 1.8 nm、場內 1.5 nm、隨機 1.2 nm，總計 √13.18 = 3.63 nm。
optionsEn: Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed.
A slowly falling collector reflectance only dims the source and does not affect wafers per hour.
Teaching decomposition (3σ): wafer linear 2.5 nm, wafer higher-order 1.8 nm, intra-field 1.5 nm and random 1.2 nm, total √13.18 = 3.63 nm.
quiz.explanation: 教學分解（3σ）：晶圓線性 2.5 nm、晶圓高階 1.8 nm、場內 1.5 nm、隨機 1.2 nm，總計 √13.18 = 3.63 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching decomposition (3σ): wafer linear 2.5 nm, wafer higher-order 1.8 nm, intra-field 1.5 nm and random 1.2 nm, total √13.18 = 3.63 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「套刻量測與逐場修正」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在監控晶圓上做高密度套刻取樣，以保留點交叉驗證選擇模型階數，確認殘差接近量測雜訊而非更低；把修正量套用到下一批後再量，比較預測與實際；並定期量測多台掃描機之間的匹配套刻，確認修正在機台間可轉移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample overlay densely on monitor wafers and choose model order by cross-validation on held-out points, confirming that residuals approach measurement noise rather than fall below it; apply the corrections to the next lot, re-measure and compare prediction with result; measure matched-machine overlay between scanners periodically to confirm that corrections transfer across tools. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以稀疏而吵雜的資料擬合 CPE，等於把雜訊寫回機台；製程路徑改變（例如換了蝕刻腔）後仍用舊修正，套刻反而變差；修正量超出致動器範圍被截斷；套刻標記與元件圖案的偏差未校正，量測合格但元件不合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Fitting CPE to sparse, noisy data writes noise back into the tool; keeping old corrections after the process route changes, such as a different etch chamber, makes overlay worse; corrections beyond actuator range are clipped; an uncalibrated target-to-device offset lets metrology pass while devices fail.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在監控晶圓上做高密度套刻取樣，以保留點交叉驗證選擇模型階數，確認殘差接近量測雜訊而非更低；把修正量套用到下一批後再量，比較預測與實際；並定期量測多台掃描機之間的匹配套刻，確認修正在機台間可轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Sample overlay densely on monitor wafers and choose model order by cross-validation on held-out points, confirming that residuals approach measurement noise rather than fall below it; apply the corrections to the next lot, re-measure and compare prediction with result; measure matched-machine overlay between scanners periodically to confirm that corrections transfer across tools.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure"?
options: 在監控晶圓上做高密度套刻取樣，以保留點交叉驗證選擇模型階數，確認殘差接近量測雜訊而非更低。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
水平感測器量到的就是光阻表面真實高度，與下層膜無關。
optionsEn: Sample overlay densely on monitor wafers and choose model order by cross-validation on held-out points, confirming that residuals approach measurement noise rather than fall below it.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The level sensor reads the true resist height regardless of the underlying film stack.
quiz.explanation: 在監控晶圓上做高密度套刻取樣，以保留點交叉驗證選擇模型階數，確認殘差接近量測雜訊而非更低；把修正量套用到下一批後再量，比較預測與實際；並定期量測多台掃描機之間的匹配套刻，確認修正在機台間可轉移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample overlay densely on monitor wafers and choose model order by cross-validation on held-out points, confirming that residuals approach measurement noise rather than fall below it; apply the corrections to the next lot, re-measure and compare prediction with result; measure matched-machine overlay between scanners periodically to confirm that corrections transfer across tools. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「套刻量測與逐場修正」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 以稀疏而吵雜的資料擬合 CPE，等於把雜訊寫回機台；製程路徑改變（例如換了蝕刻腔）後仍用舊修正，套刻反而變差；修正量超出致動器範圍被截斷；套刻標記與元件圖案的偏差未校正，量測合格但元件不合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Fitting CPE to sparse, noisy data writes noise back into the tool; keeping old corrections after the process route changes, such as a different etch chamber, makes overlay worse; corrections beyond actuator range are clipped; an uncalibrated target-to-device offset lets metrology pass while devices fail. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：參數越多能吃掉越多系統特徵，但也會把量測雜訊擬合進去，參數數與取樣點數共同決定雜訊放大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: More parameters absorb more systematic signature but also fit measurement noise, and the parameter count together with sampling density sets noise amplification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以稀疏而吵雜的資料擬合 CPE，等於把雜訊寫回機台；製程路徑改變（例如換了蝕刻腔）後仍用舊修正，套刻反而變差；修正量超出致動器範圍被截斷；套刻標記與元件圖案的偏差未校正，量測合格但元件不合格。
knowledge.textEn: Fitting CPE to sparse, noisy data writes noise back into the tool; keeping old corrections after the process route changes, such as a different etch chamber, makes overlay worse; corrections beyond actuator range are clipped; an uncalibrated target-to-device offset lets metrology pass while devices fail.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
以稀疏而吵雜的資料擬合 CPE，等於把雜訊寫回機台。
光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Fitting CPE to sparse, noisy data writes noise back into the tool.
Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour.
quiz.explanation: 以稀疏而吵雜的資料擬合 CPE，等於把雜訊寫回機台；製程路徑改變（例如換了蝕刻腔）後仍用舊修正，套刻反而變差；修正量超出致動器範圍被截斷；套刻標記與元件圖案的偏差未校正，量測合格但元件不合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fitting CPE to sparse, noisy data writes noise back into the tool; keeping old corrections after the process route changes, such as a different etch chamber, makes overlay worse; corrections beyond actuator range are clipped; an uncalibrated target-to-device offset lets metrology pass while devices fail. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「產能、可用度與交接」如何決定ASML 微影機系統工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Throughput, availability and handoff” determines the key performance of “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 產能是在指定劑量與佈局下每小時能曝多少片晶圓。單片時間由三部分組成：曝光時間（晶圓端功率除以劑量決定）、每場的額外時間（加速、減速、穩定與步進）、以及雙載台無法隱藏的晶圓交換時間。產出量等於每小時晶圓數乘可用度與使用率；可用度受計畫保養（集光鏡、錫滴產生器更換）與非計畫停機（平均故障間隔與修復時間）限制。驗收時以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉，記錄每小時晶圓數、劑量穩定度、套刻、焦距與可用度，交接時附上光源功率趨勢、集光鏡反射率與護膜狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「產能、可用度與交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Throughput is how many wafers per hour the tool exposes at a specified dose and layout. Wafer time has three parts: exposure time, set by wafer-level power divided by dose; per-field overhead for acceleration, deceleration, settling and stepping; and wafer exchange that the dual stage cannot hide. Output equals wafers per hour times availability and utilisation, and availability is limited by planned maintenance such as collector and droplet-generator swaps and by unplanned downtime governed by mean time between failures and mean time to repair. Acceptance runs the specified dose and layout continuously, logging wafers per hour, dose stability, overlay, focus and availability, and the handoff carries source-power trends, collector reflectance and pellicle status. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Throughput, availability and handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：NXE 類教學：中間焦點 250 W、光學 1.5%、護膜 0.81，晶圓端 3.04 W；掃描速度 v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s；96 場 × 858 mm² = 824 cm²，30 mJ/cm² 需 24.7 J、曝光 8.13 s；每場額外 60 ms 共 5.76 s；晶圓額外 2.0 s；合計 15.9 s，約 226 片/小時。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: NXE-like teaching case: 250 W at intermediate focus, 1.5% optics and 0.81 pellicle give 3.04 W at the wafer; scan speed v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s; 96 fields × 858 mm² = 824 cm² needs 24.7 J at 30 mJ/cm², 8.13 s of exposure; 60 ms overhead per field adds 5.76 s and wafer overhead 2.0 s, totalling 15.9 s or about 226 wafers per hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「產能、可用度與交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Throughput, availability and handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收
knowledge.titleEn: System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability
knowledge.text: 產能是在指定劑量與佈局下每小時能曝多少片晶圓。單片時間由三部分組成：曝光時間（晶圓端功率除以劑量決定）、每場的額外時間（加速、減速、穩定與步進）、以及雙載台無法隱藏的晶圓交換時間。
knowledge.textEn: Throughput is how many wafers per hour the tool exposes at a specified dose and layout. Wafer time has three parts: exposure time, set by wafer-level power divided by dose; per-field overhead for acceleration, deceleration, settling and stepping; and wafer exchange that the dual stage cannot hide.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability" is correct?
options: 光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。
High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。
產能是在指定劑量與佈局下每小時能曝多少片晶圓。
optionsEn: Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour.
High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE.
Throughput is how many wafers per hour the tool exposes at a specified dose and layout.
quiz.explanation: 產能是在指定劑量與佈局下每小時能曝多少片晶圓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Throughput is how many wafers per hour the tool exposes at a specified dose and layout. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「產能、可用度與交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Throughput, availability and handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：NXE 類教學：中間焦點 250 W、光學 1.5%、護膜 0.81，晶圓端 3.04 W；掃描速度 v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s；96 場 × 858 mm² = 824 cm²，30 mJ/cm² 需 24.7 J、曝光 8.13 s；每場額外 60 ms 共 5.76 s；晶圓額外 2.0 s；合計 15.9 s，約 226 片/小時。可用度：每週計畫保養 6 h（3.6%）、MTBF 150 h 且 MTTR 5 h（3.2%），A = 93.2%，每天 226 × 24 × 0.932 ≈ 5055 片。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: NXE-like teaching case: 250 W at intermediate focus, 1.5% optics and 0.81 pellicle give 3.04 W at the wafer; scan speed v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s; 96 fields × 858 mm² = 824 cm² needs 24.7 J at 30 mJ/cm², 8.13 s of exposure; 60 ms overhead per field adds 5.76 s and wafer overhead 2.0 s, totalling 15.9 s or about 226 wafers per hour. Availability: 6 h weekly planned maintenance (3.6%) plus MTBF 150 h with MTTR 5 h (3.2%) gives A = 93.2%, or 226 × 24 × 0.932 ≈ 5055 wafers per day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉至少 24 小時，從機台紀錄拆解每片晶圓的曝光、每場額外與晶圓交換時間，與模型逐項比較；依 SEMI E10 的設備狀態定義，以數週的事件紀錄計算可用度、MTBF 與 MTTR；同時統計每場劑量穩定度，確認產能不是以犧牲劑量控制換來的。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the specified dose and layout continuously for at least 24 hours, break each wafer's time into exposure, per-field overhead and exchange from machine logs and compare item by item with the model; compute availability, MTBF and MTTR from weeks of event logs using SEMI E10 equipment-state definitions; tally per-field dose stability at the same time to confirm that throughput was not bought by loosening dose control.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: NXE 類教學：中間焦點 250 W、光學 1.5%、護膜 0.81，晶圓端 3.04 W；掃描速度 v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s；96 場 × 858 mm² = 824 cm²，30 mJ/cm² 需 24.7 J、曝光 8.13 s；每場額外 60 ms 共 5.76 s；晶圓額外 2.0 s；合計 15.9 s，約 226 片/小時。可用度：每週計畫保養 6 h（3.6%）、MTBF 150 h 且 MTTR 5 h（3.2%），A = 93.2%，每天 226 × 24 × 0.932 ≈ 5055 片。
knowledge.textEn: NXE-like teaching case: 250 W at intermediate focus, 1.5% optics and 0.81 pellicle give 3.04 W at the wafer; scan speed v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s; 96 fields × 858 mm² = 824 cm² needs 24.7 J at 30 mJ/cm², 8.13 s of exposure; 60 ms overhead per field adds 5.76 s and wafer overhead 2.0 s, totalling 15.9 s or about 226 wafers per hour. Availability: 6 h weekly planned maintenance (3.6%) plus MTBF 150 h with MTTR 5 h (3.2%) gives A = 93.2%, or 226 × 24 × 0.932 ≈ 5055 wafers per day.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability", which statement holds?
options: NXE 類教學：中間焦點 250 W、光學 1.5%、護膜 0.81，晶圓端 3.04 W。
護膜只是透明保護層，對產能沒有影響。
水平感測器量到的就是光阻表面真實高度，與下層膜無關。
optionsEn: NXE-like teaching case: 250 W at intermediate focus, 1.5% optics and 0.81 pellicle give 3.04 W at the wafer.
A pellicle is just a transparent cover with no effect on throughput.
The level sensor reads the true resist height regardless of the underlying film stack.
quiz.explanation: NXE 類教學：中間焦點 250 W、光學 1.5%、護膜 0.81，晶圓端 3.04 W；掃描速度 v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s；96 場 × 858 mm² = 824 cm²，30 mJ/cm² 需 24.7 J、曝光 8.13 s；每場額外 60 ms 共 5.76 s；晶圓額外 2.0 s；合計 15.9 s，約 226 片/小時。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: NXE-like teaching case: 250 W at intermediate focus, 1.5% optics and 0.81 pellicle give 3.04 W at the wafer; scan speed v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s; 96 fields × 858 mm² = 824 cm² needs 24.7 J at 30 mJ/cm², 8.13 s of exposure; 60 ms overhead per field adds 5.76 s and wafer overhead 2.0 s, totalling 15.9 s or about 226 wafers per hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「產能、可用度與交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Throughput, availability and handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉至少 24 小時，從機台紀錄拆解每片晶圓的曝光、每場額外與晶圓交換時間，與模型逐項比較；依 SEMI E10 的設備狀態定義，以數週的事件紀錄計算可用度、MTBF 與 MTTR；同時統計每場劑量穩定度，確認產能不是以犧牲劑量控制換來的。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the specified dose and layout continuously for at least 24 hours, break each wafer's time into exposure, per-field overhead and exchange from machine logs and compare item by item with the model; compute availability, MTBF and MTTR from weeks of event logs using SEMI E10 equipment-state definitions; tally per-field dose stability at the same time to confirm that throughput was not bought by loosening dose control. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格產能是在參考佈局與劑量下量得，客戶佈局若有更多部分場或更高劑量，實際產能明顯較低；可用度宣稱若未計入排定的集光鏡更換，產線排程會在保養週失準；短時間的最佳紀錄被誤當成長期持續產能。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Specified throughput is measured at a reference layout and dose, so customer layouts with more partial fields or higher dose run noticeably slower; availability claims that leave out scheduled collector swaps derail fab scheduling in maintenance weeks; a short best-case run is mistaken for sustained long-term throughput.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉至少 24 小時，從機台紀錄拆解每片晶圓的曝光、每場額外與晶圓交換時間，與模型逐項比較；依 SEMI E10 的設備狀態定義，以數週的事件紀錄計算可用度、MTBF 與 MTTR；同時統計每場劑量穩定度，確認產能不是以犧牲劑量控制換來的。
knowledge.textEn: Run the specified dose and layout continuously for at least 24 hours, break each wafer's time into exposure, per-field overhead and exchange from machine logs and compare item by item with the model; compute availability, MTBF and MTTR from weeks of event logs using SEMI E10 equipment-state definitions; tally per-field dose stability at the same time to confirm that throughput was not bought by loosening dose control.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉至少 24 小時，從機台紀錄拆解每片晶圓的曝光、每場額外與晶圓交換時間，與模型逐項比較。
晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run the specified dose and layout continuously for at least 24 hours, break each wafer's time into exposure, per-field overhead and exchange from machine logs and compare item by item with the model.
Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally.
quiz.explanation: 以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉至少 24 小時，從機台紀錄拆解每片晶圓的曝光、每場額外與晶圓交換時間，與模型逐項比較；依 SEMI E10 的設備狀態定義，以數週的事件紀錄計算可用度、MTBF 與 MTTR；同時統計每場劑量穩定度，確認產能不是以犧牲劑量控制換來的。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run the specified dose and layout continuously for at least 24 hours, break each wafer's time into exposure, per-field overhead and exchange from machine logs and compare item by item with the model; compute availability, MTBF and MTTR from weeks of event logs using SEMI E10 equipment-state definitions; tally per-field dose stability at the same time to confirm that throughput was not bought by loosening dose control. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「產能、可用度與交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Throughput, availability and handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格產能是在參考佈局與劑量下量得，客戶佈局若有更多部分場或更高劑量，實際產能明顯較低；可用度宣稱若未計入排定的集光鏡更換，產線排程會在保養週失準；短時間的最佳紀錄被誤當成長期持續產能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Specified throughput is measured at a reference layout and dose, so customer layouts with more partial fields or higher dose run noticeably slower; availability claims that leave out scheduled collector swaps derail fab scheduling in maintenance weeks; a short best-case run is mistaken for sustained long-term throughput. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收時以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉，記錄每小時晶圓數、劑量穩定度、套刻、焦距與可用度，交接時附上光源功率趨勢、集光鏡反射率與護膜狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance runs the specified dose and layout continuously, logging wafers per hour, dose stability, overlay, focus and availability, and the handoff carries source-power trends, collector reflectance and pellicle status.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 規格產能是在參考佈局與劑量下量得，客戶佈局若有更多部分場或更高劑量，實際產能明顯較低；可用度宣稱若未計入排定的集光鏡更換，產線排程會在保養週失準；短時間的最佳紀錄被誤當成長期持續產能。
knowledge.textEn: Specified throughput is measured at a reference layout and dose, so customer layouts with more partial fields or higher dose run noticeably slower; availability claims that leave out scheduled collector swaps derail fab scheduling in maintenance weeks; a short best-case run is mistaken for sustained long-term throughput.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。
規格產能是在參考佈局與劑量下量得，客戶佈局若有更多部分場或更高劑量，實際產能明顯較低。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE.
Specified throughput is measured at a reference layout and dose, so customer layouts with more partial fields or higher dose run noticeably slower.
quiz.explanation: 規格產能是在參考佈局與劑量下量得，客戶佈局若有更多部分場或更高劑量，實際產能明顯較低；可用度宣稱若未計入排定的集光鏡更換，產線排程會在保養週失準；短時間的最佳紀錄被誤當成長期持續產能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Specified throughput is measured at a reference layout and dose, so customer layouts with more partial fields or higher dose run noticeably slower; availability claims that leave out scheduled collector swaps derail fab scheduling in maintenance weeks; a short best-case run is mistaken for sustained long-term throughput. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: High-NA 產能練習：劑量 50 mJ/cm²，300 mm 晶圓含部分場共 186 個半場，面積 186 × 429 mm² = 798 cm²，需能量 39.9 J；假設晶圓端功率 4.0 W，曝光時間 10.0 s。掃描速度 v = 4.0/(500 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.31 m/s，光罩速度 8 × 0.31 ≈ 2.46 m/s。光罩台 32 g 時加速 2.46/313.8 ≈ 7.8 ms，每場額外時間取加速加減速再加 20 ms 穩定與步進，共 35.7 ms，186 場為 6.64 s；晶圓額外 2.0 s，合計 18.6 s，約 193 片/小時。若光罩台只有 8 g，加速 31.4 ms，每場 82.8 ms，186 場為 15.4 s，合計 27.4 s，只剩約 131 片/小時，說明半場加倍後高加速度載台對產能的關鍵性。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: High-NA throughput exercise: at 50 mJ/cm² a 300 mm wafer holds 186 half fields including partials, 186 × 429 mm² = 798 cm², needing 39.9 J; assuming 4.0 W at the wafer the exposure time is 10.0 s. Scan speed v = 4.0/(500 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.31 m/s and the reticle runs 8 × 0.31 ≈ 2.46 m/s. With a 32 g reticle stage the ramp takes 2.46/313.8 ≈ 7.8 ms; taking per-field overhead as acceleration plus deceleration plus 20 ms for settling and stepping gives 35.7 ms, or 6.64 s for 186 fields; adding 2.0 s of wafer overhead totals 18.6 s, about 193 wafers per hour. With only 8 g the ramp is 31.4 ms, each field costs 82.8 ms, 186 fields take 15.4 s, the total is 27.4 s and throughput falls to about 131 wafers per hour, showing why high-acceleration stages are essential once fields are halved. Values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背跨錨墩拉力」如何影響淡江大橋工程的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-span anchor-pier force” governs force, deformation or durability in “Danjiang Bridge Engineering”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 淡江大橋的單塔位於河道偏淡水側，主跨 450 m 伸向八里，背跨只有 175 m。斜拉索把橋面重量吊到塔頂，塔頂兩側斜索的水平分力必須互相抵銷，否則橋塔會被拉彎；主跨長、背跨短，背索因此比前索陡，同樣的水平力在背跨端產生更大的向下拉力。若背跨本身不夠重，這個差額就要由背跨端的錨墩以拉力（或壓重）承受，背跨橋墩的支承因此可能出現上拔。設計者調整背跨壓重、錨墩配置與背索角度，就是在決定橋塔彎矩、錨墩反力與主跨撓度之間的分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背跨錨墩拉力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Danjiang Bridge’s single pylon stands toward the Tamsui side of the channel; the 450 m main span reaches toward Bali while the back span is only 175 m. Stays lift the deck weight to the pylon head, and the horizontal components of the stays on both sides must cancel or the pylon is bent. Because the main span is long and the back span short, the back stays are steeper, so the same horizontal force produces a larger downward pull at the back-span end. If the back span is not heavy enough, the difference must be carried as tension (or ballast) at the anchor pier, and back-span bearings may see uplift. Adjusting back-span ballast, anchor-pier layout and back-stay angles is how the designer distributes demand among pylon bending, anchor-pier reaction and main-span deflection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Back-span anchor-pier force” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：把全橋視為以塔為支點的槓桿：R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treat the bridge as a lever about the pylon: R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單塔斜張橋只要把橋塔做得夠粗，背跨長短就不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a single-pylon cable-stayed bridge the back-span length does not matter as long as the pylon is massive enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「背跨錨墩拉力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Back-span anchor-pier force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Stays lift the deck weight to the pylon head, and the horizontal components of the stays on both sides must cancel or the pylon is bent.

knowledge.text: 誤解：單塔斜張橋只要把橋塔做得夠粗，背跨長短就不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

quiz.explanationEn: The Danjiang Bridge’s single pylon stands toward the Tamsui side of the channel; the 450 m main span reaches toward Bali while the back span is only 175 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背跨錨墩拉力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-span anchor-pier force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：把全橋視為以塔為支點的槓桿：R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b。取 w_m = w_b = 300 kN/m、L_m = 450 m、L_b = 175 m：R = (30,375,000 − 4,593,750)/175 ≈ 147,300 kN；若背跨壓重使 w_b = 1,000 kN/m，R 降為約 86,100 kN。數值為教學假設，非本橋設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treat the bridge as a lever about the pylon: R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b. With w_m = w_b = 300 kN/m, L_m = 450 m and L_b = 175 m, R = (30,375,000 − 4,593,750)/175 ≈ 147,300 kN; ballasting the back span to w_b = 1,000 kN/m lowers R to about 86,100 kN. Values are teaching assumptions, not this bridge’s design values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在施工各階段以背跨錨墩支承的荷重計或千斤頂讀值，比對施工階段分析預測的反力；同時量測塔頂縱向偏位與背索索力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At each construction stage compare load-cell or jack readings at the back-span anchor-pier bearings with reactions predicted by the staged analysis, while measuring longitudinal pylon-head displacement and back-stay forces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 把全橋視為以塔為支點的槓桿：R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b。取 w_m = w_b = 300 kN/m、L_m = 450 m、L_b = 175 m：R = (30,375,000 − 4,593,750)/175 ≈ 147,300 kN；若背跨壓重使 w_b = 1,000 kN/m，R 降為約 86,100 kN。數值為教學假設，非本橋設計值。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the bridge as a lever about the pylon: R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b. With w_m = w_b = 300 kN/m, L_m = 450 m and L_b = 175 m, R = (30,375,000 − 4,593,750)/175 ≈ 147,300 kN; ballasting the back span to w_b = 1,000 kN/m lowers R to about 86,100 kN. Values are teaching assumptions, not this bridge’s design values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout", which statement holds?
options: 大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。
合龍節塊只要照設計圖長度製造，任何時間都能吊上去對接。
把全橋視為以塔為支點的槓桿：R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b。
optionsEn: As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability.
A closure segment made to the drawing length can be lifted and joined at any time of day.
Treat the bridge as a lever about the pylon: R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b.
quiz.explanation: 把全橋視為以塔為支點的槓桿：R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat the bridge as a lever about the pylon: R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背跨錨墩拉力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Back-span anchor-pier force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在施工各階段以背跨錨墩支承的荷重計或千斤頂讀值，比對施工階段分析預測的反力；同時量測塔頂縱向偏位與背索索力。若反力偏低而塔頂往主跨側偏，表示背跨壓重或背索力不足，需在合龍前調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At each construction stage compare load-cell or jack readings at the back-span anchor-pier bearings with reactions predicted by the staged analysis, while measuring longitudinal pylon-head displacement and back-stay forces. A low reaction together with pylon sway toward the main span indicates insufficient ballast or back-stay force, to be corrected before closure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計算書應列出背跨壓重、錨墩拉力與背索力在每一施工階段與成橋狀態的包絡值，並把錨墩支承反力列為合龍前的停留檢查點，由設計單位簽認後才可進行下一階段。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The calculations should tabulate envelopes of back-span ballast, anchor-pier tension and back-stay force for every construction stage and the completed state, and anchor-pier bearing reactions should be a hold point before closure, released only after the designer signs off.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：背跨壓重估算過輕或錨墩拉力構件設計不足時，滿載的主跨會把背跨支承拉離，產生支承上拔與反覆碰撞，塔頂偏位與主跨撓度同時超出預測，伸縮縫與支承提前損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If back-span ballast is underestimated or the anchor-pier tie is undersized, a fully loaded main span lifts the back-span bearings off their seats, causing uplift and repeated impact; pylon-head sway and main-span deflection both exceed predictions, and joints and bearings wear out early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在施工各階段以背跨錨墩支承的荷重計或千斤頂讀值，比對施工階段分析預測的反力；同時量測塔頂縱向偏位與背索索力。若反力偏低而塔頂往主跨側偏，表示背跨壓重或背索力不足，需在合龍前調整。
knowledge.textEn: At each construction stage compare load-cell or jack readings at the back-span anchor-pier bearings with reactions predicted by the staged analysis, while measuring longitudinal pylon-head displacement and back-stay forces. A low reaction together with pylon sway toward the main span indicates insufficient ballast or back-stay force, to be corrected before closure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 計算書應列出背跨壓重、錨墩拉力與背索力在每一施工階段與成橋狀態的包絡值，並把錨墩支承反力列為合龍前的停留檢查點，由設計單位簽認後才可進行下一階段。
knowledge.textEn: The calculations should tabulate envelopes of back-span ballast, anchor-pier tension and back-stay force for every construction stage and the completed state, and anchor-pier bearing reactions should be a hold point before closure, released only after the designer signs off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout"?
options: 在施工各階段以背跨錨墩支承的荷重計或千斤頂讀值，比對施工階段分析預測的反力；同時量測塔頂縱向偏位與背索索力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
載重試驗撓度比計算值小，就代表設計太保守、浪費材料。
optionsEn: At each construction stage compare load-cell or jack readings at the back-span anchor-pier bearings with reactions predicted by the staged analysis, while measuring longitudinal pylon-head displacement and back-stay forces.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A load-test deflection smaller than calculated means the design was overly conservative and wasteful.
quiz.explanation: 在施工各階段以背跨錨墩支承的荷重計或千斤頂讀值，比對施工階段分析預測的反力；同時量測塔頂縱向偏位與背索索力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At each construction stage compare load-cell or jack readings at the back-span anchor-pier bearings with reactions predicted by the staged analysis, while measuring longitudinal pylon-head displacement and back-stay forces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背跨錨墩拉力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Back-span anchor-pier force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 背跨壓重估算過輕或錨墩拉力構件設計不足時，滿載的主跨會把背跨支承拉離，產生支承上拔與反覆碰撞，塔頂偏位與主跨撓度同時超出預測，伸縮縫與支承提前損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If back-span ballast is underestimated or the anchor-pier tie is undersized, a fully loaded main span lifts the back-span bearings off their seats, causing uplift and repeated impact; pylon-head sway and main-span deflection both exceed predictions, and joints and bearings wear out early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者調整背跨壓重、錨墩配置與背索角度，就是在決定橋塔彎矩、錨墩反力與主跨撓度之間的分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adjusting back-span ballast, anchor-pier layout and back-stay angles is how the designer distributes demand among pylon bending, anchor-pier reaction and main-span deflection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單塔斜張橋只要把橋塔做得夠粗，背跨長短就不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a single-pylon cable-stayed bridge the back-span length does not matter as long as the pylon is massive enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 背跨壓重估算過輕或錨墩拉力構件設計不足時，滿載的主跨會把背跨支承拉離，產生支承上拔與反覆碰撞，塔頂偏位與主跨撓度同時超出預測，伸縮縫與支承提前損壞。
knowledge.textEn: If back-span ballast is underestimated or the anchor-pier tie is undersized, a fully loaded main span lifts the back-span bearings off their seats, causing uplift and repeated impact; pylon-head sway and main-span deflection both exceed predictions, and joints and bearings wear out early.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
背跨壓重估算過輕或錨墩拉力構件設計不足時，滿載的主跨會把背跨支承拉離，產生支承上拔與反覆碰撞，塔頂偏位與主跨撓度同時超出預測，伸縮縫與支承提前損壞。
阻尼器裝得越多越硬，橋梁在地震中就越安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If back-span ballast is underestimated or the anchor-pier tie is undersized, a fully loaded main span lifts the back-span bearings off their seats, causing uplift and repeated impact.
