quiz.explanationEn: If back-span ballast is underestimated or the anchor-pier tie is undersized, a fully loaded main span lifts the back-span bearings off their seats, causing uplift and repeated impact; pylon-head sway and main-span deflection both exceed predictions, and joints and bearings wear out early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「HFR 液壓保險阻尼器」如何影響淡江大橋工程的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic fuse restraints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Danjiang Bridge Engineering”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公路局公開資料指出，淡江大橋縱向在主橋塔設 7 支 HFR、橋梁兩端設 4 支 FVD；橫向以內側橋墩頂的 FPB 鋼製摩擦單擺支承與八里側合成橡膠墊消能。HFR 在平時像剛性保險栓，承受煞車與風力而不讓橋面漂移；地震力超過臨界值時保險動作，轉為黏滯阻尼器，讓橋面在約 40 cm 可消能位移內擺動，最後 5 cm 作為防止橋面撞擊橋塔的止擋。這種先剛後柔的安排，把常時的使用性與大地震的消能分開設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「HFR 液壓保險阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Published Highway Bureau data state that the Danjiang Bridge has 7 HFR units at the main pylon and 4 FVD units at the bridge ends in the longitudinal direction, while transversely friction-pendulum steel bearings on the inner pier tops and elastomeric pads on the Bali side dissipate energy. In service the HFR behaves like a rigid fuse, carrying braking and wind forces so the deck does not drift; when seismic force exceeds the threshold, the fuse releases and the unit becomes a viscous damper, letting the deck move within roughly 40 cm of dissipative travel, with a final 5 cm acting as a stop that keeps the deck from striking the pylon. Stiff-then-soft behaviour separates everyday serviceability from energy dissipation in a large earthquake. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hydraulic fuse restraints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：公開資料 7 支 HFR 合計約 5,250 t，平均每支約 750 t（約 7,360 kN）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The published total of about 5,250 t for 7 HFR units averages about 750 t (about 7,360 kN) each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器裝得越多越硬，橋梁在地震中就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more and stiffer the dampers, the safer the bridge is in an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「HFR 液壓保險阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hydraulic fuse restraints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限
knowledge.titleEn: Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits
knowledge.text: 公路局公開資料指出，淡江大橋縱向在主橋塔設 7 支 HFR、橋梁兩端設 4 支 FVD；橫向以內側橋墩頂的 FPB 鋼製摩擦單擺支承與八里側合成橡膠墊消能。HFR 在平時像剛性保險栓，承受煞車與風力而不讓橋面漂移；地震力超過臨界值時保險動作，轉為黏滯阻尼器，讓橋面在約 40 cm 可消能位移內擺動，最後 5 cm 作為防止橋面撞擊橋塔的止擋。

In service the HFR behaves like a rigid fuse, carrying braking and wind forces so the deck does not drift; when seismic force exceeds the threshold, the fuse releases and the unit becomes a viscous damper, letting the deck move within roughly 40 cm of dissipative travel, with a final 5 cm acting as a stop that keeps the deck from striking the pylon.

knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器裝得越多越硬，橋梁在地震中就越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

斜拉索越陡越省鋼，所以長索的股數應該比短索少。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「HFR 液壓保險阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic fuse restraints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：公開資料 7 支 HFR 合計約 5,250 t，平均每支約 750 t（約 7,360 kN）。端部 FVD 取 F = C·v^α，若設計力 9,810 kN 發生在 v = 0.8 m/s、α = 0.3，C = 9,810/0.8^0.3 ≈ 10,490 kN/(m/s)^0.3；v 只有 0.2 m/s 時 F ≈ 10,490×0.617 ≈ 6,470 kN。α 與速度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The published total of about 5,250 t for 7 HFR units averages about 750 t (about 7,360 kN) each. For an end FVD with F = C·v^α, a design force of 9,810 kN at v = 0.8 m/s with α = 0.3 gives C = 9,810/0.8^0.3 ≈ 10,490 kN/(m/s)^0.3; at only 0.2 m/s, F ≈ 10,490×0.617 ≈ 6,470 kN. α and velocities are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支阻尼器出廠前做原型與逐件試驗：HFR 驗證保險觸發力與觸發後的力—速度曲線，FVD 在多個速度與溫度下繪製遲滯迴圈；安裝後量測橋面與橋塔間的實際間隙，確認 40 cm 消能行程與 5 cm 止擋皆符合圖說。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each device receives prototype and production tests before delivery: for the HFR, verify the fuse release force and the post-release force–velocity curve; for the FVD, plot hysteresis loops at several velocities and temperatures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 公開資料 7 支 HFR 合計約 5,250 t，平均每支約 750 t（約 7,360 kN）。端部 FVD 取 F = C·v^α，若設計力 9,810 kN 發生在 v = 0.8 m/s、α = 0.3，C = 9,810/0.8^0.3 ≈ 10,490 kN/(m/s)^0.3；v 只有 0.2 m/s 時 F ≈ 10,490×0.617 ≈ 6,470 kN。α 與速度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The published total of about 5,250 t for 7 HFR units averages about 750 t (about 7,360 kN) each. For an end FVD with F = C·v^α, a design force of 9,810 kN at v = 0.8 m/s with α = 0.3 gives C = 9,810/0.8^0.3 ≈ 10,490 kN/(m/s)^0.3; at only 0.2 m/s, F ≈ 10,490×0.617 ≈ 6,470 kN. α and velocities are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits", which statement holds?

塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。

Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once.
Wind-tunnel testing only needs to check flutter in typhoons; low and moderate wind speeds do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料 7 支 HFR 合計約 5,250 t，平均每支約 750 t（約 7,360 kN）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The published total of about 5,250 t for 7 HFR units averages about 750 t (about 7,360 kN) each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「HFR 液壓保險阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic fuse restraints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每支阻尼器出廠前做原型與逐件試驗：HFR 驗證保險觸發力與觸發後的力—速度曲線，FVD 在多個速度與溫度下繪製遲滯迴圈；安裝後量測橋面與橋塔間的實際間隙，確認 40 cm 消能行程與 5 cm 止擋皆符合圖說。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each device receives prototype and production tests before delivery: for the HFR, verify the fuse release force and the post-release force–velocity curve; for the FVD, plot hysteresis loops at several velocities and temperatures. After installation measure the actual deck-to-pylon gaps and confirm the 40 cm dissipative travel and 5 cm stop match the drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保險觸發力、阻尼係數與行程必須同時列在設計圖與採購規範，並與風、煞車、溫度與地震的荷載組合逐一對照；HFR 與 FVD 的更換程序與臨時固定方式要在交接文件中寫明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Fuse release force, damping coefficient and stroke must all appear on the drawings and in the procurement specification and be checked against each wind, braking, temperature and seismic combination; replacement procedures and temporary restraint methods for the HFR and FVD units belong in the handover documents.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若保險觸發力設定太低，強烈東北季風或煞車就可能誤觸發，使橋面在常時漂移；設定太高則地震時不觸發，地震力直接灌入橋塔基礎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fuse set too low can be triggered by strong northeast-monsoon wind or braking, letting the deck drift in service; set too high it does not release in an earthquake and the full seismic force goes into the pylon foundation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每支阻尼器出廠前做原型與逐件試驗：HFR 驗證保險觸發力與觸發後的力—速度曲線，FVD 在多個速度與溫度下繪製遲滯迴圈；安裝後量測橋面與橋塔間的實際間隙，確認 40 cm 消能行程與 5 cm 止擋皆符合圖說。
knowledge.textEn: Each device receives prototype and production tests before delivery: for the HFR, verify the fuse release force and the post-release force–velocity curve; for the FVD, plot hysteresis loops at several velocities and temperatures. After installation measure the actual deck-to-pylon gaps and confirm the 40 cm dissipative travel and 5 cm stop match the drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保險觸發力、阻尼係數與行程必須同時列在設計圖與採購規範，並與風、煞車、溫度與地震的荷載組合逐一對照；HFR 與 FVD 的更換程序與臨時固定方式要在交接文件中寫明。
knowledge.textEn: Fuse release force, damping coefficient and stroke must all appear on the drawings and in the procurement specification and be checked against each wind, braking, temperature and seismic combination; replacement procedures and temporary restraint methods for the HFR and FVD units belong in the handover documents.

quiz.question: 要驗證「縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits"?

quiz.explanationEn: Each device receives prototype and production tests before delivery: for the HFR, verify the fuse release force and the post-release force–velocity curve; for the FVD, plot hysteresis loops at several velocities and temperatures. steps.title: 縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「HFR 液壓保險阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic fuse restraints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若保險觸發力設定太低，強烈東北季風或煞車就可能誤觸發，使橋面在常時漂移；設定太高則地震時不觸發，地震力直接灌入橋塔基礎。行程不足時橋面在大地震末段撞擊止擋，產生衝擊力與局部損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fuse set too low can be triggered by strong northeast-monsoon wind or braking, letting the deck drift in service; set too high it does not release in an earthquake and the full seismic force goes into the pylon foundation. Insufficient stroke lets the deck hit the stops late in a large earthquake, producing impact forces and local damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種先剛後柔的安排，把常時的使用性與大地震的消能分開設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stiff-then-soft behaviour separates everyday serviceability from energy dissipation in a large earthquake.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器裝得越多越硬，橋梁在地震中就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more and stiffer the dampers, the safer the bridge is in an earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Insufficient stroke lets the deck hit the stops late in a large earthquake, producing impact forces and local damage.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力」與「58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stay force, strand count and service stress" and "The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stay force, strand count and service stress: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主跨遠端長索」如何影響淡江大橋工程的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Far main-span stay” governs force, deformation or durability in “Danjiang Bridge Engineering”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 淡江大橋以 94 根斜拉索把鋼箱梁吊到單一橋塔，主跨遠端的索最長、最平。每根索要承擔所在節塊的分擔長度內的橋面重、鋪面與活載，但索越平，相同垂直分力需要的索力越大，所以遠端長索通常是鋼絞線數最多的一組。設計時以使用狀態的索力除以每股容許力決定股數，並按標準錨具規格向上取整，同時保留更換單股與日後調索的裕度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主跨遠端長索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Danjiang Bridge hangs its steel box girder from a single pylon with 94 stays, and the stays at the far end of the main span are the longest and flattest. Each stay carries the deck weight, surfacing and live load over its tributary length, but the flatter the stay, the larger the force needed for the same vertical component, so the far long stays usually have the most strands. The strand count is set by dividing the service force by the allowable force per strand and rounding up to a standard anchorage size, leaving margin for single-strand replacement and future force adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Far main-span stay” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the anchorage 185 m below the pylon head and 430 m away horizontally, sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395; a tributary load of 15 m×300 kN/m = 4,500 kN gives T = 4,500/0.395 ≈ 11,390 kN, and a 1.25 factor for live and superimposed load gives about 14,230 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜拉索越陡越省鋼，所以長索的股數應該比短索少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steeper stays use less steel, so long stays should have fewer strands than short ones." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主跨遠端長索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Far main-span stay”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力
knowledge.titleEn: Stay force, strand count and service stress
knowledge.text: 淡江大橋以 94 根斜拉索把鋼箱梁吊到單一橋塔，主跨遠端的索最長、最平。每根索要承擔所在節塊的分擔長度內的橋面重、鋪面與活載，但索越平，相同垂直分力需要的索力越大，所以遠端長索通常是鋼絞線數最多的一組。
knowledge.textEn: The Danjiang Bridge hangs its steel box girder from a single pylon with 94 stays, and the stays at the far end of the main span are the longest and flattest. Each stay carries the deck weight, surfacing and live load over its tributary length, but the flatter the stay, the larger the force needed for the same vertical component, so the far long stays usually have the most strands.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜拉索越陡越省鋼，所以長索的股數應該比短索少。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steeper stays use less steel, so long stays should have fewer strands than short ones. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stay force, strand count and service stress" is correct?
options: 淡江大橋以 94 根斜拉索把鋼箱梁吊到單一橋塔，主跨遠端的索最長、最平。
斜拉索越陡越省鋼，所以長索的股數應該比短索少。
大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。
optionsEn: The Danjiang Bridge hangs its steel box girder from a single pylon with 94 stays, and the stays at the far end of the main span are the longest and flattest.
Steeper stays use less steel, so long stays should have fewer strands than short ones.
As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability.
quiz.explanation: 淡江大橋以 94 根斜拉索把鋼箱梁吊到單一橋塔，主跨遠端的索最長、最平。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Danjiang Bridge hangs its steel box girder from a single pylon with 94 stays, and the stays at the far end of the main span are the longest and flattest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stay force, strand count and service stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主跨遠端長索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Far main-span stay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取塔頂高出橋面 185 m、錨點水平距 430 m，sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395；分擔 15 m×300 kN/m = 4,500 kN，T = 4,500/0.395 ≈ 11,390 kN，乘 1.25 計活載與附加靜載得約 14,230 kN。15.7 mm 鋼絞線 GUTS = 150×1,860 = 279 kN，0.45 GUTS = 125.6 kN，需 14,230/125.6 ≈ 114 股，取 127 股錨具。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the anchorage 185 m below the pylon head and 430 m away horizontally, sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395; a tributary load of 15 m×300 kN/m = 4,500 kN gives T = 4,500/0.395 ≈ 11,390 kN, and a 1.25 factor for live and superimposed load gives about 14,230 kN. A 15.7 mm strand has GUTS = 150×1,860 = 279 kN and 0.45 GUTS = 125.6 kN, so 14,230/125.6 ≈ 114 strands are needed and a 127-strand anchorage is chosen. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對設計索力表與鋼絞線出廠拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗報告，確認每批鋼絞線的破斷力與彈性模數；錨具系統依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞與破斷試驗，並在張拉紀錄中逐根核對最終索力與使用應力比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the design stay-force table with mill tensile, relaxation and fatigue reports for the strand, confirming breaking force and modulus for each lot; the anchorage system receives assembly fatigue and ultimate tests under stay-cable recommendations, and the stressing records are checked stay by stay for final force and service stress ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With the anchorage 185 m below the pylon head and 430 m away horizontally, sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395; a tributary load of 15 m×300 kN/m = 4,500 kN gives T = 4,500/0.395 ≈ 11,390 kN, and a 1.25 factor for live and superimposed load gives about 14,230 kN. A 15.7 mm strand has GUTS = 150×1,860 = 279 kN and 0.45 GUTS = 125.6 kN, so 14,230/125.6 ≈ 114 strands are needed and a 127-strand anchorage is chosen. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stay force, strand count and service stress", which statement holds?
options: 合龍節塊只要照設計圖長度製造，任何時間都能吊上去對接。
載重試驗撓度比計算值小，就代表設計太保守、浪費材料。
optionsEn: A closure segment made to the drawing length can be lifted and joined at any time of day.
With the anchorage 185 m below the pylon head and 430 m away horizontally, sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395.
A load-test deflection smaller than calculated means the design was overly conservative and wasteful.
quiz.explanationEn: With the anchorage 185 m below the pylon head and 430 m away horizontally, sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395; a tributary load of 15 m×300 kN/m = 4,500 kN gives T = 4,500/0.395 ≈ 11,390 kN, and a 1.25 factor for live and superimposed load gives about 14,230 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stay force, strand count and service stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主跨遠端長索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Far main-span stay” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對設計索力表與鋼絞線出廠拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗報告，確認每批鋼絞線的破斷力與彈性模數；錨具系統依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞與破斷試驗，並在張拉紀錄中逐根核對最終索力與使用應力比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the design stay-force table with mill tensile, relaxation and fatigue reports for the strand, confirming breaking force and modulus for each lot; the anchorage system receives assembly fatigue and ultimate tests under stay-cable recommendations, and the stressing records are checked stay by stay for final force and service stress ratio. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索力表要同時列出成橋索力、使用最大索力、單索斷失工況與更換工況，錨具尺寸按最不利者決定；圖說應註明每根索的股數、錨具型號與預留調整量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The stay-force table should list completed-state force, maximum service force, stay-loss and replacement cases, with anchorage size governed by the worst; drawings should state each stay’s strand count, anchorage type and reserved adjustment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只按恆載挑選股數而忽略活載、溫差與單索斷失的重分配，使用應力可能接近或超過容許值，長期在錨頭產生較大的疲勞應力幅，並使日後無法安全地單股更換。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting strands for dead load only, ignoring live load, temperature and redistribution after a stay loss, can push service stress close to or beyond the limit, raising fatigue stress ranges at the anchor heads and making later single-strand replacement unsafe. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對設計索力表與鋼絞線出廠拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗報告，確認每批鋼絞線的破斷力與彈性模數；錨具系統依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞與破斷試驗，並在張拉紀錄中逐根核對最終索力與使用應力比。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the design stay-force table with mill tensile, relaxation and fatigue reports for the strand, confirming breaking force and modulus for each lot; the anchorage system receives assembly fatigue and ultimate tests under stay-cable recommendations, and the stressing records are checked stay by stay for final force and service stress ratio.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 索力表要同時列出成橋索力、使用最大索力、單索斷失工況與更換工況，錨具尺寸按最不利者決定；圖說應註明每根索的股數、錨具型號與預留調整量。
knowledge.textEn: The stay-force table should list completed-state force, maximum service force, stay-loss and replacement cases, with anchorage size governed by the worst; drawings should state each stay’s strand count, anchorage type and reserved adjustment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stay force, strand count and service stress"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
裝了 24 小時監測系統，就可以取代人工巡檢。
比對設計索力表與鋼絞線出廠拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗報告，確認每批鋼絞線的破斷力與彈性模數。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A 24-hour monitoring system can replace manual inspection.
Compare the design stay-force table with mill tensile, relaxation and fatigue reports for the strand, confirming breaking force and modulus for each lot.
quiz.explanation: 比對設計索力表與鋼絞線出廠拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗報告，確認每批鋼絞線的破斷力與彈性模數；錨具系統依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞與破斷試驗，並在張拉紀錄中逐根核對最終索力與使用應力比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the design stay-force table with mill tensile, relaxation and fatigue reports for the strand, confirming breaking force and modulus for each lot; the anchorage system receives assembly fatigue and ultimate tests under stay-cable recommendations, and the stressing records are checked stay by stay for final force and service stress ratio. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stay force, strand count and service stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主跨遠端長索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Far main-span stay” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只按恆載挑選股數而忽略活載、溫差與單索斷失的重分配，使用應力可能接近或超過容許值，長期在錨頭產生較大的疲勞應力幅，並使日後無法安全地單股更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting strands for dead load only, ignoring live load, temperature and redistribution after a stay loss, can push service stress close to or beyond the limit, raising fatigue stress ranges at the anchor heads and making later single-strand replacement unsafe. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時以使用狀態的索力除以每股容許力決定股數，並按標準錨具規格向上取整，同時保留更換單股與日後調索的裕度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The strand count is set by dividing the service force by the allowable force per strand and rounding up to a standard anchorage size, leaving margin for single-strand replacement and future force adjustment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜拉索越陡越省鋼，所以長索的股數應該比短索少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steeper stays use less steel, so long stays should have fewer strands than short ones." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只按恆載挑選股數而忽略活載、溫差與單索斷失的重分配，使用應力可能接近或超過容許值，長期在錨頭產生較大的疲勞應力幅，並使日後無法安全地單股更換。
knowledge.textEn: Selecting strands for dead load only, ignoring live load, temperature and redistribution after a stay loss, can push service stress close to or beyond the limit, raising fatigue stress ranges at the anchor heads and making later single-strand replacement unsafe.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stay force, strand count and service stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只按恆載挑選股數而忽略活載、溫差與單索斷失的重分配，使用應力可能接近或超過容許值，長期在錨頭產生較大的疲勞應力幅，並使日後無法安全地單股更換。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。
optionsEn: Selecting strands for dead load only, ignoring live load, temperature and redistribution after a stay loss, can push service stress close to or beyond the limit, raising fatigue stress ranges at the anchor heads and making later single-strand replacement unsafe.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability.
quiz.explanation: 若只按恆載挑選股數而忽略活載、溫差與單索斷失的重分配，使用應力可能接近或超過容許值，長期在錨頭產生較大的疲勞應力幅，並使日後無法安全地單股更換。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Selecting strands for dead load only, ignoring live load, temperature and redistribution after a stay loss, can push service stress close to or beyond the limit, raising fatigue stress ranges at the anchor heads and making later single-strand replacement unsafe. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「P130 大體積樁帽」如何影響淡江大橋工程的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “P130 mass-concrete pile cap” governs force, deformation or durability in “Danjiang Bridge Engineering”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主塔基礎由 58 支直徑 2.5 m、長約 65 m 的全套管基樁貫入大南灣層，上方是平面約 77 m × 45 m 的大型樁帽，依公開報導約 15,000 m³ 混凝土連續澆置約 93 小時。樁群把塔與斜索的巨大垂直力分散到深層地盤，樁帽頂設在既有河床以下以減輕沖刷。如此厚的樁帽在水化期間核心溫度上升遠高於表面，內外溫差造成的拉應力若超過早齡期混凝土抗拉強度，就會出現溫度裂縫，成為日後鹽害侵入的通道。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「P130 大體積樁帽」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main-pylon foundation uses 58 fully cased bored piles, 2.5 m in diameter and about 65 m long, driven into the Dananwan layer, under a pile cap of about 77 m × 45 m in plan; public reports describe about 15,000 m³ of concrete placed continuously over about 93 hours. The pile group spreads the large vertical forces of pylon and stays into deep ground, and the cap top lies below the existing riverbed to reduce scour. In a cap this thick the core temperature during hydration rises far above the surface, and if the tensile stress from the temperature difference exceeds the early-age tensile strength, thermal cracks form and later become paths for chloride ingress. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “P130 mass-concrete pile cap” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：絕熱溫升 ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Adiabatic temperature rise ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「P130 大體積樁帽」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “P130 mass-concrete pile cap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱
knowledge.titleEn: The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration
knowledge.text: 主塔基礎由 58 支直徑 2.5 m、長約 65 m 的全套管基樁貫入大南灣層，上方是平面約 77 m × 45 m 的大型樁帽，依公開報導約 15,000 m³ 混凝土連續澆置約 93 小時。樁群把塔與斜索的巨大垂直力分散到深層地盤，樁帽頂設在既有河床以下以減輕沖刷。
knowledge.textEn: The main-pylon foundation uses 58 fully cased bored piles, 2.5 m in diameter and about 65 m long, driven into the Dananwan layer, under a pile cap of about 77 m × 45 m in plan; public reports describe about 15,000 m³ of concrete placed continuously over about 93 hours. The pile group spreads the large vertical forces of pylon and stays into deep ground, and the cap top lies below the existing riverbed to reduce scour.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration" is correct?
options: 大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。
主塔基礎由 58 支直徑 2.5 m、長約 65 m 的全套管基樁貫入大南灣層，上方是平面約 77 m × 45 m 的大型樁帽，依公開報導約 15,000 m³ 混凝土連續澆置約 93 小時。
塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。
optionsEn: As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability.
The main-pylon foundation uses 58 fully cased bored piles, 2.5 m in diameter and about 65 m long, driven into the Dananwan layer, under a pile cap of about 77 m × 45 m in plan.
Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once.
quiz.explanation: 主塔基礎由 58 支直徑 2.5 m、長約 65 m 的全套管基樁貫入大南灣層，上方是平面約 77 m × 45 m 的大型樁帽，依公開報導約 15,000 m³ 混凝土連續澆置約 93 小時。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The main-pylon foundation uses 58 fully cased bored piles, 2.5 m in diameter and about 65 m long, driven into the Dananwan layer, under a pile cap of about 77 m × 45 m in plan; public reports describe about 15,000 m³ of concrete placed continuously over about 93 hours. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「P130 大體積樁帽」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “P130 mass-concrete pile cap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：絕熱溫升 ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c)。取有效水泥量 C = 350 kg/m³、Q = 300 kJ/kg、ρ·c = 2,400 kJ/(m³·K)：ΔT = 350×300/2,400 ≈ 44 °C；改用摻料使有效水泥量降為 250 kg/m³，ΔT ≈ 31 °C。93 小時澆置 15,000 m³ 需平均約 161 m³/h 的供料率。配比數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Adiabatic temperature rise ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c). With effective cement C = 350 kg/m³, Q = 300 kJ/kg and ρ·c = 2,400 kJ/(m³·K), ΔT = 350×300/2,400 ≈ 44 °C; lowering effective cement to 250 kg/m³ with supplementary materials gives ΔT ≈ 31 °C. Placing 15,000 m³ in 93 hours needs an average supply of about 161 m³/h. Mix values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置前做溫度應力分析並訂出核心與表面溫差上限（例如 20 °C 等級），樁帽內埋設多層熱電偶連續記錄；基樁以靜載或雙向載重試驗與完整性檢測（聲波或熱完整性）驗收，比對設計承載與沉陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before casting, run a thermal-stress analysis and set a core-to-surface limit (for example of the order of 20 °C), embedding thermocouples at several levels in the cap with continuous logging; accept piles with static or bidirectional load tests and integrity tests (sonic or thermal) compared against design capacity and settlement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 絕熱溫升 ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c)。取有效水泥量 C = 350 kg/m³、Q = 300 kJ/kg、ρ·c = 2,400 kJ/(m³·K)：ΔT = 350×300/2,400 ≈ 44 °C；改用摻料使有效水泥量降為 250 kg/m³，ΔT ≈ 31 °C。93 小時澆置 15,000 m³ 需平均約 161 m³/h 的供料率。配比數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Adiabatic temperature rise ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c). With effective cement C = 350 kg/m³, Q = 300 kJ/kg and ρ·c = 2,400 kJ/(m³·K), ΔT = 350×300/2,400 ≈ 44 °C; lowering effective cement to 250 kg/m³ with supplementary materials gives ΔT ≈ 31 °C. Placing 15,000 m³ in 93 hours needs an average supply of about 161 m³/h. Mix values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration", which statement holds?
options: 風洞試驗只需要檢查颱風時會不會顫振，中低風速不必關心。
鋼橋面疲勞只跟鋼板厚度有關，鋪面材料和季節溫度不影響。
絕熱溫升 ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c)。
optionsEn: Wind-tunnel testing only needs to check flutter in typhoons; low and moderate wind speeds do not matter.
Steel-deck fatigue depends only on plate thickness; surfacing material and seasonal temperature have no effect.
Adiabatic temperature rise ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c).
quiz.explanation: 絕熱溫升 ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Adiabatic temperature rise ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「P130 大體積樁帽」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “P130 mass-concrete pile cap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前做溫度應力分析並訂出核心與表面溫差上限（例如 20 °C 等級），樁帽內埋設多層熱電偶連續記錄；基樁以靜載或雙向載重試驗與完整性檢測（聲波或熱完整性）驗收，比對設計承載與沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before casting, run a thermal-stress analysis and set a core-to-surface limit (for example of the order of 20 °C), embedding thermocouples at several levels in the cap with continuous logging; accept piles with static or bidirectional load tests and integrity tests (sonic or thermal) compared against design capacity and settlement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大體積澆置前要有供料、泵送與備援計畫（第二座拌合廠、備用泵車）、分層澆置順序、測溫與保溫措施，並把溫差超限列為停止與通報條件，由監造與設計單位共同認可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before a mass pour require a supply, pumping and backup plan (second batching plant, standby pumps), a layer sequence, temperature monitoring and insulation, with exceedance of the temperature difference as a stop-and-report condition approved by both the supervising engineer and the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：連續澆置中斷形成冷縫，或保溫不足使表面急冷，樁帽會出現貫穿或表層溫度裂縫；在河口鹽害與潮汐乾濕交替下，裂縫加速氯離子侵入，使鋼筋提前腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An interrupted pour that leaves a cold joint, or poor insulation that chills the surface, produces through or surface thermal cracks in the cap; under estuary salt exposure and tidal wetting and drying, the cracks accelerate chloride ingress and early corrosion of the reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 澆置前做溫度應力分析並訂出核心與表面溫差上限（例如 20 °C 等級），樁帽內埋設多層熱電偶連續記錄；基樁以靜載或雙向載重試驗與完整性檢測（聲波或熱完整性）驗收，比對設計承載與沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Before casting, run a thermal-stress analysis and set a core-to-surface limit (for example of the order of 20 °C), embedding thermocouples at several levels in the cap with continuous logging; accept piles with static or bidirectional load tests and integrity tests (sonic or thermal) compared against design capacity and settlement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 大體積澆置前要有供料、泵送與備援計畫（第二座拌合廠、備用泵車）、分層澆置順序、測溫與保溫措施，並把溫差超限列為停止與通報條件，由監造與設計單位共同認可。
knowledge.textEn: Before a mass pour require a supply, pumping and backup plan (second batching plant, standby pumps), a layer sequence, temperature monitoring and insulation, with exceedance of the temperature difference as a stop-and-report condition approved by both the supervising engineer and the designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration"?
options: 澆置前做溫度應力分析並訂出核心與表面溫差上限（例如 20 °C 等級），樁帽內埋設多層熱電偶連續記錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
單塔斜張橋只要把橋塔做得夠粗，背跨長短就不重要。
optionsEn: Before casting, run a thermal-stress analysis and set a core-to-surface limit (for example of the order of 20 °C), embedding thermocouples at several levels in the cap with continuous logging.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
In a single-pylon cable-stayed bridge the back-span length does not matter as long as the pylon is massive enough.
quiz.explanation: 澆置前做溫度應力分析並訂出核心與表面溫差上限（例如 20 °C 等級），樁帽內埋設多層熱電偶連續記錄；基樁以靜載或雙向載重試驗與完整性檢測（聲波或熱完整性）驗收，比對設計承載與沉陷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before casting, run a thermal-stress analysis and set a core-to-surface limit (for example of the order of 20 °C), embedding thermocouples at several levels in the cap with continuous logging; accept piles with static or bidirectional load tests and integrity tests (sonic or thermal) compared against design capacity and settlement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「P130 大體積樁帽」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “P130 mass-concrete pile cap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連續澆置中斷形成冷縫，或保溫不足使表面急冷，樁帽會出現貫穿或表層溫度裂縫；在河口鹽害與潮汐乾濕交替下，裂縫加速氯離子侵入，使鋼筋提前腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An interrupted pour that leaves a cold joint, or poor insulation that chills the surface, produces through or surface thermal cracks in the cap; under estuary salt exposure and tidal wetting and drying, the cracks accelerate chloride ingress and early corrosion of the reinforcement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：如此厚的樁帽在水化期間核心溫度上升遠高於表面，內外溫差造成的拉應力若超過早齡期混凝土抗拉強度，就會出現溫度裂縫，成為日後鹽害侵入的通道。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a cap this thick the core temperature during hydration rises far above the surface, and if the tensile stress from the temperature difference exceeds the early-age tensile strength, thermal cracks form and later become paths for chloride ingress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 連續澆置中斷形成冷縫，或保溫不足使表面急冷，樁帽會出現貫穿或表層溫度裂縫；在河口鹽害與潮汐乾濕交替下，裂縫加速氯離子侵入，使鋼筋提前腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: An interrupted pour that leaves a cold joint, or poor insulation that chills the surface, produces through or surface thermal cracks in the cap; under estuary salt exposure and tidal wetting and drying, the cracks accelerate chloride ingress and early corrosion of the reinforcement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
連續澆置中斷形成冷縫，或保溫不足使表面急冷，樁帽會出現貫穿或表層溫度裂縫；在河口鹽害與潮汐乾濕交替下，裂縫加速氯離子侵入，使鋼筋提前腐蝕。
塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An interrupted pour that leaves a cold joint, or poor insulation that chills the surface, produces through or surface thermal cracks in the cap.
Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once.
quiz.explanation: 連續澆置中斷形成冷縫，或保溫不足使表面急冷，樁帽會出現貫穿或表層溫度裂縫；在河口鹽害與潮汐乾濕交替下，裂縫加速氯離子侵入，使鋼筋提前腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An interrupted pour that leaves a cold joint, or poor insulation that chills the surface, produces through or surface thermal cracks in the cap; under estuary salt exposure and tidal wetting and drying, the cracks accelerate chloride ingress and early corrosion of the reinforcement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位」與「鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與合龍溫度窗口」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon" and "Cantilever erection and the closure temperature window": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋塔 53 個昇層」如何影響淡江大橋工程的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The 53 pylon lifts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Danjiang Bridge Engineering”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 淡江大橋橋塔高約 211 m，是三維曲面的單柱混凝土塔，公開報導指出以 53 個每層約 4 m 的昇層施築。曲面塔每一層的斷面形狀與中心都不同，模板必須逐層變形，且自重偏心會讓塔身在施工中逐漸彎曲；同時，太陽照射一側使塔身兩面溫差數度，就足以讓塔頂偏移十幾到數十公分。因此測量定位不能只看當下讀數，而要把溫度、自重偏心與後續斜索張拉造成的變形一起預測，才能讓完成時的塔軸落在設計位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋塔 53 個昇層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Danjiang pylon is about 211 m tall, a single concrete mast with a three-dimensional curved surface, and public reports state it was built in 53 lifts of about 4 m. Each lift of a curved pylon has a different shape and centroid, so the formwork must change lift by lift, and the self-weight eccentricity gradually bends the shaft during construction. At the same time, sunlight on one side creates a temperature difference of a few degrees across the section, enough to move the top by tens of centimetres. Setting-out therefore cannot rely on the instantaneous reading; temperature, self-weight eccentricity and later stay stressing must be predicted together so that the completed axis lands in its design position. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “The 53 pylon lifts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線性溫差下懸臂塔頂偏位 Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a linear temperature difference the cantilever tip displacement is Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋塔 53 個昇層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “The 53 pylon lifts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位
knowledge.titleEn: Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon
knowledge.text: 淡江大橋橋塔高約 211 m，是三維曲面的單柱混凝土塔，公開報導指出以 53 個每層約 4 m 的昇層施築。曲面塔每一層的斷面形狀與中心都不同，模板必須逐層變形，且自重偏心會讓塔身在施工中逐漸彎曲；同時，太陽照射一側使塔身兩面溫差數度，就足以讓塔頂偏移十幾到數十公分。
knowledge.textEn: The Danjiang pylon is about 211 m tall, a single concrete mast with a three-dimensional curved surface, and public reports state it was built in 53 lifts of about 4 m. Each lift of a curved pylon has a different shape and centroid, so the formwork must change lift by lift, and the self-weight eccentricity gradually bends the shaft during construction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon" is correct?
options: 塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。
合龍節塊只要照設計圖長度製造，任何時間都能吊上去對接。
淡江大橋橋塔高約 211 m，是三維曲面的單柱混凝土塔，公開報導指出以 53 個每層約 4 m 的昇層施築。
optionsEn: Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once.
A closure segment made to the drawing length can be lifted and joined at any time of day.
The Danjiang pylon is about 211 m tall, a single concrete mast with a three-dimensional curved surface, and public reports state it was built in 53 lifts of about 4 m.
quiz.explanation: 淡江大橋橋塔高約 211 m，是三維曲面的單柱混凝土塔，公開報導指出以 53 個每層約 4 m 的昇層施築。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Danjiang pylon is about 211 m tall, a single concrete mast with a three-dimensional curved surface, and public reports state it was built in 53 lifts of about 4 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋塔 53 個昇層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The 53 pylon lifts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性溫差下懸臂塔頂偏位 Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b)。取 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C、斷面兩側溫差 ΔT = 10 °C、塔高 H = 200 m、斷面深 b = 8 m：Δ = 10⁻⁵×10×200²/(2×8) = 0.25 m；溫差降為 5 °C 時約 0.125 m。53 層×4 m = 212 m，與公開塔高約 211 m 一致。斷面與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a linear temperature difference the cantilever tip displacement is Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b). With α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C, a 10 °C difference across the section, H = 200 m and section depth b = 8 m, Δ = 10⁻⁵×10×200²/(2×8) = 0.25 m; a 5 °C difference gives about 0.125 m. 53 lifts × 4 m = 212 m, consistent with the published height of about 211 m. Section and temperature values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一昇層在清晨溫度均勻時以全站儀與 GNSS 量測控制點，並同步讀取塔身溫度計；把實測與施工階段分析的預測偏位比對，再以三維雷射掃描與 BIM 模型比對曲面形狀，偏差超過允許值時調整下一層模板定位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For each lift survey the control points at dawn, when temperature is uniform, with total station and GNSS while reading embedded thermometers; compare measured with predicted displacements from the staged analysis, compare the curved surface with the BIM model by 3D laser scanning, and adjust the next lift’s formwork when deviations exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 線性溫差下懸臂塔頂偏位 Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b)。取 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C、斷面兩側溫差 ΔT = 10 °C、塔高 H = 200 m、斷面深 b = 8 m：Δ = 10⁻⁵×10×200²/(2×8) = 0.25 m；溫差降為 5 °C 時約 0.125 m。53 層×4 m = 212 m，與公開塔高約 211 m 一致。斷面與溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a linear temperature difference the cantilever tip displacement is Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b). With α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C, a 10 °C difference across the section, H = 200 m and section depth b = 8 m, Δ = 10⁻⁵×10×200²/(2×8) = 0.25 m; a 5 °C difference gives about 0.125 m. 53 lifts × 4 m = 212 m, consistent with the published height of about 211 m. Section and temperature values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon", which statement holds?
options: 線性溫差下懸臂塔頂偏位 Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b)。
載重試驗撓度比計算值小，就代表設計太保守、浪費材料。
裝了 24 小時監測系統，就可以取代人工巡檢。
optionsEn: For a linear temperature difference the cantilever tip displacement is Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b).
A load-test deflection smaller than calculated means the design was overly conservative and wasteful.
A 24-hour monitoring system can replace manual inspection.
quiz.explanation: 線性溫差下懸臂塔頂偏位 Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a linear temperature difference the cantilever tip displacement is Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋塔 53 個昇層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “The 53 pylon lifts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一昇層在清晨溫度均勻時以全站儀與 GNSS 量測控制點，並同步讀取塔身溫度計；把實測與施工階段分析的預測偏位比對，再以三維雷射掃描與 BIM 模型比對曲面形狀，偏差超過允許值時調整下一層模板定位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For each lift survey the control points at dawn, when temperature is uniform, with total station and GNSS while reading embedded thermometers; compare measured with predicted displacements from the staged analysis, compare the curved surface with the BIM model by 3D laser scanning, and adjust the next lift’s formwork when deviations exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：測量程序應規定量測時段、溫度紀錄與預拱值表，模板定位以預測的「施工時應在位置」放樣而非設計最終座標；曲面塔每批昇層的掃描比對結果要經測量技師與設計單位共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The survey procedure should specify measurement times, temperature records and a pre-set table, setting formwork to the predicted as-built-at-this-stage position rather than final design coordinates; scan comparisons for each batch of curved lifts are co-signed by the surveyor and the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在午後量測並直接以讀數修正模板，會把暫時的日照偏位當成永久誤差，累積數層後塔軸偏離設計線；曲面模板定位錯誤還會使鋼筋保護層不足或錨固箱位置偏移，影響斜索角度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surveying in the afternoon and correcting the formwork directly from the reading treats temporary solar sway as permanent error, and after several lifts the axis drifts off the design line; mispositioned curved formwork can also reduce cover or shift anchor boxes, changing stay angles. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一昇層在清晨溫度均勻時以全站儀與 GNSS 量測控制點，並同步讀取塔身溫度計；把實測與施工階段分析的預測偏位比對，再以三維雷射掃描與 BIM 模型比對曲面形狀，偏差超過允許值時調整下一層模板定位。
knowledge.textEn: For each lift survey the control points at dawn, when temperature is uniform, with total station and GNSS while reading embedded thermometers; compare measured with predicted displacements from the staged analysis, compare the curved surface with the BIM model by 3D laser scanning, and adjust the next lift’s formwork when deviations exceed tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 測量程序應規定量測時段、溫度紀錄與預拱值表，模板定位以預測的「施工時應在位置」放樣而非設計最終座標；曲面塔每批昇層的掃描比對結果要經測量技師與設計單位共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The survey procedure should specify measurement times, temperature records and a pre-set table, setting formwork to the predicted as-built-at-this-stage position rather than final design coordinates; scan comparisons for each batch of curved lifts are co-signed by the surveyor and the designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon"?

每一昇層在清晨溫度均勻時以全站儀與 GNSS 量測控制點，並同步讀取塔身溫度計。
阻尼器裝得越多越硬，橋梁在地震中就越安全。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
For each lift survey the control points at dawn, when temperature is uniform, with total station and GNSS while reading embedded thermometers.
The more and stiffer the dampers, the safer the bridge is in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 每一昇層在清晨溫度均勻時以全站儀與 GNSS 量測控制點，並同步讀取塔身溫度計；把實測與施工階段分析的預測偏位比對，再以三維雷射掃描與 BIM 模型比對曲面形狀，偏差超過允許值時調整下一層模板定位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For each lift survey the control points at dawn, when temperature is uniform, with total station and GNSS while reading embedded thermometers; compare measured with predicted displacements from the staged analysis, compare the curved surface with the BIM model by 3D laser scanning, and adjust the next lift’s formwork when deviations exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋塔 53 個昇層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “The 53 pylon lifts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在午後量測並直接以讀數修正模板，會把暫時的日照偏位當成永久誤差，累積數層後塔軸偏離設計線；曲面模板定位錯誤還會使鋼筋保護層不足或錨固箱位置偏移，影響斜索角度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surveying in the afternoon and correcting the formwork directly from the reading treats temporary solar sway as permanent error, and after several lifts the axis drifts off the design line; mispositioned curved formwork can also reduce cover or shift anchor boxes, changing stay angles. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此測量定位不能只看當下讀數，而要把溫度、自重偏心與後續斜索張拉造成的變形一起預測，才能讓完成時的塔軸落在設計位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Setting-out therefore cannot rely on the instantaneous reading; temperature, self-weight eccentricity and later stay stressing must be predicted together so that the completed axis lands in its design position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A closure segment made to the drawing length can be lifted and joined at any time of day.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與合龍溫度窗口：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cantilever erection and the closure temperature window: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「26 號合龍節塊」如何影響淡江大橋工程的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure segment no. 26” governs force, deformation or durability in “Danjiang Bridge Engineering”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 淡江大橋鋼箱梁以船運到橋下、由懸臂端吊裝，公開報導指出一般節塊約 400 至 500 t，全橋採全焊接以減輕約一成重量。最後的八里側 26 號合龍節塊長約 15.2 m、寬約 51.3 m、重約 390 t，選在漲潮時段吊裝以免駁船擱淺，吊裝前一天早、中、晚量測橋面高程與伸縮。懸臂鋼梁會隨溫度伸縮與起伏，合龍口的長度與高差在一天內持續改變；合龍前的大懸臂在強風下也曾出現約 40 cm 的擺動，所以合龍必須在溫度與風況都穩定的窗口完成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「26 號合龍節塊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Danjiang steel box girder segments were barged to the site and lifted at the cantilever tips; public reports cite typical segments of about 400 to 500 t, with full welding saving about a tenth of the weight. The final closure segment no. 26 on the Bali side is about 15.2 m long, 51.3 m wide and 390 t, lifted at high tide so the barge would not ground, after deck levels and expansion were measured morning, noon and evening the day before. A steel cantilever lengthens and rises or falls with temperature, so the closure gap’s length and level difference change throughout the day; before closure the long cantilever was also reported to sway about 40 cm in strong wind, so closure must be completed in a window of stable temperature and wind. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Closure segment no. 26” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：合龍口長度變化 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Change in closure-gap length ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「合龍節塊只要照設計圖長度製造，任何時間都能吊上去對接。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A closure segment made to the drawing length can be lifted and joined at any time of day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「26 號合龍節塊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Closure segment no. 26”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Cantilever erection and the closure temperature window
