But three curvatures are used up setting power, correcting colour and bending for spherical aberration, leaving no freedom for spherochromatism and coma at large aperture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空氣間隔雙合只是沒上膠的膠合透鏡，光學性能完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An air-spaced doublet is just an uncemented cemented doublet with identical optics. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs" is correct?
options: 膠合雙合透鏡兩片內曲率相同，只有三個面，界面以折射率接近的膠填滿，反射極低、對位穩固、鬼影路徑少。
空氣間隔雙合只是沒上膠的膠合透鏡，光學性能完全相同。
鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。
optionsEn: A cemented doublet has equal inner radii and only three surfaces.
An air-spaced doublet is just an uncemented cemented doublet with identical optics.
A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred.
quiz.explanation: 膠合雙合透鏡兩片內曲率相同，只有三個面，界面以折射率接近的膠填滿，反射極低、對位穩固、鬼影路徑少；但只有三個曲率，用來定光焦度、消色差與彎曲修正球差後就沒有自由度處理大孔徑下的色球差與彗差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cemented doublet has equal inner radii and only three surfaces; the interface is filled with index-matched cement, so reflection is very low, alignment is robust and there are few ghost paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠合界面與空氣間隔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cemented interface and air gap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：間距敏感度：φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂，∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 時 f₁ = 43.3 mm、f₂ = −76.4 mm，−φ₁φ₂ = 3.02×10⁻⁴ mm⁻²，Δf = −f²·Δφ ≈ −3.02·Δd，隔圈差 10 µm 焦距就變 −30 µm。膠合界面反射：BK7/膠 (n = 1.56) 為 2.0×10⁻⁴、膠/F2 為 3.6×10⁻⁴，未鍍膜空氣界面約 4.3%。Ø50 mm 在 ΔT = 40 K 時邊緣錯位：BK7/F2（Δα = 1.1 ppm/K）1.1 µm，15 µm 膠層剪應變 0.07；CaF₂（18.9 ppm/K）配約 8 ppm/K 的火石 10.9 µm，剪應變 0.73。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Gap sensitivity: φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂, so ∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂. For N-BK7/F2 at f = 100 mm, f₁ = 43.3 mm and f₂ = −76.4 mm give −φ₁φ₂ = 3.02×10⁻⁴ mm⁻² and Δf = −f²·Δφ ≈ −3.02·Δd, so a 10 µm spacer error moves focal length by −30 µm. Cement-interface reflectance: BK7 to cement (n = 1.56) 2.0×10⁻⁴ and cement to F2 3.6×10⁻⁴, against about 4.3% for an uncoated air surface. Edge mismatch for Ø50 mm over ΔT = 40 K: BK7/F2 (Δα = 1.1 ppm/K) 1.1 µm, a 0.07 shear strain in a 15 µm cement layer; CaF₂ (18.9 ppm/K) against a flint near 8 ppm/K gives 10.9 µm and 0.73. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：空氣間隔版在組裝時以焦距量測台量有效焦距對隔圈厚度的變化，驗證 −3 µm/µm 的敏感度；以干涉儀或波前感測器在兩個波長量球差，確認色球差被修正；膠合版做 −40 到 +70 °C 熱循環，之後以斜射光檢查邊緣是否出現牛頓環或銀白脫膠，並以偏光儀檢查應力雙折射。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For the air-spaced version measure effective focal length against spacer thickness on a focal-length bench during assembly to confirm the −3 µm/µm sensitivity, and measure spherical aberration at two wavelengths with an interferometer or wavefront sensor to confirm spherochromatism is corrected; cycle the cemented version from −40 to +70 °C, then inspect the edge under oblique light for Newton rings or silvery delamination and check stress birefringence with a polariscope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Gap sensitivity: φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂, so ∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂. For N-BK7/F2 at f = 100 mm, f₁ = 43.3 mm and f₂ = −76.4 mm give −φ₁φ₂ = 3.02×10⁻⁴ mm⁻² and Δf = −f²·Δφ ≈ −3.02·Δd, so a 10 µm spacer error moves focal length by −30 µm. Cement-interface reflectance: BK7 to cement (n = 1.56) 2.0×10⁻⁴ and cement to F2 3.6×10⁻⁴, against about 4.3% for an uncoated air surface. Edge mismatch for Ø50 mm over ΔT = 40 K: BK7/F2 (Δα = 1.1 ppm/K) 1.1 µm, a 0.07 shear strain in a 15 µm cement layer; CaF₂ (18.9 ppm/K) against a flint near 8 ppm/K gives 10.9 µm and 0.73.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs", which statement holds?
options: HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。
間距敏感度：φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂，∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂。
量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。
optionsEn: A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band.
Gap sensitivity: φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂, so ∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂.
A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released.
quiz.explanation: 間距敏感度：φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂，∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Gap sensitivity: φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂, so ∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「膠合界面與空氣間隔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cemented interface and air gap” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 空氣間隔版在組裝時以焦距量測台量有效焦距對隔圈厚度的變化，驗證 −3 µm/µm 的敏感度；以干涉儀或波前感測器在兩個波長量球差，確認色球差被修正；膠合版做 −40 到 +70 °C 熱循環，之後以斜射光檢查邊緣是否出現牛頓環或銀白脫膠，並以偏光儀檢查應力雙折射。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For the air-spaced version measure effective focal length against spacer thickness on a focal-length bench during assembly to confirm the −3 µm/µm sensitivity, and measure spherical aberration at two wavelengths with an interferometer or wavefront sensor to confirm spherochromatism is corrected; cycle the cemented version from −40 to +70 °C, then inspect the edge under oblique light for Newton rings or silvery delamination and check stress birefringence with a polariscope. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：膨脹係數差大的膠合組在低溫脫膠，邊緣出現牛頓環與銀白反光，波前與穿透率同時劣化；空氣間隔版的隔圈鬆動，受衝擊後間距與偏心改變，焦距與軸上彗差漂移；膠層在紫外光下黃化，藍端穿透率下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A cemented pair with a large expansion mismatch delaminates in the cold, showing Newton rings and silvery reflections at the edge as wavefront and transmission degrade together; a loose spacer in an air-spaced doublet lets gap and decentre change after shock so focal length and on-axis coma drift; cement yellows under UV and blue transmission falls.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 空氣間隔版在組裝時以焦距量測台量有效焦距對隔圈厚度的變化，驗證 −3 µm/µm 的敏感度；以干涉儀或波前感測器在兩個波長量球差，確認色球差被修正；膠合版做 −40 到 +70 °C 熱循環，之後以斜射光檢查邊緣是否出現牛頓環或銀白脫膠，並以偏光儀檢查應力雙折射。
knowledge.textEn: For the air-spaced version measure effective focal length against spacer thickness on a focal-length bench during assembly to confirm the −3 µm/µm sensitivity, and measure spherical aberration at two wavelengths with an interferometer or wavefront sensor to confirm spherochromatism is corrected; cycle the cemented version from −40 to +70 °C, then inspect the edge under oblique light for Newton rings or silvery delamination and check stress birefringence with a polariscope.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
只要兩片玻璃的阿貝數差夠大，就能完全消除二級光譜。
空氣間隔版在組裝時以焦距量測台量有效焦距對隔圈厚度的變化，驗證 −3 µm/µm 的敏感度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
A large enough Abbe-number difference between two glasses eliminates the secondary spectrum.

For the air-spaced version measure effective focal length against spacer thickness on a focal-length bench during assembly to confirm the −3 µm/µm sensitivity, and measure spherical aberration at two wavelengths with an interferometer or wavefront sensor to confirm spherochromatism is corrected.
quiz.explanation: 空氣間隔版在組裝時以焦距量測台量有效焦距對隔圈厚度的變化，驗證 −3 µm/µm 的敏感度；以干涉儀或波前感測器在兩個波長量球差，確認色球差被修正；膠合版做 −40 到 +70 °C 熱循環，之後以斜射光檢查邊緣是否出現牛頓環或銀白脫膠，並以偏光儀檢查應力雙折射。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For the air-spaced version measure effective focal length against spacer thickness on a focal-length bench during assembly to confirm the −3 µm/µm sensitivity, and measure spherical aberration at two wavelengths with an interferometer or wavefront sensor to confirm spherochromatism is corrected; cycle the cemented version from −40 to +70 °C, then inspect the edge under oblique light for Newton rings or silvery delamination and check stress birefringence with a polariscope. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠合界面與空氣間隔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cemented interface and air gap” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 膨脹係數差大的膠合組在低溫脫膠，邊緣出現牛頓環與銀白反光，波前與穿透率同時劣化；空氣間隔版的隔圈鬆動，受衝擊後間距與偏心改變，焦距與軸上彗差漂移；膠層在紫外光下黃化，藍端穿透率下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A cemented pair with a large expansion mismatch delaminates in the cold, showing Newton rings and silvery reflections at the edge as wavefront and transmission degrade together; a loose spacer in an air-spaced doublet lets gap and decentre change after shock so focal length and on-axis coma drift; cement yellows under UV and blue transmission falls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：空氣間隔版有四個曲率加一個間距，可在兩個波長同時修正球差並控制彗差，適合更快的 f 數與更大口徑，代價是間距與偏心公差、多兩個需鍍膜的空氣界面，以及間距誤差直接改變焦距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An air-spaced version has four curvatures plus a gap, so it can correct spherical aberration at two wavelengths and control coma, suiting faster f-numbers and larger apertures, at the cost of spacing and decentre tolerances, two more air–glass surfaces to coat, and a gap error that changes focal length directly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空氣間隔雙合只是沒上膠的膠合透鏡，光學性能完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An air-spaced doublet is just an uncemented cemented doublet with identical optics." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 膨脹係數差大的膠合組在低溫脫膠，邊緣出現牛頓環與銀白反光，波前與穿透率同時劣化。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。
optionsEn: A cemented pair with a large expansion mismatch delaminates in the cold, showing Newton rings and silvery reflections at the edge as wavefront and transmission degrade together.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Production centring, edging and cementing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「定心磨邊與膠合治具」如何決定消色差透鏡設計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Centring, edging and cementing fixtures” determines the key performance of “Achromatic lens design”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拋光完成的鏡片，其光軸（兩曲率中心的連線）通常不與外徑同軸。定心磨邊時把鏡片裝在主軸上，先讓光軸對準旋轉軸：曲率夠大的鏡片可用鐘形夾頭自動定心，曲率淺的彎月或弱負透鏡夾持角不足，必須以自準直儀觀察反射像隨旋轉的晃動做光學定心，再把外徑磨成與光軸同心，殘差以楔角或邊厚差表示。膠合時兩片在 10 到 20 µm 的膠層上相對移動，同時觀察各面反射像使它們同心，再以紫外或加熱固化；膠的固化收縮會拉動鏡片，所以固化後必須再量一次整組的定心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「定心磨邊與膠合治具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A polished element's optical axis, the line through its two centres of curvature, generally does not coincide with its outer diameter. In centring and edging the element sits on a spindle and its optical axis is first aligned to the rotation axis: strongly curved elements self-centre in bell chucks, while shallow menisci and weak negative lenses lack clamping angle and must be centred optically by watching the reflected image wobble in an autocollimator; the edge is then ground concentric with the optical axis, and the residual is stated as wedge or edge-thickness variation. In cementing the two elements are slid on a 10 to 20 µm cement layer while the reflected images of all surfaces are made concentric, then cured by UV or heat; cure shrinkage pulls the elements, so the centring of the finished pair must be measured again after cure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Centring, edging and cementing fixtures”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：半徑 R = 60 mm 的面偏心 c = 10 µm，傾斜 ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad（0.57′）；Ø25 mm 的邊厚差 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm；光束偏折 (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″，在 f = 100 mm 像面造成 8.6 µm 的視軸偏移，約 2.5 個 3.45 µm 像素。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A surface of radius R = 60 mm decentred by c = 10 µm tilts by ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad (0.57′); over Ø25 mm the edge-thickness variation is 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm; the beam deviates by (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″, shifting the boresight by 8.6 µm at f = 100 mm, about 2.5 pixels of 3.45 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「定心磨邊與膠合治具」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Centring, edging and cementing fixtures”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

In centring and edging the element sits on a spindle and its optical axis is first aligned to the rotation axis: strongly curved elements self-centre in bell chucks, while shallow menisci and weak negative lenses lack clamping angle and must be centred optically by watching the reflected image wobble in an autocollimator; the edge is then ground concentric with the optical axis, and the residual is stated as wedge or edge-thickness variation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Production centring, edging and cementing" is correct?
options: 鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。
拋光完成的鏡片，其光軸（兩曲率中心的連線）通常不與外徑同軸。
只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。
optionsEn: A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred.
A polished element's optical axis, the line through its two centres of curvature, generally does not coincide with its outer diameter.
If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp.
quiz.explanation: 拋光完成的鏡片，其光軸（兩曲率中心的連線）通常不與外徑同軸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A polished element's optical axis, the line through its two centres of curvature, generally does not coincide with its outer diameter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Production centring, edging and cementing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定心磨邊與膠合治具」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Centring, edging and cementing fixtures” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：半徑 R = 60 mm 的面偏心 c = 10 µm，傾斜 ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad（0.57′）；Ø25 mm 的邊厚差 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm；光束偏折 (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″，在 f = 100 mm 像面造成 8.6 µm 的視軸偏移，約 2.5 個 3.45 µm 像素。曲率中心自準直時，偏心 c 在主軸旋轉下表現為半徑 2c = 20 µm 的圓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A surface of radius R = 60 mm decentred by c = 10 µm tilts by ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad (0.57′); over Ø25 mm the edge-thickness variation is 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm; the beam deviates by (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″, shifting the boresight by 8.6 µm at f = 100 mm, about 2.5 pixels of 3.45 µm. In centre-of-curvature autocollimation the decentre c appears as a circle of radius 2c = 20 µm as the spindle turns. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：單片以迴轉台與千分錶量邊厚差，或以定心儀量各面曲率中心相對基準軸的偏移；膠合固化後用多面定心量測儀透過所有面量整組偏心，並以平行光管比較光學視軸與機械軸；把每片的偏心、邊厚差與固化前後差值記錄到序號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each element's edge-thickness variation with a rotary table and dial gauge, or the offset of each surface's centre of curvature from the datum axis with a centring instrument; after cure measure the pair's decentration through all surfaces with a multi-surface centring instrument and compare optical boresight with the mechanical axis using a collimator; log each element's decentre, edge variation and pre- and post-cure difference against its serial number.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 半徑 R = 60 mm 的面偏心 c = 10 µm，傾斜 ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad（0.57′）；Ø25 mm 的邊厚差 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm；光束偏折 (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″，在 f = 100 mm 像面造成 8.6 µm 的視軸偏移，約 2.5 個 3.45 µm 像素。曲率中心自準直時，偏心 c 在主軸旋轉下表現為半徑 2c = 20 µm 的圓。
knowledge.textEn: A surface of radius R = 60 mm decentred by c = 10 µm tilts by ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad (0.57′); over Ø25 mm the edge-thickness variation is 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm; the beam deviates by (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″, shifting the boresight by 8.6 µm at f = 100 mm, about 2.5 pixels of 3.45 µm. In centre-of-curvature autocollimation the decentre c appears as a circle of radius 2c = 20 µm as the spindle turns.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Production centring, edging and cementing", which statement holds?
options: 只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。
只要兩片玻璃的阿貝數差夠大，就能完全消除二級光譜。
半徑 R = 60 mm 的面偏心 c = 10 µm，傾斜 ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad（0.57′）。
optionsEn: Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear.
A large enough Abbe-number difference between two glasses eliminates the secondary spectrum.
A surface of radius R = 60 mm decentred by c = 10 µm tilts by ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad (0.57′).
quiz.explanation: 半徑 R = 60 mm 的面偏心 c = 10 µm，傾斜 ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad（0.57′）；Ø25 mm 的邊厚差 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm；光束偏折 (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″，在 f = 100 mm 像面造成 8.6 µm 的視軸偏移，約 2.5 個 3.45 µm 像素。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A surface of radius R = 60 mm decentred by c = 10 µm tilts by ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad (0.57′); over Ø25 mm the edge-thickness variation is 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm; the beam deviates by (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″, shifting the boresight by 8.6 µm at f = 100 mm, about 2.5 pixels of 3.45 µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Production centring, edging and cementing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「定心磨邊與膠合治具」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Centring, edging and cementing fixtures” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 單片以迴轉台與千分錶量邊厚差，或以定心儀量各面曲率中心相對基準軸的偏移；膠合固化後用多面定心量測儀透過所有面量整組偏心，並以平行光管比較光學視軸與機械軸；把每片的偏心、邊厚差與固化前後差值記錄到序號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each element's edge-thickness variation with a rotary table and dial gauge, or the offset of each surface's centre of curvature from the datum axis with a centring instrument; after cure measure the pair's decentration through all surfaces with a multi-surface centring instrument and compare optical boresight with the mechanical axis using a collimator; log each element's decentre, edge variation and pre- and post-cure difference against its serial number. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：膠層厚度不均使固化收縮不對稱，濕膠時對準良好的組件固化後出現楔角；膠中氣泡或灰塵成為散射點；磨邊崩角成為應力集中處，熱循環時裂紋由此擴展；邊厚差超規使軸上出現彗差，影像清晰度在視場兩側不對稱。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Uneven cement thickness makes cure shrinkage asymmetric, so a pair aligned perfectly while wet acquires a wedge after cure; bubbles or dust in the cement become scatter points; edge chips from edging concentrate stress and cracks grow from them during thermal cycling; out-of-spec edge variation puts coma on axis and makes sharpness asymmetric across the field.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 單片以迴轉台與千分錶量邊厚差，或以定心儀量各面曲率中心相對基準軸的偏移；膠合固化後用多面定心量測儀透過所有面量整組偏心，並以平行光管比較光學視軸與機械軸；把每片的偏心、邊厚差與固化前後差值記錄到序號。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each element's edge-thickness variation with a rotary table and dial gauge, or the offset of each surface's centre of curvature from the datum axis with a centring instrument; after cure measure the pair's decentration through all surfaces with a multi-surface centring instrument and compare optical boresight with the mechanical axis using a collimator; log each element's decentre, edge variation and pre- and post-cure difference against its serial number.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Production centring, edging and cementing"?
options: 單片以迴轉台與千分錶量邊厚差，或以定心儀量各面曲率中心相對基準軸的偏移。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
玻璃的熱膨脹很小，所以溫度變化不會讓焦點移動。
optionsEn: Measure each element's edge-thickness variation with a rotary table and dial gauge, or the offset of each surface's centre of curvature from the datum axis with a centring instrument.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Glass expands so little that temperature changes cannot move the focus.
quiz.explanation: 單片以迴轉台與千分錶量邊厚差，或以定心儀量各面曲率中心相對基準軸的偏移；膠合固化後用多面定心量測儀透過所有面量整組偏心，並以平行光管比較光學視軸與機械軸；把每片的偏心、邊厚差與固化前後差值記錄到序號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each element's edge-thickness variation with a rotary table and dial gauge, or the offset of each surface's centre of curvature from the datum axis with a centring instrument; after cure measure the pair's decentration through all surfaces with a multi-surface centring instrument and compare optical boresight with the mechanical axis using a collimator; log each element's decentre, edge variation and pre- and post-cure difference against its serial number. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Production centring, edging and cementing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定心磨邊與膠合治具」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Centring, edging and cementing fixtures” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 膠層厚度不均使固化收縮不對稱，濕膠時對準良好的組件固化後出現楔角；膠中氣泡或灰塵成為散射點；磨邊崩角成為應力集中處，熱循環時裂紋由此擴展；邊厚差超規使軸上出現彗差，影像清晰度在視場兩側不對稱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven cement thickness makes cure shrinkage asymmetric, so a pair aligned perfectly while wet acquires a wedge after cure; bubbles or dust in the cement become scatter points; edge chips from edging concentrate stress and cracks grow from them during thermal cycling; out-of-spec edge variation puts coma on axis and makes sharpness asymmetric across the field. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：膠合時兩片在 10 到 20 µm 的膠層上相對移動，同時觀察各面反射像使它們同心，再以紫外或加熱固化；膠的固化收縮會拉動鏡片，所以固化後必須再量一次整組的定心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In cementing the two elements are slid on a 10 to 20 µm cement layer while the reflected images of all surfaces are made concentric, then cured by UV or heat; cure shrinkage pulls the elements, so the centring of the finished pair must be measured again after cure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 膠層厚度不均使固化收縮不對稱，濕膠時對準良好的組件固化後出現楔角；膠中氣泡或灰塵成為散射點；磨邊崩角成為應力集中處，熱循環時裂紋由此擴展；邊厚差超規使軸上出現彗差，影像清晰度在視場兩側不對稱。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven cement thickness makes cure shrinkage asymmetric, so a pair aligned perfectly while wet acquires a wedge after cure; bubbles or dust in the cement become scatter points; edge chips from edging concentrate stress and cracks grow from them during thermal cycling; out-of-spec edge variation puts coma on axis and makes sharpness asymmetric across the field.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Production centring, edging and cementing" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
膠層厚度不均使固化收縮不對稱，濕膠時對準良好的組件固化後出現楔角。
只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uneven cement thickness makes cure shrinkage asymmetric, so a pair aligned perfectly while wet acquires a wedge after cure.
If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp.
quiz.explanation: 膠層厚度不均使固化收縮不對稱，濕膠時對準良好的組件固化後出現楔角；膠中氣泡或灰塵成為散射點；磨邊崩角成為應力集中處，熱循環時裂紋由此擴展；邊厚差超規使軸上出現彗差，影像清晰度在視場兩側不對稱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven cement thickness makes cure shrinkage asymmetric, so a pair aligned perfectly while wet acquires a wedge after cure; bubbles or dust in the cement become scatter points; edge chips from edging concentrate stress and cracks grow from them during thermal cycling; out-of-spec edge variation puts coma on axis and makes sharpness asymmetric across the field. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準」與「干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria" and "Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「感測器像素與 MTF」如何決定消色差透鏡設計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensor pixels and MTF” determines the key performance of “Achromatic lens design”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相機用的消色差透鏡要以感測器取樣來評判：像素間距 p 決定 Nyquist 頻率 ν_N = 1/(2p)，系統 MTF 等於鏡頭 MTF 乘像素孔徑的 sinc 響應；鏡頭在 f 數 N 的繞射截止頻率為 1/(λN)。殘餘的二級光譜就是隨波長變化的離焦，多色 MTF 要以感測器光譜響應加權；拜耳濾色片讓紅藍通道的取樣頻率再減半。因此規格應寫成在 Nyquist 或其一半、中心與邊緣的多色 MTF，並要求各色焦點散佈落在 ±2λN² 的像素尺度景深內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器像素與 MTF」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An achromat for a camera must be judged against sensor sampling: pixel pitch p sets the Nyquist frequency ν_N = 1/(2p), and system MTF is lens MTF times the sinc response of the pixel aperture, with the lens's diffraction cutoff at 1/(λN) for f-number N. Residual secondary spectrum is a wavelength-dependent defocus, so polychromatic MTF must be weighted by the sensor's spectral response, and a Bayer filter halves the sampling rate again for the red and blue channels. The specification should therefore state polychromatic MTF at Nyquist or half Nyquist at centre and edge, and require the colour focus spread to fall within the pixel-scale depth of focus ±2λN². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor pixels and MTF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：p = 3.45 µm，ν_N = 145 lp/mm；f/4、0.55 µm 截止 455 lp/mm，繞射 MTF(145) ≈ 0.60，像素 sinc 0.64，未計像差已只剩 0.38。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: p = 3.45 µm gives ν_N = 145 lp/mm; at f/4 and 0.55 µm the cutoff is 455 lp/mm, diffraction MTF(145) ≈ 0.60 and pixel sinc 0.64, already 0.38 before aberrations.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「感測器像素與 MTF」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sensor pixels and MTF”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準
knowledge.text: 相機用的消色差透鏡要以感測器取樣來評判：像素間距 p 決定 Nyquist 頻率 ν_N = 1/(2p)，系統 MTF 等於鏡頭 MTF 乘像素孔徑的 sinc 響應；鏡頭在 f 數 N 的繞射截止頻率為 1/(λN)。殘餘的二級光譜就是隨波長變化的離焦，多色 MTF 要以感測器光譜響應加權；拜耳濾色片讓紅藍通道的取樣頻率再減半。
knowledge.textEn: An achromat for a camera must be judged against sensor sampling: pixel pitch p sets the Nyquist frequency ν_N = 1/(2p), and system MTF is lens MTF times the sinc response of the pixel aperture, with the lens's diffraction cutoff at 1/(λN) for f-number N. Residual secondary spectrum is a wavelength-dependent defocus, so polychromatic MTF must be weighted by the sensor's spectral response, and a Bayer filter halves the sampling rate again for the red and blue channels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria" is correct?
options: 只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。
HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。
相機用的消色差透鏡要以感測器取樣來評判：像素間距 p 決定 Nyquist 頻率 ν_N = 1/(2p)，系統 MTF 等於鏡頭 MTF 乘像素孔徑的 sinc 響應。
optionsEn: If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp.
A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band.

An achromat for a camera must be judged against sensor sampling: pixel pitch p sets the Nyquist frequency ν_N = 1/(2p), and system MTF is lens MTF times the sinc response of the pixel aperture, with the lens's diffraction cutoff at 1/(λN) for f-number N.
quiz.explanation: 相機用的消色差透鏡要以感測器取樣來評判：像素間距 p 決定 Nyquist 頻率 ν_N = 1/(2p)，系統 MTF 等於鏡頭 MTF 乘像素孔徑的 sinc 響應；鏡頭在 f 數 N 的繞射截止頻率為 1/(λN)。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An achromat for a camera must be judged against sensor sampling: pixel pitch p sets the Nyquist frequency ν_N = 1/(2p), and system MTF is lens MTF times the sinc response of the pixel aperture, with the lens's diffraction cutoff at 1/(λN) for f-number N. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器像素與 MTF」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor pixels and MTF” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：p = 3.45 µm，ν_N = 145 lp/mm；f/4、0.55 µm 截止 455 lp/mm，繞射 MTF(145) ≈ 0.60，像素 sinc 0.64，未計像差已只剩 0.38。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 對焦在 d 線時，C、F 離焦 50 µm，W₀₂₀ = Δz/(8N²λ) 分別為 0.60λ 與 0.80λ，Nyquist MTF 只剩 0.05 與 0.02；改用 N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 雙合，色焦差 14.2 µm，C、F 為 0.47 與 0.55。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: p = 3.45 µm gives ν_N = 145 lp/mm; at f/4 and 0.55 µm the cutoff is 455 lp/mm, diffraction MTF(145) ≈ 0.60 and pixel sinc 0.64, already 0.38 before aberrations. An N-BK7/F2 doublet at f = 100 mm focused on the d line leaves C and F 50 µm out, W₀₂₀ = Δz/(8N²λ) of 0.60λ and 0.80λ, so their Nyquist MTF falls to 0.05 and 0.02; an N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 doublet has a 14.2 µm colour spread and gives 0.47 and 0.55. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斜邊法在實際感測器上量 MTF，分別取紅、綠、藍通道，或在 MTF 量測台上配窄帶濾光片逐波長量；每個波長做穿焦掃描求最佳焦點位置，直接量出色焦差並與 50 µm 或 14.2 µm 的設計值比較；量測頻率至少涵蓋 Nyquist 與其一半，並在中心與 70% 視場各量一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure MTF on the actual sensor by the slanted-edge method for the red, green and blue channels separately, or on an MTF bench with narrow-band filters wavelength by wavelength; run a through-focus scan per wavelength to locate best focus, measuring the colour focus spread directly against the 50 µm or 14.2 µm design value; cover at least Nyquist and half Nyquist, at the centre and at 70% field.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: p = 3.45 µm，ν_N = 145 lp/mm；f/4、0.55 µm 截止 455 lp/mm，繞射 MTF(145) ≈ 0.60，像素 sinc 0.64，未計像差已只剩 0.38。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 對焦在 d 線時，C、F 離焦 50 µm，W₀₂₀ = Δz/(8N²λ) 分別為 0.60λ 與 0.80λ，Nyquist MTF 只剩 0.05 與 0.02；改用 N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 雙合，色焦差 14.2 µm，C、F 為 0.47 與 0.55。
knowledge.textEn: p = 3.45 µm gives ν_N = 145 lp/mm; at f/4 and 0.55 µm the cutoff is 455 lp/mm, diffraction MTF(145) ≈ 0.60 and pixel sinc 0.64, already 0.38 before aberrations. An N-BK7/F2 doublet at f = 100 mm focused on the d line leaves C and F 50 µm out, W₀₂₀ = Δz/(8N²λ) of 0.60λ and 0.80λ, so their Nyquist MTF falls to 0.05 and 0.02; an N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 doublet has a 14.2 µm colour spread and gives 0.47 and 0.55.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria", which statement holds?
options: p = 3.45 µm，ν_N = 145 lp/mm。
量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。
玻璃的熱膨脹很小，所以溫度變化不會讓焦點移動。
optionsEn: p = 3.45 µm gives ν_N = 145 lp/mm; at f/4 and 0.55 µm the cutoff is 455 lp/mm, diffraction MTF(145) ≈ 0.60 and pixel sinc 0.64, already 0.38 before aberrations.
A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released.
Glass expands so little that temperature changes cannot move the focus.
quiz.explanation: p = 3.45 µm，ν_N = 145 lp/mm；f/4、0.55 µm 截止 455 lp/mm，繞射 MTF(145) ≈ 0.60，像素 sinc 0.64，未計像差已只剩 0.38。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: p = 3.45 µm gives ν_N = 145 lp/mm; at f/4 and 0.55 µm the cutoff is 455 lp/mm, diffraction MTF(145) ≈ 0.60 and pixel sinc 0.64, already 0.38 before aberrations. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「感測器像素與 MTF」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sensor pixels and MTF” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以斜邊法在實際感測器上量 MTF，分別取紅、綠、藍通道，或在 MTF 量測台上配窄帶濾光片逐波長量；每個波長做穿焦掃描求最佳焦點位置，直接量出色焦差並與 50 µm 或 14.2 µm 的設計值比較；量測頻率至少涵蓋 Nyquist 與其一半，並在中心與 70% 視場各量一次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure MTF on the actual sensor by the slanted-edge method for the red, green and blue channels separately, or on an MTF bench with narrow-band filters wavelength by wavelength; run a through-focus scan per wavelength to locate best focus, measuring the colour focus spread directly against the 50 µm or 14.2 µm design value; cover at least Nyquist and half Nyquist, at the centre and at 70% field. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以 N-BK7/F2 雙合搭配 3.45 µm 像素與 f/4，紅藍通道模糊，高對比邊緣出現紫邊；若規格只寫 546 nm 單色 MTF，鏡頭在檢驗台上全數合格，裝上相機後彩色影像卻不合格，責任在規格而非製造。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pairing an N-BK7/F2 doublet with 3.45 µm pixels at f/4 blurs the red and blue channels and puts purple fringes on high-contrast edges; a specification written only as 546 nm monochromatic MTF lets every lens pass on the bench while colour images fail in the camera, a fault of the specification rather than manufacturing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以斜邊法在實際感測器上量 MTF，分別取紅、綠、藍通道，或在 MTF 量測台上配窄帶濾光片逐波長量；每個波長做穿焦掃描求最佳焦點位置，直接量出色焦差並與 50 µm 或 14.2 µm 的設計值比較；量測頻率至少涵蓋 Nyquist 與其一半，並在中心與 70% 視場各量一次。
knowledge.textEn: Measure MTF on the actual sensor by the slanted-edge method for the red, green and blue channels separately, or on an MTF bench with narrow-band filters wavelength by wavelength; run a through-focus scan per wavelength to locate best focus, measuring the colour focus spread directly against the 50 µm or 14.2 µm design value; cover at least Nyquist and half Nyquist, at the centre and at 70% field.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以斜邊法在實際感測器上量 MTF，分別取紅、綠、藍通道，或在 MTF 量測台上配窄帶濾光片逐波長量。
空氣間隔雙合只是沒上膠的膠合透鏡，光學性能完全相同。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure MTF on the actual sensor by the slanted-edge method for the red, green and blue channels separately, or on an MTF bench with narrow-band filters wavelength by wavelength.
An air-spaced doublet is just an uncemented cemented doublet with identical optics.
quiz.explanation: 以斜邊法在實際感測器上量 MTF，分別取紅、綠、藍通道，或在 MTF 量測台上配窄帶濾光片逐波長量；每個波長做穿焦掃描求最佳焦點位置，直接量出色焦差並與 50 µm 或 14.2 µm 的設計值比較；量測頻率至少涵蓋 Nyquist 與其一半，並在中心與 70% 視場各量一次。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure MTF on the actual sensor by the slanted-edge method for the red, green and blue channels separately, or on an MTF bench with narrow-band filters wavelength by wavelength; run a through-focus scan per wavelength to locate best focus, measuring the colour focus spread directly against the 50 µm or 14.2 µm design value; cover at least Nyquist and half Nyquist, at the centre and at 70% field. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「感測器像素與 MTF」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sensor pixels and MTF” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 以 N-BK7/F2 雙合搭配 3.45 µm 像素與 f/4，紅藍通道模糊，高對比邊緣出現紫邊；若規格只寫 546 nm 單色 MTF，鏡頭在檢驗台上全數合格，裝上相機後彩色影像卻不合格，責任在規格而非製造。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Pairing an N-BK7/F2 doublet with 3.45 µm pixels at f/4 blurs the red and blue channels and puts purple fringes on high-contrast edges; a specification written only as 546 nm monochromatic MTF lets every lens pass on the bench while colour images fail in the camera, a fault of the specification rather than manufacturing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此規格應寫成在 Nyquist 或其一半、中心與邊緣的多色 MTF，並要求各色焦點散佈落在 ±2λN² 的像素尺度景深內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The specification should therefore state polychromatic MTF at Nyquist or half Nyquist at centre and edge, and require the colour focus spread to fall within the pixel-scale depth of focus ±2λN².
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以 N-BK7/F2 雙合搭配 3.45 µm 像素與 f/4，紅藍通道模糊，高對比邊緣出現紫邊；若規格只寫 546 nm 單色 MTF，鏡頭在檢驗台上全數合格，裝上相機後彩色影像卻不合格，責任在規格而非製造。
knowledge.textEn: Pairing an N-BK7/F2 doublet with 3.45 µm pixels at f/4 blurs the red and blue channels and puts purple fringes on high-contrast edges; a specification written only as 546 nm monochromatic MTF lets every lens pass on the bench while colour images fail in the camera, a fault of the specification rather than manufacturing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。
以 N-BK7/F2 雙合搭配 3.45 µm 像素與 f/4，紅藍通道模糊，高對比邊緣出現紫邊。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band.
Pairing an N-BK7/F2 doublet with 3.45 µm pixels at f/4 blurs the red and blue channels and puts purple fringes on high-contrast edges.
quiz.explanation: 以 N-BK7/F2 雙合搭配 3.45 µm 像素與 f/4，紅藍通道模糊，高對比邊緣出現紫邊；若規格只寫 546 nm 單色 MTF，鏡頭在檢驗台上全數合格，裝上相機後彩色影像卻不合格，責任在規格而非製造。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pairing an N-BK7/F2 doublet with 3.45 µm pixels at f/4 blurs the red and blue channels and puts purple fringes on high-contrast edges; a specification written only as 546 nm monochromatic MTF lets every lens pass on the bench while colour images fail in the camera, a fault of the specification rather than manufacturing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雙程 Fizeau 穿透波前」如何決定消色差透鏡設計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-pass Fizeau transmitted wavefront” determines the key performance of “Achromatic lens design”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穿透波前誤差通常用 632.8 nm 的 Fizeau 或 Twyman–Green 干涉儀量：平行測試光穿過鏡片聚焦到參考返回球，原路折返再穿過鏡片一次，所以量到的光程差是單程的兩倍。Zernike 擬合可把傾斜與離焦移除，剩下的像散、彗差與球差分別指向應力、定心與曲率或間距問題。但 HeNe 測試是單色的，看不到色差；它的焦點位置也與設計波長不同，球差還會隨波長改變（色球差），所以 632.8 nm 的合格判定必須依設計模型換算到使用波段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙程 Fizeau 穿透波前」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Transmitted wavefront error is usually measured with a 632.8 nm Fizeau or Twyman–Green interferometer: the collimated test beam passes through the lens to focus on a reference return sphere and comes back through the lens, so the measured optical path difference is twice the single-pass value. A Zernike fit removes tilt and focus, and the remaining astigmatism, coma and spherical terms point to stress, centring and radius or spacing problems respectively. But a HeNe test is monochromatic and blind to colour; its focus differs from the design wavelength's, and spherical aberration varies with wavelength (spherochromatism), so a pass at 632.8 nm must be converted to the working band through the design model. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Double-pass Fizeau transmitted wavefront”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙程量得 0.10λ rms（632.8 nm），單程 0.05λ = 31.6 nm；換到 546 nm 為 0.058λ，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876；Maréchal 0.8 要求在 546 nm ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A double-pass reading of 0.10λ rms at 632.8 nm is 0.05λ = 31.6 nm single pass, or 0.058λ at 546 nm, giving Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876; a Maréchal 0.8 requires ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm at 546 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雙程 Fizeau 穿透波前」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Double-pass Fizeau transmitted wavefront”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算
knowledge.titleEn: Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion
knowledge.text: 穿透波前誤差通常用 632.8 nm 的 Fizeau 或 Twyman–Green 干涉儀量：平行測試光穿過鏡片聚焦到參考返回球，原路折返再穿過鏡片一次，所以量到的光程差是單程的兩倍。Zernike 擬合可把傾斜與離焦移除，剩下的像散、彗差與球差分別指向應力、定心與曲率或間距問題。
knowledge.textEn: Transmitted wavefront error is usually measured with a 632.8 nm Fizeau or Twyman–Green interferometer: the collimated test beam passes through the lens to focus on a reference return sphere and comes back through the lens, so the measured optical path difference is twice the single-pass value. A Zernike fit removes tilt and focus, and the remaining astigmatism, coma and spherical terms point to stress, centring and radius or spacing problems respectively.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion" is correct?
options: 穿透波前誤差通常用 632.8 nm 的 Fizeau 或 Twyman–Green 干涉儀量：平行測試光穿過鏡片聚焦到參考返回球，原路折返再穿過鏡片一次，所以量到的光程差是單程的兩倍。
HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。
只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。
optionsEn: Transmitted wavefront error is usually measured with a 632.8 nm Fizeau or Twyman–Green interferometer: the collimated test beam passes through the lens to focus on a reference return sphere and comes back through the lens, so the measured optical path difference is twice the single-pass value.
A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band.
Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear.
quiz.explanation: 穿透波前誤差通常用 632.8 nm 的 Fizeau 或 Twyman–Green 干涉儀量：平行測試光穿過鏡片聚焦到參考返回球，原路折返再穿過鏡片一次，所以量到的光程差是單程的兩倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Transmitted wavefront error is usually measured with a 632.8 nm Fizeau or Twyman–Green interferometer: the collimated test beam passes through the lens to focus on a reference return sphere and comes back through the lens, so the measured optical path difference is twice the single-pass value. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙程 Fizeau 穿透波前」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-pass Fizeau transmitted wavefront” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙程量得 0.10λ rms（632.8 nm），單程 0.05λ = 31.6 nm；換到 546 nm 為 0.058λ，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876；Maréchal 0.8 要求在 546 nm ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 雙合在 632.8 nm 的焦點位於 d 焦點後 28.8 µm，返回球須放在此處，這個焦點偏移本身也能核對玻璃組合是否正確。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A double-pass reading of 0.10λ rms at 632.8 nm is 0.05λ = 31.6 nm single pass, or 0.058λ at 546 nm, giving Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876; a Maréchal 0.8 requires ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm at 546 nm. The 632.8 nm focus of an N-BK7/F2 f = 100 mm doublet lies 28.8 µm behind the d focus, so the return sphere must sit there, and that offset itself checks that the glass pair is right. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以旋轉或隨機球平均法校正返回球與參考面的誤差；鏡片在夾具中量 0° 與 180° 兩個方位，相減分離鏡片與系統誤差；把 Zernike 彗差與定心量測結果交叉比對；記錄多次量測的平均與標準差，並把量得的 632.8 nm 焦點位置與模型的 28.8 µm 預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the return sphere and reference surface first by rotation or random-ball averaging; measure the lens at 0° and 180° in its fixture and difference the results to separate lens from system error; cross-check Zernike coma with centring measurements; log the mean and standard deviation of repeated measurements, and compare the measured 632.8 nm focus position with the modelled 28.8 µm offset.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 雙程量得 0.10λ rms（632.8 nm），單程 0.05λ = 31.6 nm；換到 546 nm 為 0.058λ，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876；Maréchal 0.8 要求在 546 nm ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 雙合在 632.8 nm 的焦點位於 d 焦點後 28.8 µm，返回球須放在此處，這個焦點偏移本身也能核對玻璃組合是否正確。
knowledge.textEn: A double-pass reading of 0.10λ rms at 632.8 nm is 0.05λ = 31.6 nm single pass, or 0.058λ at 546 nm, giving Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876; a Maréchal 0.8 requires ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm at 546 nm. The 632.8 nm focus of an N-BK7/F2 f = 100 mm doublet lies 28.8 µm behind the d focus, so the return sphere must sit there, and that offset itself checks that the glass pair is right.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion", which statement holds?
options: 只要兩片玻璃的阿貝數差夠大，就能完全消除二級光譜。
雙程量得 0.10λ rms（632.8 nm），單程 0.05λ = 31.6 nm。
空氣間隔雙合只是沒上膠的膠合透鏡，光學性能完全相同。

An air-spaced doublet is just an uncemented cemented doublet with identical optics.
