quiz.explanationEn: A double-pass reading of 0.10λ rms at 632.8 nm is 0.05λ = 31.6 nm single pass, or 0.058λ at 546 nm, giving Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876; a Maréchal 0.8 requires ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm at 546 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雙程 Fizeau 穿透波前」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Double-pass Fizeau transmitted wavefront” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先以旋轉或隨機球平均法校正返回球與參考面的誤差；鏡片在夾具中量 0° 與 180° 兩個方位，相減分離鏡片與系統誤差；把 Zernike 彗差與定心量測結果交叉比對；記錄多次量測的平均與標準差，並把量得的 632.8 nm 焦點位置與模型的 28.8 µm 預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the return sphere and reference surface first by rotation or random-ball averaging; measure the lens at 0° and 180° in its fixture and difference the results to separate lens from system error; cross-check Zernike coma with centring measurements; log the mean and standard deviation of repeated measurements, and compare the measured 632.8 nm focus position with the modelled 28.8 µm offset. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：忘記把雙程結果除以 2 或沒扣除參考面誤差，合格鏡片被誤判報廢；鏡片在 632.8 nm 合格卻在 486 nm 因色球差不合格；測試夾具夾得太緊，量到的像散其實是夾持應力，卻被歸咎於拋光。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Forgetting to halve the double-pass result or to subtract reference error scraps good lenses; a lens passes at 632.8 nm but fails at 486 nm through spherochromatism; an over-tight test fixture produces astigmatism that is really clamping stress yet is blamed on polishing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先以旋轉或隨機球平均法校正返回球與參考面的誤差；鏡片在夾具中量 0° 與 180° 兩個方位，相減分離鏡片與系統誤差；把 Zernike 彗差與定心量測結果交叉比對；記錄多次量測的平均與標準差，並把量得的 632.8 nm 焦點位置與模型的 28.8 µm 預測比較。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the return sphere and reference surface first by rotation or random-ball averaging; measure the lens at 0° and 180° in its fixture and difference the results to separate lens from system error; cross-check Zernike coma with centring measurements; log the mean and standard deviation of repeated measurements, and compare the measured 632.8 nm focus position with the modelled 28.8 µm offset.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。
先以旋轉或隨機球平均法校正返回球與參考面的誤差。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred.
Calibrate the return sphere and reference surface first by rotation or random-ball averaging.
quiz.explanation: 先以旋轉或隨機球平均法校正返回球與參考面的誤差；鏡片在夾具中量 0° 與 180° 兩個方位，相減分離鏡片與系統誤差；把 Zernike 彗差與定心量測結果交叉比對；記錄多次量測的平均與標準差，並把量得的 632.8 nm 焦點位置與模型的 28.8 µm 預測比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the return sphere and reference surface first by rotation or random-ball averaging; measure the lens at 0° and 180° in its fixture and difference the results to separate lens from system error; cross-check Zernike coma with centring measurements; log the mean and standard deviation of repeated measurements, and compare the measured 632.8 nm focus position with the modelled 28.8 µm offset. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙程 Fizeau 穿透波前」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Double-pass Fizeau transmitted wavefront” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 忘記把雙程結果除以 2 或沒扣除參考面誤差，合格鏡片被誤判報廢；鏡片在 632.8 nm 合格卻在 486 nm 因色球差不合格；測試夾具夾得太緊，量到的像散其實是夾持應力，卻被歸咎於拋光。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Forgetting to halve the double-pass result or to subtract reference error scraps good lenses; a lens passes at 632.8 nm but fails at 486 nm through spherochromatism; an over-tight test fixture produces astigmatism that is really clamping stress yet is blamed on polishing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但 HeNe 測試是單色的，看不到色差；它的焦點位置也與設計波長不同，球差還會隨波長改變（色球差），所以 632.8 nm 的合格判定必須依設計模型換算到使用波段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: But a HeNe test is monochromatic and blind to colour; its focus differs from the design wavelength's, and spherical aberration varies with wavelength (spherochromatism), so a pass at 632.8 nm must be converted to the working band through the design model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忘記把雙程結果除以 2 或沒扣除參考面誤差，合格鏡片被誤判報廢；鏡片在 632.8 nm 合格卻在 486 nm 因色球差不合格；測試夾具夾得太緊，量到的像散其實是夾持應力，卻被歸咎於拋光。
knowledge.textEn: Forgetting to halve the double-pass result or to subtract reference error scraps good lenses; a lens passes at 632.8 nm but fails at 486 nm through spherochromatism; an over-tight test fixture produces astigmatism that is really clamping stress yet is blamed on polishing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忘記把雙程結果除以 2 或沒扣除參考面誤差，合格鏡片被誤判報廢。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。
optionsEn: Forgetting to halve the double-pass result or to subtract reference error scraps good lenses.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear.
quiz.explanation: 忘記把雙程結果除以 2 或沒扣除參考面誤差，合格鏡片被誤判報廢；鏡片在 632.8 nm 合格卻在 486 nm 因色球差不合格；測試夾具夾得太緊，量到的像散其實是夾持應力，卻被歸咎於拋光。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forgetting to halve the double-pass result or to subtract reference error scraps good lenses; a lens passes at 632.8 nm but fails at 486 nm through spherochromatism; an over-tight test fixture produces astigmatism that is really clamping stress yet is blamed on polishing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雜散光與鬼影分析」與「量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stray-light and ghost analysis" and "Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雜散光與鬼影分析：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Stray-light and ghost analysis: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鬼影路徑與邊緣雜散光」如何決定消色差透鏡設計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ghost paths and edge stray light” determines the key performance of “Achromatic lens design”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每個折射面都會反射一點光，經過兩次反射的光又朝感測器前進，形成亮光源的離焦複本，即鬼影。N 個面之間的二次反射路徑共有 N(N − 1)/2 條；膠合雙合有 3 個面，空氣間隔版有 4 個，再加上感測器保護玻璃與感測器本身，而感測器往往是最強的反射面。鬼影照度取決於兩面反射率與鬼影在感測器上的離焦程度，聚焦在感測器附近的鬼影最危險。另一類雜散光來自研磨鏡緣散射、鏡筒內壁與螺紋，以及膠中的氣泡。分析時先用近軸鬼影追跡找出鬼影焦點，再以非序列光線追跡估算照度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鬼影路徑與邊緣雜散光」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every refracting surface reflects a little light, and light reflected twice heads back toward the sensor as an out-of-focus copy of a bright source, a ghost. Among N surfaces there are N(N − 1)/2 two-bounce paths; a cemented doublet has 3 surfaces and an air-spaced one 4, plus the sensor cover glass and the sensor itself, which is often the strongest reflector. Ghost irradiance depends on the two reflectances and how defocused the ghost is at the sensor, and a ghost that focuses near the sensor is the most dangerous. Other stray light comes from scatter off ground lens edges, barrel walls and threads, and bubbles in the cement. Analysis starts with paraxial ghost tracing to locate ghost foci and then estimates irradiance by non-sequential ray tracing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ghost paths and edge stray light”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：路徑數：膠合 3 面有 3 條、空氣間隔 4 面有 6 條；雙合加 2 面保護玻璃與感測器共 6 面，15 條。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Paths: 3 for a cemented 3-surface doublet and 6 for an air-spaced 4-surface one; a doublet plus a 2-surface cover glass and the sensor makes 6 surfaces and 15 paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鬼影路徑與邊緣雜散光」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ghost paths and edge stray light”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雜散光與鬼影分析
knowledge.text: 每個折射面都會反射一點光，經過兩次反射的光又朝感測器前進，形成亮光源的離焦複本，即鬼影。N 個面之間的二次反射路徑共有 N(N − 1)/2 條；膠合雙合有 3 個面，空氣間隔版有 4 個，再加上感測器保護玻璃與感測器本身，而感測器往往是最強的反射面。
knowledge.textEn: Every refracting surface reflects a little light, and light reflected twice heads back toward the sensor as an out-of-focus copy of a bright source, a ghost. Among N surfaces there are N(N − 1)/2 two-bounce paths; a cemented doublet has 3 surfaces and an air-spaced one 4, plus the sensor cover glass and the sensor itself, which is often the strongest reflector.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雜散光與鬼影分析」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stray-light and ghost analysis" is correct?
options: 只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。
每個折射面都會反射一點光，經過兩次反射的光又朝感測器前進，形成亮光源的離焦複本，即鬼影。
量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。
optionsEn: Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear.
Every refracting surface reflects a little light, and light reflected twice heads back toward the sensor as an out-of-focus copy of a bright source, a ghost.
A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released.
quiz.explanation: 每個折射面都會反射一點光，經過兩次反射的光又朝感測器前進，形成亮光源的離焦複本，即鬼影。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every refracting surface reflects a little light, and light reflected twice heads back toward the sensor as an out-of-focus copy of a bright source, a ghost. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雜散光與鬼影分析：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stray-light and ghost analysis: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鬼影路徑與邊緣雜散光」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ghost paths and edge stray light” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：路徑數：膠合 3 面有 3 條、空氣間隔 4 面有 6 條；雙合加 2 面保護玻璃與感測器共 6 面，15 條。感測器（R = 4%）與鏡頭後表面（鍍膜 R = 0.5%）之間的鬼影能量比 2×10⁻⁴；若 50 µm 的 LED 像變成 0.5 mm 的鬼影圓盤，峰值比 2×10⁻⁴ × (50/500)² = 2×10⁻⁶；LED 超出滿井 1000 倍時，鬼影達滿井的 0.2%，在 12 位元感測器約 8 LSB，肉眼可見。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Paths: 3 for a cemented 3-surface doublet and 6 for an air-spaced 4-surface one; a doublet plus a 2-surface cover glass and the sensor makes 6 surfaces and 15 paths. A ghost between the sensor (R = 4%) and the rear lens surface (coated R = 0.5%) carries an energy ratio of 2×10⁻⁴; if a 50 µm LED image becomes a 0.5 mm ghost disc the peak ratio is 2×10⁻⁴ × (50/500)² = 2×10⁻⁶, and with the LED 1000 times over full well the ghost reaches 0.2% of full well, about 8 LSB on a 12-bit sensor and visible. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以準直的強光源在多個視場角掃描，用長曝光或高動態範圍拍攝鏡頭加感測器的影像，標出鬼影位置與大小並與鬼影追跡比較；以積分球加黑點的方法量面眩光指數；檢查鏡緣是否塗黑、鏡筒內壁是否有消光螺紋，並在紅外波段重複測試，確認鍍膜在感測器全響應範圍內都有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan a bright collimated source across several field angles and record lens plus sensor with long exposures or high dynamic range, mark ghost positions and sizes and compare with the ghost trace; measure the veiling-glare index with an integrating sphere and black spot; check that lens edges are blackened and barrel walls carry baffling threads, and repeat in the near infrared to confirm the coating works across the sensor's full response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 路徑數：膠合 3 面有 3 條、空氣間隔 4 面有 6 條；雙合加 2 面保護玻璃與感測器共 6 面，15 條。感測器（R = 4%）與鏡頭後表面（鍍膜 R = 0.5%）之間的鬼影能量比 2×10⁻⁴；若 50 µm 的 LED 像變成 0.5 mm 的鬼影圓盤，峰值比 2×10⁻⁴ × (50/500)² = 2×10⁻⁶；LED 超出滿井 1000 倍時，鬼影達滿井的 0.2%，在 12 位元感測器約 8 LSB，肉眼可見。
knowledge.textEn: Paths: 3 for a cemented 3-surface doublet and 6 for an air-spaced 4-surface one; a doublet plus a 2-surface cover glass and the sensor makes 6 surfaces and 15 paths. A ghost between the sensor (R = 4%) and the rear lens surface (coated R = 0.5%) carries an energy ratio of 2×10⁻⁴; if a 50 µm LED image becomes a 0.5 mm ghost disc the peak ratio is 2×10⁻⁴ × (50/500)² = 2×10⁻⁶, and with the LED 1000 times over full well the ghost reaches 0.2% of full well, about 8 LSB on a 12-bit sensor and visible.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「雜散光與鬼影分析」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stray-light and ghost analysis", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃的熱膨脹很小，所以溫度變化不會讓焦點移動。
鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。
路徑數：膠合 3 面有 3 條、空氣間隔 4 面有 6 條；雙合加 2 面保護玻璃與感測器共 6 面，15 條。
optionsEn: Glass expands so little that temperature changes cannot move the focus.
A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred.
Paths: 3 for a cemented 3-surface doublet and 6 for an air-spaced 4-surface one.
quiz.explanation: 路徑數：膠合 3 面有 3 條、空氣間隔 4 面有 6 條；雙合加 2 面保護玻璃與感測器共 6 面，15 條。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Paths: 3 for a cemented 3-surface doublet and 6 for an air-spaced 4-surface one; a doublet plus a 2-surface cover glass and the sensor makes 6 surfaces and 15 paths. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雜散光與鬼影分析：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stray-light and ghost analysis: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鬼影路徑與邊緣雜散光」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ghost paths and edge stray light” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以準直的強光源在多個視場角掃描，用長曝光或高動態範圍拍攝鏡頭加感測器的影像，標出鬼影位置與大小並與鬼影追跡比較；以積分球加黑點的方法量面眩光指數；檢查鏡緣是否塗黑、鏡筒內壁是否有消光螺紋，並在紅外波段重複測試，確認鍍膜在感測器全響應範圍內都有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan a bright collimated source across several field angles and record lens plus sensor with long exposures or high dynamic range, mark ghost positions and sizes and compare with the ghost trace; measure the veiling-glare index with an integrating sphere and black spot; check that lens edges are blackened and barrel walls carry baffling threads, and repeat in the near infrared to confirm the coating works across the sensor's full response. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：未塗黑的研磨鏡緣把視場外的強光散射成整片霧光，對比下降；抗反射膜只針對可見光最佳化，感測器在近紅外仍有響應，夜間模式鬼影突然明顯；聚焦在感測器上的鬼影成為與光源反向移動的亮點，被誤判為缺陷像素或目標。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An unblackened ground edge scatters a bright out-of-field source into a veil of haze that lowers contrast; a coating optimised only for the visible leaves high near-infrared reflectance where the sensor still responds, so ghosts suddenly appear in night mode; a ghost focused on the sensor becomes a bright spot moving opposite to the source, mistaken for a defective pixel or a target.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以準直的強光源在多個視場角掃描，用長曝光或高動態範圍拍攝鏡頭加感測器的影像，標出鬼影位置與大小並與鬼影追跡比較；以積分球加黑點的方法量面眩光指數；檢查鏡緣是否塗黑、鏡筒內壁是否有消光螺紋，並在紅外波段重複測試，確認鍍膜在感測器全響應範圍內都有效。
knowledge.textEn: Scan a bright collimated source across several field angles and record lens plus sensor with long exposures or high dynamic range, mark ghost positions and sizes and compare with the ghost trace; measure the veiling-glare index with an integrating sphere and black spot; check that lens edges are blackened and barrel walls carry baffling threads, and repeat in the near infrared to confirm the coating works across the sensor's full response.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雜散光與鬼影分析」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stray-light and ghost analysis"?
options: 以準直的強光源在多個視場角掃描，用長曝光或高動態範圍拍攝鏡頭加感測器的影像，標出鬼影位置與大小並與鬼影追跡比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。
optionsEn: Scan a bright collimated source across several field angles and record lens plus sensor with long exposures or high dynamic range, mark ghost positions and sizes and compare with the ghost trace.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp.
quiz.explanation: 以準直的強光源在多個視場角掃描，用長曝光或高動態範圍拍攝鏡頭加感測器的影像，標出鬼影位置與大小並與鬼影追跡比較；以積分球加黑點的方法量面眩光指數；檢查鏡緣是否塗黑、鏡筒內壁是否有消光螺紋，並在紅外波段重複測試，確認鍍膜在感測器全響應範圍內都有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan a bright collimated source across several field angles and record lens plus sensor with long exposures or high dynamic range, mark ghost positions and sizes and compare with the ghost trace; measure the veiling-glare index with an integrating sphere and black spot; check that lens edges are blackened and barrel walls carry baffling threads, and repeat in the near infrared to confirm the coating works across the sensor's full response. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 雜散光與鬼影分析：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stray-light and ghost analysis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鬼影路徑與邊緣雜散光」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ghost paths and edge stray light” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 未塗黑的研磨鏡緣把視場外的強光散射成整片霧光，對比下降；抗反射膜只針對可見光最佳化，感測器在近紅外仍有響應，夜間模式鬼影突然明顯；聚焦在感測器上的鬼影成為與光源反向移動的亮點，被誤判為缺陷像素或目標。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An unblackened ground edge scatters a bright out-of-field source into a veil of haze that lowers contrast; a coating optimised only for the visible leaves high near-infrared reflectance where the sensor still responds, so ghosts suddenly appear in night mode; a ghost focused on the sensor becomes a bright spot moving opposite to the source, mistaken for a defective pixel or a target. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分析時先用近軸鬼影追跡找出鬼影焦點，再以非序列光線追跡估算照度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Analysis starts with paraxial ghost tracing to locate ghost foci and then estimates irradiance by non-sequential ray tracing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未塗黑的研磨鏡緣把視場外的強光散射成整片霧光，對比下降；抗反射膜只針對可見光最佳化，感測器在近紅外仍有響應，夜間模式鬼影突然明顯；聚焦在感測器上的鬼影成為與光源反向移動的亮點，被誤判為缺陷像素或目標。
knowledge.textEn: An unblackened ground edge scatters a bright out-of-field source into a veil of haze that lowers contrast; a coating optimised only for the visible leaves high near-infrared reflectance where the sensor still responds, so ghosts suddenly appear in night mode; a ghost focused on the sensor becomes a bright spot moving opposite to the source, mistaken for a defective pixel or a target.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雜散光與鬼影分析」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stray-light and ghost analysis" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
未塗黑的研磨鏡緣把視場外的強光散射成整片霧光，對比下降。
量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
An unblackened ground edge scatters a bright out-of-field source into a veil of haze that lowers contrast.
A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released.
quiz.explanation: 未塗黑的研磨鏡緣把視場外的強光散射成整片霧光，對比下降；抗反射膜只針對可見光最佳化，感測器在近紅外仍有響應，夜間模式鬼影突然明顯；聚焦在感測器上的鬼影成為與光源反向移動的亮點，被誤判為缺陷像素或目標。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An unblackened ground edge scatters a bright out-of-field source into a veil of haze that lowers contrast; a coating optimised only for the visible leaves high near-infrared reflectance where the sensor still responds, so ghosts suddenly appear in night mode; a ghost focused on the sensor becomes a bright spot moving opposite to the source, mistaken for a defective pixel or a target. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收矩陣與保護帶」如何決定消色差透鏡設計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance matrix and guard band” determines the key performance of “Achromatic lens design”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量產驗收把設計轉成可量的門檻：有效焦距與後焦、指定頻率與視場的多色 MTF、軸向色焦差、632.8 nm 穿透波前、定心與視軸、鬼影檢查、熱離焦，以及依 ISO 10110-7 標示的表面瑕疵。量測不確定度必須遠小於公差，測試不確定度比至少 4；下限規格的允收門檻要加上保護帶，即門檻 = 規格 + U，在生產者風險（誤拒好件）與使用者風險（誤收壞件）之間取捨。量測台本身要做重複性與再現性研究，並以標準鏡每日校驗。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣與保護帶」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Production acceptance turns the design into measurable gates: effective and back focal length, polychromatic MTF at specified frequencies and fields, axial colour focus spread, 632.8 nm transmitted wavefront, centring and boresight, ghost checks, thermal defocus and surface imperfections stated per ISO 10110-7. Measurement uncertainty must be well below tolerance, with a test uncertainty ratio of at least 4; for a lower-limit specification the acceptance threshold is guard-banded as threshold = spec + U, trading producer risk of rejecting good parts against consumer risk of accepting bad ones. The test bench itself needs a repeatability and reproducibility study and a daily check against a reference lens. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix and guard band”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：規格：72 lp/mm 多色 MTF ≥ 0.30；量測擴充不確定度 U = 0.03（k = 2），保護帶門檻 0.33。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Specification: polychromatic MTF ≥ 0.30 at 72 lp/mm with expanded uncertainty U = 0.03 (k = 2), so the guard-banded threshold is 0.33.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收矩陣與保護帶」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance matrix and guard band”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff
knowledge.text: 量產驗收把設計轉成可量的門檻：有效焦距與後焦、指定頻率與視場的多色 MTF、軸向色焦差、632.8 nm 穿透波前、定心與視軸、鬼影檢查、熱離焦，以及依 ISO 10110-7 標示的表面瑕疵。量測不確定度必須遠小於公差，測試不確定度比至少 4；下限規格的允收門檻要加上保護帶，即門檻 = 規格 + U，在生產者風險（誤拒好件）與使用者風險（誤收壞件）之間取捨。
knowledge.textEn: Production acceptance turns the design into measurable gates: effective and back focal length, polychromatic MTF at specified frequencies and fields, axial colour focus spread, 632.8 nm transmitted wavefront, centring and boresight, ghost checks, thermal defocus and surface imperfections stated per ISO 10110-7. Measurement uncertainty must be well below tolerance, with a test uncertainty ratio of at least 4; for a lower-limit specification the acceptance threshold is guard-banded as threshold = spec + U, trading producer risk of rejecting good parts against consumer risk of accepting bad ones.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff" is correct?
options: 量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。
只要兩片玻璃的阿貝數差夠大，就能完全消除二級光譜。
量產驗收把設計轉成可量的門檻：有效焦距與後焦、指定頻率與視場的多色 MTF、軸向色焦差、632.8 nm 穿透波前、定心與視軸、鬼影檢查、熱離焦，以及依 ISO 10110-7 標示的表面瑕疵。
optionsEn: A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released.
A large enough Abbe-number difference between two glasses eliminates the secondary spectrum.

Production acceptance turns the design into measurable gates: effective and back focal length, polychromatic MTF at specified frequencies and fields, axial colour focus spread, 632.8 nm transmitted wavefront, centring and boresight, ghost checks, thermal defocus and surface imperfections stated per ISO 10110-7.
quiz.explanation: 量產驗收把設計轉成可量的門檻：有效焦距與後焦、指定頻率與視場的多色 MTF、軸向色焦差、632.8 nm 穿透波前、定心與視軸、鬼影檢查、熱離焦，以及依 ISO 10110-7 標示的表面瑕疵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Production acceptance turns the design into measurable gates: effective and back focal length, polychromatic MTF at specified frequencies and fields, axial colour focus spread, 632.8 nm transmitted wavefront, centring and boresight, ghost checks, thermal defocus and surface imperfections stated per ISO 10110-7. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收矩陣與保護帶」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance matrix and guard band” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：規格：72 lp/mm 多色 MTF ≥ 0.30；量測擴充不確定度 U = 0.03（k = 2），保護帶門檻 0.33。若量產平均 0.38、標準差 0.025，有保護帶的良率 Φ((0.38 − 0.33)/0.025) = Φ(2.0) = 97.7%，不加保護帶為 Φ(3.2) = 99.93%，但會放行真值略低於 0.30 的鏡頭。焦距公差 ±0.5 mm、U = 0.1 mm，測試不確定度比 5，符合 ≥ 4 的要求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Specification: polychromatic MTF ≥ 0.30 at 72 lp/mm with expanded uncertainty U = 0.03 (k = 2), so the guard-banded threshold is 0.33. With a production mean of 0.38 and standard deviation 0.025, guard-banded yield is Φ((0.38 − 0.33)/0.025) = Φ(2.0) = 97.7%, against Φ(3.2) = 99.93% without a guard band, which would release lenses whose true MTF lies just below 0.30. A focal-length tolerance of ±0.5 mm with U = 0.1 mm gives a test uncertainty ratio of 5, meeting the ≥ 4 requirement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對 MTF 量測台做量測系統分析：10 顆鏡頭 × 3 位操作員 × 3 次重複，計算重複性與再現性佔公差的百分比；每日以標準鏡確認讀值在管制界限內；與客戶的量測台做相關性比對，找出系統偏差；把每顆鏡頭的量測值、玻璃熔次、膠批號與設計模型版本一併記錄到序號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a measurement-system analysis on the MTF bench with 10 lenses × 3 operators × 3 repeats and compute repeatability and reproducibility as a percentage of tolerance; check daily that the reference lens reads within control limits; correlate with the customer's bench to find systematic bias; record each lens's results with glass melt lot, cement batch and design-model version under its serial number.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 規格：72 lp/mm 多色 MTF ≥ 0.30；量測擴充不確定度 U = 0.03（k = 2），保護帶門檻 0.33。若量產平均 0.38、標準差 0.025，有保護帶的良率 Φ((0.38 − 0.33)/0.025) = Φ(2.0) = 97.7%，不加保護帶為 Φ(3.2) = 99.93%，但會放行真值略低於 0.30 的鏡頭。焦距公差 ±0.5 mm、U = 0.1 mm，測試不確定度比 5，符合 ≥ 4 的要求。
knowledge.textEn: Specification: polychromatic MTF ≥ 0.30 at 72 lp/mm with expanded uncertainty U = 0.03 (k = 2), so the guard-banded threshold is 0.33. With a production mean of 0.38 and standard deviation 0.025, guard-banded yield is Φ((0.38 − 0.33)/0.025) = Φ(2.0) = 97.7%, against Φ(3.2) = 99.93% without a guard band, which would release lenses whose true MTF lies just below 0.30. A focal-length tolerance of ±0.5 mm with U = 0.1 mm gives a test uncertainty ratio of 5, meeting the ≥ 4 requirement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 規格：72 lp/mm 多色 MTF ≥ 0.30；量測擴充不確定度 U = 0.03（k = 2），保護帶門檻 0.33。
空氣間隔雙合只是沒上膠的膠合透鏡，光學性能完全相同。
只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。
optionsEn: Specification: polychromatic MTF ≥ 0.30 at 72 lp/mm with expanded uncertainty U = 0.03 (k = 2), so the guard-banded threshold is 0.33.
An air-spaced doublet is just an uncemented cemented doublet with identical optics.
If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp.
quiz.explanation: 規格：72 lp/mm 多色 MTF ≥ 0.30；量測擴充不確定度 U = 0.03（k = 2），保護帶門檻 0.33。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Specification: polychromatic MTF ≥ 0.30 at 72 lp/mm with expanded uncertainty U = 0.03 (k = 2), so the guard-banded threshold is 0.33. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收矩陣與保護帶」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance matrix and guard band” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對 MTF 量測台做量測系統分析：10 顆鏡頭 × 3 位操作員 × 3 次重複，計算重複性與再現性佔公差的百分比；每日以標準鏡確認讀值在管制界限內；與客戶的量測台做相關性比對，找出系統偏差；把每顆鏡頭的量測值、玻璃熔次、膠批號與設計模型版本一併記錄到序號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a measurement-system analysis on the MTF bench with 10 lenses × 3 operators × 3 repeats and compute repeatability and reproducibility as a percentage of tolerance; check daily that the reference lens reads within control limits; correlate with the customer's bench to find systematic bias; record each lens's results with glass melt lot, cement batch and design-model version under its serial number. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：供應商與客戶的 MTF 量測台相差 0.04，整批在進料檢驗被退回；未設保護帶，邊緣件流入產品造成客訴；標準鏡在搬運中受損而讀值偏高，未被察覺下所有鏡頭都被高估。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Supplier and customer MTF benches differ by 0.04 and whole lots are rejected at incoming inspection; without a guard band marginal parts reach products and return as complaints; a reference lens damaged in handling reads high unnoticed, so every lens is overestimated.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對 MTF 量測台做量測系統分析：10 顆鏡頭 × 3 位操作員 × 3 次重複，計算重複性與再現性佔公差的百分比；每日以標準鏡確認讀值在管制界限內；與客戶的量測台做相關性比對，找出系統偏差；把每顆鏡頭的量測值、玻璃熔次、膠批號與設計模型版本一併記錄到序號。
knowledge.textEn: Run a measurement-system analysis on the MTF bench with 10 lenses × 3 operators × 3 repeats and compute repeatability and reproducibility as a percentage of tolerance; check daily that the reference lens reads within control limits; correlate with the customer's bench to find systematic bias; record each lens's results with glass melt lot, cement batch and design-model version under its serial number.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
對 MTF 量測台做量測系統分析：10 顆鏡頭 × 3 位操作員 × 3 次重複，計算重複性與再現性佔公差的百分比。
HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run a measurement-system analysis on the MTF bench with 10 lenses × 3 operators × 3 repeats and compute repeatability and reproducibility as a percentage of tolerance.
A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band.
quiz.explanation: 對 MTF 量測台做量測系統分析：10 顆鏡頭 × 3 位操作員 × 3 次重複，計算重複性與再現性佔公差的百分比；每日以標準鏡確認讀值在管制界限內；與客戶的量測台做相關性比對，找出系統偏差；把每顆鏡頭的量測值、玻璃熔次、膠批號與設計模型版本一併記錄到序號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a measurement-system analysis on the MTF bench with 10 lenses × 3 operators × 3 repeats and compute repeatability and reproducibility as a percentage of tolerance; check daily that the reference lens reads within control limits; correlate with the customer's bench to find systematic bias; record each lens's results with glass melt lot, cement batch and design-model version under its serial number. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收矩陣與保護帶」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance matrix and guard band” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 供應商與客戶的 MTF 量測台相差 0.04，整批在進料檢驗被退回；未設保護帶，邊緣件流入產品造成客訴；標準鏡在搬運中受損而讀值偏高，未被察覺下所有鏡頭都被高估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Supplier and customer MTF benches differ by 0.04 and whole lots are rejected at incoming inspection; without a guard band marginal parts reach products and return as complaints; a reference lens damaged in handling reads high unnoticed, so every lens is overestimated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測台本身要做重複性與再現性研究，並以標準鏡每日校驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The test bench itself needs a repeatability and reproducibility study and a daily check against a reference lens.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 供應商與客戶的 MTF 量測台相差 0.04，整批在進料檢驗被退回；未設保護帶，邊緣件流入產品造成客訴；標準鏡在搬運中受損而讀值偏高，未被察覺下所有鏡頭都被高估。
knowledge.textEn: Supplier and customer MTF benches differ by 0.04 and whole lots are rejected at incoming inspection; without a guard band marginal parts reach products and return as complaints; a reference lens damaged in handling reads high unnoticed, so every lens is overestimated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要兩片玻璃的阿貝數差夠大，就能完全消除二級光譜。
供應商與客戶的 MTF 量測台相差 0.04，整批在進料檢驗被退回。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A large enough Abbe-number difference between two glasses eliminates the secondary spectrum.
Supplier and customer MTF benches differ by 0.04 and whole lots are rejected at incoming inspection.
quiz.explanation: 供應商與客戶的 MTF 量測台相差 0.04，整批在進料檢驗被退回；未設保護帶，邊緣件流入產品造成客訴；標準鏡在搬運中受損而讀值偏高，未被察覺下所有鏡頭都被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Supplier and customer MTF benches differ by 0.04 and whole lots are rejected at incoming inspection; without a guard band marginal parts reach products and return as complaints; a reference lens damaged in handling reads high unnoticed, so every lens is overestimated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 焦點預算練習：f = 100 mm、f/4 的 N-BK7/F2 膠合雙合，f₁ = 43.3 mm、f₂ = −76.4 mm，搭配 3.45 µm 像素（Nyquist 145 lp/mm）。二級光譜使 C、F 焦點在 d 後 50 µm；把感測器放在中間 +25 µm，d、C、F 各離焦 25 µm，W₀₂₀ 為 0.33λ、0.30λ、0.40λ，Nyquist MTF 約 0.36、0.35、0.37，乘像素 sinc 0.64 後約 0.23。溫度上升 40 K：鏡片焦距伸長 100 × 1.53×10⁻⁶ × 40 = 6.1 µm，鋁鏡筒伸長 94.4 µm，失配 88 µm 遠超 ±17.6 µm 景深；改用 Invar 隔圈後殘差 1.3 µm。若改用 N-FK51A/N-KZFS4（f₁ = 47.3 mm、f₂ = −89.8 mm），色焦差降為 14.2 µm，置中後各色離焦 7.1 µm，Nyquist MTF 約 0.51 到 0.62，乘像素響應後約 0.33 到 0.39，足以通過 0.30 的規格。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Focus-budget exercise: an f = 100 mm, f/4 cemented N-BK7/F2 doublet with f₁ = 43.3 mm and f₂ = −76.4 mm on 3.45 µm pixels (Nyquist 145 lp/mm). Secondary spectrum puts the C and F foci 50 µm behind d; placing the sensor midway at +25 µm defocuses d, C and F by 25 µm each, W₀₂₀ of 0.33λ, 0.30λ and 0.40λ, giving Nyquist MTF near 0.36, 0.35 and 0.37, about 0.23 after the 0.64 pixel sinc. A 40 K rise lengthens the lens focal length by 100 × 1.53×10⁻⁶ × 40 = 6.1 µm while an aluminium barrel grows 94.4 µm, an 88 µm mismatch far beyond the ±17.6 µm depth of focus; an Invar spacer leaves 1.3 µm. Switching to N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 (f₁ = 47.3 mm, f₂ = −89.8 mm) cuts the colour spread to 14.2 µm, so centred focus leaves each colour 7.1 µm out, Nyquist MTF about 0.51 to 0.62 and roughly 0.33 to 0.39 with the pixel response, enough to pass a 0.30 specification. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

v12Extension.focus: 三片式複消色差、熱離焦、膠合與空氣間隔取捨、定心膠合工序、感測器匹配 MTF、波前與鬼影驗收
v12Extension.focusEn: Three-glass apochromats, thermal defocus, cemented versus air-spaced trade-offs, centring and cementing, sensor-matched MTF, wavefront and ghost acceptance

steps.title: 畫出海峽限制圖
steps.objective: 區分航道淨空與結構跨距的需求。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish navigation-clearance needs from structural span requirements.
steps.instruction: 自繪兩岸、航道和候選塔位，另以符號標出深水與強潮流區。為每一個塔位寫出一項須由海事或地質資料確認的限制。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch the shores, navigation corridor and candidate tower locations; mark deep water and strong currents separately. For each tower location, name a constraint requiring marine or geological evidence.
steps.observation: 比較塔位移動是否同時改變航道餘裕、側跨與施工可達性。
steps.observationEn: Observe whether moving a tower changes navigation space, side spans and construction access together.
steps.failure: 只保留最短跨距，卻把基礎放入航道或未調查地層。
steps.failureEn: Minimizing span alone can place foundations in a navigation corridor or uninvestigated ground.
steps.check: 提交有圖例的限制圖，至少保留兩項尚待查證的資料。
steps.checkEn: Submit a keyed constraint map with at least two unresolved evidence needs.

knowledge.title: 多目標選址
knowledge.text: 塔位同時影響結構、航運和施工；跨距不是唯一決策量。
knowledge.textEn: Tower placement affects structure, navigation and construction; span is only one decision variable.

knowledge.title: 資料不確定性
knowledge.text: 未量測的水深或地層不能因示意圖畫得完整就視為已確認。
knowledge.textEn: A complete-looking sketch does not verify unmeasured depth or ground conditions.

options: 航道、地盤與施工限制是否不同
只比較總橋重，認為其可代表所有場址限制
先假定兩地地盤完全相同
optionsEn: Differences in navigation, ground and construction constraints
Compare total bridge weight as if it represented every site constraint
Assume identical ground conditions first
quiz.question: 兩個塔位方案跨距相近，下一個合理比較是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two tower layouts have similar spans. What should be compared next?
quiz.explanation: 相近的跨距不代表相同的外部條件，必須比較限制與證據缺口。
quiz.explanationEn: Similar spans do not imply similar external conditions; compare constraints and evidence gaps.

steps.title: 追蹤懸索橋載荷路徑
steps.objective: 辨認吊索、主纜、塔與錨碇的不同角色。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the distinct roles of hangers, main cables, towers and anchorages.
steps.instruction: 在自繪側視圖把一個橋面載荷依序連到吊索及主纜，再分別追蹤塔的支承和端部錨碇的反力。另畫一條溫度伸縮方向箭頭。
steps.instructionEn: On a side-view sketch, trace a deck load through hangers and main cables, then identify tower support and end-anchorage reactions. Add a separate thermal-movement arrow.
steps.observation: 注意吊索大致垂直，而主纜曲線連續通過塔頂。
steps.observationEn: Notice the approximately vertical hangers and the main cable continuing over the towers.
steps.failure: 把主纜當成從塔頂直接放射到橋面的斜張索。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking the main cable for separate stays radiating directly from a tower to the deck.
steps.check: 載荷路徑須包含錨碇，且與伸縮箭頭使用不同圖例。
steps.checkEn: Include anchorages in the load path and distinguish force arrows from movement arrows.

knowledge.title: 懸索與斜張
knowledge.text: 懸索橋以主纜與吊索承托橋面；斜張橋的斜索直接連結塔與梁。
knowledge.textEn: A suspension bridge supports its deck through main cables and hangers; stays connect a cable-stayed deck directly to towers.

knowledge.title: 反力閉合
knowledge.text: 辨識拉力仍須追查由哪個支承或地盤提供平衡反力。
knowledge.textEn: Identifying tension also requires locating the support or ground that balances it.

options: 吊索到橋面的局部傳力已完整，所以不需其他反力
主纜端部拉力的反力路徑
主塔承受壓力即可代替所有端部反力
optionsEn: Local hanger-to-deck transfer is complete, so no further reaction is needed
The reaction path for end cable tension
Tower compression can replace all end reactions
quiz.question: 如果示意圖刪掉主纜端部的錨碇，主要遺漏是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is chiefly missing if a sketch omits the main-cable anchorages?
quiz.explanation: 錨碇是懸索系統的受力邊界，不能只畫橋面、塔和吊索。
quiz.explanationEn: Anchorages define the suspension system’s force boundary; deck, towers and hangers alone are incomplete.

steps.title: 拆解海中基礎介面
steps.objective: 辨識海床、基礎與橋塔交界各需什麼證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify evidence needed at seabed, foundation and tower interfaces.
steps.instruction: 畫出海床剖面、基礎底面與塔座，列出承載、變形、海床變化三類問題。將施工定位紀錄與營運期海床觀測分成兩欄。
steps.instructionEn: Draw seabed, foundation base and tower seat. List bearing, deformation and bed-change questions, separating construction-position records from operational seabed observations.
steps.observation: 觀察同一塔頂位移可能來自基礎轉動或塔本身變形。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that tower-top movement may result from foundation rotation or tower deformation.
steps.failure: 把單一塔頂讀數直接認定為海床承載失效。
steps.failureEn: Treating one tower-top reading as proof of seabed bearing failure.
steps.check: 為三類問題各指定一種觀察量，並寫明無法由它單獨判定的事項。
steps.checkEn: Assign one observable to each question and state what it cannot establish alone.

knowledge.title: 支承條件
knowledge.text: 基礎的受力與變形都會影響上部結構的邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Foundation forces and deformations both affect superstructure boundary conditions.

knowledge.title: 分層量測
knowledge.text: 塔頂、塔座及地盤的相對量測有助於區分變形來源。
knowledge.textEn: Relative measurements at tower top, base and ground help distinguish deformation sources.

options: 只增加同一位置讀數次數，不核對支承
另一次未註記時間的塔頂照片
塔座位移與環境條件的同期紀錄
optionsEn: Repeat readings at the same point without checking support
Another tower-top photograph with no timestamp
Concurrent tower-base displacement and environmental records
quiz.question: 塔頂偏移增加時，哪組補充資料最有助診斷？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional data best helps diagnose increased tower-top displacement?
quiz.explanation: 同步的支承與環境紀錄可檢查不同假說，單點讀數不能定位原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronized support and environmental records test competing explanations; one reading cannot locate the cause.

steps.title: 核對錨碇與纜索交接
steps.objective: 將端部受力模型連結到幾何與耐久檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect an end-force model to geometry and durability checks.
steps.instruction: 自繪主纜進入錨碇的簡圖，標出拉力傳遞、可檢查空間與水分進入方向。把錨碇和橋塔基礎列成兩個不同構件。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a main cable entering an anchorage; mark force transfer, inspection space and possible moisture entry. List the anchorage separately from the tower foundation.
steps.observation: 檢查力能否從纜索一路追蹤到錨碇與地盤。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the force path can be followed continuously from cable to anchorage and ground.
steps.failure: 以表面塗層完好推論整個錨碇內部都乾燥且健全。
steps.failureEn: Inferring a dry, sound anchorage interior solely from intact surface coating.
steps.check: 交付受力圖與耐久疑問各一張，註明需要的內部證據。
steps.checkEn: Provide a force sketch and a durability-question sheet naming the necessary internal evidence.

knowledge.title: 構件職責
knowledge.text: 主塔支承主纜，端部錨碇承接纜索端力；兩者不應混為一談。
knowledge.textEn: Towers support main cables while end anchorages resist end forces; these roles differ.

knowledge.title: 可檢查性
knowledge.text: 無法直接看見的介面，需要事先規劃可追溯的檢查方法。
knowledge.textEn: Hidden interfaces require planned, traceable inspection methods.

options: 有位置與日期的內部檢查及濕度紀錄
只增加外表面檢查，假定內部條件一致
以當日車流估算內部濕度
optionsEn: Located, dated internal inspection and humidity records
Increase external inspection and assume the interior matches
Infer internal humidity from the day’s traffic
quiz.question: 哪項證據最能補足錨碇外觀照片的限制？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence best supplements external anchorage photographs?
quiz.explanation: 內部環境和檢查位置才直接對應隱蔽介面的疑問。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal conditions and inspection locations directly address hidden-interface questions.

stages.title: 海峽與受力系統
stages.description: 先把航道、地盤與懸索受力放在同一概念模型中。
stages.descriptionEn: Put navigation, ground conditions and suspension load paths in one conceptual model.

steps.title: 比較主纜形狀與載荷
steps.objective: 理解纜索幾何與張力不能分開指定。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why cable geometry and tension cannot be specified independently.
steps.instruction: 以鬆弛繩模型或自繪曲線比較兩種下垂程度，在圖上放入相同的示意橋面載荷。只作定性判讀，列出求數值時還缺的材料和邊界資料。
steps.instructionEn: Compare two cable sags using loose string or sketches under the same illustrative deck load. Keep conclusions qualitative and list missing material and boundary data for numerical analysis.
steps.observation: 觀察曲線變平時，端部力的方向也改變。
steps.observationEn: Observe that flattening the cable changes the end-force direction.
steps.failure: 把下垂量減少誤認為必然能降低所有纜索力。
steps.failureEn: Assuming reduced sag necessarily reduces every cable force.
steps.check: 圖中保留相同載荷假設，並說明不能由外形直接求出張力。
steps.checkEn: Keep the load assumption identical and explain why shape alone cannot give tension.

knowledge.title: 柔性纜索
knowledge.text: 纜索主要以拉力傳力，平衡形狀會隨載荷與支承位置改變。
knowledge.textEn: A cable primarily carries tension; its equilibrium shape depends on loading and support positions.

knowledge.title: 模型限制
knowledge.text: 繩模型未重現鋼纜剛度、溫度與橋面剛性，只展示幾何關係。
knowledge.textEn: A string model illustrates geometry without reproducing steel-cable stiffness, temperature effects or deck rigidity.

options: 只控制圖上的跨度，允許載荷不同
載荷與支承條件的假設
只控制纜索材料，忽略支承位置
optionsEn: Hold only drawn span constant while changing the load
Assumptions about loading and supports
Hold only cable material constant and ignore support positions
quiz.question: 想比較兩種垂度的受力，哪項必須先控制一致？
quiz.questionEn: What should first be held consistent when comparing forces for two sags?
quiz.explanation: 在不同載荷或支承下看到的差異不能只歸因於垂度。
quiz.explanationEn: Differences under changed loads or supports cannot be attributed to sag alone.

steps.title: 追蹤分段架設狀態
steps.objective: 區分施工中與完工後的平衡系統。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish construction-stage equilibrium from the completed system.
steps.instruction: 把橋面分成六個示意區段，自選兩種安裝先後並逐格畫出已連接構件。每一格標記不平衡載荷與尚未形成的連續性，不安排真實吊裝。
steps.instructionEn: Divide the deck into six illustrative segments and sketch two assembly sequences. For each state mark unbalanced loads and missing continuity; do not plan an actual lift.
steps.observation: 比較單側增加一段橋面時，主纜和鄰近吊索的受力路徑如何改變。
steps.observationEn: Compare load-path changes in the main cable and adjacent hangers when a segment is added on one side.
steps.failure: 直接套用完工橋的支承與連續性來評估每個施工格。
steps.failureEn: Applying completed-bridge support and continuity assumptions to every construction state.
steps.check: 選出一個最需要重新分析的中間狀態，說明理由與缺少資料。
steps.checkEn: Select an intermediate state needing renewed analysis and explain why and what data is missing.

knowledge.title: 階段結構
knowledge.text: 構件尚未連接時，完工後的載荷重分配途徑可能不存在。
knowledge.textEn: Load redistribution available after completion may not exist before components are connected.

knowledge.title: 工序依賴
knowledge.text: 幾何調整和構件接合的結果會成為下一階段的初始條件。
knowledge.textEn: Geometry adjustment and connection outcomes become initial conditions for the next stage.

options: 中間狀態可直接沿用完工載荷分配
每個中間狀態都必定比完工更安全
未完成結構的連接與載荷不同
optionsEn: Intermediate states can use final load distribution unchanged
Every intermediate state is necessarily safer than completion
Connections and loads differ in an incomplete structure
quiz.question: 哪個理由最能說明需要施工階段分析？
quiz.questionEn: What best explains the need for construction-stage analysis?
quiz.explanation: 需要檢查的是當時實際存在的結構系統，而非只看終態。
quiz.explanationEn: The relevant structure is the one that exists at that stage, not only the final state.

steps.title: 重建地震後測量基準
steps.objective: 理解基準變動如何影響尚未製造的構件。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how changed reference geometry affects unfabricated components.
steps.instruction: 依 1995 年事件畫出「地震前控制點—震後復測—更新模型—複核構件」流程。用自設的小位移示例，分開記錄地盤移動與構件相對變形。
steps.instructionEn: Based on the 1995 event, map pre-event controls, resurvey, model update and component review. In a clearly invented displacement example, separate ground movement from relative component deformation.
steps.observation: 比較兩塔間距變化與塔本身損傷是否是不同證據問題。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish a changed tower spacing from evidence of damage within a tower.
steps.failure: 控制點移動後，仍把舊座標當成固定真值調整構件。
steps.failureEn: Adjusting components to old coordinates after the control points have moved.
steps.check: 記錄示例新舊基準、相對距離與待重審構件，禁止把示例值當實測。
steps.checkEn: Record old and new references, relative distances and components needing review; label every example value as invented.

knowledge.title: 共同位移
knowledge.text: 地盤與基礎共同移動，與基礎對地盤滑動，是不同的機制。
knowledge.textEn: Ground and foundation moving together differs from a foundation sliding relative to ground.

knowledge.title: 版本追溯
knowledge.text: 幾何基準修訂要能追溯到分析模型與待製構件版本。
knowledge.textEn: A revised geometric reference must be traceable to model and component versions.

options: 仍須復測並檢查模型與構件介面
外觀正常即可忽略幾何改變
立即判定所有基礎已滑動
optionsEn: Resurvey and review model and component interfaces
Normal appearance makes geometry changes irrelevant
Conclude immediately that all foundations slid
quiz.question: 震後塔距改變，但構件外觀無明顯損傷，應如何解讀？
quiz.questionEn: Tower spacing changes after an earthquake without visible member damage. What follows?
quiz.explanation: 外觀、相對位移與受力是不同證據層次，須整合後判斷。
quiz.explanationEn: Appearance, relative displacement and force behavior are different evidence layers that must be reconciled.

steps.title: 分辨靜風與振動問題
steps.objective: 識別風力、變形與振動穩定性所需的不同模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify different models for wind force, deformation and dynamic stability.
steps.instruction: 為靜態側向風力、渦激反應與扭轉振動各寫一個研究問題。以自繪位移—時間曲線比較衰減、持續與增長，避免賦予真實橋梁限值。
steps.instructionEn: Write separate questions about static crosswind force, vortex-induced response and torsional vibration. Sketch decaying, sustained and growing motion without assigning real-bridge limits.
steps.observation: 觀察平均位移相近的曲線，振幅隨時間的變化仍可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Curves with similar mean displacement can have different amplitude trends over time.
steps.failure: 只檢查最大靜態撓度，就宣稱已驗證所有風振現象。
steps.failureEn: Claiming all wind behavior is verified by checking maximum static deflection alone.
steps.check: 將三種問題配對到合適的觀察量，標示定性曲線。
steps.checkEn: Match the three questions to suitable observables and label curves as qualitative.

knowledge.title: 時間尺度
knowledge.text: 穩定平均風荷載與反覆振動需要不同的證據描述。
knowledge.textEn: Steady mean wind loading and repeated oscillation require different evidence descriptions.

knowledge.title: 能量與阻尼
knowledge.text: 阻尼消散振動能量；它與單純提高靜態剛度的作用不同。
knowledge.textEn: Damping dissipates vibration energy, which differs from simply increasing static stiffness.

options: 圖上平均位移的方向
振幅是否隨時間增長
圖中使用的長度單位
optionsEn: Direction of the plotted mean displacement
Whether vibration amplitude grows over time
Length units shown on the plot
quiz.question: 哪個現象無法由一張平均撓度圖充分判斷？
quiz.questionEn: What cannot be adequately judged from a mean-deflection plot?
quiz.explanation: 振動增長需要時間或動態穩定性資訊；平均量會隱藏它。
quiz.explanationEn: Growth requires time-dependent or stability information; averages can hide it.

stages.title: 架設與幾何控制
stages.description: 比較未完成結構的平衡、基準變更與風振假設。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare incomplete-structure equilibrium, changed survey references and wind-response assumptions.

steps.title: 畫出主纜乾燥屏障
steps.objective: 說明外包覆與內部乾燥的互補關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how wrapping and internal drying complement each other.
steps.instruction: 自繪主纜包覆、送氣、排氣及濕度觀測點的功能圖。為「包覆局部進水」與「送氣中斷」各列一項可觀察證據，不指定設備參數。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch functional roles of cable wrapping, air supply, exhaust and humidity observations. For local water ingress and interrupted air supply, name evidence without specifying operating parameters.
steps.observation: 檢查進氣正常是否仍可能與局部高濕並存。
steps.observationEn: Ask whether normal inlet air can coexist with a locally humid region.
steps.failure: 以乾燥機正在運轉，取代主纜內部環境的證據。
steps.failureEn: Substituting evidence that a dryer is running for evidence about conditions inside the cable.
steps.check: 圖上須有兩個不同失效路徑與對應觀察點。
steps.checkEn: Include two distinct failure paths and corresponding observation locations.

knowledge.title: 防蝕多重屏障
knowledge.text: 外包覆抑制水分進入，乾燥系統改善內部環境；兩者提供不同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Wrapping limits moisture entry while drying changes internal conditions; the functions differ.

knowledge.title: 代表性採樣
knowledge.text: 一個位置的濕度，不能自動代表整條纜索的狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Humidity measured at one point does not automatically represent the entire cable.

options: 直接把遠端讀值刪除
用乾燥機功率證明全纜乾燥
核對量測與局部氣流或包覆異常
optionsEn: Delete the distant reading
Use dryer power as proof the entire cable is dry
Check measurements and local airflow or wrapping anomalies
quiz.question: 送氣端讀值正常而遠端濕度偏高，最合理的下一步是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Inlet readings are normal but a distant point is humid. What is the best next review?
quiz.explanation: 不同位置的差異可能提供局部失效線索，須先查證。
quiz.explanationEn: Differences between locations may reveal local failure and require verification.

steps.title: 辨認重複載荷與接頭
steps.objective: 區分疲勞、腐蝕與單次超載的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish evidence of fatigue, corrosion and one-time overload.
steps.instruction: 在自繪鋼橋面接頭示意上標記幾何變化處，建立三欄：反覆交通載荷、水分滯留、單次異常事件。為每欄列一種需要查證的紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark geometric changes on a steel-deck connection sketch. Create columns for repeated traffic loading, trapped moisture and a single abnormal event, assigning evidence to each.
steps.observation: 留意細小裂紋的位置及歷次變化，比單一遠景照片更具診斷性。
steps.observationEn: Crack location and change over time are more diagnostic than one distant photograph.
steps.failure: 看到鏽色就把所有裂紋歸因於腐蝕，忽略載荷歷程。
steps.failureEn: Attributing every crack to corrosion because rust is visible, without considering load history.
steps.check: 完成三種機制的證據表，至少列一項仍不能排除的替代解釋。
steps.checkEn: Complete the three-mechanism evidence table and retain at least one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 局部細節
knowledge.text: 幾何不連續可能集中應力；整體受力正常不保證每個接頭無問題。
knowledge.textEn: Geometric discontinuities can concentrate stress; normal global behavior does not prove every connection sound.

knowledge.title: 機制辨識
knowledge.text: 裂紋形態、環境與載荷歷程應一起判讀，不能只靠顏色。
knowledge.textEn: Crack form, environment and load history should be interpreted together rather than from color alone.

options: 同位置、同尺度的歷次量測
不同位置的裂紋照片但沒有時間對照
只記錄當日總車流，不核對裂紋位置
optionsEn: Repeated measurements at the same location and scale
Crack photographs from different locations without time comparison
Record only daily traffic without locating the crack
quiz.question: 哪項資料最有助區分持續發展的裂紋與穩定表面痕跡？
quiz.questionEn: Which data best distinguishes a developing crack from a stable surface mark?
quiz.explanation: 可比較的時間序列才提供變化證據；外觀單照缺少發展資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparable time-series observations provide change evidence that a single image lacks.

steps.title: 校正監測比較條件
steps.objective: 避免把溫度或儀器差異誤認為結構劣化。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mistaking environmental or instrument differences for structural deterioration.
steps.instruction: 自行製作含時間、溫度、風況、感測器和位移的六列示例表。選出可直接比較的兩列，再為其餘列註記需校正或補查的條件。
steps.instructionEn: Create a six-row example table with time, temperature, wind, sensor and displacement. Select two comparable rows and mark conditions requiring adjustment or investigation in the others.
steps.observation: 觀察位移異常是否與換感測器或環境改變同時發生。
steps.observationEn: See whether displacement changes coincide with sensor replacement or environmental changes.
steps.failure: 把不同零點或不同溫度的資料直接相減，產生假趨勢。
steps.failureEn: Direct subtraction across different zero references or temperatures creates a false trend.
steps.check: 保留原始示例值、比較依據與未解釋的殘差，不覆寫原紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Retain original example values, comparison criteria and unexplained residuals without overwriting records.

knowledge.title: 基線條件
knowledge.text: 基線不只是單一數值，還包括量測時間、環境、設備與基準。
knowledge.textEn: A baseline includes time, environment, instrument and reference, not just one value.

knowledge.title: 可重現性
knowledge.text: 他人應能利用相同選取規則重建你的比較結果。
knowledge.textEn: Another reviewer should reproduce the comparison using the same selection rules.

options: 直接宣告主纜斷裂
新舊感測器的零點和交接紀錄
把前後資料平均後忽略跳變
optionsEn: Immediately declare main-cable rupture
Old and new sensor zero references and handover records
Average the records and disregard the jump
quiz.question: 更換感測器當天出現位移跳變，應優先核對什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A displacement jump appears on the day a sensor is replaced. What should be checked first?
quiz.explanation: 先排查量測系統變動，再結合結構和環境證據判讀。
quiz.explanationEn: Check measurement-system changes before interpreting structural and environmental evidence.

steps.title: 交付懸索橋證據卷宗
steps.objective: 把結構、施工與維護的未解問題交接清楚。
steps.objectiveEn: Clearly hand over unresolved structural, construction and maintenance questions.
steps.instruction: 把前述圖表整理成索引：載荷路徑、基準版本、架設狀態、風振問題及纜索防蝕。對每份資料註明來源、假設與支持的判斷範圍。
steps.instructionEn: Index your load-path, reference-version, erection-state, wind-response and corrosion records. For each, identify source, assumptions and the conclusion it can support.
steps.observation: 檢查是否把某一階段的分析誤用為整橋所有狀態的證明。
steps.observationEn: Check whether evidence for one stage has been mistaken for proof of every bridge state.
steps.failure: 只交付漂亮模型，沒有資料版本、量測條件或待確認事項。
steps.failureEn: Delivering an attractive model without versions, measurement conditions or unresolved items.
steps.check: 以「已支持／未支持／需專業複核」分類至少五項判斷。
steps.checkEn: Classify at least five conclusions as supported, unsupported or requiring professional review.

knowledge.title: 證據對應
knowledge.text: 每項結論需對應適用狀態與資料，不能用一張圖概括全生命週期。
knowledge.textEn: Each conclusion requires applicable conditions and evidence; one sketch cannot cover an entire life cycle.

knowledge.title: 教育交付
knowledge.text: 課程完成代表學習證據齊備，不等於取得真橋施工或通行安全認證。
knowledge.textEn: Course completion records learning evidence, not construction or operational safety certification for the real bridge.

options: 只保留沒有圖例的完工圖像
刪除所有不確定事項以顯得完整
含來源版本、假設與未解問題的索引
optionsEn: Only a finished image without a key
Delete uncertainties to make the work look complete
An index with source versions, assumptions and open questions
quiz.question: 哪份交付最適合另一位工程學徒接續？
quiz.questionEn: Which handover best enables another learner to continue?
quiz.explanation: 可追溯性使下一位能看出已知與未知，避免把示意當定案。
quiz.explanationEn: Traceability distinguishes known from unknown and prevents treating a sketch as an approved design.

stages.title: 耐久與營運證據
stages.description: 把纜索、鋼構與感測紀錄連結到可追溯的維護判斷。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect cable, steelwork and sensor records to traceable maintenance decisions.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速」與「長週期模態與地震輸入」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder" and "Long-period modes and seismic input": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Truss flutter margin” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主跨接近 2 km 時，加勁梁的扭轉頻率與豎彎頻率都很低，風在某一速度下會讓兩者耦合成自激的顫振：氣動力隨扭轉角輸入能量，總阻尼由正轉負，振幅在數個週期內發散。明石海峽大橋採用約 35.5 m 寬、14 m 深的開放式鋼桁架，橋面設置格柵開口與中央垂直穩定板，目的是打亂橋面上下的壓力差、提高顫振臨界風速。桁架斷面的氣動導數與流線形箱梁差異很大，只能靠斷面模型與全橋模型試驗確定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the main span approaches 2 km, both the torsional and the vertical bending frequencies of the stiffening girder are very low, and at some wind speed the two couple into self-excited flutter: aerodynamic forces feed energy through the twist angle, total damping turns negative and the amplitude diverges within a few cycles. Akashi Kaikyo uses an open steel truss about 35.5 m wide and 14 m deep, with gratings in the deck and a central vertical stabiliser, to disrupt the pressure difference across the deck and raise the flutter onset speed. The aerodynamic derivatives of a truss differ greatly from those of a streamlined box, so they can only be fixed by section-model and full-bridge model tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Truss flutter margin” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Selberg 平板估算 U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Selberg flat-plate estimate U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Truss flutter margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速
knowledge.titleEn: Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder
knowledge.text: 主跨接近 2 km 時，加勁梁的扭轉頻率與豎彎頻率都很低，風在某一速度下會讓兩者耦合成自激的顫振：氣動力隨扭轉角輸入能量，總阻尼由正轉負，振幅在數個週期內發散。明石海峽大橋採用約 35.5 m 寬、14 m 深的開放式鋼桁架，橋面設置格柵開口與中央垂直穩定板，目的是打亂橋面上下的壓力差、提高顫振臨界風速。
knowledge.textEn: When the main span approaches 2 km, both the torsional and the vertical bending frequencies of the stiffening girder are very low, and at some wind speed the two couple into self-excited flutter: aerodynamic forces feed energy through the twist angle, total damping turns negative and the amplitude diverges within a few cycles. Akashi Kaikyo uses an open steel truss about 35.5 m wide and 14 m deep, with gratings in the deck and a central vertical stabiliser, to disrupt the pressure difference across the deck and raise the flutter onset speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder" is correct?
options: 桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。
主跨接近 2 km 時，加勁梁的扭轉頻率與豎彎頻率都很低，風在某一速度下會讓兩者耦合成自激的顫振：氣動力隨扭轉角輸入能量，總阻尼由正轉負，振幅在數個週期內發散。
懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。
optionsEn: A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter.

When the main span approaches 2 km, both the torsional and the vertical bending frequencies of the stiffening girder are very low, and at some wind speed the two couple into self-excited flutter: aerodynamic forces feed energy through the twist angle, total damping turns negative and the amplitude diverges within a few cycles.
A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it.
quiz.explanation: 主跨接近 2 km 時，加勁梁的扭轉頻率與豎彎頻率都很低，風在某一速度下會讓兩者耦合成自激的顫振：氣動力隨扭轉角輸入能量，總阻尼由正轉負，振幅在數個週期內發散。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When the main span approaches 2 km, both the torsional and the vertical bending frequencies of the stiffening girder are very low, and at some wind speed the two couple into self-excited flutter: aerodynamic forces feed energy through the twist angle, total damping turns negative and the amplitude diverges within a few cycles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Truss flutter margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Selberg 平板估算 U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]。取 B = 35.5 m、m = 44,000 kg/m、I = 6.0×10⁶ kg·m²/m、f_B = 0.065 Hz、f_T = 0.16 Hz、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³：ω_T = 1.005 rad/s，√(m·I)/(ρB³) = 513,800/55,920 = 9.19，U_F = 0.44×35.5×1.005×√(0.835×9.19) ≈ 43 m/s；f_T 提高到 0.18 Hz 時約 50 m/s。數值為教學假設，平板公式對桁架只作量級比較。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Selberg flat-plate estimate U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]. With B = 35.5 m, m = 44,000 kg/m, I = 6.0×10⁶ kg·m²/m, f_B = 0.065 Hz, f_T = 0.16 Hz and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³: ω_T = 1.005 rad/s, √(m·I)/(ρB³) = 513,800/55,920 = 9.19, so U_F = 0.44×35.5×1.005×√(0.835×9.19) ≈ 43 m/s; raising f_T to 0.18 Hz gives about 50 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions; for a truss the flat-plate formula only gives an order of magnitude. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斷面模型強迫振動試驗量測 Scanlan 氣動導數 H*、A*，代入多模態顫振分析求臨界風速，再與全橋氣彈模型在紊流中的發散風速比較；驗收以顫振臨界風速高於規範的照查風速（設計風速乘陣風與安全係數）為準，並檢查不同風攻角（例如 ±3°）下的最低值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Scanlan aerodynamic derivatives H* and A* with forced-oscillation section-model tests, feed them into a multi-mode flutter analysis, and compare the predicted onset speed with the divergence speed of a full aeroelastic model in turbulent flow; acceptance requires the flutter onset to exceed the code verification speed (design wind times gust and safety factors), checking the lowest value over angles of attack such as ±3°.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Selberg flat-plate estimate U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]. With B = 35.5 m, m = 44,000 kg/m, I = 6.0×10⁶ kg·m²/m, f_B = 0.065 Hz, f_T = 0.16 Hz and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³: ω_T = 1.005 rad/s, √(m·I)/(ρB³) = 513,800/55,920 = 9.19, so U_F = 0.44×35.5×1.005×√(0.835×9.19) ≈ 43 m/s; raising f_T to 0.18 Hz gives about 50 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions; for a truss the flat-plate formula only gives an order of magnitude.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder", which statement holds?
options: 水中混凝土只要配比強度夠高，澆置方式不影響品質。
地震後只要把橋塔推回原位，就能維持原設計線形。
Selberg 平板估算 U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]。
optionsEn: If the underwater mix is strong enough, the placing method does not affect quality.
After an earthquake you simply push the towers back to restore the design profile.
Selberg flat-plate estimate U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)].

quiz.explanationEn: Selberg flat-plate estimate U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Truss flutter margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以斷面模型強迫振動試驗量測 Scanlan 氣動導數 H*、A*，代入多模態顫振分析求臨界風速，再與全橋氣彈模型在紊流中的發散風速比較；驗收以顫振臨界風速高於規範的照查風速（設計風速乘陣風與安全係數）為準，並檢查不同風攻角（例如 ±3°）下的最低值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Scanlan aerodynamic derivatives H* and A* with forced-oscillation section-model tests, feed them into a multi-mode flutter analysis, and compare the predicted onset speed with the divergence speed of a full aeroelastic model in turbulent flow; acceptance requires the flutter onset to exceed the code verification speed (design wind times gust and safety factors), checking the lowest value over angles of attack such as ±3°. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何在加勁桁架上新增的檢修走道、管線或防護網，都要先由風工程師評估對格柵開孔率與穩定板的影響，必要時補做斷面模型試驗；維護計畫須把格柵清潔列為定期項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any walkway, duct or screen added to the stiffening truss must first be assessed by the wind engineer for its effect on grating porosity and the stabiliser, with a new section-model test if needed; the maintenance plan must list grating cleaning as a routine item.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沿用平板或箱梁的經驗值而未針對桁架做試驗，可能高估臨界風速；顫振一旦發生，扭轉振幅在數分鐘內增長，1940 年塔科馬海峽橋就是以扭轉發散破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Borrowing flat-plate or box-girder values without testing the truss can overestimate the onset speed; once flutter starts, torsional amplitude grows within minutes, as in the torsional collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以斷面模型強迫振動試驗量測 Scanlan 氣動導數 H*、A*，代入多模態顫振分析求臨界風速，再與全橋氣彈模型在紊流中的發散風速比較；驗收以顫振臨界風速高於規範的照查風速（設計風速乘陣風與安全係數）為準，並檢查不同風攻角（例如 ±3°）下的最低值。
knowledge.textEn: Measure Scanlan aerodynamic derivatives H* and A* with forced-oscillation section-model tests, feed them into a multi-mode flutter analysis, and compare the predicted onset speed with the divergence speed of a full aeroelastic model in turbulent flow; acceptance requires the flutter onset to exceed the code verification speed (design wind times gust and safety factors), checking the lowest value over angles of attack such as ±3°.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 任何在加勁桁架上新增的檢修走道、管線或防護網，都要先由風工程師評估對格柵開孔率與穩定板的影響，必要時補做斷面模型試驗；維護計畫須把格柵清潔列為定期項目。
knowledge.textEn: Any walkway, duct or screen added to the stiffening truss must first be assessed by the wind engineer for its effect on grating porosity and the stabiliser, with a new section-model test if needed; the maintenance plan must list grating cleaning as a routine item.

quiz.question: 要驗證「桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder"?
options: 以斷面模型強迫振動試驗量測 Scanlan 氣動導數 H*、A*，代入多模態顫振分析求臨界風速，再與全橋氣彈模型在紊流中的發散風速比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。
optionsEn: Measure Scanlan aerodynamic derivatives H* and A* with forced-oscillation section-model tests, feed them into a multi-mode flutter analysis, and compare the predicted onset speed with the divergence speed of a full aeroelastic model in turbulent flow.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration.
