quiz.explanationEn: Measure Scanlan aerodynamic derivatives H* and A* with forced-oscillation section-model tests, feed them into a multi-mode flutter analysis, and compare the predicted onset speed with the divergence speed of a full aeroelastic model in turbulent flow; acceptance requires the flutter onset to exceed the code verification speed (design wind times gust and safety factors), checking the lowest value over angles of attack such as ±3°. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Truss flutter margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沿用平板或箱梁的經驗值而未針對桁架做試驗，可能高估臨界風速；顫振一旦發生，扭轉振幅在數分鐘內增長，1940 年塔科馬海峽橋就是以扭轉發散破壞。格柵被雜物或後加設備堵塞，也會讓實橋氣動特性偏離試驗斷面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Borrowing flat-plate or box-girder values without testing the truss can overestimate the onset speed; once flutter starts, torsional amplitude grows within minutes, as in the torsional collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940. Gratings blocked by debris or later-added equipment also move the real deck away from the tested section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：桁架斷面的氣動導數與流線形箱梁差異很大，只能靠斷面模型與全橋模型試驗確定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The aerodynamic derivatives of a truss differ greatly from those of a streamlined box, so they can only be fixed by section-model and full-bridge model tests.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若沿用平板或箱梁的經驗值而未針對桁架做試驗，可能高估臨界風速；顫振一旦發生，扭轉振幅在數分鐘內增長，1940 年塔科馬海峽橋就是以扭轉發散破壞。格柵被雜物或後加設備堵塞，也會讓實橋氣動特性偏離試驗斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Borrowing flat-plate or box-girder values without testing the truss can overestimate the onset speed; once flutter starts, torsional amplitude grows within minutes, as in the torsional collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940. Gratings blocked by debris or later-added equipment also move the real deck away from the tested section.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若沿用平板或箱梁的經驗值而未針對桁架做試驗，可能高估臨界風速；顫振一旦發生，扭轉振幅在數分鐘內增長，1940 年塔科馬海峽橋就是以扭轉發散破壞。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Borrowing flat-plate or box-girder values without testing the truss can overestimate the onset speed.

steps.title: 長週期模態與地震輸入：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-period modes and seismic input: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「長週期豎彎模態」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-period vertical modes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸索橋的豎向勁度主要來自主纜的重力張力，而不是加勁梁的彎曲勁度，因此低階模態週期可長達十秒以上，像一條張緊的弦。這使主跨對短週期地震加速度不敏感，卻對長週期地震波、海峽地盤的大變位與基礎間的相對位移很敏感。明石海峽大橋的耐震設計考慮規模 8.5 級的板塊交界地震，並把基礎設在避開活動斷層的位置；但 1995 年兵庫縣南部地震的斷層錯動仍使地盤與基礎一起移動，提醒設計者：相對位移與絕對加速度是兩個不同的設計問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長週期豎彎模態」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The vertical stiffness of a suspension bridge comes mainly from the gravity tension in its main cables rather than the bending stiffness of the stiffening girder, so the lowest modes can have periods of more than ten seconds, like a taut string. The main span is therefore insensitive to short-period ground acceleration but sensitive to long-period waves, large ground displacement in the strait and relative movement between foundations. The Akashi Kaikyo design considered a magnitude 8.5 interplate earthquake and sited foundations away from active faults, yet in the 1995 Hyogo-ken Nanbu earthquake fault movement still carried the ground and foundations together, a reminder that relative displacement and absolute acceleration are two separate design problems. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-period vertical modes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以弦近似，反對稱第一豎彎頻率 f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In the string approximation the first antisymmetric vertical frequency is f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「長週期豎彎模態」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-period vertical modes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長週期模態與地震輸入
knowledge.text: 懸索橋的豎向勁度主要來自主纜的重力張力，而不是加勁梁的彎曲勁度，因此低階模態週期可長達十秒以上，像一條張緊的弦。這使主跨對短週期地震加速度不敏感，卻對長週期地震波、海峽地盤的大變位與基礎間的相對位移很敏感。
knowledge.textEn: The vertical stiffness of a suspension bridge comes mainly from the gravity tension in its main cables rather than the bending stiffness of the stiffening girder, so the lowest modes can have periods of more than ten seconds, like a taut string. The main span is therefore insensitive to short-period ground acceleration but sensitive to long-period waves, large ground displacement in the strait and relative movement between foundations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長週期模態與地震輸入」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-period modes and seismic input" is correct?
options: 懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。
鋼絲強度越高，主纜就越不需要防蝕。
懸索橋的豎向勁度主要來自主纜的重力張力，而不是加勁梁的彎曲勁度，因此低階模態週期可長達十秒以上，像一條張緊的弦。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it.
The stronger the wire, the less corrosion protection the cable needs.

The vertical stiffness of a suspension bridge comes mainly from the gravity tension in its main cables rather than the bending stiffness of the stiffening girder, so the lowest modes can have periods of more than ten seconds, like a taut string.
quiz.explanation: 懸索橋的豎向勁度主要來自主纜的重力張力，而不是加勁梁的彎曲勁度，因此低階模態週期可長達十秒以上，像一條張緊的弦。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The vertical stiffness of a suspension bridge comes mainly from the gravity tension in its main cables rather than the bending stiffness of the stiffening girder, so the lowest modes can have periods of more than ten seconds, like a taut string. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長週期模態與地震輸入：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-period modes and seismic input: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長週期豎彎模態」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-period vertical modes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以弦近似，反對稱第一豎彎頻率 f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m)。取兩纜合計 H = 1,074 MN、m = 44,000 kg/m、l = 1,991 m：√(1.074×10⁹/44,000) = 156 m/s，f ≈ 156/1,991 = 0.078 Hz，週期約 12.7 s。若 m 增加 10%，週期增為約 13.4 s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In the string approximation the first antisymmetric vertical frequency is f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m). With H = 1,074 MN for both cables, m = 44,000 kg/m and l = 1,991 m: √(1.074×10⁹/44,000) = 156 m/s, f ≈ 156/1,991 = 0.078 Hz and the period is about 12.7 s. A 10% increase in m lengthens the period to about 13.4 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把手算弦頻率與有限元素模態分析比較，確認前幾個模態的形狀（對稱、反對稱、側向、扭轉）與排序；耐震檢核需同時輸入長週期設計波與各基礎不同步的地盤位移，並把塔頂、索鞍與伸縮縫的相對位移與容許值逐一比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the hand string frequency with finite-element modal analysis, confirming the shape and order of the first modes (symmetric, antisymmetric, lateral, torsional); seismic checks must input long-period design motions and non-synchronous ground displacement at each foundation, comparing relative displacement at tower tops, saddles and expansion joints with their allowances.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: In the string approximation the first antisymmetric vertical frequency is f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m). With H = 1,074 MN for both cables, m = 44,000 kg/m and l = 1,991 m: √(1.074×10⁹/44,000) = 156 m/s, f ≈ 156/1,991 = 0.078 Hz and the period is about 12.7 s. A 10% increase in m lengthens the period to about 13.4 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長週期模態與地震輸入」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-period modes and seismic input", which statement holds?
options: 以弦近似，反對稱第一豎彎頻率 f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m)。
索股垂度只要白天量一次，誤差幾公分不影響主纜受力。
全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。
optionsEn: In the string approximation the first antisymmetric vertical frequency is f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m).
Measuring strand sag once in daytime is fine; a few centimetres of error do not affect cable forces.
A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge.
quiz.explanation: 以弦近似，反對稱第一豎彎頻率 f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: In the string approximation the first antisymmetric vertical frequency is f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長週期模態與地震輸入：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-period modes and seismic input: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長週期豎彎模態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-period vertical modes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把手算弦頻率與有限元素模態分析比較，確認前幾個模態的形狀（對稱、反對稱、側向、扭轉）與排序；耐震檢核需同時輸入長週期設計波與各基礎不同步的地盤位移，並把塔頂、索鞍與伸縮縫的相對位移與容許值逐一比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the hand string frequency with finite-element modal analysis, confirming the shape and order of the first modes (symmetric, antisymmetric, lateral, torsional); seismic checks must input long-period design motions and non-synchronous ground displacement at each foundation, comparing relative displacement at tower tops, saddles and expansion joints with their allowances. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐震設計書應列出各基礎的地盤位移假設與斷層位置圖，並把相對位移需求寫進伸縮縫、支承與索鞍的採購規格；完工後的模態實測要回饋修正模型，作為日後事件評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The seismic design report should list ground-displacement assumptions for each foundation with a fault-location map, and write the relative-displacement demand into expansion-joint, bearing and saddle specifications; measured modes after completion must update the model as the baseline for future event assessments.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用單一同步地震波分析時，會低估塔與錨碇之間的相對位移，伸縮縫、支承與索鞍可能超出行程；長週期波若與主跨低階模態接近，加勁梁位移可能遠大於以加速度反應譜估算的結果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Analysing with a single synchronous record underestimates relative movement between towers and anchorages, so expansion joints, bearings and saddles may exceed their travel; long-period waves near the low modes of the main span can produce girder displacements far larger than an acceleration-spectrum estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把手算弦頻率與有限元素模態分析比較，確認前幾個模態的形狀（對稱、反對稱、側向、扭轉）與排序；耐震檢核需同時輸入長週期設計波與各基礎不同步的地盤位移，並把塔頂、索鞍與伸縮縫的相對位移與容許值逐一比對。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the hand string frequency with finite-element modal analysis, confirming the shape and order of the first modes (symmetric, antisymmetric, lateral, torsional); seismic checks must input long-period design motions and non-synchronous ground displacement at each foundation, comparing relative displacement at tower tops, saddles and expansion joints with their allowances.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 耐震設計書應列出各基礎的地盤位移假設與斷層位置圖，並把相對位移需求寫進伸縮縫、支承與索鞍的採購規格；完工後的模態實測要回饋修正模型，作為日後事件評估的基準。
knowledge.textEn: The seismic design report should list ground-displacement assumptions for each foundation with a fault-location map, and write the relative-displacement demand into expansion-joint, bearing and saddle specifications; measured modes after completion must update the model as the baseline for future event assessments.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長週期模態與地震輸入」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-period modes and seismic input"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把手算弦頻率與有限元素模態分析比較，確認前幾個模態的形狀（對稱、反對稱、側向、扭轉）與排序。
主纜外面有鍍鋅纏絲與塗裝，內部就不會潮濕。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compare the hand string frequency with finite-element modal analysis, confirming the shape and order of the first modes (symmetric, antisymmetric, lateral, torsional).
With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet.
quiz.explanation: 把手算弦頻率與有限元素模態分析比較，確認前幾個模態的形狀（對稱、反對稱、側向、扭轉）與排序；耐震檢核需同時輸入長週期設計波與各基礎不同步的地盤位移，並把塔頂、索鞍與伸縮縫的相對位移與容許值逐一比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the hand string frequency with finite-element modal analysis, confirming the shape and order of the first modes (symmetric, antisymmetric, lateral, torsional); seismic checks must input long-period design motions and non-synchronous ground displacement at each foundation, comparing relative displacement at tower tops, saddles and expansion joints with their allowances. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長週期模態與地震輸入：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-period modes and seismic input: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長週期豎彎模態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-period vertical modes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用單一同步地震波分析時，會低估塔與錨碇之間的相對位移，伸縮縫、支承與索鞍可能超出行程；長週期波若與主跨低階模態接近，加勁梁位移可能遠大於以加速度反應譜估算的結果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Analysing with a single synchronous record underestimates relative movement between towers and anchorages, so expansion joints, bearings and saddles may exceed their travel; long-period waves near the low modes of the main span can produce girder displacements far larger than an acceleration-spectrum estimate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：明石海峽大橋的耐震設計考慮規模 8.5 級的板塊交界地震，並把基礎設在避開活動斷層的位置；但 1995 年兵庫縣南部地震的斷層錯動仍使地盤與基礎一起移動，提醒設計者：相對位移與絕對加速度是兩個不同的設計問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Akashi Kaikyo design considered a magnitude 8.5 interplate earthquake and sited foundations away from active faults, yet in the 1995 Hyogo-ken Nanbu earthquake fault movement still carried the ground and foundations together, a reminder that relative displacement and absolute acceleration are two separate design problems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用單一同步地震波分析時，會低估塔與錨碇之間的相對位移，伸縮縫、支承與索鞍可能超出行程；長週期波若與主跨低階模態接近，加勁梁位移可能遠大於以加速度反應譜估算的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Analysing with a single synchronous record underestimates relative movement between towers and anchorages, so expansion joints, bearings and saddles may exceed their travel; long-period waves near the low modes of the main span can produce girder displacements far larger than an acceleration-spectrum estimate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長週期模態與地震輸入」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-period modes and seismic input" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼絲強度越高，主纜就越不需要防蝕。
只用單一同步地震波分析時，會低估塔與錨碇之間的相對位移，伸縮縫、支承與索鞍可能超出行程。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The stronger the wire, the less corrosion protection the cable needs.
Analysing with a single synchronous record underestimates relative movement between towers and anchorages, so expansion joints, bearings and saddles may exceed their travel.
quiz.explanation: 只用單一同步地震波分析時，會低估塔與錨碇之間的相對位移，伸縮縫、支承與索鞍可能超出行程；長週期波若與主跨低階模態接近，加勁梁位移可能遠大於以加速度反應譜估算的結果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Analysing with a single synchronous record underestimates relative movement between towers and anchorages, so expansion joints, bearings and saddles may exceed their travel; long-period waves near the low modes of the main span can produce girder displacements far larger than an acceleration-spectrum estimate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強度鋼絲與單纜斷面」與「設置沉箱與抗水洗混凝土」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High-strength wire and the single-cable section" and "Laying-down caisson and antiwashout concrete": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高強度鋼絲與單纜斷面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: High-strength wire and the single-cable section: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1,760 N/mm² 鍍鋅鋼絲」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1,760 N/mm² galvanised wire” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜是懸索橋最難更換的構件，其強度決定跨度上限。本州四國連絡橋公團公開說明：若沿用 160 kgf/mm²（約 1,570 N/mm²）鋼絲，明石海峽大橋每側需要兩條約 1,000 mm 的主纜；開發 180 kgf/mm²（約 1,760 N/mm²，製造商資料稱 1,770 MPa 級）鋼絲後，每側只需一條約 1,100 mm 主纜。每條主纜由 290 股、每股 127 根 5.23 mm 鍍鋅鋼絲組成。鋼絲強度提高也提高了工作應力，因此鍍鋅層、乾燥空氣與疲勞細部變得更關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1,760 N/mm² 鍍鋅鋼絲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 高強度鋼絲與單纜斷面：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1,760 N/mm² galvanised wire” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單絲面積 a = π/4×5.23² = 21.48 mm²，每纜 290×127 = 36,830 根，A = 36,830×21.48 ≈ 791,200 mm²；破斷力 = 791,200×1,760 ≈ 1,393 MN。若用 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲提供相同破斷力需 886,900 mm²，多約 12%。主纜外徑約 1.122 m，毛面積 0.989 m²，空隙率 = 1 − 0.791/0.989 ≈ 20%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wire area a = π/4×5.23² = 21.48 mm², with 290×127 = 36,830 wires per cable, A = 36,830×21.48 ≈ 791,200 mm²; breaking force = 791,200×1,760 ≈ 1,393 MN. Supplying the same force with 1,570 N/mm² wire needs 886,900 mm², about 12% more. With an outer diameter of about 1.122 m the gross area is 0.989 m² and the void ratio = 1 − 0.791/0.989 ≈ 20%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼絲出廠要逐捲抽驗抗拉強度、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗及鍍鋅附著量（製造商資料指出長大橋鋼絲鍍鋅量常在 300 g/m² 以上），索股完成後量測長度標記與直徑；架設後以纜徑量測與空隙率計算確認擠壓品質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample every coil for tensile strength, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests and zinc coating mass (the steelmaker notes that long-span bridge wire is usually coated with 300 g/m² or more), check length marks and diameter on each finished strand, and after erection confirm squeezing quality by measured cable diameter and computed void ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 鋼絲出廠要逐捲抽驗抗拉強度、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗及鍍鋅附著量（製造商資料指出長大橋鋼絲鍍鋅量常在 300 g/m² 以上），索股完成後量測長度標記與直徑；架設後以纜徑量測與空隙率計算確認擠壓品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Wire specifications must set strength, ductility indicators such as torsion turns and zinc mass together, with every coil traceable to its heat; squeezing and wrapping must protect the zinc from scratches, and repair methods and acceptance for damaged spots must be approved in advance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高強度鋼絲對氫脆與應力腐蝕更敏感，鍍鋅層若在運輸或擠壓時刮傷，加上潮濕空氣，就可能出現局部腐蝕坑與脆性斷絲；斷絲在纜內不易察覺，累積到一定比例才顯現為安全係數下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High-strength wire is more sensitive to hydrogen embrittlement and stress corrosion; zinc scratched during transport or squeezing, combined with humid air, can start local pits and brittle wire breaks that are hard to see inside the cable and only appear as a loss of safety factor once enough have accumulated. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 主塔基礎位於水深約 60 m、潮流最大約 8 節的海峽中，無法築圍堰抽乾。做法是先開挖整平海床，再把工廠製造的雙壁圓形鋼沉箱拖航到位、灌水沉放（設置沉箱工法），然後在沉箱內以抗水洗水中混凝土分層澆置，讓鋼殼成為永久模板。2P 沉箱外徑 80 m、內徑 56 m、高約 65 m，內核混凝土約 270,000 m³；基礎周邊再鋪濾層與拋石防止強潮流沖刷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「2P 鋼沉箱與水中混凝土」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The tower foundations sit in about 60 m of water with tidal currents up to about 8 knots, where no cofferdam can be pumped dry. The seabed is excavated and levelled, a factory-built double-walled circular steel caisson is towed into place and ballasted down (the laying-down caisson method), and antiwashout underwater concrete is then placed in layers inside it, the steel shell acting as permanent formwork. The 2P caisson is 80 m in outer diameter, 56 m inner, about 65 m high, with about 270,000 m³ of core concrete; filter layers and rock armour around it resist scour by the strong currents. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “2P steel caisson and underwater concrete” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：內核面積 = π/4×56² ≈ 2,463 m²，每層 4 m，單次澆置約 2,463×4 ≈ 9,850 m³，連續約 72 h，平均 9,850/72 ≈ 137 m³/h；六台泵各 110 m³/h，總能力 660 m³/h，平均利用率約 21%。

steps.title: 設置沉箱與抗水洗混凝土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Laying-down caisson and antiwashout concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「2P 鋼沉箱與水中混凝土」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2P steel caisson and underwater concrete” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：內核面積 = π/4×56² ≈ 2,463 m²，每層 4 m，單次澆置約 2,463×4 ≈ 9,850 m³，連續約 72 h，平均 9,850/72 ≈ 137 m³/h；六台泵各 110 m³/h，總能力 660 m³/h，平均利用率約 21%。24 支澆置管平均各負責 2,463/24 ≈ 103 m²，等效半徑 √(103/π) ≈ 5.7 m，小於 8 m 流動距離上限。面積與層厚引自公開論文，其餘為推算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Core area = π/4×56² ≈ 2,463 m²; with 4 m layers each pour is about 2,463×4 ≈ 9,850 m³, placed continuously over about 72 h, an average of 9,850/72 ≈ 137 m³/h; six pumps of 110 m³/h give 660 m³/h of capacity, about 21% average utilisation. Each of 24 tremie pipes serves about 2,463/24 ≈ 103 m², an equivalent radius of √(103/π) ≈ 5.7 m, within the 8 m flow-distance limit. Area and layer thickness come from a published paper; the rest is derived. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置中以測深錘或感測器追蹤各管周邊混凝土面高程，確保管口埋入深度與層面平整；試體量測水中與氣中強度比、坍流度與凝結時間；完成後鑽心取樣檢查層間結合與空洞，並以海床測深監測沉箱周邊沖刷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During placement track the concrete surface around each pipe with sounding weights or sensors to keep pipe embedment and a level surface; test specimens for the underwater-to-air strength ratio, slump flow and setting time; afterwards core through layers to check bond and voids, and monitor scour around the caisson by seabed soundings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 設置沉箱與抗水洗混凝土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Laying-down caisson and antiwashout concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「2P 鋼沉箱與水中混凝土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “2P steel caisson and underwater concrete” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置中以測深錘或感測器追蹤各管周邊混凝土面高程，確保管口埋入深度與層面平整；試體量測水中與氣中強度比、坍流度與凝結時間；完成後鑽心取樣檢查層間結合與空洞，並以海床測深監測沉箱周邊沖刷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During placement track the concrete surface around each pipe with sounding weights or sensors to keep pipe embedment and a level surface; test specimens for the underwater-to-air strength ratio, slump flow and setting time; afterwards core through layers to check bond and voids, and monitor scour around the caisson by seabed soundings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：水中混凝土計畫應規定管口最小埋深、最大流動距離、層間間隔時間與停止條件，並在試驗槽先做足尺試澆；沉箱就位精度與海床整平度列為進入澆置前的停留點，由監造簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The underwater concreting plan must fix minimum pipe embedment, maximum flow distance, layer interval and stop conditions, with a full-scale trial pour in a test tank; caisson positioning accuracy and seabed levelness are hold points signed by the supervising engineer before placement begins.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水中混凝土若抗水洗性不足或管口拔出，水泥漿被潮流帶走，形成骨材鬆散層與層間弱面；某一區流動距離過長則產生材料分離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concrete with poor washout resistance, or a pipe lifted out of the mass, lets the current strip the paste and leaves loose aggregate and weak layer joints; excessive flow distance in one zone causes segregation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 設置沉箱與抗水洗混凝土：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Laying-down caisson and antiwashout concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「2P 鋼沉箱與水中混凝土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “2P steel caisson and underwater concrete” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水中混凝土若抗水洗性不足或管口拔出，水泥漿被潮流帶走，形成骨材鬆散層與層間弱面；某一區流動距離過長則產生材料分離。基礎周邊沖刷若未及時防護，可能淘空沉箱邊緣、降低承載與抗傾覆能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete with poor washout resistance, or a pipe lifted out of the mass, lets the current strip the paste and leaves loose aggregate and weak layer joints; excessive flow distance in one zone causes segregation. Unchecked scour around the foundation can undermine the caisson edge and reduce bearing and overturning capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2P 沉箱外徑 80 m、內徑 56 m、高約 65 m，內核混凝土約 270,000 m³；基礎周邊再鋪濾層與拋石防止強潮流沖刷。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水中混凝土只要配比強度夠高，澆置方式不影響品質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 索股垂度的溫度敏感度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature sensitivity of strand sag: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預製平行鋼絲索股垂度」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “PWS strand sag” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 明石海峽大橋以預製平行鋼絲索股（PWS）架設主纜：每股 127 根鋼絲在工廠成束、端部預裝錨頭，再沿導索與貓道牽引過海峽，290 股依序放入索鞍。每一股都必須調整到與基準索股相同的垂度，否則擠壓成纜後各股受力不均。由於主纜長度隨溫度伸縮，而垂度對長度變化極為敏感，調整通常安排在夜間溫度穩定、索股內外溫差小的時段，並以溫度修正量測值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預製平行鋼絲索股垂度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Akashi Kaikyo's main cables were erected with prefabricated parallel-wire strands (PWS): each bundle of 127 wires is made in the factory with sockets fitted at the ends, hauled across the strait along guide ropes and catwalks, and the 290 strands are placed in the saddles in sequence. Every strand must be adjusted to the same sag as the reference strand, otherwise the wires share load unequally after squeezing. Because cable length changes with temperature and sag is very sensitive to length, adjustment is usually done at night when temperatures are stable and the difference between strand surface and core is small, with temperature-corrected readings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “PWS strand sag” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拋物線纜長 S ≈ l + 8f²/(3l)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Parabolic cable length S ≈ l + 8f²/(3l).

steps.title: 索股垂度的溫度敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature sensitivity of strand sag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預製平行鋼絲索股垂度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “PWS strand sag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拋物線纜長 S ≈ l + 8f²/(3l)。取 l = 1,991 m、f = 199.1 m（垂跨比 1/10）：S ≈ 1,991 + 53.1 = 2,044.1 m。溫度上升 1 °C，ΔS = 1.2×10⁻⁵×2,044.1 ≈ 0.0245 m，Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS = 1.875×0.0245 ≈ 0.046 m。也就是每 1 °C 垂度約改變 46 mm，5 °C 溫差即約 230 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Parabolic cable length S ≈ l + 8f²/(3l). With l = 1,991 m and f = 199.1 m (sag ratio 1/10): S ≈ 1,991 + 53.1 = 2,044.1 m. A 1 °C rise gives ΔS = 1.2×10⁻⁵×2,044.1 ≈ 0.0245 m and Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS = 1.875×0.0245 ≈ 0.046 m, so sag changes by about 46 mm per °C and a 5 °C error means about 230 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：基準索股以全站儀或水準量測跨中與邊跨垂度，配合多點索股溫度計取平均溫度修正；其他索股以相對於基準股的高差量測調整，允收以修正後高差在數毫米至十餘毫米內為準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure mid-span and side-span sag of the reference strand by total station or levelling with multi-point strand thermometers for temperature correction; adjust other strands by their height difference relative to the reference, accepting corrected differences within a few to about a dozen millimetres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Parabolic cable length S ≈ l + 8f²/(3l). With l = 1,991 m and f = 199.1 m (sag ratio 1/10): S ≈ 1,991 + 53.1 = 2,044.1 m. A 1 °C rise gives ΔS = 1.2×10⁻⁵×2,044.1 ≈ 0.0245 m and Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS = 1.875×0.0245 ≈ 0.046 m, so sag changes by about 46 mm per °C and a 5 °C error means about 230 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「索股垂度的溫度敏感度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 索股垂度的溫度敏感度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature sensitivity of strand sag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預製平行鋼絲索股垂度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “PWS strand sag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 基準索股以全站儀或水準量測跨中與邊跨垂度，配合多點索股溫度計取平均溫度修正；其他索股以相對於基準股的高差量測調整，允收以修正後高差在數毫米至十餘毫米內為準。每日記錄氣溫、風速與量測時間，作為異常時的回溯依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure mid-span and side-span sag of the reference strand by total station or levelling with multi-point strand thermometers for temperature correction; adjust other strands by their height difference relative to the reference, accepting corrected differences within a few to about a dozen millimetres. Log air temperature, wind speed and time daily as a trace for anomalies. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索股調整的量測時段、溫度計位置與修正公式應寫入施工規範；基準索股須定期複測，若連續數股偏差同向，先停工檢查基準點與溫度修正，再繼續牽引。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should fix the measuring window, thermometer positions and correction formula for strand adjustment; the reference strand must be re-surveyed periodically, and if several strands deviate in the same direction, stop to check the benchmarks and temperature correction before hauling more.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：日間陽光照射使上層索股比下層熱數度，若此時調整，夜間冷卻後各股垂度不一，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲長期過載、部分鬆弛；鬆弛鋼絲在纜內會形成鼓起，影響索夾夾緊與防護包覆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adjusting in daytime sun, when top strands run several degrees warmer than lower ones, leaves unequal sags after night cooling; once squeezed, some wires are permanently overloaded and others slack, and slack wires bulge inside the cable, spoiling cable-band clamping and wrapping. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 基準索股以全站儀或水準量測跨中與邊跨垂度，配合多點索股溫度計取平均溫度修正；其他索股以相對於基準股的高差量測調整，允收以修正後高差在數毫米至十餘毫米內為準。每日記錄氣溫、風速與量測時間，作為異常時的回溯依據。
knowledge.textEn: Measure mid-span and side-span sag of the reference strand by total station or levelling with multi-point strand thermometers for temperature correction; adjust other strands by their height difference relative to the reference, accepting corrected differences within a few to about a dozen millimetres. Log air temperature, wind speed and time daily as a trace for anomalies.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 索股調整的量測時段、溫度計位置與修正公式應寫入施工規範；基準索股須定期複測，若連續數股偏差同向，先停工檢查基準點與溫度修正，再繼續牽引。

quiz.question: 要驗證「索股垂度的溫度敏感度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature sensitivity of strand sag"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
基準索股以全站儀或水準量測跨中與邊跨垂度，配合多點索股溫度計取平均溫度修正；其他索股以相對於基準股的高差量測調整，允收以修正後高差在數毫米至十餘毫米內為準。

steps.title: 索股垂度的溫度敏感度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature sensitivity of strand sag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預製平行鋼絲索股垂度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “PWS strand sag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 日間陽光照射使上層索股比下層熱數度，若此時調整，夜間冷卻後各股垂度不一，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲長期過載、部分鬆弛；鬆弛鋼絲在纜內會形成鼓起，影響索夾夾緊與防護包覆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adjusting in daytime sun, when top strands run several degrees warmer than lower ones, leaves unequal sags after night cooling; once squeezed, some wires are permanently overloaded and others slack, and slack wires bulge inside the cable, spoiling cable-band clamping and wrapping. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於主纜長度隨溫度伸縮，而垂度對長度變化極為敏感，調整通常安排在夜間溫度穩定、索股內外溫差小的時段，並以溫度修正量測值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because cable length changes with temperature and sag is very sensitive to length, adjustment is usually done at night when temperatures are stable and the difference between strand surface and core is small, with temperature-corrected readings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索股垂度只要白天量一次，誤差幾公分不影響主纜受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Measuring strand sag once in daytime is fine; a few centimetres of error do not affect cable forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 日間陽光照射使上層索股比下層熱數度，若此時調整，夜間冷卻後各股垂度不一，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲長期過載、部分鬆弛；鬆弛鋼絲在纜內會形成鼓起，影響索夾夾緊與防護包覆。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「索股垂度的溫度敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature sensitivity of strand sag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
地震後只要把橋塔推回原位，就能維持原設計線形。
日間陽光照射使上層索股比下層熱數度，若此時調整，夜間冷卻後各股垂度不一，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲長期過載、部分鬆弛；鬆弛鋼絲在纜內會形成鼓起，影響索夾夾緊與防護包覆。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
After an earthquake you simply push the towers back to restore the design profile.
Adjusting in daytime sun, when top strands run several degrees warmer than lower ones, leaves unequal sags after night cooling.
quiz.explanation: 日間陽光照射使上層索股比下層熱數度，若此時調整，夜間冷卻後各股垂度不一，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲長期過載、部分鬆弛；鬆弛鋼絲在纜內會形成鼓起，影響索夾夾緊與防護包覆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adjusting in daytime sun, when top strands run several degrees warmer than lower ones, leaves unequal sags after night cooling; once squeezed, some wires are permanently overloaded and others slack, and slack wires bulge inside the cable, spoiling cable-band clamping and wrapping. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 跨徑變化後的垂度與桁段修正：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sag change and truss correction after the span grew: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1995 年地震後桁段加長」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-1995 truss lengthening” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 1995 年 1 月 17 日地震發生時，主塔已完成、所有索股已架設，正在進行主纜擠壓，加勁桁尚未架設。斷層錯動使基礎隨地盤移動，中央跨徑約增加 0.8 m。由於主纜長度已固定，跨徑變長意味著垂度變小、張力略增；設計團隊重新計算後，把尚未製造的加勁桁構件在中央跨加長 800 mm、淡路側邊跨加長 340 mm，使完工線形仍與主纜幾何相容。公開論文指出中央跨垂度約減少 1.3 m，主纜張力增加約為原設計最大張力的 0.6%，仍在容許範圍內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1995 年地震後桁段加長」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the earthquake struck on 17 January 1995 the towers were complete and all strands erected, cable squeezing was in progress and the stiffening truss had not yet been erected. Fault movement carried the foundations with the ground and lengthened the centre span by about 0.8 m. With the cable length already fixed, a longer span means less sag and slightly more tension; after re-analysis the team lengthened truss members not yet fabricated by 800 mm in the centre span and 340 mm in the Awaji side span so that the completed profile stayed compatible with the cable geometry. The published paper reports a centre-span sag reduction of about 1.3 m and an extra cable tension of about 0.6% of the original maximum, within the allowable. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-1995 truss lengthening” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：纜長固定時 dS = (1 − 8n²/3)·dl + (16f/(3l))·df = 0，故 df = −dl·(1 − 8n²/3)·3l/(16f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With fixed cable length dS = (1 − 8n²/3)·dl + (16f/(3l))·df = 0, so df = −dl·(1 − 8n²/3)·3l/(16f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震後只要把橋塔推回原位，就能維持原設計線形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After an earthquake you simply push the towers back to restore the design profile." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1995 年地震後桁段加長」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-1995 truss lengthening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 跨徑變化後的垂度與桁段修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sag change and truss correction after the span grew: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1995 年地震後桁段加長」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-1995 truss lengthening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：纜長固定時 dS = (1 − 8n²/3)·dl + (16f/(3l))·df = 0，故 df = −dl·(1 − 8n²/3)·3l/(16f)。取 n = 0.1、l = 1,991 m、f = 199.1 m、dl = 0.8 m：df = −0.8×0.973×1.875 ≈ −1.46 m。不可伸長假設高估了垂度變化；實際張力增加使主纜彈性伸長、塔頂也有變位，公開報告值約 1.3 m。n 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With fixed cable length dS = (1 − 8n²/3)·dl + (16f/(3l))·df = 0, so df = −dl·(1 − 8n²/3)·3l/(16f). With n = 0.1, l = 1,991 m, f = 199.1 m and dl = 0.8 m: df = −0.8×0.973×1.875 ≈ −1.46 m. The inextensible assumption overestimates the change; the extra tension stretches the cable elastically and the tower tops also move, and the published value is about 1.3 m. n is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：事件後以 GPS 與精密測量重新建立各基礎與塔頂座標，量測主纜各跨垂度與索鞍位置，回饋到完工線形分析；加長的桁段在工廠以修正圖說製造，架設中逐段比對節點高程與預測值，最終與設計車道縱斷面比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After the event re-establish coordinates of every foundation and tower top by GPS and precise survey, measure cable sag in each span and saddle positions, and feed them into the final-profile analysis; fabricate the lengthened members to revised drawings and compare node levels with predictions segment by segment during erection, finally checking against the design road profile.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With n = 0.1, l = 1,991 m, f = 199.1 m and dl = 0.8 m: df = −0.8×0.973×1.875 ≈ −1.46 m. knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨徑變化後的垂度與桁段修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter.

steps.title: 跨徑變化後的垂度與桁段修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sag change and truss correction after the span grew: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1995 年地震後桁段加長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-1995 truss lengthening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 事件後以 GPS 與精密測量重新建立各基礎與塔頂座標，量測主纜各跨垂度與索鞍位置，回饋到完工線形分析；加長的桁段在工廠以修正圖說製造，架設中逐段比對節點高程與預測值，最終與設計車道縱斷面比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After the event re-establish coordinates of every foundation and tower top by GPS and precise survey, measure cable sag in each span and saddle positions, and feed them into the final-profile analysis; fabricate the lengthened members to revised drawings and compare node levels with predictions segment by segment during erection, finally checking against the design road profile. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型懸索橋施工期間應持續保存基礎、塔頂與主纜的測量基準與時間序列，並預先規劃「事件後重新測量—重算線形—修正未製構件」的決策流程與核准層級；修正圖說須由設計者簽認後才可投料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: During construction of a major suspension bridge keep survey baselines and time series for foundations, tower tops and cables, and plan in advance the decision path of post-event survey, profile re-analysis and revision of unfabricated members with its approval levels; revised drawings must be signed by the designer before steel is cut.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沿用原設計長度製造加勁桁，桁段與吊索幾何不相容，合龍時會出現強迫的拉壓力與伸縮縫錯位；未重新檢核塔底應力與主纜張力，也可能低估地震造成的永久附加應力（公開論文報告塔底附加應力最大約 18.2 N/mm²）。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fabricating the truss to the original lengths would make segments incompatible with hanger geometry, forcing tension and compression at closure and misaligning expansion joints; skipping a re-check of tower-base stress and cable tension could miss the permanent added stress from the quake (the paper reports up to about 18.2 N/mm² at the tower base). A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 若沿用原設計長度製造加勁桁，桁段與吊索幾何不相容，合龍時會出現強迫的拉壓力與伸縮縫錯位；未重新檢核塔底應力與主纜張力，也可能低估地震造成的永久附加應力（公開論文報告塔底附加應力最大約 18.2 N/mm²）。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地震後只要把橋塔推回原位，就能維持原設計線形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沿用原設計長度製造加勁桁，桁段與吊索幾何不相容，合龍時會出現強迫的拉壓力與伸縮縫錯位；未重新檢核塔底應力與主纜張力，也可能低估地震造成的永久附加應力（公開論文報告塔底附加應力最大約 18.2 N/mm²）。
knowledge.textEn: Fabricating the truss to the original lengths would make segments incompatible with hanger geometry, forcing tension and compression at closure and misaligning expansion joints; skipping a re-check of tower-base stress and cable tension could miss the permanent added stress from the quake (the paper reports up to about 18.2 N/mm² at the tower base).

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「跨徑變化後的垂度與桁段修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sag change and truss correction after the span grew" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若沿用原設計長度製造加勁桁，桁段與吊索幾何不相容，合龍時會出現強迫的拉壓力與伸縮縫錯位。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。
optionsEn: Fabricating the truss to the original lengths would make segments incompatible with hanger geometry, forcing tension and compression at closure and misaligning expansion joints.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge.
quiz.explanation: 若沿用原設計長度製造加勁桁，桁段與吊索幾何不相容，合龍時會出現強迫的拉壓力與伸縮縫錯位；未重新檢核塔底應力與主纜張力，也可能低估地震造成的永久附加應力（公開論文報告塔底附加應力最大約 18.2 N/mm²）。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fabricating the truss to the original lengths would make segments incompatible with hanger geometry, forcing tension and compression at closure and misaligning expansion joints; skipping a re-check of tower-base stress and cable tension could miss the permanent added stress from the quake (the paper reports up to about 18.2 N/mm² at the tower base). Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」與「長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records" and "Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「全橋氣彈模型與颱風實測」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full model and typhoon records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斷面模型只能代表二維流場，懸索橋的顫振與抖振卻牽涉多個三維模態、主纜與塔的氣動力，以及沿跨長變化的紊流。明石海峽大橋因此在大型風洞中做全橋氣彈模型試驗，模型需同時滿足幾何、質量、勁度與重力相似，以 Froude 相似律換算風速與頻率；完工後研究者再以颱風期間的風速計、加速度計與 GPS 實測，比對抖振位移與模態阻尼，驗證設計假設。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「全橋氣彈模型與颱風實測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A section model represents only two-dimensional flow, while flutter and buffeting of a suspension bridge involve several three-dimensional modes, aerodynamic forces on cables and towers, and turbulence that varies along the span. Akashi Kaikyo was therefore tested with a full aeroelastic model in a large wind tunnel, which must reproduce geometry, mass, stiffness and gravity together, with wind speed and frequency scaled by Froude similarity; after completion researchers compared buffeting displacement and modal damping with anemometer, accelerometer and GPS records from typhoons to validate the design assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full model and typhoon records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Froude 相似：長度比 λ = 1/100 時，風速比 √λ = 1/10、頻率比 1/√λ = 10、單位長質量比 λ² = 1/10,000。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Froude similarity: with length scale λ = 1/100, velocity scales by √λ = 1/10, frequency by 1/√λ = 10 and mass per length by λ² = 1/10,000.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「全橋氣彈模型與颱風實測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full model and typhoon records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對
knowledge.titleEn: Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records
knowledge.text: 斷面模型只能代表二維流場，懸索橋的顫振與抖振卻牽涉多個三維模態、主纜與塔的氣動力，以及沿跨長變化的紊流。明石海峽大橋因此在大型風洞中做全橋氣彈模型試驗，模型需同時滿足幾何、質量、勁度與重力相似，以 Froude 相似律換算風速與頻率；完工後研究者再以颱風期間的風速計、加速度計與 GPS 實測，比對抖振位移與模態阻尼，驗證設計假設。
knowledge.textEn: A section model represents only two-dimensional flow, while flutter and buffeting of a suspension bridge involve several three-dimensional modes, aerodynamic forces on cables and towers, and turbulence that varies along the span. Akashi Kaikyo was therefore tested with a full aeroelastic model in a large wind tunnel, which must reproduce geometry, mass, stiffness and gravity together, with wind speed and frequency scaled by Froude similarity; after completion researchers compared buffeting displacement and modal damping with anemometer, accelerometer and GPS records from typhoons to validate the design assumptions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records" is correct?
options: 全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。
斷面模型只能代表二維流場，懸索橋的顫振與抖振卻牽涉多個三維模態、主纜與塔的氣動力，以及沿跨長變化的紊流。
只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。
optionsEn: A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge.

A section model represents only two-dimensional flow, while flutter and buffeting of a suspension bridge involve several three-dimensional modes, aerodynamic forces on cables and towers, and turbulence that varies along the span.
Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration.
quiz.explanation: 斷面模型只能代表二維流場，懸索橋的顫振與抖振卻牽涉多個三維模態、主纜與塔的氣動力，以及沿跨長變化的紊流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A section model represents only two-dimensional flow, while flutter and buffeting of a suspension bridge involve several three-dimensional modes, aerodynamic forces on cables and towers, and turbulence that varies along the span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「全橋氣彈模型與颱風實測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full model and typhoon records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Froude 相似：長度比 λ = 1/100 時，風速比 √λ = 1/10、頻率比 1/√λ = 10、單位長質量比 λ² = 1/10,000。實橋 80 m/s 對應模型 8 m/s；0.065 Hz 對應 0.65 Hz；44,000 kg/m 對應 4.4 kg/m；全長 3,911 m 的模型約 39 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Froude similarity: with length scale λ = 1/100, velocity scales by √λ = 1/10, frequency by 1/√λ = 10 and mass per length by λ² = 1/10,000. A full-scale 80 m/s maps to 8 m/s in the model, 0.065 Hz to 0.65 Hz, 44,000 kg/m to 4.4 kg/m, and the 3,911 m bridge becomes a model about 39 m long. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：模型先做自由振動試驗確認各模態頻率與阻尼符合相似要求，再在均勻流與紊流中逐級提高風速記錄位移與發散點；實橋比對時把颱風紀錄依平均風速分段，以頻譜辨識模態頻率與阻尼，並比較量測抖振位移與預測值的比值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: First run free-vibration tests on the model to confirm modal frequencies and damping meet similarity, then raise wind speed step by step in smooth and turbulent flow, recording displacement and divergence; for full-scale comparison bin typhoon records by mean wind speed, identify frequencies and damping from spectra, and compare the ratio of measured to predicted buffeting displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Froude 相似：長度比 λ = 1/100 時，風速比 √λ = 1/10、頻率比 1/√λ = 10、單位長質量比 λ² = 1/10,000。實橋 80 m/s 對應模型 8 m/s；0.065 Hz 對應 0.65 Hz；44,000 kg/m 對應 4.4 kg/m；全長 3,911 m 的模型約 39 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Froude similarity: with length scale λ = 1/100, velocity scales by √λ = 1/10, frequency by 1/√λ = 10 and mass per length by λ² = 1/10,000. A full-scale 80 m/s maps to 8 m/s in the model, 0.065 Hz to 0.65 Hz, 44,000 kg/m to 4.4 kg/m, and the 3,911 m bridge becomes a model about 39 m long. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records", which statement holds?
options: 減振裝置維護得越頻繁，橋梁一定越安全。
懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。
Froude 相似：長度比 λ = 1/100 時，風速比 √λ = 1/10、頻率比 1/√λ = 10、單位長質量比 λ² = 1/10,000。
optionsEn: The more often dampers are serviced, the safer the bridge must be.
A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it.
Froude similarity: with length scale λ = 1/100, velocity scales by √λ = 1/10, frequency by 1/√λ = 10 and mass per length by λ² = 1/10,000.
quiz.explanation: Froude 相似：長度比 λ = 1/100 時，風速比 √λ = 1/10、頻率比 1/√λ = 10、單位長質量比 λ² = 1/10,000。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Froude similarity: with length scale λ = 1/100, velocity scales by √λ = 1/10, frequency by 1/√λ = 10 and mass per length by λ² = 1/10,000. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「全橋氣彈模型與颱風實測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full model and typhoon records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 模型先做自由振動試驗確認各模態頻率與阻尼符合相似要求，再在均勻流與紊流中逐級提高風速記錄位移與發散點；實橋比對時把颱風紀錄依平均風速分段，以頻譜辨識模態頻率與阻尼，並比較量測抖振位移與預測值的比值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First run free-vibration tests on the model to confirm modal frequencies and damping meet similarity, then raise wind speed step by step in smooth and turbulent flow, recording displacement and divergence; for full-scale comparison bin typhoon records by mean wind speed, identify frequencies and damping from spectra, and compare the ratio of measured to predicted buffeting displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗計畫應明列相似律、模型頻率與阻尼的允差、紊流條件與試驗風攻角；完工監測報告要附原始資料與處理參數，讓日後研究者能以新方法重新分析並與風洞結果比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The test plan must state the similarity law, tolerances on model frequency and damping, turbulence conditions and angles of attack; completion monitoring reports should include raw data and processing parameters so later researchers can reanalyse them and compare with the tunnel results.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型阻尼過高或質量分布不符，會使顫振風速被高估；紊流強度與積分尺度若與海峽實況不同，抖振預測可能偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excess damping or wrong mass distribution in the model overestimates the flutter speed; turbulence intensity and integral scale unlike the strait's can bias buffeting predictions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 模型先做自由振動試驗確認各模態頻率與阻尼符合相似要求，再在均勻流與紊流中逐級提高風速記錄位移與發散點；實橋比對時把颱風紀錄依平均風速分段，以頻譜辨識模態頻率與阻尼，並比較量測抖振位移與預測值的比值。
knowledge.textEn: First run free-vibration tests on the model to confirm modal frequencies and damping meet similarity, then raise wind speed step by step in smooth and turbulent flow, recording displacement and divergence; for full-scale comparison bin typhoon records by mean wind speed, identify frequencies and damping from spectra, and compare the ratio of measured to predicted buffeting displacement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫應明列相似律、模型頻率與阻尼的允差、紊流條件與試驗風攻角；完工監測報告要附原始資料與處理參數，讓日後研究者能以新方法重新分析並與風洞結果比較。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan must state the similarity law, tolerances on model frequency and damping, turbulence conditions and angles of attack; completion monitoring reports should include raw data and processing parameters so later researchers can reanalyse them and compare with the tunnel results.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records"?
options: 模型先做自由振動試驗確認各模態頻率與阻尼符合相似要求，再在均勻流與紊流中逐級提高風速記錄位移與發散點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
水中混凝土只要配比強度夠高，澆置方式不影響品質。
optionsEn: First run free-vibration tests on the model to confirm modal frequencies and damping meet similarity, then raise wind speed step by step in smooth and turbulent flow, recording displacement and divergence.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the underwater mix is strong enough, the placing method does not affect quality.
quiz.explanation: 模型先做自由振動試驗確認各模態頻率與阻尼符合相似要求，再在均勻流與紊流中逐級提高風速記錄位移與發散點；實橋比對時把颱風紀錄依平均風速分段，以頻譜辨識模態頻率與阻尼，並比較量測抖振位移與預測值的比值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: First run free-vibration tests on the model to confirm modal frequencies and damping meet similarity, then raise wind speed step by step in smooth and turbulent flow, recording displacement and divergence; for full-scale comparison bin typhoon records by mean wind speed, identify frequencies and damping from spectra, and compare the ratio of measured to predicted buffeting displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「全橋氣彈模型與颱風實測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full model and typhoon records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型阻尼過高或質量分布不符，會使顫振風速被高估；紊流強度與積分尺度若與海峽實況不同，抖振預測可能偏差。實測時若 GPS 多路徑誤差或風速計受橋體遮蔽未修正，也會錯誤地「驗證」或否定設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excess damping or wrong mass distribution in the model overestimates the flutter speed; turbulence intensity and integral scale unlike the strait's can bias buffeting predictions. In field data, uncorrected GPS multipath or anemometers shielded by the deck can falsely confirm or reject the design. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：明石海峽大橋因此在大型風洞中做全橋氣彈模型試驗，模型需同時滿足幾何、質量、勁度與重力相似，以 Froude 相似律換算風速與頻率；完工後研究者再以颱風期間的風速計、加速度計與 GPS 實測，比對抖振位移與模態阻尼，驗證設計假設。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Akashi Kaikyo was therefore tested with a full aeroelastic model in a large wind tunnel, which must reproduce geometry, mass, stiffness and gravity together, with wind speed and frequency scaled by Froude similarity; after completion researchers compared buffeting displacement and modal damping with anemometer, accelerometer and GPS records from typhoons to validate the design assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 模型阻尼過高或質量分布不符，會使顫振風速被高估；紊流強度與積分尺度若與海峽實況不同，抖振預測可能偏差。實測時若 GPS 多路徑誤差或風速計受橋體遮蔽未修正，也會錯誤地「驗證」或否定設計。

In field data, uncorrected GPS multipath or anemometers shielded by the deck can falsely confirm or reject the design.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
模型阻尼過高或質量分布不符，會使顫振風速被高估；紊流強度與積分尺度若與海峽實況不同，抖振預測可能偏差。
只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Excess damping or wrong mass distribution in the model overestimates the flutter speed.
Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration.
quiz.explanation: 模型阻尼過高或質量分布不符，會使顫振風速被高估；紊流強度與積分尺度若與海峽實況不同，抖振預測可能偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excess damping or wrong mass distribution in the model overestimates the flutter speed; turbulence intensity and integral scale unlike the strait's can bias buffeting predictions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「長吊索尾流振動」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-hanger wake vibration” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 明石海峽大橋部分吊索長度超過 200 m，每個索夾處有並排的平行鋼絲吊索，間距約為吊索直徑的 9 倍。完工後觀察到在約 20 m/s 的風中，背風側吊索因位於迎風吊索的尾流中而大幅振動；過去一般認為這類尾流馳振只在間距小於約 5 倍直徑時發生。風洞試驗顯示，在吊索表面螺旋纏繞直徑 10 mm 的鋼絲可打亂尾流與表面分離，降低振動，營運單位並開發了纏絲機械施作。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長吊索尾流振動」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Some Akashi Kaikyo hangers exceed 200 m, and at each cable band parallel-wire hanger ropes run side by side at a spacing of about nine rope diameters. After completion the leeward ropes were seen vibrating strongly in winds of about 20 m/s because they sat in the wake of the windward ropes; such wake galloping had previously been thought to occur only at spacings below about five diameters. Wind-tunnel tests showed that winding 10 mm wire helically around the rope disrupts the wake and surface separation and reduces the vibration, and the operator developed a winding machine to install it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-hanger wake vibration” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: String frequency f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「長吊索尾流振動」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-hanger wake vibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire

knowledge.textEn: Some Akashi Kaikyo hangers exceed 200 m, and at each cable band parallel-wire hanger ropes run side by side at a spacing of about nine rope diameters. After completion the leeward ropes were seen vibrating strongly in winds of about 20 m/s because they sat in the wake of the windward ropes; such wake galloping had previously been thought to occur only at spacings below about five diameters.
