knowledge.text: 誤解：只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire" is correct?
options: 只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。
主纜外面有鍍鋅纏絲與塗裝，內部就不會潮濕。
明石海峽大橋部分吊索長度超過 200 m，每個索夾處有並排的平行鋼絲吊索，間距約為吊索直徑的 9 倍。
optionsEn: Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration.
With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet.
Some Akashi Kaikyo hangers exceed 200 m, and at each cable band parallel-wire hanger ropes run side by side at a spacing of about nine rope diameters.
quiz.explanation: 明石海峽大橋部分吊索長度超過 200 m，每個索夾處有並排的平行鋼絲吊索，間距約為吊索直徑的 9 倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Some Akashi Kaikyo hangers exceed 200 m, and at each cable band parallel-wire hanger ropes run side by side at a spacing of about nine rope diameters. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長吊索尾流振動」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-hanger wake vibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。取 L = 200 m、T = 1.6 MN、m = 40 kg/m：√(T/m) = 200 m/s，f₁ = 200/400 = 0.5 Hz。直徑 D = 0.09 m、風速 20 m/s 時折減風速 U/(f·D) = 20/(0.5×0.09) ≈ 444，遠高於渦振範圍，屬尾流馳振區；間距 9D ≈ 0.81 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: String frequency f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With L = 200 m, T = 1.6 MN and m = 40 kg/m: √(T/m) = 200 m/s and f₁ = 200/400 = 0.5 Hz. With D = 0.09 m at 20 m/s the reduced velocity U/(f·D) = 20/(0.5×0.09) ≈ 444, far above the vortex range and in the wake-galloping regime; the spacing 9D ≈ 0.81 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性吊索上安裝加速度計與風速風向計，記錄振幅與風向、風速的關係，辨識振動只出現在特定風向與背風索；風洞中以成對索段試驗有無纏絲、不同纏繞節距的反應，選定方案後再在實橋試裝並比較前後振幅。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit accelerometers and anemometers to representative hangers and relate amplitude to wind speed and direction, confirming that vibration appears only for certain directions and on the leeward rope; in the wind tunnel test paired rope segments with and without wire and with different pitches, then trial-fit the chosen scheme on the bridge and compare amplitudes before and after.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 弦頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。取 L = 200 m、T = 1.6 MN、m = 40 kg/m：√(T/m) = 200 m/s，f₁ = 200/400 = 0.5 Hz。直徑 D = 0.09 m、風速 20 m/s 時折減風速 U/(f·D) = 20/(0.5×0.09) ≈ 444，遠高於渦振範圍，屬尾流馳振區；間距 9D ≈ 0.81 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: String frequency f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With L = 200 m, T = 1.6 MN and m = 40 kg/m: √(T/m) = 200 m/s and f₁ = 200/400 = 0.5 Hz. With D = 0.09 m at 20 m/s the reduced velocity U/(f·D) = 20/(0.5×0.09) ≈ 444, far above the vortex range and in the wake-galloping regime; the spacing 9D ≈ 0.81 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire", which statement holds?
options: 弦頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。
桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。
鋼絲強度越高，主纜就越不需要防蝕。
optionsEn: String frequency f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter.
The stronger the wire, the less corrosion protection the cable needs.
quiz.explanation: 弦頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: String frequency f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長吊索尾流振動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-hanger wake vibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性吊索上安裝加速度計與風速風向計，記錄振幅與風向、風速的關係，辨識振動只出現在特定風向與背風索；風洞中以成對索段試驗有無纏絲、不同纏繞節距的反應，選定方案後再在實橋試裝並比較前後振幅。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit accelerometers and anemometers to representative hangers and relate amplitude to wind speed and direction, confirming that vibration appears only for certain directions and on the leeward rope; in the wind tunnel test paired rope segments with and without wire and with different pitches, then trial-fit the chosen scheme on the bridge and compare amplitudes before and after. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長吊索的振動觀測應從完工初期就納入監測計畫，特定風向的異常振動要記錄並回報設計者；纏絲、阻尼器或連結件等對策必須先經風洞或試裝驗證，並確認不妨礙日後的磁通檢測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Observation of long-hanger vibration should be in the monitoring plan from the first year, recording and reporting unusual vibration in particular wind directions; wire winding, dampers or ties must be proven by wind-tunnel tests or trial fitting and must not obstruct later magnetic-flux inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：長吊索反覆大振幅擺動會使索夾出口與錨頭處彎曲應力集中、鋼絲磨損與疲勞，兩索相互碰撞也會損傷護套與防蝕層，讓水分進入吊索內部。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated large swings of long hangers concentrate bending stress where the rope exits the cable band and at its socket, wearing and fatiguing the wires; ropes striking each other also damage sheathing and corrosion protection and let water into the rope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性吊索上安裝加速度計與風速風向計，記錄振幅與風向、風速的關係，辨識振動只出現在特定風向與背風索；風洞中以成對索段試驗有無纏絲、不同纏繞節距的反應，選定方案後再在實橋試裝並比較前後振幅。
knowledge.textEn: Fit accelerometers and anemometers to representative hangers and relate amplitude to wind speed and direction, confirming that vibration appears only for certain directions and on the leeward rope; in the wind tunnel test paired rope segments with and without wire and with different pitches, then trial-fit the chosen scheme on the bridge and compare amplitudes before and after.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長吊索的振動觀測應從完工初期就納入監測計畫，特定風向的異常振動要記錄並回報設計者；纏絲、阻尼器或連結件等對策必須先經風洞或試裝驗證，並確認不妨礙日後的磁通檢測。
knowledge.textEn: Observation of long-hanger vibration should be in the monitoring plan from the first year, recording and reporting unusual vibration in particular wind directions; wire winding, dampers or ties must be proven by wind-tunnel tests or trial fitting and must not obstruct later magnetic-flux inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在代表性吊索上安裝加速度計與風速風向計，記錄振幅與風向、風速的關係，辨識振動只出現在特定風向與背風索。
索股垂度只要白天量一次，誤差幾公分不影響主纜受力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Fit accelerometers and anemometers to representative hangers and relate amplitude to wind speed and direction, confirming that vibration appears only for certain directions and on the leeward rope.
Measuring strand sag once in daytime is fine; a few centimetres of error do not affect cable forces.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性吊索上安裝加速度計與風速風向計，記錄振幅與風向、風速的關係，辨識振動只出現在特定風向與背風索；風洞中以成對索段試驗有無纏絲、不同纏繞節距的反應，選定方案後再在實橋試裝並比較前後振幅。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit accelerometers and anemometers to representative hangers and relate amplitude to wind speed and direction, confirming that vibration appears only for certain directions and on the leeward rope; in the wind tunnel test paired rope segments with and without wire and with different pitches, then trial-fit the chosen scheme on the bridge and compare amplitudes before and after. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長吊索尾流振動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-hanger wake vibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 長吊索反覆大振幅擺動會使索夾出口與錨頭處彎曲應力集中、鋼絲磨損與疲勞，兩索相互碰撞也會損傷護套與防蝕層，讓水分進入吊索內部。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated large swings of long hangers concentrate bending stress where the rope exits the cable band and at its socket, wearing and fatiguing the wires; ropes striking each other also damage sheathing and corrosion protection and let water into the rope. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風洞試驗顯示，在吊索表面螺旋纏繞直徑 10 mm 的鋼絲可打亂尾流與表面分離，降低振動，營運單位並開發了纏絲機械施作。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wind-tunnel tests showed that winding 10 mm wire helically around the rope disrupts the wake and surface separation and reduces the vibration, and the operator developed a winding machine to install it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 長吊索反覆大振幅擺動會使索夾出口與錨頭處彎曲應力集中、鋼絲磨損與疲勞，兩索相互碰撞也會損傷護套與防蝕層，讓水分進入吊索內部。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated large swings of long hangers concentrate bending stress where the rope exits the cable band and at its socket, wearing and fatiguing the wires; ropes striking each other also damage sheathing and corrosion protection and let water into the rope.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
主纜外面有鍍鋅纏絲與塗裝，內部就不會潮濕。
長吊索反覆大振幅擺動會使索夾出口與錨頭處彎曲應力集中、鋼絲磨損與疲勞，兩索相互碰撞也會損傷護套與防蝕層，讓水分進入吊索內部。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet.
Repeated large swings of long hangers concentrate bending stress where the rope exits the cable band and at its socket, wearing and fatiguing the wires.
quiz.explanation: 長吊索反覆大振幅擺動會使索夾出口與錨頭處彎曲應力集中、鋼絲磨損與疲勞，兩索相互碰撞也會損傷護套與防蝕層，讓水分進入吊索內部。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated large swings of long hangers concentrate bending stress where the rope exits the cable band and at its socket, wearing and fatiguing the wires; ropes striking each other also damage sheathing and corrosion protection and let water into the rope. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支」與「減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection" and "Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主纜送氣出口濕度」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cable exhaust humidity” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 本州四國連絡橋的檢查發現，舊有懸索橋拆開鍍鋅纏絲後鋼絲已有鏽蝕，因此開發了將乾燥空氣送入主纜內部的系統，並以世界首創的形式用於明石海峽大橋與其他懸索橋。管理目標是纜內相對濕度 40%，比會發生腐蝕的約 60% 留有安全餘裕；夏季高濕時另加預冷設備除濕。乾燥空氣沿主纜空隙流動，一路蒸發並帶走殘留水分，最後從排氣口排出，排氣口的濕度就是纜內是否已乾燥的指標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主纜送氣出口濕度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inspections of older Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges found rust on wires once the galvanised wrapping was removed, so a system injecting dry air into the main cable was developed and used, as a world first, on Akashi Kaikyo and the other suspension bridges. The management target is 40% relative humidity inside the cable, a margin below the roughly 60% at which corrosion occurs; pre-coolers dehumidify humid summer air. The dry air travels through the cable voids, evaporating and carrying away trapped moisture before leaving at exhaust points, so exhaust humidity is the indicator of whether the cable interior is dry. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cable exhaust humidity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：25 °C 飽和水氣密度約 23.0 g/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Saturated vapour density at 25 °C is about 23.0 g/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜外面有鍍鋅纏絲與塗裝，內部就不會潮濕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主纜送氣出口濕度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cable exhaust humidity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支
knowledge.titleEn: Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection
knowledge.text: 本州四國連絡橋的檢查發現，舊有懸索橋拆開鍍鋅纏絲後鋼絲已有鏽蝕，因此開發了將乾燥空氣送入主纜內部的系統，並以世界首創的形式用於明石海峽大橋與其他懸索橋。管理目標是纜內相對濕度 40%，比會發生腐蝕的約 60% 留有安全餘裕；夏季高濕時另加預冷設備除濕。

The management target is 40% relative humidity inside the cable, a margin below the roughly 60% at which corrosion occurs; pre-coolers dehumidify humid summer air.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主纜外面有鍍鋅纏絲與塗裝，內部就不會潮濕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection" is correct?
options: 本州四國連絡橋的檢查發現，舊有懸索橋拆開鍍鋅纏絲後鋼絲已有鏽蝕，因此開發了將乾燥空氣送入主纜內部的系統，並以世界首創的形式用於明石海峽大橋與其他懸索橋。

With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet.
The more often dampers are serviced, the safer the bridge must be.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主纜送氣出口濕度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cable exhaust humidity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：25 °C 飽和水氣密度約 23.0 g/m³。送入 15% RH 空氣（3.5 g/m³），出口 40% RH（9.2 g/m³），每立方公尺帶走約 5.7 g。流量 1.0 m³/min 時每日 1,440 m³，約 8.2 kg 水；若段內殘留 50 kg 水，約 6 天才能排除。主纜空隙約 0.989×20% ≈ 0.198 m³/m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Saturated vapour density at 25 °C is about 23.0 g/m³. Injecting air at 15% RH (3.5 g/m³) with exhaust at 40% RH (9.2 g/m³) removes about 5.7 g per cubic metre. At 1.0 m³/min, 1,440 m³ a day carries about 8.2 kg of water, so 50 kg trapped in a section takes about 6 days to clear. Cable voids are about 0.989×20% ≈ 0.198 m³ per metre. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在每個送氣與排氣口連續記錄溫度、相對濕度與流量，計算各段的露點與水分移除量；排氣濕度持續高於目標時，先檢查包覆氣密與送氣壓力，再於低點開窗目視檢查鋼絲鍍鋅狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log temperature, relative humidity and flow continuously at every injection and exhaust point, computing dew point and moisture removal per section; if exhaust humidity stays above target, first check wrapping airtightness and supply pressure, then open an inspection window at a low point to inspect the zinc on the wires.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 25 °C 飽和水氣密度約 23.0 g/m³。送入 15% RH 空氣（3.5 g/m³），出口 40% RH（9.2 g/m³），每立方公尺帶走約 5.7 g。流量 1.0 m³/min 時每日 1,440 m³，約 8.2 kg 水；若段內殘留 50 kg 水，約 6 天才能排除。主纜空隙約 0.989×20% ≈ 0.198 m³/m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Saturated vapour density at 25 °C is about 23.0 g/m³. Injecting air at 15% RH (3.5 g/m³) with exhaust at 40% RH (9.2 g/m³) removes about 5.7 g per cubic metre. At 1.0 m³/min, 1,440 m³ a day carries about 8.2 kg of water, so 50 kg trapped in a section takes about 6 days to clear. Cable voids are about 0.989×20% ≈ 0.198 m³ per metre. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection", which statement holds?
options: 懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。
25 °C 飽和水氣密度約 23.0 g/m³。
水中混凝土只要配比強度夠高，澆置方式不影響品質。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it.
Saturated vapour density at 25 °C is about 23.0 g/m³.
If the underwater mix is strong enough, the placing method does not affect quality.
quiz.explanation: 25 °C 飽和水氣密度約 23.0 g/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Saturated vapour density at 25 °C is about 23.0 g/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主纜送氣出口濕度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cable exhaust humidity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在每個送氣與排氣口連續記錄溫度、相對濕度與流量，計算各段的露點與水分移除量；排氣濕度持續高於目標時，先檢查包覆氣密與送氣壓力，再於低點開窗目視檢查鋼絲鍍鋅狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log temperature, relative humidity and flow continuously at every injection and exhaust point, computing dew point and moisture removal per section; if exhaust humidity stays above target, first check wrapping airtightness and supply pressure, then open an inspection window at a low point to inspect the zinc on the wires. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把每個區段的排氣濕度、流量與設備運轉狀態納入中央監控與警報，維修紀錄須連結到區段編號；包覆修補、索夾更換等作業後要重新做氣密與流量確認，才算結案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bring exhaust humidity, flow and equipment status for every section into central monitoring with alarms, link maintenance records to section numbers, and close out wrapping repairs or cable-band work only after airtightness and flow are re-verified.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：包覆破損或索夾密封失效會讓乾燥空氣從近端漏出，遠端仍潮濕，平均讀值卻看似正常；送氣設備故障未被警報偵測時，纜內濕度數週內就可能回升到腐蝕門檻以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Damaged wrapping or failed cable-band seals let dry air escape near the inlet while the far end stays wet, even though average readings look normal; an equipment fault not caught by alarms can let internal humidity climb above the corrosion threshold within weeks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在每個送氣與排氣口連續記錄溫度、相對濕度與流量，計算各段的露點與水分移除量；排氣濕度持續高於目標時，先檢查包覆氣密與送氣壓力，再於低點開窗目視檢查鋼絲鍍鋅狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Log temperature, relative humidity and flow continuously at every injection and exhaust point, computing dew point and moisture removal per section; if exhaust humidity stays above target, first check wrapping airtightness and supply pressure, then open an inspection window at a low point to inspect the zinc on the wires.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把每個區段的排氣濕度、流量與設備運轉狀態納入中央監控與警報，維修紀錄須連結到區段編號；包覆修補、索夾更換等作業後要重新做氣密與流量確認，才算結案。
knowledge.textEn: Bring exhaust humidity, flow and equipment status for every section into central monitoring with alarms, link maintenance records to section numbers, and close out wrapping repairs or cable-band work only after airtightness and flow are re-verified.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
地震後只要把橋塔推回原位，就能維持原設計線形。
在每個送氣與排氣口連續記錄溫度、相對濕度與流量，計算各段的露點與水分移除量；排氣濕度持續高於目標時，先檢查包覆氣密與送氣壓力，再於低點開窗目視檢查鋼絲鍍鋅狀態。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
After an earthquake you simply push the towers back to restore the design profile.
Log temperature, relative humidity and flow continuously at every injection and exhaust point, computing dew point and moisture removal per section.
quiz.explanation: 在每個送氣與排氣口連續記錄溫度、相對濕度與流量，計算各段的露點與水分移除量；排氣濕度持續高於目標時，先檢查包覆氣密與送氣壓力，再於低點開窗目視檢查鋼絲鍍鋅狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log temperature, relative humidity and flow continuously at every injection and exhaust point, computing dew point and moisture removal per section; if exhaust humidity stays above target, first check wrapping airtightness and supply pressure, then open an inspection window at a low point to inspect the zinc on the wires. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主纜送氣出口濕度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cable exhaust humidity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 包覆破損或索夾密封失效會讓乾燥空氣從近端漏出，遠端仍潮濕，平均讀值卻看似正常；送氣設備故障未被警報偵測時，纜內濕度數週內就可能回升到腐蝕門檻以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Damaged wrapping or failed cable-band seals let dry air escape near the inlet while the far end stays wet, even though average readings look normal; an equipment fault not caught by alarms can let internal humidity climb above the corrosion threshold within weeks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：乾燥空氣沿主纜空隙流動，一路蒸發並帶走殘留水分，最後從排氣口排出，排氣口的濕度就是纜內是否已乾燥的指標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The dry air travels through the cable voids, evaporating and carrying away trapped moisture before leaving at exhaust points, so exhaust humidity is the indicator of whether the cable interior is dry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜外面有鍍鋅纏絲與塗裝，內部就不會潮濕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 包覆破損或索夾密封失效會讓乾燥空氣從近端漏出，遠端仍潮濕，平均讀值卻看似正常；送氣設備故障未被警報偵測時，纜內濕度數週內就可能回升到腐蝕門檻以上。
knowledge.textEn: Damaged wrapping or failed cable-band seals let dry air escape near the inlet while the far end stays wet, even though average readings look normal; an equipment fault not caught by alarms can let internal humidity climb above the corrosion threshold within weeks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
減振裝置維護得越頻繁，橋梁一定越安全。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔內 TMD 與 200 年目標」如何影響明石海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower TMDs and 200-year target” governs force, deformation or durability in “Akashi Kaikyo Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 本州四國連絡橋的維護方針以 200 年以上的長期使用為目標，以預防保全與資產管理把生命週期成本降到最低。明石海峽主塔為十字形斷面，風洞試驗顯示若無減振裝置，塔在橫向風中振幅可達約 95 cm，裝設 TMD 與附加阻尼器後約 10 cm，容許值 30 cm；公開簡報列出共約 40 組 TMD 與 8 組附加阻尼器。營運後實測塔位移小於約 2 cm，營運單位因而研究把減振裝置的維護週期由每 5 年延長到約 14 年。這是以監測數據調整維護投入的典型案例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔內 TMD 與 200 年目標」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Honshu-Shikoku maintenance policy targets service of 200 years or more, minimising life-cycle cost through preventive maintenance and asset management. The Akashi Kaikyo towers have a cruciform section; wind-tunnel tests showed transverse-wind amplitudes of about 95 cm without dampers and about 10 cm with TMDs and additional dampers, against an allowable 30 cm, and a public presentation lists about 40 TMDs and 8 additional dampers. Measured tower displacement in service stayed below about 2 cm, so the operator studied extending the damper maintenance interval from every 5 years to about 14 years, a typical case of using monitoring data to tune maintenance effort. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tower TMDs and 200-year target” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦振振幅約與總阻尼成反比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vortex-induced amplitude is roughly inversely proportional to total damping.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「減振裝置維護得越頻繁，橋梁一定越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more often dampers are serviced, the safer the bridge must be." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔內 TMD 與 200 年目標」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tower TMDs and 200-year target”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理
knowledge.text: 本州四國連絡橋的維護方針以 200 年以上的長期使用為目標，以預防保全與資產管理把生命週期成本降到最低。明石海峽主塔為十字形斷面，風洞試驗顯示若無減振裝置，塔在橫向風中振幅可達約 95 cm，裝設 TMD 與附加阻尼器後約 10 cm，容許值 30 cm；公開簡報列出共約 40 組 TMD 與 8 組附加阻尼器。

The Akashi Kaikyo towers have a cruciform section; wind-tunnel tests showed transverse-wind amplitudes of about 95 cm without dampers and about 10 cm with TMDs and additional dampers, against an allowable 30 cm, and a public presentation lists about 40 TMDs and 8 additional dampers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：減振裝置維護得越頻繁，橋梁一定越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management" is correct?
options: 減振裝置維護得越頻繁，橋梁一定越安全。
本州四國連絡橋的維護方針以 200 年以上的長期使用為目標，以預防保全與資產管理把生命週期成本降到最低。
桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。

The Honshu-Shikoku maintenance policy targets service of 200 years or more, minimising life-cycle cost through preventive maintenance and asset management.
A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter.
quiz.explanation: 本州四國連絡橋的維護方針以 200 年以上的長期使用為目標，以預防保全與資產管理把生命週期成本降到最低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Honshu-Shikoku maintenance policy targets service of 200 years or more, minimising life-cycle cost through preventive maintenance and asset management. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔內 TMD 與 200 年目標」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower TMDs and 200-year target” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦振振幅約與總阻尼成反比。設塔結構阻尼 ζ_s = 0.5%，95 cm 降到 10 cm 需總阻尼 0.5%×95/10 ≈ 4.75%，即 TMD 附加約 4.25%；要符合 30 cm 只需 0.5%×95/30 ≈ 1.58%。若 TMD 劣化使附加阻尼減半，總阻尼約 2.6%，振幅約 95×0.5/2.6 ≈ 18 cm，仍低於容許值。阻尼比為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex-induced amplitude is roughly inversely proportional to total damping. With tower damping ζ_s = 0.5%, cutting 95 cm to 10 cm needs about 0.5%×95/10 ≈ 4.75% in total, so the TMDs add about 4.25%; meeting 30 cm needs only 0.5%×95/30 ≈ 1.58%. If TMD ageing halves the added damping, the total is about 2.6% and the amplitude about 95×0.5/2.6 ≈ 18 cm, still within the limit. Damping ratios are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以塔內加速度與位移長期紀錄，篩選可能引發振動的強風事件，比較實測振幅與設計預測；定期抽驗 TMD 的頻率與阻尼係數，並做阻尼變化 ±20%、±50% 的敏感度分析，確認延長維護週期後仍滿足容許位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use long-term tower acceleration and displacement records to pick out strong-wind events capable of exciting vibration and compare measured amplitudes with design predictions; periodically spot-check TMD frequency and damping coefficient, and run sensitivity analyses for ±20% and ±50% damping changes to confirm that the allowable displacement is still met with a longer interval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 渦振振幅約與總阻尼成反比。設塔結構阻尼 ζ_s = 0.5%，95 cm 降到 10 cm 需總阻尼 0.5%×95/10 ≈ 4.75%，即 TMD 附加約 4.25%；要符合 30 cm 只需 0.5%×95/30 ≈ 1.58%。若 TMD 劣化使附加阻尼減半，總阻尼約 2.6%，振幅約 95×0.5/2.6 ≈ 18 cm，仍低於容許值。阻尼比為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Vortex-induced amplitude is roughly inversely proportional to total damping. With tower damping ζ_s = 0.5%, cutting 95 cm to 10 cm needs about 0.5%×95/10 ≈ 4.75% in total, so the TMDs add about 4.25%; meeting 30 cm needs only 0.5%×95/30 ≈ 1.58%. If TMD ageing halves the added damping, the total is about 2.6% and the amplitude about 95×0.5/2.6 ≈ 18 cm, still within the limit. Damping ratios are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management", which statement holds?
options: 鋼絲強度越高，主纜就越不需要防蝕。
索股垂度只要白天量一次，誤差幾公分不影響主纜受力。
渦振振幅約與總阻尼成反比。
optionsEn: The stronger the wire, the less corrosion protection the cable needs.
Measuring strand sag once in daytime is fine; a few centimetres of error do not affect cable forces.
Vortex-induced amplitude is roughly inversely proportional to total damping.
quiz.explanation: 渦振振幅約與總阻尼成反比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Vortex-induced amplitude is roughly inversely proportional to total damping. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔內 TMD 與 200 年目標」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tower TMDs and 200-year target” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以塔內加速度與位移長期紀錄，篩選可能引發振動的強風事件，比較實測振幅與設計預測；定期抽驗 TMD 的頻率與阻尼係數，並做阻尼變化 ±20%、±50% 的敏感度分析，確認延長維護週期後仍滿足容許位移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use long-term tower acceleration and displacement records to pick out strong-wind events capable of exciting vibration and compare measured amplitudes with design predictions; periodically spot-check TMD frequency and damping coefficient, and run sensitivity analyses for ±20% and ±50% damping changes to confirm that the allowable displacement is still met with a longer interval. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何維護週期的延長都要附上監測證據、敏感度分析與重新評估的觸發條件（例如觀測到某風速以上的事件或振幅超過門檻），並由業主的技術委員會核准；檢查與修繕紀錄納入資料庫以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any extension of a maintenance interval must come with monitoring evidence, sensitivity analysis and re-assessment triggers (such as an event above a given wind speed or amplitude above a threshold), approved by the owner's technical committee; inspection and repair records go into the database so the plan is updated through a PDCA cycle.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若不看監測數據而一律縮短週期，維護成本與封閉作業增加卻無性能收益；反之若沒有敏感度分析就延長週期，TMD 卡滯或失調可能在下一次強風時才被發現，塔與索鞍承受未預期的反覆應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shortening intervals regardless of monitoring data adds cost and closures for no performance gain; extending them without sensitivity analysis can leave a stuck or detuned TMD undiscovered until the next strong wind, exposing towers and saddles to unexpected cyclic stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以塔內加速度與位移長期紀錄，篩選可能引發振動的強風事件，比較實測振幅與設計預測；定期抽驗 TMD 的頻率與阻尼係數，並做阻尼變化 ±20%、±50% 的敏感度分析，確認延長維護週期後仍滿足容許位移。
knowledge.textEn: Use long-term tower acceleration and displacement records to pick out strong-wind events capable of exciting vibration and compare measured amplitudes with design predictions; periodically spot-check TMD frequency and damping coefficient, and run sensitivity analyses for ±20% and ±50% damping changes to confirm that the allowable displacement is still met with a longer interval.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 任何維護週期的延長都要附上監測證據、敏感度分析與重新評估的觸發條件（例如觀測到某風速以上的事件或振幅超過門檻），並由業主的技術委員會核准；檢查與修繕紀錄納入資料庫以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Any extension of a maintenance interval must come with monitoring evidence, sensitivity analysis and re-assessment triggers (such as an event above a given wind speed or amplitude above a threshold), approved by the owner's technical committee; inspection and repair records go into the database so the plan is updated through a PDCA cycle.

quiz.question: 要驗證「減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management"?
options: 以塔內加速度與位移長期紀錄，篩選可能引發振動的強風事件，比較實測振幅與設計預測。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。
optionsEn: Use long-term tower acceleration and displacement records to pick out strong-wind events capable of exciting vibration and compare measured amplitudes with design predictions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge.
quiz.explanation: 以塔內加速度與位移長期紀錄，篩選可能引發振動的強風事件，比較實測振幅與設計預測；定期抽驗 TMD 的頻率與阻尼係數，並做阻尼變化 ±20%、±50% 的敏感度分析，確認延長維護週期後仍滿足容許位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use long-term tower acceleration and displacement records to pick out strong-wind events capable of exciting vibration and compare measured amplitudes with design predictions; periodically spot-check TMD frequency and damping coefficient, and run sensitivity analyses for ±20% and ±50% damping changes to confirm that the allowable displacement is still met with a longer interval. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔內 TMD 與 200 年目標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tower TMDs and 200-year target” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若不看監測數據而一律縮短週期，維護成本與封閉作業增加卻無性能收益；反之若沒有敏感度分析就延長週期，TMD 卡滯或失調可能在下一次強風時才被發現，塔與索鞍承受未預期的反覆應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shortening intervals regardless of monitoring data adds cost and closures for no performance gain; extending them without sensitivity analysis can leave a stuck or detuned TMD undiscovered until the next strong wind, exposing towers and saddles to unexpected cyclic stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是以監測數據調整維護投入的典型案例。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measured tower displacement in service stayed below about 2 cm, so the operator studied extending the damper maintenance interval from every 5 years to about 14 years, a typical case of using monitoring data to tune maintenance effort.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「減振裝置維護得越頻繁，橋梁一定越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more often dampers are serviced, the safer the bridge must be." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若不看監測數據而一律縮短週期，維護成本與封閉作業增加卻無性能收益；反之若沒有敏感度分析就延長週期，TMD 卡滯或失調可能在下一次強風時才被發現，塔與索鞍承受未預期的反覆應力。
knowledge.textEn: Shortening intervals regardless of monitoring data adds cost and closures for no performance gain; extending them without sensitivity analysis can leave a stuck or detuned TMD undiscovered until the next strong wind, exposing towers and saddles to unexpected cyclic stress.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若不看監測數據而一律縮短週期，維護成本與封閉作業增加卻無性能收益。
桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shortening intervals regardless of monitoring data adds cost and closures for no performance gain.
A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter.
quiz.explanation: 若不看監測數據而一律縮短週期，維護成本與封閉作業增加卻無性能收益；反之若沒有敏感度分析就延長週期，TMD 卡滯或失調可能在下一次強風時才被發現，塔與索鞍承受未預期的反覆應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shortening intervals regardless of monitoring data adds cost and closures for no performance gain; extending them without sensitivity analysis can leave a stuck or detuned TMD undiscovered until the next strong wind, exposing towers and saddles to unexpected cyclic stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 明石海峽大橋
summary: 從海峽條件到主纜防蝕，拆解懸索橋的受力、施工幾何與營運證據。
summaryEn: Trace a suspension bridge from strait conditions to cable corrosion protection through load paths, construction geometry and operating evidence.
scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.
subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 延伸練習：假設主跨 l = 1,991 m、垂跨比 n = 1/10（f = 199.1 m），兩條主纜與加勁梁合計恆載 w = 431.6 kN/m（44 t/m）。水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f) = 431.6×1,991²/(8×199.1) ≈ 1,074,000 kN，每纜 537 MN；塔頂最大張力 T = H·√(1+16n²) = 537×1.077 ≈ 578 MN。每纜鋼絲面積 0.791 m²，恆載應力 = 578/0.791 ≈ 731 N/mm²，對 1,760 N/mm² 鋼絲的恆載安全係數約 2.41；若活載與溫度再使張力增加 10%，係數降為約 2.19。若改用 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲而面積不變，恆載係數只剩約 2.15，這正是公開資料說需要每側兩條纜的原因。地震後跨徑若增加 0.8 m，不可伸長估算垂度減少約 1.46 m。數值為教學假設，不代表明石海峽大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Extension exercise: assume l = 1,991 m, sag ratio n = 1/10 (f = 199.1 m) and a dead load for both cables and the girder of w = 431.6 kN/m (44 t/m). Horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f) = 431.6×1,991²/(8×199.1) ≈ 1,074,000 kN, or 537 MN per cable; maximum tension at the tower T = H·√(1+16n²) = 537×1.077 ≈ 578 MN. With 0.791 m² of wire per cable the dead-load stress is 578/0.791 ≈ 731 N/mm², a dead-load safety factor of about 2.41 on 1,760 N/mm² wire; if live load and temperature add 10% to tension the factor drops to about 2.19. With 1,570 N/mm² wire and the same area the dead-load factor would be only about 2.15, which is why the public account says two cables per side would have been needed. A 0.8 m span increase after the earthquake reduces sag by about 1.46 m in the inextensible estimate. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

v13Extension.focus: 以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣
v13Extension.focusEn: Numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables

steps.title: 建立地層與路線剖面
steps.objective: 分開已觀測地層與推估延伸。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate observed strata from inferred continuity.
steps.instruction: 自繪兩岸及海床，將白堊泥灰岩畫成有厚度的帶狀層。以實線代表假設鑽孔位置、虛線表示孔間推論，另標出可能含水或破碎區。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch both coasts and seabed with a chalk-marl band. Mark hypothetical boreholes with solid symbols and inferred continuity with dashed lines; add potentially wet or fractured zones.
steps.observation: 觀察最短直線是否始終位於選定地層內。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the shortest straight alignment stays inside the selected layer.
steps.failure: 把「主要穿越某地層」誤解成全線均質且不會滲水。
steps.failureEn: Treating a dominant stratum as proof of uniform, watertight conditions everywhere.
steps.check: 剖面須有觀測／推論圖例及兩處需補充調查的位置。
steps.checkEn: Include an observation/inference key and two locations needing further investigation.

knowledge.title: 地層追蹤
knowledge.text: 路線可以為了維持較合適地層而調整，不必是兩點最短連線。
knowledge.textEn: Alignment may follow favorable ground rather than the shortest line between two points.

knowledge.title: 局部差異
knowledge.text: 斷層、褶皺和含水差異會使同名岩層的施工表現不同。
knowledge.textEn: Faults, folding and water conditions can change behavior within a named rock layer.

options: 標成推論並列出驗證需求
延用最近鑽孔結果當成全段實測
從剖面刪掉不確定區
optionsEn: As an inference with a verification need
Treat the nearest borehole as measurement of the whole interval
Remove the uncertain area from the section
quiz.question: 鑽孔間出現未確認的構造，應如何標記？
quiz.questionEn: How should an unconfirmed feature between boreholes be shown?
quiz.explanation: 地質模型應保留不確定性，讓後續觀察能修正它。
quiz.explanationEn: A geological model should preserve uncertainty so subsequent observations can revise it.

steps.title: 連結兩岸測量基準
steps.titleEn: Connect survey references on both shores
steps.objective: 理解長距離對向掘進的基準一致性。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand reference consistency in long opposing drives.
steps.instruction: 畫出地面控制網、井下傳遞點與隧道導線的關係。用自設兩岸座標示例，先核對單位、方向與高程基準，再比較預期會合位置。
steps.instructionEn: Diagram surface controls, underground transfer points and tunnel traverses. With invented coordinates from both shores, reconcile units, orientation and height datum before comparing predicted meeting positions.
steps.observation: 比較共同偏移和兩側相向軸線不一致造成的不同結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare a common offset with disagreement between opposing drive axes.
steps.failure: 未統一高程基準，就把兩側標高差當成施工誤差。
steps.failureEn: Treating height differences as construction error before reconciling datums.
steps.check: 交付一張基準對照表及一個可重現的示例閉合檢查。
steps.checkEn: Submit a reference table and a reproducible example closure check.

knowledge.title: 基準傳遞
knowledge.text: 地面控制需經過可追溯的傳遞才能用於地下方向判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Surface control must be transferred traceably before underground directions can be interpreted.

knowledge.title: 誤差累積
knowledge.text: 長距離測量的小方向誤差可能累積成明顯位置差。
knowledge.textEn: Small directional errors over long distances can accumulate into substantial positional differences.

options: 立即修改襯砌環直徑
單位、基準面及控制點版本
只採用數字較小的一組
optionsEn: Immediately change lining-ring diameter
Units, datum and control-point versions
Use whichever numbers are smaller
quiz.question: 兩隊高程數字不一致時，第一項核對是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two teams report different elevations. What should be checked first?
quiz.explanation: 先確定數據在同一參考系，才能判斷幾何偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Data must share a reference system before geometric discrepancies are assessed.

steps.title: 選擇開挖配置的證據
steps.objective: 把機台功能與地層及地下水問題配對。
steps.objectiveEn: Match machine functions to ground and groundwater questions.
steps.instruction: 建立硬度、裂隙、含水與出碴四列需求表，分別說明刀盤、工作面支承、密封與運輸的角色。比較英法兩側條件可能不同的理由，不填操作壓力。
steps.instructionEn: Create a table for strength, fractures, water and spoil handling; identify cutting, face support, sealing and transport roles. Explain why the two shores may need different configurations without specifying operating pressures.
steps.observation: 觀察「能切削岩石」與「能管理水及出碴」是否是不同能力。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish ability to cut rock from ability to manage water and spoil.
steps.failure: 只以隧道直徑挑選機台，忽略地層與水壓條件。
steps.failureEn: Selecting a machine by tunnel diameter alone while ignoring ground and water conditions.
steps.check: 每項功能至少連到一項地質證據或待調查事項。
steps.checkEn: Link each function to geological evidence or an investigation need.

knowledge.title: 適地配置
knowledge.text: 同一工程可採用不同配置，以回應各段地層與地下水差異。
knowledge.textEn: One project may use different configurations to address sectional ground and groundwater differences.

knowledge.title: 連續物流
knowledge.text: 切削、出碴與環片供應互相制約；單一速度不能代表整體能力。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting, spoil removal and segment supply constrain one another; one speed does not represent total capability.

options: 直徑相同就必須使用相同配置
只需改變列車速度
工作面支承與密封需求仍可能不同
optionsEn: Equal diameter requires identical configuration
Only train speed needs changing
Face-support and sealing requirements may still differ
quiz.question: 兩段隧道直徑相同但含水條件不同，哪個結論合理？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections share a diameter but differ in water conditions. Which conclusion is reasonable?
quiz.explanation: 直徑只是幾何要求；地下水和地層決定另外的功能需求。
quiz.explanationEn: Diameter defines geometry; ground and groundwater impose additional functional requirements.

steps.title: 用開挖觀察修訂地質模型
steps.titleEn: Update the ground model from excavation observations
steps.objective: 建立預測與現地觀察不一致時的判讀流程。
steps.objectiveEn: Define a response when predictions and field observations disagree.
steps.instruction: 自行寫三則示例觀察：出碴性質改變、滲水增加、測量方向偏移。分別列出可能機制、需補查紀錄與模型要修訂的欄位。
steps.instructionEn: Invent three observations: changed spoil, increased ingress and a survey-direction shift. For each, list candidate mechanisms, records to check and model fields to revise.
steps.observation: 注意相同表徵可以有地質、設備或量測等不同原因。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that the same symptom may have geological, equipment or measurement causes.
steps.failure: 因原模型標示低透水，就把新增滲水當成量測錯誤刪除。
steps.failureEn: Discarding increased ingress as measurement error because the original model predicts low permeability.
steps.check: 至少保留兩種競爭假說，並寫出可區分它們的證據。
steps.checkEn: Retain at least two competing explanations and evidence that could distinguish them.

knowledge.title: 觀察回饋
knowledge.text: 地質預測應接受新證據檢驗；模型不是現地狀態的保證。
knowledge.textEn: Geological predictions must be tested against new evidence; a model does not guarantee field conditions.

knowledge.title: 可區分證據
knowledge.text: 有用的補查應能讓不同假說產生不同預期結果。
knowledge.textEn: Useful follow-up evidence produces different expected results under competing explanations.

options: 保留原版本，加入新觀察並重新評估
只保留原先最有利的假設
把兩種現象平均成一個正常值
optionsEn: Preserve the old version, add observations and reassess
Retain only the original favorable assumption
Average both symptoms into a normal value
quiz.question: 出碴變化與新滲水同時發生時，應如何處理模型？
quiz.questionEn: Spoil changes and new water ingress occur together. How should the model be treated?
quiz.explanation: 版本化修訂保留決策依據，並讓新增證據改變推論。
quiz.explanationEn: Versioned revision preserves decision context while allowing new evidence to change conclusions.

stages.title: 地質、測量與開挖
stages.description: 把預期地層、實際觀察與開挖配置建立可修訂的對照。
stages.descriptionEn: Build a revisable comparison between expected ground, observations and excavation configuration.

steps.title: 檢查襯砌環與接縫
steps.objective: 分清承載、防水與幾何接合證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate evidence for load support, water control and geometric fit.
steps.instruction: 畫一圈分片襯砌及相鄰兩環，標記接縫、接觸面與可能漏水路徑。建立環片識別、位置、缺損和接縫觀察的記錄欄位。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a segmented ring and two adjacent rings, marking joints, contacts and potential ingress paths. Define records for segment identity, location, defects and joint observations.
steps.observation: 比較環片本體完整與接縫完整是否能互相替代。
steps.observationEn: Ask whether sound segment bodies and sound joints provide interchangeable evidence.
steps.failure: 環片外表沒有裂縫，就認定所有接縫都止水良好。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every joint is watertight because segment faces have no visible cracks.
steps.check: 為承載、幾何、防水各列一種不同的檢核證據。
steps.checkEn: Name distinct evidence for support, geometry and water control.

knowledge.title: 系統接縫
knowledge.text: 襯砌不是孤立環片的集合；環內與環間接合會影響整體性能。
knowledge.textEn: Lining behavior depends on within-ring and between-ring joints, not only isolated segments.

knowledge.title: 位置追溯
knowledge.text: 缺陷紀錄須能回到具體環號與方位，才能比較後續變化。
knowledge.textEn: Defect records need ring identity and orientation to support later comparisons.

options: 全隧道環片總數
同環號、方位及時間的觀察序列
未註位置的零散照片
optionsEn: Total number of tunnel segments
Observations with matching ring, orientation and timestamps
Unlocated photographs
quiz.question: 哪項記錄最適合追蹤接縫漏水是否擴大？
quiz.questionEn: Which record best tracks whether joint leakage is spreading?
quiz.explanation: 可定位、可比較的紀錄才支持變化判斷。
quiz.explanationEn: Located and comparable records support judgments about change.

steps.title: 區分漏水來源與排水路徑
steps.titleEn: Distinguish ingress sources from drainage paths
steps.objective: 解釋抽排能力不等於止水成功。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why pumping capacity does not prove successful water exclusion.
steps.instruction: 自繪接縫、集水溝、集水井和抽排出口，分別用箭頭表示外水進入與收集輸送。以示例時間表比較降雨、漏水位置及抽排量。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch joints, drains, sumps and discharge, using different arrows for water ingress and collection. Compare rainfall, leak locations and pumping in an invented timeline.
steps.observation: 觀察集水量變化可能來自入流改變，也可能來自排水路徑堵塞。
steps.observationEn: Changes in collected flow may reflect altered inflow or blocked drainage routes.
steps.failure: 抽水機仍運轉就推論沒有漏水，或流量下降就推論問題改善。
steps.failureEn: Inferring no ingress because pumps run, or improvement because measured flow falls.
steps.check: 指出兩種使觀測流量下降的不同情境與辨別資料。
steps.checkEn: Identify two different causes of reduced measured flow and evidence distinguishing them.

knowledge.title: 入流與輸送
knowledge.text: 滲入隧道的水與被量測到的排水，可能因蓄積或堵塞而不同。
knowledge.textEn: Ingress and measured drainage can differ because of storage or obstruction.

knowledge.title: 水量平衡
knowledge.text: 在有明確時間範圍的模型中，入流、出流和蓄積須互相一致。
knowledge.textEn: In a time-bounded model, inflow, outflow and storage change must be consistent.

options: 只確認供電存在，便排除所有排水問題
直接宣告外水已減少
收集及輸送路徑是否受阻
optionsEn: Confirm supply power and rule out all drainage problems
Immediately conclude external ingress has decreased
Whether collection or conveyance is obstructed
quiz.question: 排水量下降但局部積水升高，最應檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Drainage flow falls while local ponding rises. What most needs checking?
quiz.explanation: 流量與積水相反變化提示輸送問題，需核查路徑和量測。
quiz.explanationEn: Opposing flow and ponding trends suggest a conveyance issue requiring route and measurement checks.

steps.title: 辨認三條隧道的功能
steps.objective: 將交通、維護與避難功能在圖中分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate traffic, maintenance and refuge functions on a diagram.
steps.instruction: 自繪兩條行車隧道和中央服務隧道，再加入聯絡通道。用三種線型表示列車路線、維護通行與示意撤離方向，避免填入真實緊急操作命令。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch two running tunnels and a central service tunnel with cross-passages. Use distinct line styles for trains, maintenance and illustrative evacuation, without issuing real emergency instructions.
steps.observation: 觀察聯絡通道與供列車換線的橫渡洞室是否是不同構造。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish pedestrian/service cross-passages from rail crossover caverns.
steps.failure: 把服務隧道畫成第三條正常載客鐵路。
steps.failureEn: Drawing the service tunnel as a third regular passenger railway.
steps.check: 圖例應能一眼分辨三種功能與兩種橫向連接。
steps.checkEn: The key must distinguish the three functions and the two types of lateral connection.

knowledge.title: 功能隔離
knowledge.text: 中央服務隧道提供維護與緊急支援，與行車隧道用途不同。
knowledge.textEn: The central service tunnel supports maintenance and emergencies rather than normal rail traffic.

knowledge.title: 連接類型
knowledge.text: 聯絡通道服務人員移動；橫渡洞室則提供列車跨線能力。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-passages support movement of people; crossover caverns allow trains to change running tunnels.

options: 設有軌道的橫渡洞室
一般人行聯絡通道
服務隧道內的排水溝
optionsEn: A rail crossover cavern
An ordinary pedestrian cross-passage
A service-tunnel drain
quiz.question: 需要列車從一條行車隧道移到另一條時，對應哪個構造？
quiz.questionEn: Which structure allows a train to change from one running tunnel to the other?
quiz.explanation: 不同橫向連接有不同尺寸和用途，不能在系統圖上混用。
quiz.explanationEn: Different lateral connections serve different functions and must not be conflated.

steps.title: 讀懂服務隧道壓差概念
steps.objective: 理解保護空間與門、通風的相互依賴。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand dependencies among protected space, doors and ventilation.
steps.instruction: 以兩個箱體代表服務與行車隧道，畫出正常示意氣流和門開啟時的可能路徑。列出判斷氣流方向需要的資料，不自行設定火災排煙程序。
steps.instructionEn: Represent service and running tunnels as two boxes. Sketch intended airflow and possible paths when a door opens. List data needed to judge flow without defining fire-smoke operating procedures.
steps.observation: 注意風機狀態、壓差與門的位置並非同一個訊號。
steps.observationEn: Fan status, pressure difference and door position are different signals.
steps.failure: 只因風機顯示開啟，就認定保護空間一定維持壓差。
steps.failureEn: Assuming a protected space maintains pressure simply because a fan indicates running.
steps.check: 列出至少三個互相核對的狀態或觀察量。
steps.checkEn: List at least three states or observations to cross-check.

knowledge.title: 壓差屏障
knowledge.text: 適當的壓差可引導氣流；實際效果仍受開口與系統狀態影響。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure differences can direct flow; openings and system state affect actual performance.

knowledge.title: 功能驗證
knowledge.text: 設備運转訊號只能證明部分狀態，不能代替完整功能證據。
knowledge.textEn: A running indication establishes only part of the state, not complete functional performance.

options: 忽略壓差，因馬達已運轉
核對開口、氣流及感測狀態
立即認定所有門都關妥
optionsEn: Ignore pressure because motors are running
Check openings, airflow and sensor state
Assume all doors are properly closed
quiz.question: 風機開啟但保護區壓差不足，哪個判斷較合理？
quiz.questionEn: Fans run but protected-zone pressure is insufficient. Which judgment is sound?
quiz.explanation: 保護功能依賴整體狀態，必須把設備與環境證據合看。
quiz.explanationEn: Protection depends on system state, so equipment and environmental evidence must be combined.

stages.title: 襯砌與三隧道介面
stages.description: 追蹤環片接合、排水與聯絡通道在不同狀態的功能。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace segment joints, drainage and cross-passages under different system states.

steps.title: 整理軌道與機電淨空
steps.objective: 看出斷面配置中的安裝與維護衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify installation and maintenance conflicts in a cross-section.
steps.instruction: 在自繪圓形斷面放入列車包絡、步道、電車線、冷卻管與電纜。再畫一個設備維護所需空間，以虛線標記尚無尺寸資料的部分。
steps.instructionEn: Place a train envelope, walkway, catenary, cooling pipes and cables in a circular sketch. Add maintenance space and use dashed boundaries where dimensional evidence is missing.
steps.observation: 比較「裝得下」與「仍可檢查、撤離和維護」是否不同。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish physical fit from retained inspection, egress and maintenance access.
steps.failure: 只畫設備外形，忽略人員通行及拆換路徑。
steps.failureEn: Drawing equipment outlines without access or replacement paths.
steps.check: 找出兩個潛在介面衝突並列明需向哪個專業取得資料。
steps.checkEn: Identify two potential conflicts and the disciplines that must provide missing data.

knowledge.title: 包絡介面
knowledge.text: 設備配置須同時考慮車輛動態、結構和通行空間。
knowledge.textEn: Equipment layout must account for vehicle motion, structure and access together.

knowledge.title: 維護空間
knowledge.text: 正常運轉不碰撞，不等於能安全拆換或檢查設備。
knowledge.textEn: Collision-free operation does not establish that equipment can be inspected or replaced safely.

options: 是，唯一條件是不碰列車
只要管線顏色不同即可
尚未，通行與維護需求仍未滿足
optionsEn: Yes; avoiding the train is the only condition
Yes, if the pipe has a different color
No; access and maintenance requirements remain unresolved
quiz.question: 一條新管線不碰列車但占用步道，是否已完成介面檢核？
quiz.questionEn: A new pipe avoids the train but occupies the walkway. Is interface review complete?
quiz.explanation: 斷面有多種功能包絡，不能只檢查車輛外形。
quiz.explanationEn: The cross-section contains multiple functional envelopes, not only a train outline.

steps.title: 檢查供電與服務依賴
steps.objective: 說明冗餘電源不等於所有設備都無中斷。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why redundant supplies do not prove uninterrupted service for every load.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩岸電源、供電分段及列車、排水、照明三類負載。以紙上情境移除一個來源，標記哪些功能仍需切換與控制證據。
steps.instructionEn: Diagram power from both shores, supply sections and train, drainage and lighting loads. Remove one source in a paper scenario and mark functions requiring transfer and control evidence.
steps.observation: 比較電源存在、路徑可用與末端設備運轉三種狀態。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish source availability, path availability and operation of the final device.
steps.failure: 把圖上有兩個電源直接視為所有故障情況都有備援。
steps.failureEn: Treating two drawn power sources as proof of redundancy for every failure case.
steps.check: 為一個負載畫出完整替代路徑，並列一個共同失效點的疑問。
steps.checkEn: Trace an alternative path to one load and identify a possible common failure point.

knowledge.title: 端到端功能
knowledge.text: 備援需要從來源到負載的完整可用路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Redundancy requires a complete available path from source to load.

knowledge.title: 共同依賴
knowledge.text: 兩條供電路徑仍可能共用控制、保護或連接設備。
knowledge.textEn: Two supply paths may still share control, protection or connection equipment.

options: 替代來源到排水設備的整條路徑是否可用
只核對備援來源額定容量，不追蹤配電路徑
以其他負載正常推論排水設備必定可用
optionsEn: Is the complete alternative path to drainage equipment available?
Check backup source rating without tracing distribution
Infer drainage availability because other loads work
quiz.question: 確認排水備援時，哪個問題最重要？
quiz.questionEn: Which question matters most when verifying drainage backup?
quiz.explanation: 功能驗證必須追到負載，不能停在上游電源。
quiz.explanationEn: Verification must reach the load rather than stop at the upstream source.

steps.title: 組織維護占用與復歸證據
steps.titleEn: Organize maintenance possession and return evidence
steps.objective: 辨認施工完成與恢復運行間的交接責任。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish completion of work from authorization to resume service.
steps.instruction: 建立示意交接表，含區段、受影響設備、隔離狀態、檢查結果及未結案項。用「換線維護」桌上情境辨認交通與設備團隊的交界，不模擬真實控制指令。
steps.instructionEn: Build an illustrative handover sheet with section, affected equipment, isolation state, checks and open items. Use a crossover-maintenance tabletop scenario to identify team interfaces without simulating real control commands.
steps.observation: 觀察工件安裝完成是否仍有功能測試與文件核對未完成。
steps.observationEn: Notice whether physical completion still leaves functional tests or document reconciliation pending.
steps.failure: 以工時結束代替設備復歸與路線交接確認。
steps.failureEn: Treating the end of a work shift as confirmation of equipment restoration and route handover.
steps.check: 將施工完成、測試完成與授權狀態分成獨立欄位。
steps.checkEn: Keep work completion, test completion and authorization state in separate fields.

knowledge.title: 狀態交接
knowledge.text: 跨班或跨專業交接應描述實際設備狀態及尚未解除的限制。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-shift or cross-discipline handover must describe actual equipment state and remaining restrictions.

knowledge.title: 責任邊界
knowledge.text: 驗證證據與運行授權由不同角色承擔時，介面必須清楚。
knowledge.textEn: Interfaces must be explicit when verification and operating authority belong to different roles.

options: 直接填寫已全面復歸
機械完成與功能未驗證分別列示
刪除測試欄以免混淆
optionsEn: Mark fully restored
Record mechanical completion and unverified function separately
Remove the test field
quiz.question: 工件已裝回但功能測試未完成，交接表應如何表示？
quiz.questionEn: A component is reinstalled but functional testing is incomplete. How should it be recorded?
quiz.explanation: 不同完成層次不能互相替代，否則會掩蓋未結案工作。
quiz.explanationEn: Different completion levels are not interchangeable and must not hide unfinished work.

steps.title: 交付三隧道整合模型
steps.objective: 將土建與機電證據連成可查核的系統。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect civil and service-system evidence into an auditable model.
steps.instruction: 把地質、襯砌、漏水、通風和供電圖表整理成同一介面索引。選一個「供電中斷伴隨滲水」假想情境，指出需聯合查證的兩個系統與資料缺口。
steps.instructionEn: Index ground, lining, ingress, ventilation and power records together. For an invented power-loss-plus-ingress scenario, identify two systems requiring joint review and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 檢查每個功能主張是否有可定位的圖表或紀錄支持。
steps.observationEn: Check that each functional claim has a located diagram or record behind it.
steps.failure: 各專業圖表單獨完整，卻無法對齊區段名稱與狀態。
steps.failureEn: Individually complete discipline records cannot be reconciled by location or state.
steps.check: 提交共享區段索引、假設清單與至少三項未解介面問題。
steps.checkEn: Submit a common section index, assumptions and at least three unresolved interface questions.

knowledge.title: 系統整合
knowledge.text: 隧道能否服務取決於土建、設備、交通與維護的共同狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Tunnel service depends on combined civil, equipment, traffic and maintenance states.

knowledge.title: 共同識別
knowledge.text: 一致的區段與設備識別可防止把不同位置的證據錯接。
knowledge.textEn: Consistent section and equipment identifiers prevent mismatching evidence from different locations.

options: 只核對總設備數量是否相同
只比較各自最後一次正常結果
區段、設備識別、時間及狀態
optionsEn: Whether total equipment counts match
Compare only each system’s latest normal result
Section, equipment identity, time and state
quiz.question: 整合兩份排水與供電紀錄前，最先應核對什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What should first be reconciled when integrating drainage and power records?
quiz.explanation: 共同識別與時間狀態使不同專業證據可以正確連結。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared identifiers and time/state information allow evidence from different disciplines to be connected correctly.

stages.title: 機電整合與交付
stages.description: 以桌上情境檢查通風、供電、交通和維護的依賴。
stages.descriptionEn: Use tabletop scenarios to review dependencies among ventilation, power, traffic and maintenance.

title: 英法海底隧道
summary: 從白堊泥灰岩選線到三隧道營運系統，練習地質推論、支承、防水與機電整合。
summaryEn: Study geological inference, support, water control and systems integration from chalk-marl alignment to three-bore operation.
scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.

steps.title: 分開水庫、壩體與洩流路徑
steps.titleEn: Separate reservoir, dam and release paths
steps.objective: 分辨擋水、蓄水、發電和溢洪功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish retention, storage, generation and spillway functions.
steps.instruction: 自繪水庫、壩體、進水塔、壓力管、電廠及兩側溢洪路徑。以不同線型追蹤發電水路與溢洪水路到下游，標出它們與壩體的介面。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch reservoir, dam, intake towers, penstocks, powerhouse and side spillways. Trace generation and spillway routes to downstream using distinct line styles and mark dam interfaces.
steps.observation: 確認溢洪水路並非越過壩頂流向電廠。
steps.observationEn: Confirm that the spillway route does not pass over the dam crest onto the powerhouse.
steps.failure: 將所有放流水都畫成穿過水輪機，忽略獨立洩流功能。
steps.failureEn: Drawing all released water through turbines and overlooking separate release functions.
steps.check: 圖中須有兩條可獨立追蹤的水路及各自功能。
steps.checkEn: Show two independently traceable water routes and their functions.

knowledge.title: 功能分流
knowledge.text: 蓄水結構與不同出流路徑共同構成水庫系統。
knowledge.textEn: The retaining structure and different outlet routes jointly form the reservoir system.

knowledge.title: 介面辨識
knowledge.text: 進水、管路、發電與下游水流的交界需要清楚定義。
knowledge.textEn: Interfaces among intakes, conduits, generation and downstream flow need clear definitions.

options: 溢洪道
水輪機壓力管，所有溢洪都必須經過它
壩頂道路，作為預定水流越頂路徑
optionsEn: Spillway
Turbine penstocks, which all spill flow must use
The crest road as the intended overtopping route
quiz.question: 哪個構造最直接提供與發電水路分開的高水位洩流途徑？
quiz.questionEn: Which structure most directly provides a high-water release path separate from generation?
quiz.explanation: 溢洪系統有獨立的水流路徑，不能以水輪機水路代替。
quiz.explanationEn: The spillway has its own hydraulic path and cannot be represented by the turbine route.

steps.title: 追蹤拱壩與重力作用
steps.objective: 解釋壩體、基底與兩岸岩體如何共同受力。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain joint load transfer through dam body, base and canyon rock.
steps.instruction: 畫平面與剖面兩張示意：平面標水壓與向兩岸傳力，剖面標自重、基底及水壓。註明這是厚拱壩的定性模型，不能用箭頭直接判定安全。
steps.instructionEn: Draw plan and section: show pressure and transfer toward abutments in plan, then weight, base and water pressure in section. Label this a qualitative thick-arch model, not a safety calculation.
steps.observation: 觀察只畫剖面是否會遺漏兩岸岩體的作用。
steps.observationEn: Notice what abutment action is lost when only a section is drawn.
steps.failure: 將壩的全部抵抗能力只歸因於重量或只歸因於拱形。
steps.failureEn: Attributing all resistance solely to weight or solely to curvature.
steps.check: 兩張圖應共同包含水、壩體、基底和兩岸的力路徑。
steps.checkEn: Together, the sketches must include water, dam, base and abutment force paths.

knowledge.title: 三維受力
knowledge.text: 厚拱壩的行為需同時考慮壩體與岩體支承，單一剖面不完整。
knowledge.textEn: A thick arch dam requires consideration of dam and rock support; one section is incomplete.

knowledge.title: 邊界可靠性
knowledge.text: 理想模型假設的支承能力需要地質與變形證據支持。
knowledge.textEn: Support capacity assumed in an ideal model needs geological and deformation evidence.

options: 兩岸只限制滲水，不參與傳力
拱作用把部分荷載傳入兩岸
拱形會使地基完全不受力
optionsEn: Abutments only limit seepage and carry no structural load
Arch action transfers part of the load into the abutments
Curvature makes the foundation entirely unloaded
quiz.question: 兩岸岩體的條件為何影響拱作用判讀？
quiz.questionEn: Why do abutment-rock conditions matter for arch action?
quiz.explanation: 受力路徑需要能承接反力的岩體邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: The load path needs rock boundaries capable of providing reactions.

steps.title: 重建導流與乾地作業依賴
steps.objective: 理解臨時導流如何提供永久工程的作業條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how temporary diversion enables permanent works.
steps.instruction: 依歷史資料畫出原河道、導流隧道與壩基作業區。用三格示意比較導流前、導流中和永久水路形成後，記錄每格水流去向。
steps.instructionEn: From historical accounts, sketch the river, diversion tunnels and foundation work area. Compare pre-diversion, diversion and permanent-waterway states, recording the flow destination in each.
steps.observation: 檢查某一格是否意外把所有流路同時關閉。
steps.observationEn: Check whether a state inadvertently closes every flow route.
steps.failure: 把圍堰視為不受來水影響的永久邊界，省略施工期洪水疑問。
steps.failureEn: Treating cofferdams as permanent, flow-independent boundaries and omitting construction-flood questions.
steps.check: 每一格都保留連續水路及尚待專業分析的施工期風險。
steps.checkEn: Preserve a continuous water route and a construction-risk question in each state.

knowledge.title: 臨時工程
knowledge.text: 臨時設施的功能與失效會直接影響永久工程的施工條件。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary-work functions and failures directly affect conditions for permanent construction.

knowledge.title: 狀態轉換
knowledge.text: 由導流到蓄水是系統邊界的變更，需要另行驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Transition from diversion to impoundment changes system boundaries and needs separate verification.

options: 尚未列出最後一台發電機的安裝日期
沒有先列出永久工程總材料量
某階段沒有說明來水可往何處流
optionsEn: The last generator’s installation date is not yet given
Permanent-work material totals are not listed first
A stage gives no destination for incoming water
quiz.question: 在導流轉換圖中最嚴重的缺漏是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is the most significant omission in a diversion-transition diagram?
quiz.explanation: 轉換階段仍須追蹤水流，不能因圖是中間狀態就忽略。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow must remain accounted for even during an intermediate state.

steps.title: 整理壩基與裂隙證據
steps.objective: 分開岩石材料、接觸面與滲流路徑問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate rock-material, contact and seepage-path questions.
steps.instruction: 在假想基岩剖面標記裂隙、壩基接觸面、排水與觀測位置。建立「材料強度」「接面狀態」「水壓」三欄，為每欄列出不同證據。
steps.instructionEn: On an invented rock section, mark discontinuities, dam contact, drains and observations. Create separate material-strength, contact-condition and water-pressure columns with distinct evidence needs.
steps.observation: 注意堅硬岩石仍可能包含需要調查的裂隙與水路。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that strong rock may still contain discontinuities and water paths needing investigation.
steps.failure: 只用岩石名稱或表面硬度，就認定壩基介面完整。
steps.failureEn: Declaring the foundation interface sound from rock name or surface hardness alone.
steps.check: 三欄均須有觀察量與至少一項無法單獨推論的結論。
steps.checkEn: Give an observable and a conclusion it cannot establish alone in each column.

knowledge.title: 岩體與岩塊
knowledge.text: 岩塊性質不能完整代表含裂隙岩體的行為。
knowledge.textEn: Intact-rock properties do not fully describe a fractured rock mass.

knowledge.title: 水壓與接觸
knowledge.text: 滲流條件會影響接觸面的有效受力，需與結構資料一起判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Seepage conditions affect effective contact loading and must be interpreted with structural evidence.

options: 該試體在試驗條件下的材料表現
整個壩基所有裂隙均不透水
任何水位下都不需監測
optionsEn: Material behavior of that specimen under test conditions
Every foundation discontinuity is watertight
Monitoring is unnecessary at any reservoir level
quiz.question: 完整岩心強度良好，可直接證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Good intact-core strength directly establishes what?
quiz.explanation: 試體證據有取樣與尺度範圍，不能無條件推廣到整個岩體。
quiz.explanationEn: Specimen evidence has sampling and scale limits and cannot automatically represent the whole rock mass.

stages.title: 河谷與施工邊界
stages.description: 分清永久工程的受力、水路與臨時導流。
stages.descriptionEn: Distinguish permanent load paths, water routes and temporary diversion.

steps.title: 閱讀分塊澆置的介面
steps.objective: 辨認分塊施工與最終整體作用的差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish block construction from final integrated behavior.
steps.instruction: 把壩體畫成少量教學用方塊，標記不同完成高度與接縫。比較「單塊已有強度」和「相鄰區塊已形成設計傳力」兩種判斷所需的證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a few educational dam blocks with unequal completion heights and joints. Compare evidence for one block gaining strength with evidence for intended transfer between adjacent blocks.
steps.observation: 觀察接縫狀態改變時，整體模型的連續性假設也需變更。
steps.observationEn: Notice how joint-state changes alter assumptions about structural continuity.
steps.failure: 因所有塊體都已澆完，就視為接縫與整體作用自動完成。
steps.failureEn: Assuming joints and integrated action are complete because all blocks have been poured.
steps.check: 標記每個示意接縫的狀態與尚缺驗證，避免填施工尺寸。
steps.checkEn: Mark each joint state and missing verification without assigning construction dimensions.

knowledge.title: 分塊邏輯
knowledge.text: 分塊可管理施工與熱行為；最終整體作用仍須處理接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Blocks organize construction and thermal behavior; final integrated action still depends on joints.

knowledge.title: 狀態紀錄
knowledge.text: 施工紀錄須能說明各區塊在同一時間的實際成熟與接合狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Records should identify each block’s maturity and connection state at a common time.

options: 以最後澆置日期代替所有接合驗證
接縫處理與整體傳力條件
以各塊外觀完整代替整體作用查證
optionsEn: Use the last pour date in place of all joint verification
Joint treatment and conditions for integrated load transfer
Use intact block appearance as proof of integrated action
quiz.question: 所有壩塊已澆置，哪項仍須單獨查證？
quiz.questionEn: All blocks are poured. What still requires independent verification?
quiz.explanation: 材料放置完成不等於所有介面功能完成。
quiz.explanationEn: Completion of material placement does not establish completion of every interface function.

steps.title: 比較水化熱與冷卻歷程
steps.titleEn: Compare hydration heat and cooling histories
steps.objective: 理解溫度梯度、收縮與裂縫的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand relationships among thermal gradients, contraction and cracking.
steps.instruction: 自繪混凝土核心與表面兩條溫度—時間曲線，再畫冷卻較快的比較曲線。標記水化放熱、散熱及相對收縮，不採用歷史設備數值作今日設定。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch core and surface temperature histories and a faster-cooling comparison. Mark hydration heat, heat loss and relative contraction without using historical equipment values as present settings.
steps.observation: 比較最高溫相近但內外溫差不同的情況。
steps.observationEn: Compare cases with similar peak temperature but different internal-to-surface gradients.
steps.failure: 把快速降溫一概當作越快越好，忽略拘束與梯度。
steps.failureEn: Assuming faster cooling is always better while ignoring restraint and gradients.
steps.check: 解釋為何峰值、梯度與時間歷程都需保留。
steps.checkEn: Explain why peak, gradient and time history all need to be retained.

knowledge.title: 熱源與尺度
knowledge.text: 大體積混凝土的內部熱不易迅速逸散，溫度分布會不均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Heat within mass concrete does not escape quickly, producing nonuniform temperatures.

knowledge.title: 拘束收縮
knowledge.text: 自由收縮受到相鄰材料或幾何拘束時，可能產生應力。
knowledge.textEn: Contraction restrained by adjacent material or geometry can generate stress.

options: 是，最高溫是唯一需要的資料
只需表面溫度相同即可認定等效
不一定，梯度、拘束與材料歷程也影響結果
optionsEn: Yes; peak temperature is the only relevant data
Equal surface temperature alone establishes equivalence
No; gradients, restraint and material history also matter
quiz.question: 相同最高溫的兩塊混凝土，裂縫風險必定相同嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Do two concrete blocks with the same peak temperature necessarily share cracking risk?
quiz.explanation: 最高溫只描述熱歷程的一部分，無法取代梯度和拘束證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Peak temperature captures only part of thermal history and cannot replace gradient and restraint evidence.

steps.title: 分清接縫灌漿與排水
steps.objective: 避免把填充接縫與降低滲流水壓混成同一功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid conflating joint filling with management of seepage pressure.
steps.instruction: 在兩張小圖分別畫壩塊接縫與壩基排水路徑。用功能敘述解釋灌漿、止水與排水各想改變什麼，再列出需查證的效果。
steps.instructionEn: Draw block joints and foundation drainage in separate sketches. Explain what grouting, water barriers and drainage seek to change, then identify evidence of their effects.
steps.observation: 觀察流量減少是否同時需要查看水壓，而非單獨判為改善。
steps.observationEn: Check whether reduced flow also requires pressure data before it is called an improvement.
steps.failure: 把排水孔流量變小直接認定為止水良好，忽略可能堵塞。
steps.failureEn: Treating falling drain flow as proof of improved water exclusion while overlooking possible blockage.
steps.check: 提交功能對照與一組「流量下降」的兩種替代解釋。
steps.checkEn: Provide a function comparison and two alternative explanations for falling flow.
