knowledge.title: 功能區別
knowledge.text: 填充或接合、限制入流與引導排水，是不同工程功能。
knowledge.textEn: Filling or joining, limiting ingress and conveying drainage are different engineering functions.

knowledge.title: 組合證據
knowledge.text: 流量與壓力一起看，比只看其中一項更能限制錯誤推論。
knowledge.textEn: Flow and pressure considered together constrain interpretations better than either alone.

options: 排水路徑受阻等替代原因
整體止水效果必然變好
只增加流量讀數次數，忽略壓力上升
optionsEn: Alternative causes such as obstructed drainage
Water exclusion has necessarily improved
Repeat flow readings while ignoring rising pressure
quiz.question: 排水流量下降而附近水壓升高，應優先考慮什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Drain flow falls while nearby water pressure rises. What warrants consideration?
quiz.explanation: 相反的水壓與流量趨勢不能只解讀為漏水減少。
quiz.explanationEn: Opposing pressure and flow trends cannot be interpreted solely as reduced leakage.

steps.title: 連結進水、管路與水輪機
steps.titleEn: Link intake, conduit and turbine interfaces
steps.objective: 辨識高程差、流量與瞬變的不同問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish head, flow and transient-response questions.
steps.instruction: 自繪水面、進水口、壓力管和水輪機的高程關係。用兩格比較穩定流動與流量改變的概念，註明沒有進行真實閥門操作或壓力計算。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch elevations of reservoir surface, intake, penstock and turbine. Compare steady flow and changing flow in two panels, explicitly excluding real valve operation or pressure calculations.
steps.observation: 注意管路不是只把水運送到機組，也承受壓力與約束反力。
steps.observationEn: A conduit transports water while also carrying pressure and restraint forces.
steps.failure: 只用高程差估算發電概念，就宣稱已驗證管路所有受力。
steps.failureEn: Claiming complete conduit verification from an elevation-based generation estimate alone.
steps.check: 列出穩態與瞬變各需的資料，並保留未知邊界條件。
steps.checkEn: List data needed for steady and transient states, keeping unknown boundary conditions explicit.

knowledge.title: 能量路徑
knowledge.text: 水位差提供能量潛力；實際輸出還受流量與損失影響。
knowledge.textEn: Water-level difference provides energy potential; output also depends on flow and losses.

knowledge.title: 瞬變效應
knowledge.text: 流速改變會引起隨時間變化的壓力，不能只用穩態圖描述。
knowledge.textEn: Changing velocity produces time-varying pressure that a steady-state diagram cannot fully describe.

options: 穩態平均壓力必定等於所有瞬時峰值
流量變化可能造成動態壓力反應
只要高程不變，壓力就不可能隨時間變化
optionsEn: Steady mean pressure necessarily equals every transient peak
Changing flow can create a dynamic pressure response
If elevation stays fixed, pressure cannot change with time
quiz.question: 為何穩態壓力資料不能單獨代表快速流量變化時的狀態？
quiz.questionEn: Why cannot steady pressure alone represent a rapid flow change?
quiz.explanation: 瞬變是時間相關的系統反應，需要額外的模型及資料。
quiz.explanationEn: A transient is a time-dependent system response requiring additional modeling and evidence.

stages.title: 壩體與水工介面
stages.description: 追蹤分塊、熱變形、接縫與管路的相互影響。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace interactions among blocks, thermal movement, joints and conduits.

steps.title: 從溢洪道侵蝕追查水流
steps.titleEn: Trace spillway erosion to flow behavior
steps.objective: 區分看到的損傷與尚未確定的侵蝕機制。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate observed damage from an unconfirmed erosion mechanism.
steps.instruction: 依歷史案例自繪溢洪道至斜隧道的路徑，在一處標示假想侵蝕。列出流路幾何、接縫、流量歷程與表面調查等需查證資料，不直接指定修補材料。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch the historical spillway-to-inclined-tunnel path and mark hypothetical erosion. List geometry, joints, flow history and surface evidence to investigate without prescribing repair materials.
steps.observation: 比較同樣「混凝土缺損」可能具有不同位置、發展速度及成因。
steps.observationEn: Similar concrete loss may differ in location, growth rate and cause.
steps.failure: 看見侵蝕就套用單一成因，或把修補完成當成成因已排除。
steps.failureEn: Assigning one cause from appearance or treating a completed repair as proof the cause is removed.
steps.check: 建立損傷地圖，明確分出已觀察事實與待驗證機制。
steps.checkEn: Create a damage map distinguishing observed facts from mechanisms requiring verification.

knowledge.title: 水工損傷
knowledge.text: 高速水流與局部幾何可能形成複雜作用；外觀不足以單獨辨因。
knowledge.textEn: High-speed flow and local geometry can interact in complex ways; appearance alone is insufficient for diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 歷史回饋
knowledge.text: 既有侵蝕與修復紀錄提供檢查重點，但不能直接代替新事件調查。
knowledge.textEn: Historical erosion and repairs guide inspection but do not replace investigation of a new event.

options: 只核對修補材料強度，不檢查流路
沿用前次成因，不核對本次事件條件
事件流量歷程、幾何和局部表面狀態
optionsEn: Check repair strength without examining the water route
Reuse the previous diagnosis without checking this event
Event flow history, geometry and local surface conditions
quiz.question: 修補區再次出現侵蝕，最應補查哪類證據？
quiz.questionEn: Erosion reappears near a repair. What evidence most needs review?
quiz.explanation: 反覆損傷需要回到水流與局部介面的機制，而非只記錄修補外觀。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated damage requires review of flow and interface mechanisms, not only repaired appearance.

steps.title: 建立壩體監測比較窗
steps.objective: 把水位、溫度與變形的時間關係分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate time relationships among reservoir level, temperature and deformation.
steps.instruction: 自行製作六列示例水位、氣溫、位移與排水紀錄，標記季節性變化。挑出兩組相近條件資料，比較剩餘差異並保留儀器核對欄。
steps.instructionEn: Invent six records of reservoir level, temperature, movement and drainage, marking seasonal variation. Compare two matched-condition groups and retain an instrument-check field.
steps.observation: 觀察同一位移數字可能對應不同水位或溫度狀態。
steps.observationEn: The same displacement value may occur under different water-level or temperature conditions.
steps.failure: 把正常環境循環或感測器零點變更直接當成永久損傷。
steps.failureEn: Treating environmental cycles or sensor-zero changes as permanent damage.
steps.check: 為一個異常保留環境、儀器與結構三種可能解釋。
steps.checkEn: Retain environmental, instrument and structural explanations for one anomaly.

knowledge.title: 條件化比較
knowledge.text: 跨時比較應記錄荷載與環境，避免將不同條件混成趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Comparisons over time should retain load and environment rather than merge different conditions into one trend.

knowledge.title: 證據交叉核對
knowledge.text: 位移、滲流和目視紀錄各有盲點，組合使用有助限制誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Movement, seepage and visual records have different blind spots; combining them limits misinterpretation.

options: 有需要進一步檢驗的相關性
已證明全部由溫度造成
已證明壩體永久失效
optionsEn: A correlation requiring further examination
Temperature has been proven the sole cause
Permanent dam failure has been proven
quiz.question: 位移季節性變化與氣溫同步，能直接推論什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Displacement varies seasonally with temperature. What can be inferred directly?
quiz.explanation: 同步變化是線索，並非單獨的因果或安全證明。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronous variation is a clue, not standalone causal or safety proof.

steps.title: 做有邊界的水量收支
steps.objective: 區分蓄水變化與不同出流用途。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish storage change from different outflow uses.
steps.instruction: 自設一個單日水量例子，列入入流、放流、蒸發與蓄水變化。再畫兩個不同放流分配的教學情境，只比較質量守恆，不提出真實調度建議。
steps.instructionEn: Invent a one-day example with inflow, release, evaporation and storage change. Compare two illustrative release allocations for mass balance only, without recommending real reservoir operations.
steps.observation: 檢查發電流量與總放流是否被重複計入。
steps.observationEn: Check whether generation flow is double-counted within total release.
steps.failure: 將通過水輪機的水當成消失，或忽略水庫蓄積。
steps.failureEn: Treating turbine flow as consumed water or omitting storage change.
steps.check: 收支需閉合，並標明全部數字是自設例子及尚缺用途限制。
steps.checkEn: Close the balance and label all numbers as invented, with unmodeled use constraints.

knowledge.title: 守恆邊界
knowledge.text: 在選定空間與時間內，水量入出與蓄積必須一致。
knowledge.textEn: Within defined space and time, inflow, outflow and storage must balance.

knowledge.title: 多重目標
knowledge.text: 供水、發電、洪水與環境問題不會被單一水量平衡自動解決。
knowledge.textEn: A water balance alone does not resolve supply, energy, flood and environmental objectives.

options: 同時列為兩次出流
作為出流，不再另列一次消耗
從所有收支欄刪除
optionsEn: As two separate outflows
As outflow, without counting a second consumption
Omit it from the balance
quiz.question: 水流經水輪機後到達下游，在水庫收支中應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: Water passes through turbines to downstream. How is it represented in the reservoir balance?
quiz.explanation: 同一水量不能因用途名稱不同而重複計算。
quiz.explanationEn: The same water must not be counted twice because it has different use labels.

steps.title: 編成壩工證據與限制清單
steps.objective: 交付能區分歷史案例、模型與實測需求的資料。
steps.objectiveEn: Deliver records distinguishing historical cases, models and measurement needs.
steps.instruction: 整理水路圖、受力圖、施工狀態、熱曲線與監測表。為每項結論註記它屬歷史事實、教學假設或仍需實測，並列出專業複核邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Organize route, force, construction-state, thermal and monitoring records. Label each conclusion as historical fact, educational assumption or needing measurement, and identify professional-review boundaries.
steps.observation: 核對舊施工記錄是否被誤寫成現行通用規格。
steps.observationEn: Check whether a historical construction record has been misrepresented as a current universal specification.
steps.failure: 把課程示意數值寫入真實施工、設備或放流水量設定。
steps.failureEn: Transferring illustrative course values into actual construction, equipment or release settings.
steps.check: 至少五項判斷可回查到來源或自設假設，未解問題單獨列出。
steps.checkEn: Make at least five conclusions traceable to sources or declared assumptions, with open issues listed separately.

knowledge.title: 歷史與規範
knowledge.text: 歷史工程能提供思考案例，但今日設計需另外的資料與程序。
knowledge.textEn: Historical engineering provides cases for reasoning; present design requires additional evidence and procedures.

knowledge.title: 範圍宣告
knowledge.text: 證據能支持什麼及不能支持什麼，都應出現在交付中。
knowledge.textEn: A handover should state both what evidence supports and what it does not.

options: 已完成課程，所以真壩可按此圖操作
歷史數字可直接套用任何新壩
本模型展示功能與依賴，尚非壩體安全鑑定
optionsEn: Course completion authorizes operation from this sketch
Historical values apply directly to any new dam
This model shows functions and dependencies, not a dam-safety assessment
quiz.question: 哪項交付敘述最合適？
quiz.questionEn: Which handover statement is most appropriate?
quiz.explanation: 學習模型的可審查性不等於真實工程驗證完成。
quiz.explanationEn: A reviewable learning model is not completed validation of a real engineering system.

stages.title: 洩流與長期判讀
stages.description: 以侵蝕、監測與水量證據檢查工程的運作邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Review operating boundaries using erosion, monitoring and water-balance evidence.

title: 胡佛壩
summary: 以導流、大體積混凝土、壩基及洩流系統理解大型壩工的工序依賴與證據。
summaryEn: Understand dependencies and evidence in large-dam engineering through diversion, mass concrete, foundations and water-release systems.
scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.

steps.title: 建立高鐵系統邊界
steps.objective: 分開土建、軌道、供電、車輛、控制及營運介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate civil, track, power, vehicle, control and operations interfaces.
steps.instruction: 畫出土建承托軌道、軌道導引車輛的主鏈，再加供電與控制連到車輛。以不同箭頭表示力、能量與資訊，為每種介面列一項驗證問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw civil support to track to vehicle, then connect power and control to the vehicle. Use distinct arrows for force, energy and information, with one verification question per interface.
steps.observation: 觀察車輛能運轉是否仍不足以證明軌道與控制整合已完成。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that a moving train alone does not establish completed track and control integration.
steps.failure: 把高鐵等同於一列高速列車，省略路線與控制條件。
steps.failureEn: Equating a high-speed railway with a fast train while omitting route and control conditions.
steps.check: 六個子系統都有介面，且箭頭的物理意義清楚。
steps.checkEn: Connect all six subsystems and explain the physical meaning of each arrow.

knowledge.title: 跨專業系統
knowledge.text: 高速運行取決於車輛與路線、供電、控制及營運的一致性。
knowledge.textEn: High-speed operation depends on compatibility among vehicles, route, power, control and operations.

knowledge.title: 不同傳遞量
knowledge.text: 力、電能與控制資訊需要不同驗證，不能用同一箭頭含糊表示。
knowledge.textEn: Force, electrical energy and control information require different verification and should not share an ambiguous arrow.

options: 與路線動態及控制系統相容
列車靜態寬度已被量測
尺寸文件有可比對的幾何內容
optionsEn: Compatibility with route dynamics and control
That static train width was measured
That the dimensional record contains comparable geometry
quiz.question: 列車靜態尺寸合格，還不能單獨證明哪件事？
quiz.questionEn: A train meets static dimensional requirements. What does that not establish by itself?
quiz.explanation: 靜態幾何只是整合條件的一部分，仍需動態與控制證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Static geometry is only part of integration; dynamic and control evidence remains necessary.

steps.title: 比較曲線與行車需求
steps.titleEn: Compare alignment curves and service needs
steps.objective: 理解速度、曲線與舒適性的相互約束。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand relationships among speed, curvature and ride requirements.
steps.instruction: 自繪直線、緩和曲線與圓曲線的概念路線，標出方向變化。比較兩種示意速度下需要關注的橫向反應，不指定實線設計半徑或超高。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch straight, transition and circular alignment sections, marking direction changes. Compare lateral-response concerns at two illustrative speeds without assigning real design radius or cant.
steps.observation: 觀察平面方向平順，是否仍有垂向坡度或接續問題。
steps.observationEn: Check whether a smooth plan alignment still leaves vertical-gradient or transition issues.
steps.failure: 只看列車最高速度，就認定所有曲線都能以同速通過。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every curve supports a train’s maximum rated speed.
steps.check: 交付平面及縱向問題各一項，說明缺少的驗證資料。
steps.checkEn: Provide one plan and one vertical-profile question with missing verification data.

knowledge.title: 速度與曲率
knowledge.text: 橫向運動反應取決於速度與曲率的組合，而非車輛標稱速度。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral motion depends on the combination of speed and curvature, not the vehicle’s rated speed alone.

knowledge.title: 平順接續
knowledge.text: 方向或坡度變化需要連續性考量，不能只把直線片段接起來。
knowledge.textEn: Direction and gradient changes require continuity considerations rather than simply joining straight segments.

options: 車輛靜態長度是否自行縮短
橫向動態反應與舒適性如何改變
既有曲線的幾何是否因速度而自動改變
optionsEn: Whether static vehicle length automatically shortens
How lateral response and comfort change
Whether curve geometry automatically changes with speed
quiz.question: 同一曲線提高示意速度時，最合理的研究問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: If illustrative speed increases on the same curve, which question is most relevant?
quiz.explanation: 速度變動改變動態需求；不能假定幾何或車輛尺寸會自行補償。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing speed alters dynamic demands; geometry and vehicle dimensions do not automatically compensate.

steps.title: 追蹤地層下陷到軌道
steps.objective: 分辨均勻沉降與差異沉降的介面影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish interface effects of uniform and differential settlement.
steps.instruction: 用同一條示意軌道畫均勻下降與局部下降兩種剖面。將地面觀測、橋墩位移與軌道高低資料列成三層，說明不能互相替代的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Draw uniform and localized settlement beneath the same illustrative track. Separate ground observations, pier movement and track levels into three evidence layers and explain their limits.
steps.observation: 比較總沉降相近的兩例，局部坡折是否不同。
steps.observationEn: Compare local gradient changes in examples with similar total settlement.
steps.failure: 以沿線平均沉降值代表所有局部軌道變化。
steps.failureEn: Using average line-wide settlement to represent every local track change.
steps.check: 指出最需補充局部量測的位置，並維持共同高程基準。
steps.checkEn: Identify locations needing local measurements and retain a common elevation datum.

knowledge.title: 差異變形
knowledge.text: 鄰近支承的相對變形會影響幾何連續性，不能只看平均值。
knowledge.textEn: Relative movement of neighboring supports affects geometric continuity and is not captured by an average.

knowledge.title: 跨層證據
knowledge.text: 地盤、土建與軌道的反應需對齊位置和時間才可比較。
knowledge.textEn: Ground, civil and track responses must share location and time references to be compared.

options: 所有支承一起均勻下降的一段必定較差
僅憑總沉降即可判定兩者完全相同
沉降集中在短距離內的一段
optionsEn: The uniformly settling section must be worse
Total settlement alone proves the sections identical
The section where settlement is concentrated over a short distance
quiz.question: 兩段總沉降相同，哪段仍可能有較大的幾何變化？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections have equal total settlement. Which may still have greater geometric change?
quiz.explanation: 沉降的空間分布會改變坡度與曲率，即使總量相同。
quiz.explanationEn: Spatial distribution changes slope and curvature even when total settlement is equal.

steps.title: 檢查橋梁與軌道支承介面
steps.objective: 把預鑄構件交接連到軌道幾何基準。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect precast-member handover to track-geometry references.
steps.instruction: 以自繪高架橋分開橋墩、支承、梁體與軌道層，標出縱向伸縮和量測基準。列出梁體就位後，軌道專業仍需取得的幾何與狀態資料。
steps.instructionEn: Separate piers, bearings, girders and track layers in a viaduct sketch. Mark longitudinal movement and survey references; list geometry and state records needed by the track team after girder placement.
steps.observation: 注意梁體就位合格不等於軌道精度與長期位移已被驗證。
steps.observationEn: Accepted girder placement does not establish track precision or long-term movement behavior.
steps.failure: 將橋梁竣工標高直接當成最終鋼軌標高，忽略中間構造。
steps.failureEn: Treating bridge as-built level as final rail level while omitting intermediate layers.
steps.check: 完成土建到軌道的介面表，至少含基準、可動方向與待補資料。
steps.checkEn: Complete a civil-to-track interface sheet including reference, movement direction and missing records.

knowledge.title: 層間累積
knowledge.text: 各層厚度、調整與變形共同決定鋼軌最終幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Layer thickness, adjustment and deformation together determine final rail geometry.

knowledge.title: 可動支承
knowledge.text: 設計允許的伸縮與需要限制的位移，應在模型中分清。
knowledge.textEn: Intended movement and movement that must be restrained should be distinguished in the model.

options: 中間層與調整量共同決定軌面位置
梁頂標高與軌面必定相同
軌道幾何與土建從不互相影響
optionsEn: Intermediate layers and adjustments determine rail position
Girder-top and rail elevations are necessarily identical
Track geometry and civil works never interact
quiz.question: 梁頂標高正確，為何還需軌道層交接資料？
quiz.questionEn: Why are track-layer records needed even if girder-top elevation is correct?
quiz.explanation: 交接要追蹤完整尺寸鏈，而不是只驗證其中一層。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover must trace the full dimensional chain, not only one layer.

stages.title: 路線與土建介面
stages.description: 將路線幾何、地盤與橋梁條件連到軌道需求。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect alignment, ground and bridge conditions to track requirements.

steps.title: 比較軌道形式及轉換區
steps.titleEn: Compare track forms and transition zones
steps.objective: 理解不同軌道形式回應不同介面要求。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how track forms respond to different interface needs.
steps.instruction: 依探索館說明，整理版式軌道、道岔附近的配置和低振動軌道三種功能重點。畫兩種剛度不同的軌道相接，列出需量測的幾何與動態反應。
steps.instructionEn: Using the museum overview, compare slab-track, turnout-area and low-vibration functions. Sketch a transition between track forms of different stiffness and identify geometric and dynamic observations.
steps.observation: 觀察靜態軌面平順是否仍可能有支承剛度變化。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that a smooth static rail profile can still cross a stiffness change.
steps.failure: 把全線軌道假定為單一材料與單一剛度。
steps.failureEn: Assuming one material and stiffness for the entire line.
steps.check: 比較表須有功能、支承差異及轉換區待驗證事項。
steps.checkEn: Include purpose, support differences and transition-zone verification needs.

knowledge.title: 功能選型
knowledge.text: 道岔定位、一般正線與振動控制可能需要不同構造組合。
knowledge.textEn: Turnout positioning, ordinary main line and vibration control can require different structural arrangements.

knowledge.title: 過渡反應
knowledge.text: 支承特性突變可影響輪軌互動，需與幾何一起檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Abrupt support-property changes can affect wheel–rail interaction and should be examined with geometry.

options: 有，軌頂相同即代表剛度相同
沒有，支承特性與動態反應仍需證據
只要列車靜止不晃就已足夠
optionsEn: Yes; equal rail elevation means equal stiffness
No; support properties and dynamic response still need evidence
A stationary train not rocking is sufficient
quiz.question: 兩段軌頂高程相同，是否已證明轉換區動態相容？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections have equal rail elevation. Does that prove dynamic compatibility at the transition?
quiz.explanation: 高程只描述幾何的一部分，無法取代動態介面檢核。
quiz.explanationEn: Elevation describes only part of geometry and does not replace dynamic interface review.

steps.title: 分開道岔位置與路線確認
steps.titleEn: Separate turnout position from route confirmation
steps.objective: 辨識機械位置、位置證據與通行授權。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish mechanical position, position evidence and movement authority.
steps.instruction: 畫一個簡化分岔軌道，用不同符號表示移動部件、位置回報和控制狀態。寫出「位置未知」的桌上案例，說明為何不能只看遠景照片決定路線。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a turnout with separate symbols for moving components, position indication and control state. Describe an unknown-position tabletop case and why a distant photograph cannot establish a route.
steps.observation: 觀察部件看似靠妥與完整位置證據是否為不同層次。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish apparent mechanical closure from complete position evidence.
steps.failure: 將目視位置直接等同於系統已確認且允許列車通行。
steps.failureEn: Equating visual position with system confirmation and authority to move.
steps.check: 表格保留機械、檢知、控制三欄，未知狀態不得寫成已驗證。
steps.checkEn: Keep mechanical, detection and control columns separate; do not relabel unknown states as verified.

knowledge.title: 證據鏈
knowledge.text: 幾何位置、檢知資訊和系統授權屬於不同介面。
knowledge.textEn: Physical position, detection information and system authority are different interfaces.

knowledge.title: 未知狀態
knowledge.text: 資料不足不是正常的同義詞，應保留為待查證。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient information is not equivalent to normal operation and must remain unresolved.

options: 外觀可替代全部系統證據
可直接推論控制授權已成立
機械觀察已記錄，系統位置仍未驗證
optionsEn: Appearance replaces all system evidence
Movement authority can be inferred directly
Mechanical observation recorded; system position unverified
quiz.question: 道岔外觀位置正確但位置回報未確認，最合適的課程記錄是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A turnout looks aligned but its position indication is unconfirmed. What is the best learning record?
quiz.explanation: 不同證據欄位不能互相冒充，未知應清楚留下。
quiz.explanationEn: Different evidence fields are not interchangeable; unknowns must remain visible.

steps.title: 建立集電與供電介面圖
steps.objective: 分辨供電存在與受電弓接觸品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish supply availability from pantograph contact quality.
steps.instruction: 自繪變電、電車線、受電弓與車輛用電鏈，另加接觸幾何示意。以「有電但接觸不穩」假想例子列出電氣與機械兩類證據，不提供接近帶電設備的作業。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch supply, catenary, pantograph and vehicle demand, adding contact geometry. For an invented energized-but-unstable-contact case, list electrical and mechanical evidence without field work near live equipment.
steps.observation: 比較上游供電量測與車上集電狀態能回答的不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Compare the questions answered by upstream supply readings and onboard collection observations.
steps.failure: 看到上游電壓正常就排除所有集電介面問題。
steps.failureEn: Ruling out every collection-interface problem because upstream voltage is normal.
steps.check: 每一個假說須連到電氣或機械證據，並註明位置與時間。
steps.checkEn: Link each hypothesis to electrical or mechanical evidence with location and time.

knowledge.title: 機電接觸
knowledge.text: 集電同時是電能傳遞與運動接觸問題。
knowledge.textEn: Current collection involves both electrical transfer and moving mechanical contact.

knowledge.title: 觀測位置
knowledge.text: 不同測點位於不同系統邊界，不能隨意互相替代。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements at different system boundaries cannot be substituted indiscriminately.

options: 該測點電壓在觀察期間穩定
受電弓全程接觸品質必定良好
所有車上負載均無異常
optionsEn: Voltage at that location was stable during observation
Pantograph contact was necessarily good throughout
Every onboard load was fault-free
quiz.question: 上游電壓穩定能直接證明哪項？
quiz.questionEn: What does stable upstream voltage directly establish?
quiz.explanation: 測量只能先支持其所在邊界與時間範圍內的結論。
quiz.explanationEn: A measurement initially supports conclusions within its own location and time boundary.

steps.title: 理解ATC速度防護證據
steps.objective: 區分行車計畫、允許速度與實際速度。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish timetable intent, permitted speed and actual speed.
steps.instruction: 自繪三條明確標成假想的曲線：計畫速度、允許速度、實際速度。找出實際速度接近或超出允許範圍的區域，說明需要防護而非只調整時刻表。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch explicitly fictional planned, permitted and actual speed curves. Identify where actual speed approaches or exceeds permission and explain the need for protection rather than merely changing the timetable.
steps.observation: 觀察晚點與違反速度限制是不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish lateness from violation of a speed limit.
steps.failure: 因列車晚點就把時刻表目標速度當成可突破的安全限制。
steps.failureEn: Treating a timetable target as permission to exceed a safety limit because the train is late.
steps.check: 標示三種曲線的來源角色與一個資料不足的區段。
steps.checkEn: Identify the role behind each curve and one section with insufficient information.

knowledge.title: 控制約束
knowledge.text: 允許速度受前方路線與行車條件影響，不只取決於車輛能力。
knowledge.textEn: Permitted speed depends on route and traffic conditions, not only vehicle capability.

knowledge.title: 安全與服務
knowledge.text: 準點目標與防護約束不是同一層級的判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Punctuality objectives and protection constraints are different decision layers.

options: 計畫速度自動覆蓋允許速度
計畫需受當時允許範圍約束
只要實際速度低於車輛最高速度即可
optionsEn: Planned speed automatically overrides permission
The plan remains constrained by current permission
Actual speed need only remain below vehicle maximum
quiz.question: 計畫速度高於當時允許速度，應如何解讀課程圖？
quiz.questionEn: Planned speed exceeds current permitted speed. How should the diagram be interpreted?
quiz.explanation: 車輛能力與時刻表不能取代路線與行車防護條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Vehicle capability and timetable goals do not replace route and traffic protection conditions.

stages.title: 軌道與機電整合
stages.description: 辨識軌道形式、道岔、集電與控制的不同證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Identify distinct evidence for track forms, turnouts, current collection and control.

steps.title: 配對災害與偵測位置
steps.objective: 說明不同災害需要不同觀察量與布設邏輯。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why hazards require different observables and siting logic.
steps.instruction: 自繪隧道口、跨河橋、邊坡及一般路段，將落石、水位、地滑、風與地震觀察配到合理區域。為每一配對補一句不能保證偵測所有事件的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a portal, river bridge, slope and ordinary section. Assign rockfall, water level, slope movement, wind and earthquake observations, noting one limitation for each.
steps.observation: 觀察單一感測器位置能代表的空間範圍是否有限。
steps.observationEn: Consider the spatial limits of any one detector location.
steps.failure: 認定只要全線裝有同一類感測器，就能覆蓋所有災害。
steps.failureEn: Assuming one detector type across the line covers every hazard.
steps.check: 完成至少四個「災害—位置—觀察量—盲點」配對。
steps.checkEn: Complete at least four hazard–location–observable–blind-spot mappings.

knowledge.title: 需求導向偵測
knowledge.text: 偵測器選擇與位置應回應特定事件如何影響路線。
knowledge.textEn: Detector type and location should respond to how a particular event affects the route.

knowledge.title: 覆蓋限制
knowledge.text: 沒有告警可能是未發生，也可能是超出覆蓋或設備狀態問題。
knowledge.textEn: No alarm may mean no event, an event outside coverage, or a device-state problem.

options: 遠方車站的室內溫度
其他路段道岔的位置回報
相關河段的水位與流況
optionsEn: Indoor temperature at a distant station
Turnout indication in another section
Water level and flow conditions in the relevant reach
quiz.question: 跨河橋的洪水風險，哪個觀察最直接相關？
quiz.questionEn: Which observation is most directly relevant to flooding at a river bridge?
quiz.explanation: 觀察量需對應災害機制與位置；不相關的正常訊號不能替代。
quiz.explanationEn: Observables must match hazard mechanism and location; unrelated normal readings are no substitute.

steps.title: 拆解地震後查證鏈
steps.objective: 區分告警、停止、檢查與恢復狀態。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish alarm, stop, inspection and restoration states.
steps.instruction: 以紙上流程排列事件紀錄、影響區段、設施檢查、資料複核與授權交接。為每一節點寫出輸入證據與未完成時的標記，不填真實復駛速度或門檻。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange event records, affected sections, inspections, evidence review and authorization handover on paper. Name input evidence and incomplete-state labels without actual restart speeds or thresholds.
steps.observation: 觀察地震訊號結束與設施已確認可用是否是不同時點。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish the end of shaking from confirmation that facilities are usable.
steps.failure: 因感測器恢復正常，就省略受影響土建與軌道的查證。
steps.failureEn: Skipping civil and track checks because sensor readings have returned to normal.
steps.check: 流程需顯示至少一個不能由感測器單獨證明的節點。
steps.checkEn: Show at least one stage that a sensor reading alone cannot verify.

knowledge.title: 事件與狀態
knowledge.text: 告警描述事件或觀察；設施狀態仍需其他證據確認。
knowledge.textEn: An alarm describes an event or observation; facility condition requires additional evidence.

knowledge.title: 分階段復核
knowledge.text: 停止、檢查與運行授權是不同責任，應各自留下紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Stopping, inspection and operating authority are distinct responsibilities requiring records.

options: 不能，受影響設施與授權仍需查證
可以，事件結束等於設施無損
可以，只要列車沒有明顯外觀損傷
optionsEn: No; affected facilities and authorization still require verification
Yes; an ended event means undamaged facilities
Yes, if trains show no visible damage
quiz.question: 地震波已停止，能否單憑此資訊判定全線可恢復？
quiz.questionEn: Shaking has stopped. Does that alone establish line-wide readiness?
quiz.explanation: 事件停止不能證明每個結構、軌道與系統介面都仍符合要求。
quiz.explanationEn: An ended event does not establish that every structure, track and system interface meets requirements.

steps.title: 管理維護與零件變更證據
steps.objective: 理解相容性需要超過外形與料號。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why compatibility needs more than appearance and part numbers.
steps.instruction: 自設一個更換感測器的紀錄，包含功能、接線介面、校正、版本與測試結果。比較新舊元件，在每個差異旁列出需更新的文件。
steps.instructionEn: Invent a sensor-replacement record with function, connection interface, calibration, version and test result. Compare old and new items, noting documents that each difference requires updating.
steps.observation: 注意外形相同但量程、輸出定義或版本不同的情境。
steps.observationEn: Consider identical-looking parts with different ranges, output meanings or versions.
steps.failure: 只因安裝孔位相同，就認定替代零件已完成相容驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring a replacement compatible solely because mounting holes match.
steps.check: 交付功能差異表與可追溯的測試／文件清單。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a functional-difference table and a traceable test/document list.

knowledge.title: 配置管理
knowledge.text: 實際安裝狀態應與圖紙、設定及維護紀錄相符。
knowledge.textEn: Installed configuration should match drawings, settings and maintenance records.

knowledge.title: 相容性驗證
knowledge.text: 機械裝得上不代表電氣、資訊或功能語意相同。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical fit does not establish electrical, information or functional equivalence.

options: 僅沿用原先的單位標籤
核對接收端解讀、校正與文件
只確認外殼沒有損傷
optionsEn: Simply retain the old unit label
Review receiver interpretation, calibration and documentation
Only inspect the housing for damage
quiz.question: 新感測器孔位相同但輸出單位不同，最需要什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A new sensor fits mechanically but uses different output units. What is most needed?
quiz.explanation: 輸出語意是系統介面的一部分，不能由機械相容取代。
quiz.explanationEn: Output meaning is part of the system interface and is not verified by mechanical fit.

steps.title: 交付高鐵整合證據矩陣
steps.objective: 讓跨專業判斷有一致位置、版本與完成狀態。
steps.objectiveEn: Give cross-discipline judgments consistent location, version and completion state.
steps.instruction: 將土建、軌道、集電、ATC及災害圖表列成需求—證據矩陣。選一個橋梁沉降情境，追蹤它可能影響哪些介面，註明只屬學習分析。
steps.instructionEn: Build a requirement–evidence matrix for civil works, track, collection, ATC and hazards. Trace interfaces potentially affected by a bridge-settlement scenario, labeling it as a learning analysis.
steps.observation: 檢查某一系統的正常證據是否被誤用來替其他系統背書。
steps.observationEn: Check whether normal evidence for one subsystem is being used to certify another.
steps.failure: 只有各專業合格結論，缺乏交界處相容性的證據。
steps.failureEn: Collecting individual discipline approvals without evidence of compatibility at their interfaces.
steps.check: 每個介面都有來源、適用情境、未解問題及後續責任。
steps.checkEn: Give each interface a source, applicable scenario, open issue and follow-up responsibility.

knowledge.title: 整合驗證
knowledge.text: 子系統各自符合要求，仍須檢查連接後的共同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Individually compliant subsystems still require verification of their connected functions.

knowledge.title: 可追溯交付
knowledge.text: 共享位置與版本使不同團隊能重建同一項判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Shared location and version identifiers allow teams to reconstruct the same judgment.

options: 是否可以刪除全部介面測試
是否已證明所有未測情境都合格
相互連接後是否滿足共同功能
optionsEn: Whether every interface test can be removed
Whether all untested scenarios are thereby proven acceptable
Whether their connections meet shared functional requirements
quiz.question: 五個子系統各自通過單機測試，下一個合理問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Five subsystems pass standalone tests. What is the next reasonable question?
quiz.explanation: 整合行為可能不是單機測試的範圍，需另外的對應證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrated behavior may lie outside standalone tests and needs evidence of its own.

stages.title: 災害、維護與交付
stages.description: 把偵測、決策、現地複核與變更管理分成可追溯步驟。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate detection, decisions, inspection and configuration changes into traceable stages.

title: 台灣高速鐵路
summary: 以路線、橋隧、軌道、列車與安全控制的介面，理解高速鐵路整合與長期維護。
summaryEn: Understand high-speed railway integration and maintenance through interfaces among alignment, civil works, track, trains and safety control.
scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.

steps.title: 閉合回用水流程
steps.objective: 區分已處理用水、再生水與最終使用。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish treated used water, reclaimed product and final use.
steps.instruction: 畫出已處理用水→MF/UF→RO→UV的概念流程，另分工業專管與水庫→淨水場→自來水兩條用途支路。標示這是一般教學路線，MBR等實廠配置可能不同。
steps.instructionEn: Draw treated used water to MF/UF, RO and UV. Add industrial dedicated supply and reservoir-to-waterworks-to-taps branches. Label this a general teaching route; actual configurations such as MBR may differ.
steps.observation: 確認原污水並未直接接入再生水產品端，間接飲用支路也沒有略過淨水場。
steps.observationEn: Confirm raw sewage is not connected directly to product and the indirect-potable branch does not omit waterworks.
steps.failure: 把NEWater等同未處理污水，或把間接飲用畫成直接供水。
steps.failureEn: Equating NEWater with untreated sewage or drawing indirect reuse as direct tap supply.
steps.check: 每個水質邊界都有名稱，兩條使用支路可獨立追蹤。
steps.checkEn: Name each water-quality boundary and make both use branches traceable.

knowledge.title: 水質邊界
knowledge.text: 已處理用水仍需後續純化；不同水流名稱代表不同處理狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Treated used water still requires further purification; stream names indicate different treatment states.

knowledge.title: 用途路徑
knowledge.text: 工業供水與間接飲用回用有不同的下游系統介面。
knowledge.textEn: Industrial supply and indirect potable reuse connect to different downstream systems.

options: 淨水場再處理後才供應自來水
直接跳過任何後續處理
改由工業專管自動變成家戶管線
optionsEn: Waterworks treatment before tap-water supply
Bypass all subsequent treatment
Automatically turn an industrial main into household supply
quiz.question: 在PUB描述的間接飲用路徑中，水庫之後還有什麼？
quiz.questionEn: In PUB’s described indirect-potable route, what follows the reservoir?
quiz.explanation: 「間接」包含水庫混合與後續淨水處理，不能刪除。
quiz.explanationEn: Indirect reuse includes reservoir blending and subsequent waterworks treatment.

steps.title: 建立進流水的資料邊界
steps.objective: 把上游處理狀態與下游膜系統需求對齊。
steps.objectiveEn: Match upstream treatment status with downstream membrane evidence needs.
steps.instruction: 自設一張進流水紀錄表，分別列流量、混濁、溶解物及微生物資料欄。對缺少數據的欄位保留未知，說明它可能影響哪一道後續屏障。
steps.instructionEn: Create a feedwater-record template for flow, turbidity, dissolved substances and microbiological evidence. Keep missing fields unknown and identify the downstream barrier each may affect.
steps.observation: 比較水看起來透明與已取得化學或微生物證據的差別。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish visual clarity from chemical or microbiological evidence.
steps.failure: 以肉眼清澈取代進流水品質與處理狀態確認。
steps.failureEn: Substituting visual clarity for feed-quality and treatment-status verification.
steps.check: 至少四個資料欄各連到一項後續功能或驗證需求。
steps.checkEn: Link at least four fields to a downstream function or verification need.

knowledge.title: 污染物類別
knowledge.text: 粒子、溶解成分與微生物需要不同的量測與處理觀點。
knowledge.textEn: Particles, dissolved constituents and microorganisms require different measurement and treatment perspectives.

knowledge.title: 上游依賴
knowledge.text: 後段設備的表現受進流水條件影響，不能只看設備名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Downstream performance depends on feed conditions, not just equipment names.

options: 透明等於所有溶解物已去除
外觀已觀察，化學條件仍未知
可用出水流量代替化學資料
optionsEn: Clarity means all dissolved substances are removed
Appearance observed; chemical conditions unknown
Product flow can replace chemical data
quiz.question: 進流水透明但化學資料缺漏，最適合的記錄是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Feedwater looks clear but chemical data is missing. What should be recorded?
quiz.explanation: 外觀只能描述有限性質，不能補出未量測的污染物資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Appearance describes limited properties and cannot supply missing contaminant measurements.

steps.title: 分辨MF/UF與RO的任務
steps.objective: 用污染物類型理解不同膜屏障的互補。
steps.objectiveEn: Use contaminant classes to understand complementary membrane barriers.
steps.instruction: 畫三類符號代表粒子、微生物與溶解離子，將MF/UF與RO畫成不同功能方塊。用「可能被截留／仍需下段處理／需量測確認」標記，不填通用百分之百去除承諾。
steps.instructionEn: Represent particles, microorganisms and dissolved ions with symbols, and draw separate MF/UF and RO blocks. Label retained, requiring downstream treatment and needing measurement without universal 100-percent removal claims.
steps.observation: 注意前段粒子控制可改善後段條件，但不是所有溶解物的證明。
steps.observationEn: Particle control upstream can improve downstream conditions without proving removal of every dissolved constituent.
steps.failure: 把所有膜都當成同一種細篩，認為第一道即可取代全部後段。
steps.failureEn: Treating all membranes as the same fine sieve and assuming the first replaces every later barrier.
steps.check: 三類符號均有去向與未確認項，且MF/UF和RO功能可區分。
steps.checkEn: Give each symbol a destination and unresolved point, with distinguishable MF/UF and RO roles.

knowledge.title: 互補屏障
knowledge.text: 不同單元針對不同性質的污染物，串接可處理不同風險。
knowledge.textEn: Different units address different contaminant properties; a train combines complementary functions.

knowledge.title: 簡化限制
knowledge.text: 圖上符號只教分類，不代表特定膜在所有條件下的截留率。
knowledge.textEn: Diagram symbols teach categories, not rejection rates of a particular membrane under all conditions.

options: 所有溶解鹽類都已移除
後段RO和UV永遠可以取消
該量測條件下粒子相關指標較低
optionsEn: All dissolved salts have been removed
RO and UV can always be omitted
A low particle-related indicator under those measurement conditions
quiz.question: MF/UF出水低濁度能單獨證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does low MF/UF product turbidity establish on its own?
quiz.explanation: 低濁度不是所有化學與微生物條件的完整證明。
quiz.explanationEn: Low turbidity is not complete evidence of every chemical and microbiological condition.

steps.title: 檢查第一道膜屏障的完整性
steps.objective: 辨認產水量與膜屏障完整性不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish water production from membrane-barrier integrity.
steps.instruction: 自繪膜模組及密封介面，標出穿膜與繞過密封的兩種可能路徑。建立完整性證據、出水觀察與設備狀態三欄，所有數據留作自設教學示例。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a membrane module and seals, marking passage through the membrane and possible seal bypass. Create integrity-evidence, product-observation and equipment-state columns using only labeled example data.
steps.observation: 觀察出水量正常是否仍可能有旁通或局部缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Consider whether normal product flow can coexist with bypass or a local defect.
steps.failure: 以流量正常或馬達運轉，替代屏障完整性證據。
steps.failureEn: Using normal flow or a running motor as proof of barrier integrity.
steps.check: 列出兩種缺陷假說及能區分它們的觀察，不能只寫「正常」。
steps.checkEn: List two defect hypotheses and observations distinguishing them rather than simply writing normal.

knowledge.title: 完整性與通量
knowledge.text: 流得過去說明有產水，不等於水只經過預期的屏障。
knowledge.textEn: Flow establishes production, not that all water passed through the intended barrier.

knowledge.title: 繞流介面
knowledge.text: 接合或密封也屬屏障的一部分，不能只檢查膜材料。
knowledge.textEn: Joints and seals are part of the barrier, not just the membrane material.

options: 產量有證據，屏障完整性尚未驗證
產量正常已足以證明完整性
可直接視為所有污染物都不存在
optionsEn: Production evidenced; barrier integrity unverified
Normal production proves integrity
All contaminants can be considered absent
quiz.question: 流量正常但完整性證據不明，應如何分類？
quiz.questionEn: Flow is normal but integrity evidence is unclear. How should the result be classified?
quiz.explanation: 功能宣稱需要對應證據，產量不能替代完整性。
quiz.explanationEn: Functional claims need matching evidence; output quantity cannot substitute for integrity.

stages.title: 回用水邊界與前處理
stages.description: 辨認進流水、不同污染物與第一道膜屏障的證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Identify feedwater, contaminant classes and evidence for the first membrane barrier.

steps.title: 閉合RO三股水的物料平衡
steps.objective: 區分進水、透過水與濃縮水的數量。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish feed, permeate and concentrate quantities.
steps.instruction: 用自設且標明假想的單位流量，畫進水分成透過水和濃縮水。先檢查水量加總，再比較溶質去向，不把濃縮水當作消失或無污染的水。
steps.instructionEn: Use explicitly invented unit flows to split feed into permeate and concentrate. Check the water balance, then trace solutes without treating concentrate as vanished or contaminant-free.
steps.observation: 觀察透過水比例提高時，濃縮側需要重新檢查哪些假設。
steps.observationEn: Consider which concentrate-side assumptions need review as the permeate fraction rises.
steps.failure: 只報告產水量，遺漏濃縮水量及所攜帶的物質。
steps.failureEn: Reporting product flow without concentrate flow or transported substances.
steps.check: 水量收支閉合，並標記尚未納入的溶質與實際設備限制。
steps.checkEn: Close the water balance and identify unmodeled solutes and actual equipment limits.

knowledge.title: 分離不是消滅
knowledge.text: 膜分離改變物質分配，並不使被排除的物質憑空消失。
knowledge.textEn: Membrane separation redistributes substances rather than making rejected material disappear.

knowledge.title: 比例與條件
knowledge.text: 水量回收比例只描述部分績效，須與品質和濃縮側條件一起看。
knowledge.textEn: Water recovery describes only part of performance and must be considered with quality and concentrate conditions.

options: 75單位，因與產水相同
25單位
0單位，因被膜去除
optionsEn: 75 units, because it equals product flow
25 units
0 units, because the membrane removes it
quiz.question: 假想進水100單位、透過水75單位，在忽略蓄積下濃縮水多少？
quiz.questionEn: For invented feed of 100 units and permeate of 75, with no storage, what is concentrate flow?
quiz.explanation: 水量守恆給出100−75＝25；這只是教學收支，未代表可用操作比例。
quiz.explanationEn: Conservation gives 100−75=25; this teaching balance does not define an operating recovery.

steps.title: 解讀導電度而不過度推論
steps.objective: 區分離子相關指標與完整水質。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish an ion-related indicator from complete water quality.
steps.instruction: 閱讀PUB水質表的導電度、濁度和有機碳欄位，分開記下單位與描述性質。自設兩份導電度相近但其他欄位不同的示例，比較可以及不可以下的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Read conductivity, turbidity and organic-carbon fields in PUB’s table, recording units and properties separately. Invent two samples with similar conductivity but differing other fields and compare valid and invalid conclusions.
steps.observation: 注意單一低讀值不能補出未測項目。
steps.observationEn: A single low reading cannot supply unmeasured parameters.
steps.failure: 用低導電度直接證明無微生物或所有有機污染物。
steps.failureEn: Using low conductivity as proof of no microorganisms or all organic contaminants.
steps.check: 為三個指標各寫出一項能回答與不能回答的問題。
steps.checkEn: For each indicator, state one question it can and cannot answer.

knowledge.title: 代理指標
knowledge.text: 導電度反映水中導電性成分的綜合影響，不是每種污染物的直接濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Conductivity reflects combined conductive constituents, not direct concentration of every contaminant.

knowledge.title: 單位語意
knowledge.text: 不同量測單位代表不同性質，不能因數字小就彼此比較優劣。
knowledge.textEn: Different units describe different properties; small numbers cannot be compared indiscriminately.

options: 低導電度證明微生物為零
可把導電度單位換成菌落數
離子相關指標已有資料，微生物狀態仍待驗證
optionsEn: Low conductivity proves zero microorganisms
Conductivity units can be relabeled as colony counts
Ion-related evidence exists; microbial status remains unverified
quiz.question: 導電度很低而微生物結果尚未取得，最合理的結論是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Conductivity is low but microbiological results are unavailable. What follows?
quiz.explanation: 不同指標不能互相替代，尤其不能把物理電性當成微生物檢驗。
quiz.explanationEn: Indicators are not interchangeable, particularly electrical properties and microbial testing.

steps.title: 診斷膜效能趨勢
steps.objective: 在比較膜效能前檢查進水與量測條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Check feed and measurement conditions before comparing membrane performance.
steps.instruction: 自行建立兩段時間的流量、壓差、溫度與進水品質示例。先標記條件差異，再為產水下降列出積垢、進水變化與儀器偏差等假說，不指定清洗藥劑。
steps.instructionEn: Create example flow, differential pressure, temperature and feed-quality records for two periods. Mark condition changes before considering fouling, changed feed or instrument bias for lower output; prescribe no cleaning chemicals.
steps.observation: 比較是否在相近條件下仍有持續偏差。
steps.observationEn: Check whether persistent differences remain under comparable conditions.
steps.failure: 只用產量降低就斷定膜已損壞，忽略溫度、進水與量測。
steps.failureEn: Declaring membrane damage from lower output alone while ignoring temperature, feed and measurements.
steps.check: 至少保留三種原因與一項可區分它們的補充資料。
steps.checkEn: Retain three candidate causes and a discriminating additional observation.

knowledge.title: 條件化趨勢
knowledge.text: 性能比較需保留進水與環境條件，避免把條件變化當設備退化。
knowledge.textEn: Performance comparisons require feed and environmental context to distinguish condition changes from deterioration.

knowledge.title: 診斷而非猜測
knowledge.text: 同一現象可能有多因；查證計畫應讓假說可被反駁。
knowledge.textEn: One symptom can have multiple causes; investigation should make hypotheses testable.

options: 核對比較條件與量測，再評估設備趨勢
直接認定膜完整性破壞
刪除溫度資料以保持表格簡單
optionsEn: Reconcile conditions and measurements before judging equipment trends
Immediately conclude loss of membrane integrity
Delete temperature to simplify the table
quiz.question: 兩次產水量不同，但進水溫度也不同，應先做什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Product flow differs between periods with different feed temperatures. What comes first?
quiz.explanation: 先控制比較範圍，才能讓效能趨勢具有可解釋性。
quiz.explanationEn: Establishing comparable conditions makes performance trends interpretable.

steps.title: 辨認UV屏障與驗證量
steps.titleEn: Identify the UV barrier and its evidence
steps.objective: 說明消毒與物質分離的不同任務。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the different tasks of disinfection and separation.
steps.instruction: 在RO後方加入UV功能方塊，分別記錄光源狀態、水流與水的透光相關證據。畫出「燈亮但驗證不完整」情境，不自行提供飲用水消毒劑量。
steps.instructionEn: Add a UV block after RO, separating light-source state, flow and transmission-related evidence. Illustrate a lamp-on-but-unverified case without specifying drinking-water disinfection doses.
steps.observation: 觀察光源通電是否能直接證明所有水得到足夠作用。
steps.observationEn: Ask whether an energized source proves adequate treatment of all passing water.
steps.failure: 把燈亮等同消毒已驗證，或認為UV會把溶解鹽類分走。
steps.failureEn: Equating a lit lamp with verified disinfection or assuming UV separates dissolved salts.
steps.check: 用不同證據欄位分開設備狀態、處理條件與水質驗證。
steps.checkEn: Separate equipment state, treatment conditions and quality verification in the record.

knowledge.title: 功能差異
knowledge.text: UV作用於微生物失活；它不是RO式的溶質分流。
knowledge.textEn: UV targets microbial inactivation rather than RO-like solute separation.

knowledge.title: 完整作用條件
knowledge.text: 光源、流動與水的光學條件共同影響處理，不能只看開關。
knowledge.textEn: Source, flow and optical conditions jointly affect treatment; an on/off signal is insufficient.

options: 出水所有化學成分均已去除
設備有開啟指示，處理效果仍需對應證據
全部水質項目已通過檢驗
optionsEn: Every chemical constituent has been removed
An on indication exists; treatment performance still needs evidence
All water-quality parameters have passed
quiz.question: UV燈顯示開啟，可直接證明哪項？
quiz.questionEn: A UV lamp indicates on. What does that directly prove?
quiz.explanation: 設備狀態不是完整水質結果，必須保留各自的驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Equipment state is not a complete quality result; each requires its own verification.

stages.title: 分離、診斷與消毒
stages.description: 把逆滲透的水量與水質、膜狀態及UV功能分開判讀。
stages.descriptionEn: Interpret RO flow and quality, membrane condition and UV function separately.

steps.title: 建立採樣追溯鏈
steps.objective: 讓結果對應到正確位置、時間與樣品。
steps.objectiveEn: Link results to the correct location, time and sample.
steps.instruction: 設計樣品表單，包含編號、取樣位置、時間、分析項目、方法和結果狀態。用兩個假想相近編號，演練如何辨認進水樣被誤標為出水樣。
steps.instructionEn: Design a sample form with ID, location, time, analyte, method and result state. Use two similar invented IDs to detect feedwater mislabeled as product.
steps.observation: 檢查只有檢驗數字、沒有樣品身分時是否仍能解讀。
steps.observationEn: Assess whether a result remains interpretable without sample identity.
steps.failure: 將不同時間、位置或方法的結果拼成同一批水的證明。
steps.failureEn: Combining results from different times, locations or methods as proof about one water batch.
steps.check: 每筆示例結果可反查完整身分，錯置樣品須保留更正紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Trace each example result to its identity and retain correction records for mislabeling.

knowledge.title: 代表性
knowledge.text: 樣品能代表的水流與時間範圍，取決於採樣設計及紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: The stream and time represented by a sample depend on sampling design and records.

knowledge.title: 結果狀態
knowledge.text: 待分析、低於檢出能力及未檢測是不同狀態，不應都填成零。
knowledge.textEn: Pending, below detection capability and not tested are different states and should not all become zero.

options: 0，表示沒有檢出
以另一位置的結果自動補入
未檢測，保留待取得證據
optionsEn: Zero, meaning not detected
Automatically fill with a result from another location
Not tested; evidence pending
quiz.question: 某項分析尚未執行，表格應怎麼填？
quiz.questionEn: How should an analysis that has not been performed be recorded?
quiz.explanation: 未檢測並不等於未檢出；誠實的狀態是追溯鏈的一部分。
quiz.explanationEn: Not tested is not equivalent to not detected; accurate status is part of traceability.

steps.title: 核對工業與間接回用介面
steps.objective: 把目的地要求連到對應供水路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect destination requirements to the appropriate supply route.
steps.instruction: 建立兩欄：工業專管與水庫後接淨水場。為兩欄分別列交付點、後續處理與需確認的品質責任；不把工業廠內額外純化假定為PUB已完成。
steps.instructionEn: Compare dedicated industrial supply with reservoir-to-waterworks reuse. List handover point, further treatment and quality responsibility, without assuming PUB performs every customer’s additional purification.
steps.observation: 觀察相同再生水來源在不同使用者端是否仍有不同後續需求。
steps.observationEn: The same reclaimed source may face different downstream needs at different users.
steps.failure: 把NEWater典型值直接視為每一家工業製程的完整規格。
steps.failureEn: Treating NEWater typical values as complete specifications for every industrial process.
steps.check: 兩條路徑各保留一項使用端需另行確認的介面條件。
steps.checkEn: Retain one destination-specific condition requiring separate confirmation for each route.

knowledge.title: 適用途徑
knowledge.text: 水的目的地與後續處理會影響應驗證的介面，不能只看名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Destination and subsequent treatment influence the interface to verify, not just the water’s name.

knowledge.title: 交付邊界
knowledge.text: 公用供水與客戶製程之間的品質責任須明確，不能隱含轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Quality responsibilities between utility supply and customer processes must be explicit.

options: 在客戶端增加明確的處理與驗證邊界
將供水典型值改成客戶所有需求
假定所有再生水用途完全相同
optionsEn: Add an explicit customer treatment and verification boundary
Relabel typical supply values as all customer requirements
Assume every reuse application is identical
quiz.question: 某晶圓廠需要額外純化，合理的模型表示是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A wafer fab requires further purification. How should the model show it?
quiz.explanation: 上游供水與下游製程需求是不同邊界，需分開交代。
quiz.explanationEn: Utility supply and downstream process needs are different boundaries that must be stated separately.

steps.title: 記錄異常與未驗證狀態
steps.objective: 避免在證據矛盾時給出過度的品質結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid overclaiming quality when evidence conflicts.
steps.instruction: 自行寫一個導電度趨勢改變但重測尚未完成的案例。列出感測器、取樣身分、進水條件與處理狀態的核對清單，交付狀態標成待驗證，不作真實放水指令。
steps.instructionEn: Invent a changed conductivity trend with repeat analysis pending. List sensor, sample identity, feed and treatment checks; label the learning handover unverified without issuing actual release commands.
steps.observation: 注意一次正常重測是否足以解釋先前異常與整段時間。
steps.observationEn: Consider whether one normal repeat explains the prior anomaly and the entire affected period.
steps.failure: 只留下正常讀值、刪除異常資料，造成虛假的連續合格紀錄。
steps.failureEn: Keeping normal readings while deleting anomalies to create a falsely continuous acceptable record.
steps.check: 保留事件時間線、原始異常與待取得資料，結論不得超出觀察期間。
steps.checkEn: Preserve the timeline, original anomaly and missing evidence; limit conclusions to observed periods.

knowledge.title: 偏差追查
knowledge.text: 異常應有可追溯的查證與結案理由，不能只靠後續正常值覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Anomalies need traceable investigation and closure reasons rather than being overwritten by later normal values.

knowledge.title: 時間範圍
knowledge.text: 採樣結果有其時間與位置範圍，不自動涵蓋未觀測時段。
knowledge.textEn: Sample results have time and location scope and do not automatically cover unobserved periods.

options: 直接刪除，僅保留最後結果
保留並查明適用範圍與原因
用兩次平均值宣告整段正常
optionsEn: Delete it and retain only the latest result
Preserve it and investigate its scope and cause
Average the two and declare the entire interval normal
quiz.question: 後一次樣品正常，先前異常應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: A later sample is normal. What should happen to the earlier anomaly?
quiz.explanation: 後續結果不會自動解釋前次異常或填補時間空白。
quiz.explanationEn: A later result does not automatically explain an earlier anomaly or fill a time gap.

steps.title: 交付多重屏障品質卷宗
steps.objective: 區分典型資料、操作準則與產品驗證證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish typical data, operating criteria and product-verification evidence.
steps.instruction: 整理流程、物料平衡、屏障狀態、採樣紀錄與目的地介面。閱讀PUB典型值表的欄名及日期，為每個課程結論標上来源或自設假設，不把典型值轉成自行放行標準。
steps.instructionEn: Organize process, balance, barrier, sampling and destination records. Read the headings and date of PUB’s typical-values table; label sources or invented assumptions without converting typical values into self-authorized release criteria.
steps.observation: 核對「典型」「指引」「本次實測」是否在文件中被混用。
steps.observationEn: Check whether typical, guideline and current measurement are being conflated.
steps.failure: 拿公開典型值表代替當批水的實測與完整驗證。
steps.failureEn: Substituting a public typical-values table for measurements and verification of a specific batch.
steps.check: 交付三類資料的區分表及至少四項可追溯證據，明示這不是飲水安全認證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a distinction table and at least four traceable evidence items, explicitly identifying this as no drinking-water safety certification.

knowledge.title: 資料類別
knowledge.text: 典型值描述通常表現；指引、操作判準與特定樣品結果有不同角色。
knowledge.textEn: Typical values describe usual performance; guidelines, operating criteria and sample results have distinct roles.

knowledge.title: 多重證據
knowledge.text: 屏障、監測、採樣與目的地需求需相互吻合，單一指標無法概括。
knowledge.textEn: Barriers, monitoring, sampling and destination requirements must agree; one indicator cannot represent them all.

options: 使用者自行處理的水已通過全部驗證
任何實廠都可照表自行設定放行門檻
官方描述的通常水質表現與資料範圍
optionsEn: User-treated water has passed all verification
Every plant may adopt the table as release settings
The authority’s described usual quality and data scope
quiz.question: 一張標示「典型值」的官方表格能直接證明哪件事？
quiz.questionEn: What does an official table labeled typical values directly establish?
quiz.explanation: 公開典型資料是背景證據，不是特定樣品、設備或操作授權。
quiz.explanationEn: Public typical data is background evidence, not verification or authorization for a particular sample, device or operation.

stages.title: 採樣、用途與品質交付
stages.description: 將追溯、異常處置概念及目的地要求連成驗證鏈。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect traceability, anomaly-handling concepts and destination requirements into an evidence chain.

title: 新加坡新生水系統
summary: 以多重處理屏障、物料平衡與水質證據，理解再生水如何連接城市與工業用水。
summaryEn: Understand how reclaimed water links cities and industry through multiple treatment barriers, mass balance and water-quality evidence.
scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.

title: Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程
summary: 從機翼載荷、複材方向、公差鏈到配置變更，用原創示意與紙上算例學習A350類客機的系統整合。
summaryEn: Study A350-class airliner integration through original sketches and paper exercises on wing loads, composite directionality, tolerance chains and configuration change.
scope: 12道入門工程學習任務；引用A350公開背景，力學數值為明示教學假設。不是原廠鋪層表、裝配SOP、維修手冊、適航符合性證明或製造授權。
scopeEn: Twelve introductory engineering tasks grounded in public A350 background, with explicitly hypothetical mechanics values. Not manufacturer layup schedules, assembly SOPs, maintenance instructions, airworthiness substantiation or manufacturing authorization.

stages.title: 需求、載荷與基準
stages.description: 先定義系統邊界，再用質量、力矩及座標建立可追溯的整合問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Define boundaries, then use mass, moments and coordinates to establish traceable integration questions.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 分配客機系統邊界
steps.objective: 把機體、動力、供電與控制的介面分開記錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate interfaces among airframe, propulsion, power and control.
steps.instruction: 在紙上畫四個系統方塊，分別用實線、虛線表示載荷與資訊交換。以A350公開介紹辨識用途，再為每條箭頭寫下輸入、輸出與責任者；圖是你的原創示意。
steps.instructionEn: Draw four system blocks, using solid and dashed arrows for loads and information. Identify purposes from the public A350 overview, then label each interface with its input, output and owner. This is your own schematic.
steps.observation: 觀察一條電源線與一項結構支承是否被錯當成同一種介面。
steps.observationEn: Check whether an electrical supply and a structural support have been treated as the same interface.
steps.failure: 只列零件名稱而沒有交換量，會隱藏整合問題。
steps.failureEn: A parts list without exchanged quantities hides integration problems.
steps.check: 至少列出一項機械、一項電力及一項資訊介面，各有可檢查的量。
steps.checkEn: Identify mechanical, electrical and information interfaces, each with a checkable quantity.

knowledge.title: 功能與實體
knowledge.text: 一個功能可能跨越多個實體零件；方塊邊界是分析選擇。
knowledge.textEn: One function may span several physical parts; block boundaries are analytical choices.

knowledge.title: 介面責任
knowledge.text: 輸出符合自己的規格，仍須與接收端假設相容。
knowledge.textEn: Meeting an output specification still requires compatibility with the receiving side.

quiz.question: 兩團隊零件各自合格，整合卻失敗，先查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two teams pass their component checks but integration fails. What should be checked first?
options: 只確認各零件單獨合格即可接受整合
只核對總質量是否與原計畫相同
介面的交換量與假設是否一致
optionsEn: Accept integration as soon as the individual parts pass
Check only whether total mass matches the original plan
Whether exchanged quantities and interface assumptions agree
quiz.explanation: 局部合格不自動證明跨系統相容。
quiz.explanationEn: Local compliance does not automatically establish system compatibility.

steps.title: 計算示意配重的重心
steps.objective: 以位置加權理解配置變更對重心的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Use position-weighted mass to understand configuration changes.
steps.instruction: 設兩個教學質量：2單位位於x=1，1單位位於x=4。算總質量與重心，再把後者移到x=7重算；所有數值均為無因次例題，不是飛機限制。
steps.instructionEn: Use teaching masses of 2 units at x=1 and 1 unit at x=4. Calculate total mass and center of mass, then move the latter to x=7 and recalculate. All values are dimensionless examples, not aircraft limits.
steps.observation: 總質量不變，重心卻由2移到3。
steps.observationEn: Total mass stays constant while the center moves from 2 to 3.
steps.failure: 直接平均兩個位置，等於錯把不同質量視為相等。
steps.failureEn: Averaging positions directly wrongly assigns equal weight to unequal masses.
steps.check: 保留兩次力矩和，並用總質量除回重心。
steps.checkEn: Retain both moment sums and divide by total mass to recover the center.

knowledge.title: 一階質量矩
knowledge.text: 重心由Σmx／Σm求得，必須使用共同原點。
knowledge.textEn: The center is Σmx/Σm, using a common origin.

knowledge.title: 配置管理
knowledge.text: 搬動設備可能改變重心，即使沒有新增重量。
knowledge.textEn: Relocating equipment can change balance without adding mass.

quiz.question: 把同一設備往後移，哪項必然不變？
quiz.questionEn: When the same item is moved aft, which quantity necessarily stays unchanged?
options: 重心位置
總質量
總質量矩
optionsEn: Center-of-mass position
Total mass
Total mass moment
quiz.explanation: 位置改變影響力矩，不改變該設備質量。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing position alters the moment, not the item’s mass.

steps.title: 追蹤機翼到機身的載荷路徑
steps.objective: 區分分布載荷、接合處反力與局部應力。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish distributed load, joint reaction and local stress.
steps.instruction: 畫一根固定端示意樑，把三支向上箭頭分布在翼展上。先令總力相同，再把箭頭外移；比较固定端彎矩。僅做紙上力學，不推算真機強度。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a fixed-end teaching beam with three upward arrows along its span. Keep total force unchanged, move the arrows outward and compare root bending moments. Use paper mechanics only, without inferring aircraft strength.
steps.observation: 相同升力總和，作用點更遠時根部力矩增加。
steps.observationEn: The same total lift produces a larger root moment when applied farther out.
steps.failure: 只比較總力會漏掉力臂，接頭也不能用外觀大小判定安全。
steps.failureEn: Comparing total force alone misses the lever arm; joint appearance cannot establish safety.
steps.check: 每支箭頭標出到根部的距離，列出ΣFr。
steps.checkEn: Label each lever arm and calculate ΣFr.

knowledge.title: 力臂
knowledge.text: 力矩取決於力與其垂直作用距離。
knowledge.textEn: Moment depends on force and its perpendicular lever arm.

knowledge.title: 局部與整體
knowledge.text: 整體平衡提供反力，局部接頭仍需獨立驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Global equilibrium gives reactions; local joints still require separate substantiation.

quiz.question: 總升力不變、向翼尖移動，根部彎矩如何變化？
quiz.questionEn: With total lift unchanged but moved toward the tip, how does root bending moment change?
options: 增大
必定降為零
因總力相同而不變
optionsEn: It increases
It necessarily becomes zero
It is unchanged because total force is unchanged
quiz.explanation: 外移增加力臂，因此增加根部力矩。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving the load outward increases its lever arm and root moment.

steps.title: 核對裝配基準與公差鏈
steps.titleEn: Check assembly datums and tolerance chains
steps.objective: 讓兩個分段使用一致的座標與驗收基準。
steps.objectiveEn: Give two sections consistent coordinates and acceptance datums.
steps.instruction: 在兩張原創機身分段圖標出共同原點、軸向和接合平面。假設兩段偏差各為±0.4示意單位，求最壞相對錯位，再與假設允收±0.6比較。
steps.instructionEn: Mark a shared origin, axes and mating plane on two original fuselage-section sketches. Assume each has an error of ±0.4 teaching units. Find the worst relative mismatch and compare with an assumed ±0.6 allowance.
steps.observation: 單段各自合格，反向偏差仍可能造成0.8錯位。
steps.observationEn: Individually acceptable sections can still mismatch by 0.8 when errors oppose.
steps.failure: 混用機身座標與局部治具座標，會產生看似固定的系統偏差。
steps.failureEn: Mixing body and fixture frames can create an apparently fixed systematic offset.
steps.check: 指出最壞組合，且圖上所有尺寸可追溯到相同基準。
steps.checkEn: Identify the worst combination and trace every dimension to the common datum.

knowledge.title: 基準
knowledge.text: 尺寸的意義依賴其參考平面與方向。
knowledge.textEn: A dimension depends on its reference plane and direction.

knowledge.title: 公差累積
knowledge.text: 最壞相對誤差需考慮兩零件朝相反方向偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Worst relative error includes opposite deviations of the two parts.

quiz.question: 兩段各±0.4，最壞相對錯位是多少？
quiz.questionEn: For two sections each at ±0.4, what is the worst relative mismatch?
quiz.explanationEn: One at +0.4 and the other at −0.4 differ by 0.8.

stages.title: 材料回應與損傷證據
stages.description: 比较方向性、熱相容、檢測範圍與循環載荷；不替代任何實機材料試驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare directionality, thermal compatibility, inspection scope and cyclic loading without replacing aircraft material tests.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 辨識複材方向性
steps.objective: 把纖維方向與載荷方向連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate fiber direction to loading direction.
steps.instruction: 畫三張試片示意：纖維沿0°、90°及混合方向。對同一軸向拉力標出纖維與基材可能扮演的角色；只提出待測假設，不自填材料強度。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch coupons with fibers at 0°, 90° and mixed orientations. Under the same axial load, identify possible fiber and matrix roles. Record hypotheses requiring tests instead of inventing strength values.
steps.observation: 旋轉試片方向會改變材料回應，即使外形與厚度相同。
steps.observationEn: Rotating the material direction can alter response despite identical shape and thickness.
steps.failure: 把複材當作各方向相同的金屬，會掩蓋方向性與層間問題。
steps.failureEn: Treating a laminate as direction-independent metal hides anisotropy and interlaminar issues.
steps.check: 每張試片都有載荷箭頭、纖維方向及一項待驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Each coupon shows a load arrow, fiber orientation and a testable hypothesis.

knowledge.title: 異向性
knowledge.text: 複材性質可能隨方向改變，不能只用單一強度數字描述。
knowledge.textEn: Composite properties can vary by direction and cannot be described by one strength value alone.

knowledge.title: 基材功能
knowledge.text: 基材保持纖維配置並傳遞載荷，不能視為無功能的填充物。
knowledge.textEn: The matrix maintains fiber arrangement and transfers load; it is not an inert filler.

quiz.question: 兩試片外形一樣卻反應不同，哪項應優先核對？
quiz.questionEn: Two equal-shaped coupons respond differently. Which factor should be checked first?
options: 只比較外形與厚度是否相同
纖維方向與鋪層資訊
只核對總質量，不看鋪層
optionsEn: Compare only external shape and thickness
Fiber orientation and laminate information
Check only mass without examining the layup
quiz.explanation: 方向與鋪層直接影響複材力學回應。
quiz.explanationEn: Orientation and layup directly affect composite mechanical response.

steps.title: 比較異材接合的熱伸長
steps.titleEn: Compare thermal expansion at a mixed-material joint
steps.objective: 理解相連材料自由伸長不同的後果。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand consequences of unequal free thermal expansion.
steps.instruction: 假設兩條等長教學材料的熱膨脹係數為2與10個相同單位，在相同升溫下比較自由伸長比。再畫出端部被共同約束的情境，列出需要分析的接頭反力。
steps.instructionEn: Assume equal-length teaching strips with expansion coefficients of 2 and 10 in the same units. Compare free expansion under equal heating, then sketch a shared end restraint and identify joint reactions needing analysis.
steps.observation: 較大係數的自由伸長為另一條的5倍；接合後不能各自自由伸長。
steps.observationEn: The higher-coefficient strip expands five times as much freely; joined strips cannot both follow their free expansion.
steps.failure: 把自由熱伸長直接當作受約束後的實際位移，忽略了相容条件。
steps.failureEn: Using free expansion as constrained displacement ignores compatibility.
steps.check: 分別列出自由伸長與約束後需解的未知量，不猜接頭應力值。
steps.checkEn: Separate free expansion from unknown constrained quantities without guessing joint stress.

knowledge.title: 熱應變
knowledge.text: 自由熱應變由膨脹係數乘溫度變化得到。
knowledge.textEn: Free thermal strain is expansion coefficient times temperature change.

knowledge.title: 相容條件
knowledge.text: 被接在一起的部位須同時滿足幾何相容與力平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Connected parts must satisfy both geometric compatibility and force equilibrium.

quiz.question: 自由伸長不同的材料被接合後，還需加入什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What must be added when joining materials with different free expansions?
options: 約束與相容條件
把較小伸長直接刪掉
假設接頭永遠沒有反力
optionsEn: Restraints and compatibility conditions
Discard the smaller expansion
Assume the joint never develops a reaction
quiz.explanation: 接頭限制相對移動，可能因此產生內力。
quiz.explanationEn: The joint limits relative movement and can generate internal forces.

steps.title: 建立複材檢查的證據地圖
steps.objective: 區分表面觀察與內部損傷的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish surface observation from internal-damage evidence.
steps.instruction: 畫一片有表面撞痕與假設層間缺陷的示意板。把目視、適用的非破壞檢測與後續工程評估放在不同欄位；為每種方法註明它能回答與不能回答的問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a panel with a surface impact mark and a hypothetical internal defect. Separate visual inspection, applicable nondestructive inspection and engineering assessment into columns, stating what each can and cannot answer.
steps.observation: 外表平整不能排除內部異常，檢測訊號也不自動等於可放行。
steps.observationEn: A smooth surface cannot rule out internal anomalies, and a signal alone does not authorize release.
steps.failure: 用照片替代經核准的檢測與判讀，會把未知狀態誤標合格。
steps.failureEn: Substituting a photo for approved inspection and interpretation mislabels uncertainty as acceptance.
steps.check: 至少一項未知量保留為待確認，並列出需要的合格判讀證據。
steps.checkEn: Retain at least one unresolved question and identify the qualified interpretation needed.

knowledge.title: 損傷容限
knowledge.text: 發現、評估和處置損傷是不同工作。
knowledge.textEn: Detecting, assessing and dispositioning damage are separate tasks.

knowledge.title: 檢測範圍
knowledge.text: 每種方法有適用材料、幾何與缺陷範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Every method has applicable materials, geometries and defect classes.

quiz.question: 沒有看見裂痕，能直接得出哪個結論？
quiz.questionEn: No crack is visible. Which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有內部層間皆完整
已符合真機放行要求
目前目視範圍沒有可見裂痕
optionsEn: All internal interfaces are intact
The aircraft release requirements are satisfied
No visible crack was found within the visual inspection scope
quiz.explanation: 證據只能支援其觀察範圍內的結論。
quiz.explanationEn: Evidence supports conclusions only within its observation scope.

steps.title: 區分靜態強度與循環疲勞
steps.titleEn: Separate static strength from cyclic fatigue
steps.objective: 用載荷歷程而非一次峰值描述耐久問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Describe durability through load history rather than one peak.
steps.instruction: 自畫兩條無因次載荷曲線：一次峰值與多次較低振幅循環。標記循環數、平均值和振幅，列出需要何種試驗資料才能比較壽命；不自行推算服役年限。
steps.instructionEn: Draw dimensionless load histories: one peak and repeated lower-amplitude cycles. Mark cycle count, mean and amplitude, then identify test data needed to compare life. Do not infer service years.
steps.observation: 低於一次試驗峰值的循環載荷，仍可能累積損傷。
steps.observationEn: Repeated loading below a single-test peak can still accumulate damage.
steps.failure: 一次靜載通過就宣稱無限壽命，混淆了不同驗證目的。
steps.failureEn: Claiming unlimited life after one static pass confuses different verification purposes.
steps.check: 報告分開寫靜態判定、循環資料與尚未回答的壽命問題。
steps.checkEn: Report static assessment, cyclic data and unanswered life questions separately.

knowledge.title: 载荷歷程
knowledge.text: 疲勞問題包含次數、振幅、平均值與順序。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue problems include count, amplitude, mean and sequence.

knowledge.title: 驗證範圍
knowledge.text: 一種試驗合格不自動覆蓋所有失效機制。
knowledge.textEn: Passing one test does not cover every failure mechanism.

quiz.question: 靜載測試通過後，仍不能直接宣稱什麼？
quiz.questionEn: After passing a static test, what still cannot be claimed directly?
options: 仍需要辨識使用載荷歷程
已證明所有循環疲勞壽命
該靜載情境已取得一項證據
optionsEn: The service-load history still needs identification
Every cyclic-fatigue life requirement is proven
Evidence exists for that static-load case
quiz.explanation: 靜態與疲勞的驗證對象不同。
quiz.explanationEn: Static and fatigue verification address different behavior.

stages.title: 系統整合與配置交付
stages.description: 把冗餘、空間、變更及證據成熟度納入同一份工程紀錄。
stages.descriptionEn: Bring redundancy, space, change and evidence maturity into one engineering record.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 檢查冗餘電源的共同依賴
steps.titleEn: Check shared dependencies in redundant power
steps.objective: 避免把兩條線路誤認成兩套獨立供電。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid confusing two wires with two independent supplies.
steps.instruction: 畫两路教學電源供應同一感測器，先讓它們共用一個上游開關，再另畫分開的上游路徑。用紙上斷點逐一追蹤失效影響，不模擬真機電路。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two teaching supplies feeding one sensor, first sharing an upstream switch and then using separate upstream paths. Trace failures with paper break points, without simulating an aircraft circuit.
steps.observation: 共用開關失效可同時切斷兩條下游線路。
steps.observationEn: A shared switch failure can interrupt both downstream paths.
steps.failure: 只數備份元件，未檢查共同依賴，會高估可用性。
steps.failureEn: Counting backup components without shared-dependency analysis overstates availability.
steps.check: 標出至少一個共同失效點及其影響，將未知獨立性列為待驗證。
steps.checkEn: Mark a common failure point and its effect, retaining unproven independence as an open item.

knowledge.title: 共同原因
knowledge.text: 相同來源或環境可能同時影響看似分開的設備。
knowledge.textEn: A shared source or environment can affect apparently separate equipment.

knowledge.title: 失效傳播
knowledge.text: 系統邊界上的依賴決定故障如何擴散。
knowledge.textEn: Dependencies across boundaries determine how faults propagate.

quiz.question: 兩路電源共用上游開關，該開關失效代表什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two supplies share an upstream switch. What does its failure imply?
options: 兩路可能同時失去供電
必定只有一路受影響
下游有兩條線就不受影響
optionsEn: Both paths may lose power together
Only one path can be affected
Two downstream wires prevent any effect
quiz.explanation: 路徑數量不能取代獨立性分析。
quiz.explanationEn: Path count is not a substitute for independence analysis.

steps.title: 審查管線與維修可達性
steps.objective: 在原創配置圖上辨識跨系統的空間衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify cross-system spatial conflicts on an original layout.
steps.instruction: 畫一段機身設備艙示意，放入管線、線束、支承與可拆面板。先標運動及熱源區，再安排檢查視線和拆卸路徑；尺寸只用自訂教學單位。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a fuselage equipment bay with pipes, wiring, supports and a removable panel. Mark moving and hot zones, then inspection sightlines and removal paths. Use invented teaching units only.
steps.observation: 在安裝時放得進去，不代表日後能安全檢查或取出。
steps.observationEn: Fitting during installation does not ensure later inspection or removal access.
steps.failure: 只看靜止的正視圖，可能漏掉運動包络或拆卸空間。
steps.failureEn: A static front view may hide motion envelopes or removal clearances.
steps.check: 為一項元件畫出完整移出路徑，並列出至少一項介面衝突。
steps.checkEn: Draw a complete removal path for one item and identify an interface conflict.

knowledge.title: 維護設計
knowledge.text: 可達性是生命周期需求，不是完工後才處理的附加項。
knowledge.textEn: Access is a lifecycle requirement rather than an afterthought.

knowledge.title: 空間包络
knowledge.text: 位置、運動、工具與拆卸路徑佔用不同空間。
knowledge.textEn: Installed position, motion, tools and removal paths occupy different spaces.

quiz.question: 元件安裝後被固定管線擋住，主要漏了什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A fixed pipe blocks an installed component’s removal. What was omitted?
options: 只確認最初裝配時元件放得進去
只比較檢修口面積而不檢查移出路徑
維修拆卸的空間介面
optionsEn: Confirm only that the component fitted during initial assembly
Compare access-panel area without checking the removal path
The maintenance-removal spatial interface
quiz.explanation: 維修需要考慮整條拆卸路徑。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance requires considering the entire removal path.

steps.title: 追蹤設計變更的影響鏈
steps.objective: 讓一項材料變更連回所有受影響的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect a material change to every affected evidence item.
steps.instruction: 設想教學支架由材料甲改為乙。建立變更卡，逐欄檢查質量、熱膨脹、接合、檢測方式及圖面版本；未知欄寫待確認，不自行批准替代。
steps.instructionEn: Imagine changing a teaching bracket from material A to B. Create a change card covering mass, thermal expansion, joining, inspection and drawing revision. Mark unknowns for review rather than approving substitution.
steps.observation: 外形相同的支架仍可能改變負載與檢驗需求。
steps.observationEn: An equal-shaped bracket may still change loads and inspection needs.
steps.failure: 只更新採購名稱而保留舊驗證結論，會切斷配置追溯。
steps.failureEn: Updating only the purchase name while keeping old verification breaks configuration traceability.
steps.check: 變更卡至少連到兩項需重新審查的既有證據。
steps.checkEn: Link the change card to at least two existing evidence items requiring review.

knowledge.title: 配置基線
knowledge.text: 驗證結果只對特定版本與假設成立。
knowledge.textEn: Verification results apply to a particular revision and assumptions.

knowledge.title: 變更影響
knowledge.text: 一項局部替換可能跨越結構、熱與維護介面。
knowledge.textEn: A local substitution may cross structural, thermal and maintenance interfaces.

quiz.question: 材料已更換、外形不變，舊驗證可以如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: Material changes but shape does not. How should previous verification be treated?
options: 外形相同就自動沿用所有舊證據
先審查適用性與影響，再決定需重做部分
僅比較新舊材料密度，不審查其他介面
optionsEn: Automatically reuse every old result because shape is unchanged
Review applicability and impact before selecting re-verification
Compare only density without reviewing other interfaces
quiz.explanation: 外形一致不足以證明材料變更沒有影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal geometry does not establish that a material change has no effect.

steps.title: 組成分層驗證證據包
steps.objective: 把分析、試片、分系統與整合的證據分層。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate analysis, coupon, subsystem and integration evidence.
steps.instruction: 將前十一道工序的筆記排成矩陣，每列是一項需求，每欄是一種證據。明確標示教學推論、引用事實與尚缺測試；選一項接合需求追蹤到底。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange the previous eleven task notes in a matrix with requirements as rows and evidence types as columns. Mark teaching deductions, cited facts and missing tests. Trace one joint requirement through the layers.
steps.observation: 完整欄位不代表實際取得證據，空缺應維持可見。
steps.observationEn: A filled form does not mean evidence was obtained; gaps must remain visible.
steps.failure: 用漂亮模型截圖代替結構試驗或審查紀錄，會高估完成度。
steps.failureEn: Replacing structural tests or review records with attractive model screenshots overstates completion.
steps.check: 交付一條可追溯證據鏈，且沒有把本課程當作真機製造放行。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a traceable evidence chain without treating the course as an aircraft manufacturing release.

knowledge.title: 驗證階層
knowledge.text: 局部材料表現與整機整合是不同尺度的問題。
knowledge.textEn: Local material behavior and aircraft integration are different scales of problem.

knowledge.title: 證據成熟度
knowledge.text: 假設、計畫與已完成量測應有不同狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Assumptions, plans and completed measurements need distinct status labels.

quiz.question: 哪項最適合標為「待取得證據」？
quiz.questionEn: Which item should be marked as evidence still to obtain?
options: 已規劃但尚未執行的試驗
已引用並核對的公開首飛日期
已算出的教學重心例題
optionsEn: A planned but unperformed test
A checked and cited public first-flight date
A completed classroom center-of-mass calculation
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫不等於試驗結果。
quiz.explanationEn: A test plan is not a test result.

title: Alvin 載人科學潛器
summary: 以Alvin公開科學任務為背景，拆解浮力、縱傾、觀測幾何、樣本識別及資料驗證，理解深海研究平台如何服務科學問題。
summaryEn: Use Alvin’s public science mission to study buoyancy, trim, viewing geometry, sample identity and data verification, linking an ocean platform to scientific questions.
scope: 12道紙上與示意模型任務，數值均為明示教學假設；不提供耐壓艙設計、生命維持規格、載人試驗、真實下潛計畫或操作許可。
scopeEn: Twelve paper and schematic-model tasks with explicitly hypothetical values. No pressure-hull design, life-support specifications, crewed tests, actual dive planning or operating authorization.

stages.title: 科學目的與靜力模型
stages.description: 把觀測需求連到壓差、浮力與力矩，區分平台功能與科學目的。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect observation needs to pressure difference, buoyancy and moments, separating platform function from science purpose.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 把科學問題轉成觀測需求
steps.titleEn: Turn a science question into observation requirements
steps.objective: 定義潛器要取得的資料，而非只列設備。
steps.objectiveEn: Define the required data rather than merely listing instruments.
steps.instruction: 設定虛構任務：比較兩處海底岩石外觀。列出影像、樣本識別、位置及時間四欄，說明每欄如何回答問題；不規劃真實下潛。
steps.instructionEn: Set a fictional mission comparing rock appearance at two seafloor sites. List imagery, sample identity, position and time, explaining how each answers the question. Do not plan an actual dive.
steps.observation: 缺少位置或樣本識別的照片，難以連回同一觀測對象。
steps.observationEn: A photograph without location or sample identity is difficult to connect to its observation target.
steps.failure: 把相機解析度當成整個任務成功標準，忽略資料脈絡。
steps.failureEn: Treating camera resolution as the entire success criterion ignores data context.
steps.check: 每項資料均對應科學問題，且有識別與時間欄位。
steps.checkEn: Each datum maps to the science question and has identity and time fields.

knowledge.title: 需求分配
knowledge.text: 科學目的必須轉成可收集、可追溯的資料。
knowledge.textEn: A scientific purpose must become collectible, traceable data.

knowledge.title: 任務邊界
knowledge.text: 教育案例只討論資料需求，不授權現場操作。
knowledge.textEn: The educational case addresses data requirements, not operational authorization.

quiz.question: 要把岩石照片與實體樣本對上，最缺不得的是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is essential for matching a rock photograph to its physical sample?
options: 只依相近拍攝時間猜測配對
只依容器擺放順序配對
共同樣本識別碼與記錄
optionsEn: Infer the pairing only from similar capture times
Match only by container placement order
A shared sample identifier and record
quiz.explanation: 共同識別碼維持影像與樣本間的關聯。
quiz.explanationEn: A shared identifier preserves the image-to-sample relationship.

steps.title: 區分水深與壓差
steps.objective: 用靜水概念標記外部與內部環境。
steps.objectiveEn: Use hydrostatics to label exterior and interior environments.
steps.instruction: 畫一個封閉教學球體，分別標示外部水壓及內部壓力。以p外=p表面+ρgh比較h與2h的水柱貢獻；保持ρ與g不變，不計算艙壁厚度。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a closed teaching sphere and label external and internal pressures. Use p_external=p_surface+ρgh to compare water-column contributions at h and 2h with constant density and gravity. Do not calculate wall thickness.
steps.observation: 加倍深度使水柱壓力項加倍，但不使含表面壓力的絕對壓力恰好加倍。
steps.observationEn: Doubling depth doubles the water-column term, not necessarily the absolute pressure including surface pressure.
steps.failure: 混用絕對壓力與壓差，會使載荷敘述不清。
steps.failureEn: Mixing absolute pressure with differential pressure obscures the load definition.
steps.check: 圖上同時標出內壓、外壓及兩者差，寫明模型假設。
steps.checkEn: Label internal, external and differential pressures and state the assumptions.

knowledge.title: 靜水壓力
knowledge.text: 在密度近似固定時，水柱壓力隨深度線性增加。
knowledge.textEn: With approximately constant density, water-column pressure grows linearly with depth.

knowledge.title: 壓差
knowledge.text: 結構兩側環境的差異決定相應載荷問題。
knowledge.textEn: The difference between environments on either side defines the corresponding load problem.

quiz.question: 將h變為2h，哪一項恰好加倍？
quiz.questionEn: When h becomes 2h, which term doubles exactly in this model?
options: 內部壓力必然
ρgh水柱項
所有絕對壓力
optionsEn: The internal pressure necessarily
The ρgh water-column term
Every absolute pressure
quiz.explanation: 表面壓力項不隨水深加倍。
quiz.explanationEn: The surface-pressure term does not double with depth.

steps.title: 建立浮力與重量帳
steps.titleEn: Build a buoyancy and weight balance
steps.objective: 以排水體積與總質量判斷淨垂直力。
steps.objectiveEn: Use displaced volume and total mass to determine net vertical force.
steps.instruction: 使用紙上假設ρ=1、g=1、排水體積V=12、質量m=10，算B−W。再加入3單位質量而不改體積，重新判讀；這不是Alvin的實際數值。
