Owner data state that the two main cables place about 61,500 tons (short tons) on each tower.
A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load.
quiz.explanation: 業主資料指出兩條主纜施加在每座橋塔的荷重約 61,500 噸（美噸）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Owner data state that the two main cables place about 61,500 tons (short tons) on each tower. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Back-calculating cable tension from tower load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「每塔 61,500 噸纜力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “61,500-ton cable load per tower” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V = 61,500 short ton×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN。取主跨 tanθ_m = 0.44、邊跨 tanθ_s = 0.40：H = V/(0.44+0.40) ≈ 651 MN（兩纜），每纜 326 MN；T = 326×√(1+0.44²) ≈ 356 MN。每纜鋼絲面積 27,572×18.68 mm² ≈ 515,000 mm²，應力 ≈ 691 N/mm²，對最低強度 1,517 N/mm² 的係數約 2.19。傾角為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V = 61,500 short tons×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN. Taking tanθ_m = 0.44 for the main span and tanθ_s = 0.40 for the side span: H = V/(0.44+0.40) ≈ 651 MN for both cables, 326 MN each; T = 326×√(1+0.44²) ≈ 356 MN. Wire area per cable 27,572×18.68 mm² ≈ 515,000 mm² gives a stress of about 691 N/mm², a factor of about 2.19 on the 1,517 N/mm² minimum strength. The angles are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工測量或光達掃描取得塔頂兩側主纜實際傾角，代回計算 H 與 T，並與原設計值和有限元素模型比較；若三者差異超過約定範圍，檢查恆載假設（例如 1986 年更換後的橋面重量）與塔頂索鞍位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain actual cable angles on both sides of the tower top from as-built survey or lidar, recompute H and T, and compare with original design values and the finite-element model; if the three differ beyond an agreed band, check dead-load assumptions such as the deck weight after the 1986 replacement and the saddle positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: V = 61,500 short ton×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN。取主跨 tanθ_m = 0.44、邊跨 tanθ_s = 0.40：H = V/(0.44+0.40) ≈ 651 MN（兩纜），每纜 326 MN；T = 326×√(1+0.44²) ≈ 356 MN。每纜鋼絲面積 27,572×18.68 mm² ≈ 515,000 mm²，應力 ≈ 691 N/mm²，對最低強度 1,517 N/mm² 的係數約 2.19。傾角為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: V = 61,500 short tons×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN. Taking tanθ_m = 0.44 for the main span and tanθ_s = 0.40 for the side span: H = V/(0.44+0.40) ≈ 651 MN for both cables, 326 MN each; T = 326×√(1+0.44²) ≈ 356 MN. Wire area per cable 27,572×18.68 mm² ≈ 515,000 mm² gives a stress of about 691 N/mm², a factor of about 2.19 on the 1,517 N/mm² minimum strength. The angles are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Back-calculating cable tension from tower load", which statement holds?
options: 吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。
把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。
optionsEn: Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter.
A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry.
quiz.explanation: V = 61,500 short ton×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: V = 61,500 short tons×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Back-calculating cable tension from tower load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「每塔 61,500 噸纜力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “61,500-ton cable load per tower” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工測量或光達掃描取得塔頂兩側主纜實際傾角，代回計算 H 與 T，並與原設計值和有限元素模型比較；若三者差異超過約定範圍，檢查恆載假設（例如 1986 年更換後的橋面重量）與塔頂索鞍位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain actual cable angles on both sides of the tower top from as-built survey or lidar, recompute H and T, and compare with original design values and the finite-element model; if the three differ beyond an agreed band, check dead-load assumptions such as the deck weight after the 1986 replacement and the saddle positions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每塔 61,500 噸纜力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “61,500-ton cable load per tower” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若評估仍沿用 1937 年的恆載而忽略後來的橋面更換、加勁與附加設施，計算出的主纜應力與安全係數會偏離實際；反過來若遺漏新增荷重（防墜網、抗風整流板），可能高估剩餘容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An evaluation still using 1937 dead loads, ignoring later deck replacement, bracing and attachments, misstates cable stress and safety factor; conversely, missing added loads such as the deterrent net or wind fairings can overstate remaining capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種「由支承反力反推內力」的檢核，是評估既有懸索橋時最常用的獨立驗算，可與原始計算書或有限元素模型相互印證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Back-calculating internal forces from support reactions is the most common independent check when evaluating an existing suspension bridge, cross-checking the original calculations or a finite-element model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔頂荷重就等於主纜張力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The load on the tower equals the cable tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。

quiz.explanationEn: An evaluation still using 1937 dead loads, ignoring later deck replacement, bracing and attachments, misstates cable stress and safety factor; conversely, missing added loads such as the deterrent net or wind fairings can overstate remaining capacity. steps.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「27.7 ft 橫向變位」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “27.7 ft lateral deflection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主資料列出主跨中央最大橫向變位約 27.7 ft（約 8.4 m），遠大於最大下垂 10.8 ft 與上揚 5.8 ft。懸索橋抵抗側風的勁度主要不是來自加勁桁架的側向彎曲，而是來自主纜的「重力勁度」：受張的主纜像鐘擺一樣，被側向推開時，張力的水平分量會把它拉回中心。張力越大、跨徑越短，回復力越強；1950 年代增設的下層橫向斜撐則提高了橋面本身的側向與扭轉勁度，兩者共同決定側風下的變位與振動特性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「27.7 ft 橫向變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft. A suspension bridge resists crosswind mainly not through lateral bending of the stiffening truss but through the gravity stiffness of the cables: like a pendulum, a tensioned cable pushed sideways is pulled back by the horizontal component of its tension. Higher tension and shorter span give stronger restoring force; the lower lateral bracing added in the 1950s raised the deck's own lateral and torsional stiffness, and the two together set deflection and vibration in crosswinds. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “27.7 ft lateral deflection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「27.7 ft 橫向變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “27.7 ft lateral deflection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位
knowledge.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection
knowledge.text: 業主資料列出主跨中央最大橫向變位約 27.7 ft（約 8.4 m），遠大於最大下垂 10.8 ft 與上揚 5.8 ft。懸索橋抵抗側風的勁度主要不是來自加勁桁架的側向彎曲，而是來自主纜的「重力勁度」：受張的主纜像鐘擺一樣，被側向推開時，張力的水平分量會把它拉回中心。
knowledge.textEn: Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft. A suspension bridge resists crosswind mainly not through lateral bending of the stiffening truss but through the gravity stiffness of the cables: like a pendulum, a tensioned cable pushed sideways is pulled back by the horizontal component of its tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜重力勁度與橫向變位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection" is correct?
options: 懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。
老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。
業主資料列出主跨中央最大橫向變位約 27.7 ft（約 8.4 m），遠大於最大下垂 10.8 ft 與上揚 5.8 ft。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load.
Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless.
Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft.

quiz.explanationEn: Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「27.7 ft 橫向變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “27.7 ft lateral deflection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。取 H = 651 MN（兩纜合計）、l = 1,280 m、側向風力 w_L = 15 kN/m：δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m；反算達到 8.4 m 需 w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m。忽略桁架側向勁度，為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H). With H = 651 MN for both cables, l = 1,280 m and lateral wind load w_L = 15 kN/m: δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m; reaching 8.4 m would need w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m. Truss lateral stiffness is ignored; values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 GNSS 在跨中與四分點量測強風中的側向位移，同步記錄橋面高度的風速風向，將位移對風壓（∝U²）作圖，檢查斜率是否符合重力勁度加桁架勁度的模型；並比較伸縮縫與風支承在側向位移時的行程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure lateral displacement in strong wind with GNSS at mid-span and quarter points, recording deck-level wind speed and direction, plot displacement against wind pressure (∝U²) and check the slope against a gravity-plus-truss stiffness model; also compare the travel of expansion joints and wind shoes during lateral movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。取 H = 651 MN（兩纜合計）、l = 1,280 m、側向風力 w_L = 15 kN/m：δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m；反算達到 8.4 m 需 w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m。忽略桁架側向勁度，為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H). With H = 651 MN for both cables, l = 1,280 m and lateral wind load w_L = 15 kN/m: δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m; reaching 8.4 m would need w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m. Truss lateral stiffness is ignored; values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜重力勁度與橫向變位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “27.7 ft lateral deflection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 GNSS 在跨中與四分點量測強風中的側向位移，同步記錄橋面高度的風速風向，將位移對風壓（∝U²）作圖，檢查斜率是否符合重力勁度加桁架勁度的模型；並比較伸縮縫與風支承在側向位移時的行程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure lateral displacement in strong wind with GNSS at mid-span and quarter points, recording deck-level wind speed and direction, plot displacement against wind pressure (∝U²) and check the slope against a gravity-plus-truss stiffness model; also compare the travel of expansion joints and wind shoes during lateral movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何會增加橋面受風面積或改變斷面形狀的工程，都要在設計階段提出側風變位與氣動穩定的評估，並由業主的風工程顧問核可；評估須同時列出伸縮縫、風支承與管線的位移容量。

steps.instruction: 若改造增加了橋面側向受風面積（例如加裝圍欄或設備）而未更新側風分析，實際橫向變位與伸縮縫行程需求可能超出原設計；側向勁度不足也會讓渦振與扭轉耦合更容易發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire" and "Suspender forces and the 1970s full replacement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “0.192 in galvanised wire” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 金門大橋每條主纜含 27,572 根直徑 0.192 in（約 4.88 mm）的鍍鋅鋼絲，分成 61 束、平均每束約 452 根，連同纏繞外徑約 36⅜ in（0.92 m）。業主公布的鋼絲平均抗拉強度 235,600 psi（規格最低 220,000 psi）、降伏強度 182,600 psi、斷裂伸長率 6.3%（最低 4.0%）。與現代 1,770 至 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲相比強度較低，但延性與降伏比較寬裕；評估既有主纜時，要用當時規格的最低值與實際抽樣結果，而不是現代鋼絲的數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each Golden Gate cable contains 27,572 galvanised wires of 0.192 in (about 4.88 mm) diameter in 61 strands averaging about 452 wires, about 36⅜ in (0.92 m) in diameter with wrapping. The owner lists average wire tensile strength of 235,600 psi (220,000 psi specified minimum), yield of 182,600 psi and elongation at rupture of 6.3% (4.0% minimum). The strength is lower than modern 1,770 to 1,960 MPa wire, but ductility and yield ratio are generous; evaluating an existing cable must use the period specification minimum and actual sample results, not modern wire figures. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “0.192 in galvanised wire” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Conversions: 235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm², 220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm², 182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm², a yield ratio ≈ 0.775.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “0.192 in galvanised wire”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “0.192 in galvanised wire” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：換算：235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm²、220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm²、182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm²，降伏比 ≈ 0.775。單絲面積 π/4×4.877² ≈ 18.68 mm²，每纜面積 ≈ 515,000 mm²，以最低強度計破斷力 ≈ 781 MN。兩纜總長核算：2×27,572×2,332 m ≈ 128,600 km，與公布的約 129,000 km 一致。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Conversions: 235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm², 220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm², 182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm², a yield ratio ≈ 0.775. Wire area π/4×4.877² ≈ 18.68 mm², about 515,000 mm² per cable, for a minimum breaking force ≈ 781 MN. Total length check: 2×27,572×2,332 m ≈ 128,600 km, matching the published 129,000 km or so. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開纜檢查時取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸、伸長率與扭轉試驗，並以金相與鍍鋅層量測判斷腐蝕階段；依試驗結果與斷絲統計建立剩餘強度模型，比較設計時的最低強度與實際分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During cable openings remove representative wires for tensile, elongation and torsion tests, and assess corrosion stage by metallography and zinc measurement; build a remaining-strength model from test results and broken-wire counts, comparing the original specified minimum with the actual distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Applying modern wire strengths overstates the cable's safety factor; judging only by appearance without testing can miss embrittlement or corrosion cracking of inner wires and delay dehumidification or strengthening decisions. steps.title: 吊索受力與 1970 年代全面更換：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Suspender forces and the 1970s full replacement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「250 對吊索」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “250 pairs of suspenders” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 金門大橋有 250 對豎向吊索，間距 50 ft，每根直徑 2-11/16 in；原吊索於 1972 至 1976 年間全部更換，最後一根於 1976 年 5 月 4 日完成。吊索把橋面荷重傳到索夾與主纜，最脆弱的部位通常是下端錨頭附近：雨水沿吊索流下積聚、海鹽與鋼絲彎曲應力在此疊加。更換吊索時，必須在不中斷交通的情況下以臨時吊具分擔荷重，逐根卸載、拆除與張拉，並控制橋面高程與相鄰吊索的受力變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「250 對吊索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Golden Gate has 250 pairs of vertical suspender ropes at 50 ft spacing, each 2-11/16 in in diameter; the originals were all replaced between 1972 and 1976, the last on 4 May 1976. Suspenders carry deck load to the cable bands and main cables, and the weakest zone is usually near the lower socket, where rainwater running down the rope collects and salt and wire bending stress combine. Replacing suspenders without stopping traffic means sharing load through temporary hangers, then unloading, removing and tensioning ropes one at a time while controlling deck level and force changes in neighbouring suspenders. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “250 pairs of suspenders” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每對吊索承擔 50 ft（15.24 m）橋面。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each pair carries 50 ft (15.24 m) of deck.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「250 對吊索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “250 pairs of suspenders”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 吊索受力與 1970 年代全面更換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Suspender forces and the 1970s full replacement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「250 對吊索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “250 pairs of suspenders” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每對吊索承擔 50 ft（15.24 m）橋面。若每側橋面恆載 100 kN/m，每對受力 100×15.24 ≈ 1,524 kN，每根 762 kN。直徑 68.3 mm 鋼索若金屬面積約為毛面積的 60%，A ≈ 0.6×π/4×68.3² ≈ 2,196 mm²，應力 ≈ 347 N/mm²。恆載與填充率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each pair carries 50 ft (15.24 m) of deck. With 100 kN/m of dead load per side, a pair carries 100×15.24 ≈ 1,524 kN, or 762 kN per rope. For a 68.3 mm rope with metallic area about 60% of gross, A ≈ 0.6×π/4×68.3² ≈ 2,196 mm², a stress of about 347 N/mm². Dead load and fill factor are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：更換時以千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計量測新舊吊索受力轉移，量測橋面高程變化與相鄰吊索力，確保偏差在容許範圍；完成後以振動法或荷重計抽測吊索力，並以磁通檢測建立新吊索的基準剖面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During replacement measure the force transfer between old and new ropes with jack readings and strain gauges, monitoring deck level and neighbouring forces within tolerance; afterwards spot-check forces by vibration method or load cell and record a magnetic-flux baseline for each new rope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.observation: 現場實務：吊索更換計畫應列出臨時吊具容量、逐根卸載與張拉的停留點、橋面高程允差與停止條件，並由結構工程師現場核可；新吊索要建立可追溯的出廠證明與安裝張力紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A suspender replacement plan should list temporary hanger capacity, hold points for unloading and tensioning each rope, deck-level tolerance and stop conditions, approved on site by the structural engineer; new ropes need traceable mill certificates and installation tension records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：下端錨頭附近的腐蝕斷絲常被護套或塗裝遮蔽，若只做目視檢查可能延誤更換；更換時若荷重轉移順序錯誤，相鄰吊索過載或橋面局部下陷，可能造成桁架構件附加應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Broken wires near lower sockets are often hidden under sleeves or paint, so visual inspection alone can delay replacement; a wrong load-transfer order during replacement can overload neighbouring ropes or locally drop the deck, adding stress to truss members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 更換時以千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計量測新舊吊索受力轉移，量測橋面高程變化與相鄰吊索力，確保偏差在容許範圍；完成後以振動法或荷重計抽測吊索力，並以磁通檢測建立新吊索的基準剖面。
knowledge.textEn: During replacement measure the force transfer between old and new ropes with jack readings and strain gauges, monitoring deck level and neighbouring forces within tolerance; afterwards spot-check forces by vibration method or load cell and record a magnetic-flux baseline for each new rope.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊索更換計畫應列出臨時吊具容量、逐根卸載與張拉的停留點、橋面高程允差與停止條件，並由結構工程師現場核可；新吊索要建立可追溯的出廠證明與安裝張力紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: A suspender replacement plan should list temporary hanger capacity, hold points for unloading and tensioning each rope, deck-level tolerance and stop conditions, approved on site by the structural engineer; new ropes need traceable mill certificates and installation tension records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊索受力與 1970 年代全面更換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Suspender forces and the 1970s full replacement"?
options: 更換時以千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計量測新舊吊索受力轉移，量測橋面高程變化與相鄰吊索力，確保偏差在容許範圍。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
塔頂荷重就等於主纜張力。
optionsEn: During replacement measure the force transfer between old and new ropes with jack readings and strain gauges, monitoring deck level and neighbouring forces within tolerance.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The load on the tower equals the cable tension.
quiz.explanation: 更換時以千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計量測新舊吊索受力轉移，量測橋面高程變化與相鄰吊索力，確保偏差在容許範圍；完成後以振動法或荷重計抽測吊索力，並以磁通檢測建立新吊索的基準剖面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During replacement measure the force transfer between old and new ropes with jack readings and strain gauges, monitoring deck level and neighbouring forces within tolerance; afterwards spot-check forces by vibration method or load cell and record a magnetic-flux baseline for each new rope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊索受力與 1970 年代全面更換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Suspender forces and the 1970s full replacement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「250 對吊索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “250 pairs of suspenders” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 下端錨頭附近的腐蝕斷絲常被護套或塗裝遮蔽，若只做目視檢查可能延誤更換；更換時若荷重轉移順序錯誤，相鄰吊索過載或橋面局部下陷，可能造成桁架構件附加應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Broken wires near lower sockets are often hidden under sleeves or paint, so visual inspection alone can delay replacement; a wrong load-transfer order during replacement can overload neighbouring ropes or locally drop the deck, adding stress to truss members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：更換吊索時，必須在不中斷交通的情況下以臨時吊具分擔荷重，逐根卸載、拆除與張拉，並控制橋面高程與相鄰吊索的受力變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Replacing suspenders without stopping traffic means sharing load through temporary hangers, then unloading, removing and tensioning ropes one at a time while controlling deck level and force changes in neighbouring suspenders.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 下端錨頭附近的腐蝕斷絲常被護套或塗裝遮蔽，若只做目視檢查可能延誤更換；更換時若荷重轉移順序錯誤，相鄰吊索過載或橋面局部下陷，可能造成桁架構件附加應力。
knowledge.textEn: Broken wires near lower sockets are often hidden under sleeves or paint, so visual inspection alone can delay replacement; a wrong load-transfer order during replacement can overload neighbouring ropes or locally drop the deck, adding stress to truss members.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊索受力與 1970 年代全面更換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Suspender forces and the 1970s full replacement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
下端錨頭附近的腐蝕斷絲常被護套或塗裝遮蔽，若只做目視檢查可能延誤更換；更換時若荷重轉移順序錯誤，相鄰吊索過載或橋面局部下陷，可能造成桁架構件附加應力。
空中紡線的速度只取決於紡線輪跑多快。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Broken wires near lower sockets are often hidden under sleeves or paint, so visual inspection alone can delay replacement.
Aerial-spinning speed depends only on how fast the wheels run.
quiz.explanation: 下端錨頭附近的腐蝕斷絲常被護套或塗裝遮蔽，若只做目視檢查可能延誤更換；更換時若荷重轉移順序錯誤，相鄰吊索過載或橋面局部下陷，可能造成桁架構件附加應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Broken wires near lower sockets are often hidden under sleeves or paint, so visual inspection alone can delay replacement; a wrong load-transfer order during replacement can overload neighbouring ropes or locally drop the deck, adding stress to truss members. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算」與「橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Estimating 1930s aerial-spinning progress" and "Cable rise after the lighter deck": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Estimating 1930s aerial-spinning progress: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「6 個月又 9 天的紡線」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Six months and nine days of spinning” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主資料記載金門大橋主纜鋼絲紡線在 6 個月又 9 天內完成，兩條主纜共用約 80,000 mi（約 129,000 km）的鍍鋅鋼絲。空中紡線讓紡線輪沿貓道上方來回運行，每趟把鋼絲環從一座錨碇帶到另一座，在兩端錨碇的索靴上繞回；工人在塔頂與跨中逐根調整鋼絲垂度，使每束鋼絲受力一致。速度受限於紡線輪數量、運行速度、調整垂度所需的時間與風。這個進度數字可以用來回推每天必須鋪設的鋼絲長度與每束完成所需時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「6 個月又 9 天的紡線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Owner data record that wire spinning for the Golden Gate cables was completed in six months and nine days, using about 80,000 mi (about 129,000 km) of galvanised wire for both cables. Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, where it turns around strand shoes; crews at the towers and mid-span adjust wire sag one by one so every wire in a strand carries the same force. Speed is limited by the number of wheels, their travel speed, the time to adjust sag, and wind. The progress figure lets us back-calculate the wire length that had to be laid each day and the time per strand. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Six months and nine days of spinning” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總長 129,000 km ÷ 190 天 ≈ 679 km/天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total 129,000 km ÷ 190 days ≈ 679 km a day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空中紡線的速度只取決於紡線輪跑多快。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Aerial-spinning speed depends only on how fast the wheels run." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「6 個月又 9 天的紡線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Six months and nine days of spinning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算
knowledge.text: 業主資料記載金門大橋主纜鋼絲紡線在 6 個月又 9 天內完成，兩條主纜共用約 80,000 mi（約 129,000 km）的鍍鋅鋼絲。空中紡線讓紡線輪沿貓道上方來回運行，每趟把鋼絲環從一座錨碇帶到另一座，在兩端錨碇的索靴上繞回；工人在塔頂與跨中逐根調整鋼絲垂度，使每束鋼絲受力一致。
knowledge.textEn: Owner data record that wire spinning for the Golden Gate cables was completed in six months and nine days, using about 80,000 mi (about 129,000 km) of galvanised wire for both cables. Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, where it turns around strand shoes; crews at the towers and mid-span adjust wire sag one by one so every wire in a strand carries the same force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空中紡線的速度只取決於紡線輪跑多快。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Aerial-spinning speed depends only on how fast the wheels run. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Estimating 1930s aerial-spinning progress" is correct?
options: 空中紡線的速度只取決於紡線輪跑多快。
把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。
業主資料記載金門大橋主纜鋼絲紡線在 6 個月又 9 天內完成，兩條主纜共用約 80,000 mi（約 129,000 km）的鍍鋅鋼絲。
optionsEn: Aerial-spinning speed depends only on how fast the wheels run.
A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry.
Owner data record that wire spinning for the Golden Gate cables was completed in six months and nine days, using about 80,000 mi (about 129,000 km) of galvanised wire for both cables.
quiz.explanation: 業主資料記載金門大橋主纜鋼絲紡線在 6 個月又 9 天內完成，兩條主纜共用約 80,000 mi（約 129,000 km）的鍍鋅鋼絲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Owner data record that wire spinning for the Golden Gate cables was completed in six months and nine days, using about 80,000 mi (about 129,000 km) of galvanised wire for both cables. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「6 個月又 9 天的紡線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Six months and nine days of spinning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總長 129,000 km ÷ 190 天 ≈ 679 km/天。單根主纜鋼絲長約 2,332 m，相當於每天約 679,000/2,332 ≈ 291 根全長鋼絲；兩纜共 122 束，平均每束約 190/122 ≈ 1.6 天完成（忽略並行作業）。若因強風停工 20 天，日進度需提高到約 129,000/170 ≈ 759 km/天。工作日假設為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total 129,000 km ÷ 190 days ≈ 679 km a day. With each cable wire about 2,332 m long, that is about 679,000/2,332 ≈ 291 full-length wires a day; across 122 strands in both cables, about 190/122 ≈ 1.6 days per strand on average (ignoring parallel work). Losing 20 days to wind would require about 129,000/170 ≈ 759 km a day. Working-day assumptions are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：紡線期間每日記錄各紡線輪趟數、完成鋼絲數、停工時間與天氣，並以每束完成後的垂度量測確認品質；進度曲線與計畫比較，落後時優先檢討停工原因而不是縮短垂度調整時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During spinning log trips per wheel, wires completed, downtime and weather daily, confirming quality by sag survey after each strand; compare the progress curve with the plan and, when behind, examine causes of downtime first rather than shortening sag adjustment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 總長 129,000 km ÷ 190 天 ≈ 679 km/天。單根主纜鋼絲長約 2,332 m，相當於每天約 679,000/2,332 ≈ 291 根全長鋼絲；兩纜共 122 束，平均每束約 190/122 ≈ 1.6 天完成（忽略並行作業）。若因強風停工 20 天，日進度需提高到約 129,000/170 ≈ 759 km/天。工作日假設為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Total 129,000 km ÷ 190 days ≈ 679 km a day. With each cable wire about 2,332 m long, that is about 679,000/2,332 ≈ 291 full-length wires a day; across 122 strands in both cables, about 190/122 ≈ 1.6 days per strand on average (ignoring parallel work). Losing 20 days to wind would require about 129,000/170 ≈ 759 km a day. Working-day assumptions are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Estimating 1930s aerial-spinning progress", which statement holds?
options: 螺栓一旦鎖到規定張力，就能永久保持。
防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: Total 129,000 km ÷ 190 days ≈ 679 km a day.
Once bolts are tightened to the specified tension, they keep it forever.
The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability.
quiz.explanation: 總長 129,000 km ÷ 190 天 ≈ 679 km/天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Total 129,000 km ÷ 190 days ≈ 679 km a day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Estimating 1930s aerial-spinning progress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「6 個月又 9 天的紡線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Six months and nine days of spinning” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 紡線期間每日記錄各紡線輪趟數、完成鋼絲數、停工時間與天氣，並以每束完成後的垂度量測確認品質；進度曲線與計畫比較，落後時優先檢討停工原因而不是縮短垂度調整時間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During spinning log trips per wheel, wires completed, downtime and weather daily, confirming quality by sag survey after each strand; compare the progress curve with the plan and, when behind, examine causes of downtime first rather than shortening sag adjustment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：紡線施工規範要寫明每束垂度允差、量測時段與溫度修正，以及停工風速；進度壓力下任何放寬品質門檻的提議都必須經設計者書面核可。

steps.title: 1930 年代空中紡線的進度估算：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 為追趕進度而縮短垂度調整，會讓同一束鋼絲受力不均，壓擠後產生鬆弛絲，長期影響主纜耐久與索夾夾緊；強風中強行紡線則可能使鋼絲纏繞或斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting sag adjustment to catch up leaves uneven forces in a strand and slack wires after compaction, harming long-term durability and cable-band grip; spinning in strong wind can tangle or break wires. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個進度數字可以用來回推每天必須鋪設的鋼絲長度與每束完成所需時間。

steps.title: 橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable rise after the lighter deck: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1986 年橋面減重 12,300 噸」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1986 deck lightening of 12,300 tons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 1980 年代金門大橋把原有鋼筋混凝土橋面與縱梁更換為正交異性鋼橋面，業主資料記載重量減少約 12,300 噸，相當於每延英尺約 1.37 噸。施工多在夜間分段進行，每天早上恢復通車。橋面變輕後主纜張力下降、彈性伸長減少，主跨垂度隨之變小，橋面整體抬升；同時塔頂索鞍兩側的平衡改變，塔頂可能朝邊跨方向移動。因此更換順序必須控制左右對稱與跨間平衡，並預先計算完工後的路面縱斷面與伸縮縫位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1986 年橋面減重 12,300 噸」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In the 1980s the original reinforced-concrete deck and stringers were replaced with an orthotropic steel deck; owner data record a weight reduction of about 12,300 tons, about 1.37 tons per lineal foot. Work was done mostly at night in sections, reopening to traffic each morning. A lighter deck lowers cable tension and elastic stretch, so main-span sag decreases and the deck rises; the balance on either side of the tower saddles also changes and tower tops may move toward the side spans. The replacement sequence therefore had to control symmetry and balance between spans, and the final road profile and joint positions had to be predicted in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1986 deck lightening of 12,300 tons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Δw = 1.37 short ton/ft ≈ 40 kN/m（兩纜合計）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Δw = 1.37 short tons/ft ≈ 40 kN/m for both cables.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1986 年橋面減重 12,300 噸」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1986 deck lightening of 12,300 tons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升
knowledge.titleEn: Cable rise after the lighter deck
knowledge.text: 1980 年代金門大橋把原有鋼筋混凝土橋面與縱梁更換為正交異性鋼橋面，業主資料記載重量減少約 12,300 噸，相當於每延英尺約 1.37 噸。施工多在夜間分段進行，每天早上恢復通車。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cable rise after the lighter deck" is correct?

只要整座橋在強風中穩定，欄杆的振動與聲音就不是工程問題。
optionsEn: In the 1980s the original reinforced-concrete deck and stringers were replaced with an orthotropic steel deck.

steps.title: 橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable rise after the lighter deck: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1986 年橋面減重 12,300 噸」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1986 deck lightening of 12,300 tons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δw = 1.37 short ton/ft ≈ 40 kN/m（兩纜合計）。取 f = 142 m：ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 40×1,280²/(8×142) ≈ 57,700 kN，每纜 28.8 MN；主跨主纜縮短 ΔS ≈ 28.8×10⁶×1,320/(2×10¹¹×0.515) ≈ 0.37 m；Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS ≈ 1.69×0.37 ≈ 0.62 m 抬升。垂度、E 與纜長為教學假設，忽略塔頂位移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δw = 1.37 short tons/ft ≈ 40 kN/m for both cables. With f = 142 m: ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 40×1,280²/(8×142) ≈ 57,700 kN, or 28.8 MN per cable; the main-span cable shortens by ΔS ≈ 28.8×10⁶×1,320/(2×10¹¹×0.515) ≈ 0.37 m, and Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS ≈ 1.69×0.37 ≈ 0.62 m of rise. Sag, E and cable length are teaching assumptions; tower-top movement is ignored. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一施工段完成後量測橋面高程、塔頂位移與主纜垂度，並與分段更換分析比較；全部完成後重新測量路面縱斷面、伸縮縫開口與吊索力，更新恆載履歷與結構模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each section measure deck levels, tower-top movement and cable sag against the staged-replacement analysis; at completion re-survey the road profile, joint openings and suspender forces, updating the dead-load history and structural model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Δw = 1.37 short tons/ft ≈ 40 kN/m for both cables. With f = 142 m: ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 40×1,280²/(8×142) ≈ 57,700 kN, or 28.8 MN per cable; the main-span cable shortens by ΔS ≈ 28.8×10⁶×1,320/(2×10¹¹×0.515) ≈ 0.37 m, and Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS ≈ 1.69×0.37 ≈ 0.62 m of rise. Sag, E and cable length are teaching assumptions; tower-top movement is ignored.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cable rise after the lighter deck", which statement holds?
options: 1989 年地震中金門大橋沒有損壞，代表它不需要耐震改造。
Δw = 1.37 short ton/ft ≈ 40 kN/m（兩纜合計）。
塔頂荷重就等於主纜張力。

Δw = 1.37 short tons/ft ≈ 40 kN/m for both cables.

steps.title: 橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cable rise after the lighter deck: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1986 年橋面減重 12,300 噸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1986 deck lightening of 12,300 tons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一施工段完成後量測橋面高程、塔頂位移與主纜垂度，並與分段更換分析比較；全部完成後重新測量路面縱斷面、伸縮縫開口與吊索力，更新恆載履歷與結構模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each section measure deck levels, tower-top movement and cable sag against the staged-replacement analysis; at completion re-survey the road profile, joint openings and suspender forces, updating the dead-load history and structural model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大規模恆載改變的工程，應事先完成分段施工分析、列出每階段允許的不平衡重量與幾何監測點，並在每夜施工結束時核對量測值；超出觸發值即停止下一段，由設計者評估後才繼續。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Major dead-load changes require a staged analysis listing the allowable unbalanced weight and geometric checkpoints for each stage, with readings checked at the end of every night shift; exceeding a trigger stops the next section until the designer has assessed it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若更換不對稱推進，單側或單跨減重過多，塔頂索鞍兩側張力差增大，塔身彎矩與伸縮縫偏位可能超限；未預先調整路面高程則完工後出現縱斷面不平順與排水問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Asymmetric progress that lightens one side or span too much increases the tension difference across the saddles, possibly overstressing tower bending and shifting joints beyond limits; failing to plan road levels leaves an uneven profile and drainage problems after completion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一施工段完成後量測橋面高程、塔頂位移與主纜垂度，並與分段更換分析比較；全部完成後重新測量路面縱斷面、伸縮縫開口與吊索力，更新恆載履歷與結構模型。
knowledge.textEn: After each section measure deck levels, tower-top movement and cable sag against the staged-replacement analysis; at completion re-survey the road profile, joint openings and suspender forces, updating the dead-load history and structural model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 大規模恆載改變的工程，應事先完成分段施工分析、列出每階段允許的不平衡重量與幾何監測點，並在每夜施工結束時核對量測值；超出觸發值即停止下一段，由設計者評估後才繼續。
knowledge.textEn: Major dead-load changes require a staged analysis listing the allowable unbalanced weight and geometric checkpoints for each stage, with readings checked at the end of every night shift; exceeding a trigger stops the next section until the designer has assessed it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cable rise after the lighter deck"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。
每一施工段完成後量測橋面高程、塔頂位移與主纜垂度，並與分段更換分析比較；全部完成後重新測量路面縱斷面、伸縮縫開口與吊索力，更新恆載履歷與結構模型。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless.
After each section measure deck levels, tower-top movement and cable sag against the staged-replacement analysis.
quiz.explanation: 每一施工段完成後量測橋面高程、塔頂位移與主纜垂度，並與分段更換分析比較；全部完成後重新測量路面縱斷面、伸縮縫開口與吊索力，更新恆載履歷與結構模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each section measure deck levels, tower-top movement and cable sag against the staged-replacement analysis; at completion re-survey the road profile, joint openings and suspender forces, updating the dead-load history and structural model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable rise after the lighter deck: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1986 年橋面減重 12,300 噸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1986 deck lightening of 12,300 tons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若更換不對稱推進，單側或單跨減重過多，塔頂索鞍兩側張力差增大，塔身彎矩與伸縮縫偏位可能超限；未預先調整路面高程則完工後出現縱斷面不平順與排水問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Asymmetric progress that lightens one side or span too much increases the tension difference across the saddles, possibly overstressing tower bending and shifting joints beyond limits; failing to plan road levels leaves an uneven profile and drainage problems after completion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此更換順序必須控制左右對稱與跨間平衡，並預先計算完工後的路面縱斷面與伸縮縫位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The replacement sequence therefore had to control symmetry and balance between spans, and the final road profile and joint positions had to be predicted in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若更換不對稱推進，單側或單跨減重過多，塔頂索鞍兩側張力差增大，塔身彎矩與伸縮縫偏位可能超限；未預先調整路面高程則完工後出現縱斷面不平順與排水問題。
knowledge.textEn: Asymmetric progress that lightens one side or span too much increases the tension difference across the saddles, possibly overstressing tower bending and shifting joints beyond limits; failing to plan road levels leaves an uneven profile and drainage problems after completion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「橋面更換減重後的主纜抬升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable rise after the lighter deck" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若更換不對稱推進，單側或單跨減重過多，塔頂索鞍兩側張力差增大，塔身彎矩與伸縮縫偏位可能超限；未預先調整路面高程則完工後出現縱斷面不平順與排水問題。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要整座橋在強風中穩定，欄杆的振動與聲音就不是工程問題。
optionsEn: Asymmetric progress that lightens one side or span too much increases the tension difference across the saddles, possibly overstressing tower bending and shifting joints beyond limits.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the whole bridge is stable in strong wind, railing vibration and noise are not engineering problems.
quiz.explanation: 若更換不對稱推進，單側或單跨減重過多，塔頂索鞍兩側張力差增大，塔身彎矩與伸縮縫偏位可能超限；未預先調整路面高程則完工後出現縱斷面不平順與排水問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Asymmetric progress that lightens one side or span too much increases the tension difference across the saddles, possibly overstressing tower bending and shifting joints beyond limits; failing to plan road levels leaves an uneven profile and drainage problems after completion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「抗風改造欄杆的風鳴試驗」與「索夾螺栓預力損失與再張拉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind-tunnel tests of the singing retrofit railing" and "Cable-band bolt preload loss and re-tensioning": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 抗風改造欄杆的風鳴試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel tests of the singing retrofit railing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「西側欄杆鋼條風鳴」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “West railing slat tones” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 為了讓金門大橋在持續 100 mph 的風中保持結構完整，並承擔新增防墜網帶來的風阻，抗風改造把兩塔之間的西側人行道欄杆換成較透風的細長直立鋼條，並在人行道下方的桁架加裝整流板。2020 年春天起，強風中出現明顯的鳴聲：風以某些角度穿過鋼條時，渦流脫落頻率與鋼條或條間空氣的自然振動吻合。業主公布兩種音調：西風垂直吹向欄杆且達 22 mph 以上時約 280 至 700 Hz，風以小角度吹來且達 27 mph 以上時約 1.1 kHz。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「西側欄杆鋼條風鳴」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: To keep the Golden Gate structurally sound in sustained winds up to 100 mph and to carry the extra wind resistance of the new deterrent net, the wind retrofit replaced the west sidewalk railing between the towers with thin vertical slats that let more air through, and added a wind fairing on the truss below the sidewalk. From spring 2020 a distinct tone was heard in strong wind: as wind passed through the slats at certain angles, the vortex-shedding frequency matched the natural vibration of the slats or of the air between them. The owner reports two tones: about 280 to 700 Hz with west wind perpendicular to the railing at 22 mph or more, and about 1.1 kHz with wind at a slight angle at 27 mph or more. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “West railing slat tones” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦流脫落 f = St·U/d。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vortex shedding f = St·U/d.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要整座橋在強風中穩定，欄杆的振動與聲音就不是工程問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the whole bridge is stable in strong wind, railing vibration and noise are not engineering problems." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「西側欄杆鋼條風鳴」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “West railing slat tones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 抗風改造欄杆的風鳴試驗
knowledge.titleEn: Wind-tunnel tests of the singing retrofit railing
knowledge.text: 為了讓金門大橋在持續 100 mph 的風中保持結構完整，並承擔新增防墜網帶來的風阻，抗風改造把兩塔之間的西側人行道欄杆換成較透風的細長直立鋼條，並在人行道下方的桁架加裝整流板。2020 年春天起，強風中出現明顯的鳴聲：風以某些角度穿過鋼條時，渦流脫落頻率與鋼條或條間空氣的自然振動吻合。
knowledge.textEn: To keep the Golden Gate structurally sound in sustained winds up to 100 mph and to carry the extra wind resistance of the new deterrent net, the wind retrofit replaced the west sidewalk railing between the towers with thin vertical slats that let more air through, and added a wind fairing on the truss below the sidewalk. From spring 2020 a distinct tone was heard in strong wind: as wind passed through the slats at certain angles, the vortex-shedding frequency matched the natural vibration of the slats or of the air between them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要整座橋在強風中穩定，欄杆的振動與聲音就不是工程問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the whole bridge is stable in strong wind, railing vibration and noise are not engineering problems. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「抗風改造欄杆的風鳴試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind-tunnel tests of the singing retrofit railing" is correct?
options: 只要整座橋在強風中穩定，欄杆的振動與聲音就不是工程問題。
為了讓金門大橋在持續 100 mph 的風中保持結構完整，並承擔新增防墜網帶來的風阻，抗風改造把兩塔之間的西側人行道欄杆換成較透風的細長直立鋼條，並在人行道下方的桁架加裝整流板。
螺栓一旦鎖到規定張力，就能永久保持。
optionsEn: If the whole bridge is stable in strong wind, railing vibration and noise are not engineering problems.

To keep the Golden Gate structurally sound in sustained winds up to 100 mph and to carry the extra wind resistance of the new deterrent net, the wind retrofit replaced the west sidewalk railing between the towers with thin vertical slats that let more air through, and added a wind fairing on the truss below the sidewalk.
Once bolts are tightened to the specified tension, they keep it forever.
quiz.explanation: 為了讓金門大橋在持續 100 mph 的風中保持結構完整，並承擔新增防墜網帶來的風阻，抗風改造把兩塔之間的西側人行道欄杆換成較透風的細長直立鋼條，並在人行道下方的桁架加裝整流板。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: To keep the Golden Gate structurally sound in sustained winds up to 100 mph and to carry the extra wind resistance of the new deterrent net, the wind retrofit replaced the west sidewalk railing between the towers with thin vertical slats that let more air through, and added a wind fairing on the truss below the sidewalk. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 抗風改造欄杆的風鳴試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel tests of the singing retrofit railing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「西側欄杆鋼條風鳴」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “West railing slat tones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦流脫落 f = St·U/d。U = 22 mph ≈ 9.8 m/s、f = 280 Hz、St = 0.2 時，對應特徵尺寸 d = St·U/f ≈ 0.2×9.8/280 ≈ 7.0 mm；27 mph（12.1 m/s）、1.1 kHz 則 d ≈ 2.2 mm，暗示高音調來自不同的流動特徵（例如邊緣或條間間隙）。St 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex shedding f = St·U/d. With U = 22 mph ≈ 9.8 m/s, f = 280 Hz and St = 0.2, the implied characteristic size is d = St·U/f ≈ 0.2×9.8/280 ≈ 7.0 mm; 27 mph (12.1 m/s) at 1.1 kHz gives d ≈ 2.2 mm, suggesting the higher tone comes from a different flow feature such as an edge or the gap between slats. St is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：業主自 2020 年秋以足尺欄杆模型做風洞試驗，比較橫桿、粗糙膠帶、U 形夾、紋理塗料與填頂等方案，最後以附薄橡膠墊的 U 形夾在 110 種風速與風向組合中消除或大幅降低聲音；剩餘情境預估每年平均約 70 小時與 18 小時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: From autumn 2020 the owner tested a full-scale railing model in a wind tunnel, comparing horizontal bars, coarse tape, U-shaped clips, textured paint and top fillers; U-shaped clips with a thin rubber insert eliminated or greatly reduced sound across 110 wind speed and direction combinations, with the remaining cases expected for about 70 and 18 hours a year on average.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 渦流脫落 f = St·U/d。U = 22 mph ≈ 9.8 m/s、f = 280 Hz、St = 0.2 時，對應特徵尺寸 d = St·U/f ≈ 0.2×9.8/280 ≈ 7.0 mm；27 mph（12.1 m/s）、1.1 kHz 則 d ≈ 2.2 mm，暗示高音調來自不同的流動特徵（例如邊緣或條間間隙）。St 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Vortex shedding f = St·U/d. With U = 22 mph ≈ 9.8 m/s, f = 280 Hz and St = 0.2, the implied characteristic size is d = St·U/f ≈ 0.2×9.8/280 ≈ 7.0 mm; 27 mph (12.1 m/s) at 1.1 kHz gives d ≈ 2.2 mm, suggesting the higher tone comes from a different flow feature such as an edge or the gap between slats. St is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「抗風改造欄杆的風鳴試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind-tunnel tests of the singing retrofit railing", which statement holds?
options: 防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。
懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。
渦流脫落 f = St·U/d。
optionsEn: The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability.
A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load.
Vortex shedding f = St·U/d.
quiz.explanation: 渦流脫落 f = St·U/d。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Vortex shedding f = St·U/d. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 抗風改造欄杆的風鳴試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel tests of the singing retrofit railing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「西側欄杆鋼條風鳴」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “West railing slat tones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 業主自 2020 年秋以足尺欄杆模型做風洞試驗，比較橫桿、粗糙膠帶、U 形夾、紋理塗料與填頂等方案，最後以附薄橡膠墊的 U 形夾在 110 種風速與風向組合中消除或大幅降低聲音；剩餘情境預估每年平均約 70 小時與 18 小時。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: From autumn 2020 the owner tested a full-scale railing model in a wind tunnel, comparing horizontal bars, coarse tape, U-shaped clips, textured paint and top fillers; U-shaped clips with a thin rubber insert eliminated or greatly reduced sound across 110 wind speed and direction combinations, with the remaining cases expected for about 70 and 18 hours a year on average. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改變橋面細部的工程，風洞試驗範圍應包含局部構件的渦振與聲學，並在合約中訂出可接受的聲音與振動準則；改善措施（例如 12,000 根鋼條的夾具）須有安裝品質抽查與維修計畫。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “West railing slat tones” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改造只檢核結構氣動穩定而未評估聲學與局部渦振，細長構件可能在常見風速下鳴響並承受高頻應力循環；高頻振動長期也可能使鋼條銲道或螺栓疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only global aerodynamic stability without assessing acoustics and local vortex shedding can leave slender parts singing at common wind speeds and seeing high-frequency stress cycles, which over time can fatigue slat welds or bolts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the whole bridge is stable in strong wind, railing vibration and noise are not engineering problems." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 索夾螺栓預力損失與再張拉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable-band bolt preload loss and re-tensioning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索夾螺栓預力」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cable-band bolt preload” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索夾靠螺栓夾緊主纜，以摩擦力抵抗吊索力沿主纜方向的下滑分量。業主資料記載，1953 至 1954 年增設下層橫向斜撐時發現索夾螺栓最多損失了規定張力的 50%，1954 年重新張拉，1970 年代再張拉至 90,000 lb；1999 年做過張力檢查，2000 至 2001 年把 256 根直徑 2⅛ in、長 3 ft 的繫固螺栓再張拉至 92,000 lb。預力流失的主因是主纜鋼絲在夾壓下逐漸重新排列與壓密、鍍鋅層潛變，以及溫度循環；螺栓伸長量只有零點幾毫米，因此很小的直徑變化就能吃掉大半預力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索夾螺栓預力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cable bands grip the main cable by bolt clamping, using friction to resist the component of suspender force acting down the cable slope. Owner data record that when the lower lateral bracing was added in 1953–1954, cable-band bolts were found to have lost as much as 50% of their specified tension; they were re-tensioned in 1954, again to 90,000 lb in the 1970s, checked in 1999, and in 2000–2001 the 256 tie-down bolts, each 2⅛ in in diameter and 3 ft long, were re-tensioned to 92,000 lb. Preload is lost mainly as cable wires rearrange and compact under clamping, as zinc creeps and through thermal cycles; bolt elongation is only fractions of a millimetre, so a tiny diameter change can consume most of the preload. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cable-band bolt preload” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：90,000 lb ≈ 400 kN，2⅛ in 螺栓毛面積 ≈ 2,288 mm²，應力 ≈ 175 N/mm²；夾緊長度取 0.6 m，彈性伸長 = 175×600/200,000 ≈ 0.52 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 90,000 lb ≈ 400 kN; a 2⅛ in bolt has a gross area ≈ 2,288 mm², a stress ≈ 175 N/mm²; with a 0.6 m grip the elastic elongation = 175×600/200,000 ≈ 0.52 mm, so just 0.26 mm of cable compaction under the band loses about 50% of preload.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓一旦鎖到規定張力，就能永久保持。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once bolts are tightened to the specified tension, they keep it forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索夾螺栓預力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cable-band bolt preload”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 索夾螺栓預力損失與再張拉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable-band bolt preload loss and re-tensioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索夾螺栓預力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cable-band bolt preload” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：90,000 lb ≈ 400 kN，2⅛ in 螺栓毛面積 ≈ 2,288 mm²，應力 ≈ 175 N/mm²；夾緊長度取 0.6 m，彈性伸長 = 175×600/200,000 ≈ 0.52 mm。只要主纜在索夾處壓密約 0.26 mm，預力即損失約 50%。3 ft 長、92,000 lb 的繫固螺栓伸長約 179×914/200,000 ≈ 0.82 mm。夾緊長度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 90,000 lb ≈ 400 kN; a 2⅛ in bolt has a gross area ≈ 2,288 mm², a stress ≈ 175 N/mm²; with a 0.6 m grip the elastic elongation = 175×600/200,000 ≈ 0.52 mm, so just 0.26 mm of cable compaction under the band loses about 50% of preload. A 3 ft tie-down bolt at 92,000 lb stretches about 179×914/200,000 ≈ 0.82 mm. The grip length is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以超音波量測螺栓伸長或以液壓張拉器做起始脫離（lift-off）試驗求現有預力，抽樣範圍涵蓋不同跨段與坡度；再張拉後記錄每根螺栓的目標值與實際值，數年後複測以求預力流失曲線，並檢查索夾是否有滑移痕跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure existing preload by ultrasonic bolt elongation or hydraulic lift-off tests on a sample covering different spans and slopes; after re-tensioning record target and achieved values for each bolt, re-test after some years to derive the preload-loss curve, and inspect bands for slip marks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cable-band bolt preload” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以超音波量測螺栓伸長或以液壓張拉器做起始脫離（lift-off）試驗求現有預力，抽樣範圍涵蓋不同跨段與坡度；再張拉後記錄每根螺栓的目標值與實際值，數年後複測以求預力流失曲線，並檢查索夾是否有滑移痕跡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure existing preload by ultrasonic bolt elongation or hydraulic lift-off tests on a sample covering different spans and slopes; after re-tensioning record target and achieved values for each bolt, re-test after some years to derive the preload-loss curve, and inspect bands for slip marks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索夾螺栓應列入定期抽測的檢查項目，訂出觸發全面再張拉的預力門檻；任何會增加吊索力或改變主纜壓密狀態的工程（加撐、換橋面、除濕包覆）完成後，都要安排一次螺栓預力複測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make cable-band bolts a periodic sampling item with a preload threshold that triggers full re-tensioning; after any work that raises suspender forces or changes cable compaction, such as bracing, deck replacement or dehumidification wrapping, schedule a preload re-check.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預力流失到摩擦力不足時，陡坡段的索夾會沿主纜下滑，吊索偏斜、索夾邊緣刮傷鋼絲並破壞防護包覆，水分隨之進入主纜；滑移也會改變吊索長度分配與橋面線形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 索夾螺栓預力損失與再張拉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable-band bolt preload loss and re-tensioning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索夾螺栓預力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cable-band bolt preload” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預力流失到摩擦力不足時，陡坡段的索夾會沿主纜下滑，吊索偏斜、索夾邊緣刮傷鋼絲並破壞防護包覆，水分隨之進入主纜；滑移也會改變吊索長度分配與橋面線形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: When preload falls until friction is inadequate, bands on steep cable slopes slide down, tilting suspenders, scoring wires at band edges and breaking the wrapping so water enters the cable; slip also redistributes suspender lengths and alters the deck profile. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預力流失的主因是主纜鋼絲在夾壓下逐漸重新排列與壓密、鍍鋅層潛變，以及溫度循環；螺栓伸長量只有零點幾毫米，因此很小的直徑變化就能吃掉大半預力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Preload is lost mainly as cable wires rearrange and compact under clamping, as zinc creeps and through thermal cycles; bolt elongation is only fractions of a millimetre, so a tiny diameter change can consume most of the preload.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺栓一旦鎖到規定張力，就能永久保持。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once bolts are tightened to the specified tension, they keep it forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
