stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「第 3B 期主橋耐震改造」與「防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge" and "Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 第 3B 期主橋耐震改造：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「38 組消能裝置」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “38 energy-dissipation devices” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震後的脆弱度研究指出，近距離 7.0 級以上地震可能造成嚴重損壞，8.0 級以上則可能使引橋與 Fort Point 拱段倒塌。改造以 10% 50 年超越機率（約 0.46 g）的中度地震與 1,000 年回歸期（約 0.65 g、相當於 1906 年舊金山地震）的最大可信地震為準則，分三期進行；第 2 期於 2008 年 7 月完成，消除了引橋倒塌風險。第 3B 期涵蓋主跨、兩邊跨、兩座橋塔與南塔基座：塔底以大型鋼板補強、塔內桁架補強、更換橋面與主塔及混凝土塔柱交接處的伸縮縫以容納三維位移、補強橋面橫向斜撐、改造 255 根橫梁，並安裝 38 組消能裝置，大幅減少傳入橋梁的地震能量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「38 組消能裝置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A vulnerability study after the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake found that a nearby magnitude 7.0 or larger event could cause severe damage, and one of 8.0 or larger could collapse the approach viaducts and Fort Point Arch. The retrofit uses a moderate earthquake with 10% exceedance in 50 years (about 0.46 g) and a maximum credible earthquake with a 1,000-year return period (about 0.65 g, equivalent to the 1906 San Francisco earthquake), in three phases; Phase 2, finished in July 2008, removed the approach collapse risk. Phase 3B covers the main span, both side spans, both towers and the South Tower pier: steel plates at the tower bases, strengthened tower trusses, new expansion joints at the towers and pylons for three-dimensional movement, reinforced roadway lateral bracing, 255 retrofitted floor beams and 38 energy-dissipation devices that greatly reduce seismic energy entering the bridge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “38 energy-dissipation devices” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「1989 年地震中金門大橋沒有損壞，代表它不需要耐震改造。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the bridge was undamaged in 1989, it does not need seismic retrofit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「38 組消能裝置」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “38 energy-dissipation devices”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 第 3B 期主橋耐震改造：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「38 組消能裝置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “38 energy-dissipation devices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。取 C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4、振幅 X = 0.5 m、週期 4 s（ω = 1.571 rad/s）：峰值速度 0.785 m/s，F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN；每循環耗能 E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α，λ ≈ 3.58，E ≈ 4,880 kJ。裝置型式與參數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α. With C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4, α = 0.4, amplitude X = 0.5 m and a 4 s period (ω = 1.571 rad/s): peak velocity 0.785 m/s and F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN; energy per cycle E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α with λ ≈ 3.58 gives E ≈ 4,880 kJ. Device type and parameters are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較；全橋以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層紀錄，檢查塔底應力、伸縮縫三維位移與橋面斜撐受力是否符合兩級地震的性能目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。取 C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4、振幅 X = 0.5 m、週期 4 s（ω = 1.571 rad/s）：峰值速度 0.785 m/s，F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN；每循環耗能 E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α，λ ≈ 3.58，E ≈ 4,880 kJ。裝置型式與參數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α. With C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4, α = 0.4, amplitude X = 0.5 m and a 4 s period (ω = 1.571 rad/s): peak velocity 0.785 m/s and F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN; energy per cycle E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α with λ ≈ 3.58 gives E ≈ 4,880 kJ. Device type and parameters are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「第 3B 期主橋耐震改造」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge", which statement holds?
options: 懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。
以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。
吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load.
Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α.
Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 第 3B 期主橋耐震改造：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「38 組消能裝置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “38 energy-dissipation devices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較；全橋以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層紀錄，檢查塔底應力、伸縮縫三維位移與橋面斜撐受力是否符合兩級地震的性能目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐震改造的分期順序應依構件勁度與倒塌後果排定（業主先做較不柔的橋塔與邊跨），每期完工都要更新全橋模型與性能矩陣；消能裝置需納入定期檢查與抽測計畫，並保存原型試驗曲線作為基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Sequence retrofit phases by stiffness and collapse consequence (the owner starts with the less flexible towers and side spans), updating the whole-bridge model and performance matrix at the end of each phase; put damping devices on a periodic inspection and sampling programme with prototype test curves kept as the baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels.

knowledge.text: 耐震改造的分期順序應依構件勁度與倒塌後果排定（業主先做較不柔的橋塔與邊跨），每期完工都要更新全橋模型與性能矩陣；消能裝置需納入定期檢查與抽測計畫，並保存原型試驗曲線作為基準。

quiz.question: 要驗證「第 3B 期主橋耐震改造」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。
消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry.
Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification.
quiz.explanation: 消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較；全橋以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層紀錄，檢查塔底應力、伸縮縫三維位移與橋面斜撐受力是否符合兩級地震的性能目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 第 3B 期主橋耐震改造：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「38 組消能裝置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “38 energy-dissipation devices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：第 3B 期涵蓋主跨、兩邊跨、兩座橋塔與南塔基座：塔底以大型鋼板補強、塔內桁架補強、更換橋面與主塔及混凝土塔柱交接處的伸縮縫以容納三維位移、補強橋面橫向斜撐、改造 255 根橫梁，並安裝 38 組消能裝置，大幅減少傳入橋梁的地震能量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Phase 3B covers the main span, both side spans, both towers and the South Tower pier: steel plates at the tower bases, strengthened tower trusses, new expansion joints at the towers and pylons for three-dimensional movement, reinforced roadway lateral bracing, 255 retrofitted floor beams and 38 energy-dissipation devices that greatly reduce seismic energy entering the bridge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「1989 年地震中金門大橋沒有損壞，代表它不需要耐震改造。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because the bridge was undamaged in 1989, it does not need seismic retrofit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。
knowledge.textEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「第 3B 期主橋耐震改造」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability.
quiz.explanation: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「防墜網與整流板」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deterrent net and wind fairing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 防墜系統在東西兩側人行道下方 20 ft 處裝設海洋級不鏽鋼網，向外伸出 20 ft，沿 1.7 mi 全長連續，2018 年動工、2024 年初完成。網片與支架改變了橋面邊緣的流場並增加風阻，因此必須搭配抗風改造：透風的西側欄杆與人行道下方整流板，確保橋梁在持續 100 mph 的風中仍保有結構完整與氣動穩定。這說明一座 1937 年的懸索橋，每次在斷面上加東西，都要重新回答「顫振、抖振、渦振與側向變位是否仍可接受」的問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「防墜網與整流板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deterrent system hangs marine-grade stainless-steel netting 20 ft below the sidewalks on both sides, extending 20 ft out and running continuously for the full 1.7 miles; it began in 2018 and was complete in early 2024. The netting and its supports change the flow at the deck edges and add wind resistance, so it had to be paired with the wind retrofit, the more porous west railing and a fairing below the sidewalk, to keep the bridge structurally sound and aerodynamically stable in sustained winds up to 100 mph. It shows that every addition to the section of a 1937 suspension bridge reopens the question of whether flutter, buffeting, vortex shedding and lateral deflection remain acceptable. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deterrent net and wind fairing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 mph（44.7 m/s）風壓 q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 100 mph (44.7 m/s) the wind pressure q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「防墜網與整流板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deterrent net and wind fairing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management

knowledge.text: 誤解：防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management" is correct?
options: 防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。
防墜系統在東西兩側人行道下方 20 ft 處裝設海洋級不鏽鋼網，向外伸出 20 ft，沿 1.7 mi 全長連續，2018 年動工、2024 年初完成。
塔頂荷重就等於主纜張力。
