knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三級風力準則與角隅修形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只拿 100 年強度風載設計構架而未檢核半年回歸期加速度，結構雖安全，常見颱風時高樓層使用者仍會明顯不適。
外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing the frame only for 100-year strength loads without checking half-year accelerations leaves a safe structure that still makes upper-floor occupants uncomfortable in common typhoons.
The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most.
quiz.explanation: 若只拿 100 年強度風載設計構架而未檢核半年回歸期加速度，結構雖安全，常見颱風時高樓層使用者仍會明顯不適；若角隅缺角在施工中為了帷幕牆單元化而被簡化，實際風力可能回到未修形的較高水準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing the frame only for 100-year strength loads without checking half-year accelerations leaves a safe structure that still makes upper-floor occupants uncomfortable in common typhoons; if the corner notches are simplified during construction to ease unitised cladding, actual wind forces can revert to the higher unnotched level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「八支巨柱的力偶」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eight-mega-column couple” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 周邊有八支巨柱（每面兩支），26 樓以下每面另有次巨柱與角柱經帶狀桁架加入；外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，依位置做成單層、雙層或三層高。核心筒受風彎曲時，外伸桁架像槓桿一樣把核心的轉角變成巨柱軸力：一側減壓、另一側增壓，形成力偶抵抗大部分傾覆彎矩。因為巨柱本身已承受很大的重力壓力，風或地震造成的軸力變化多半只是減少壓力，但柱續接仍須檢核少量的淨上拉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「八支巨柱的力偶」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101 has eight perimeter mega-columns, two per face; below level 26, sub-super columns and corner columns on each face are engaged through belt trusses. Outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep depending on location. When the core bends in wind, the outriggers act as levers that turn core rotation into mega-column axial force, unloading one side and adding compression to the other, so a couple resists most of the overturning moment. Because the mega-columns already carry heavy gravity compression, wind or seismic axial changes mostly reduce compression, yet column splices must still be checked for small net uplift. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Eight-mega-column couple” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「八支巨柱的力偶」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Eight-mega-column couple”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力
knowledge.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force
knowledge.text: 台北 101 周邊有八支巨柱（每面兩支），26 樓以下每面另有次巨柱與角柱經帶狀桁架加入；外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，依位置做成單層、雙層或三層高。核心筒受風彎曲時，外伸桁架像槓桿一樣把核心的轉角變成巨柱軸力：一側減壓、另一側增壓，形成力偶抵抗大部分傾覆彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Taipei 101 has eight perimeter mega-columns, two per face; below level 26, sub-super columns and corner columns on each face are engaged through belt trusses. Outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep depending on location.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force" is correct?
options: 外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。
鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。
台北 101 周邊有八支巨柱（每面兩支），26 樓以下每面另有次巨柱與角柱經帶狀桁架加入；外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，依位置做成單層、雙層或三層高。
optionsEn: The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most.
The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection.

quiz.explanation: 台北 101 周邊有八支巨柱（每面兩支），26 樓以下每面另有次巨柱與角柱經帶狀桁架加入；外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，依位置做成單層、雙層或三層高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Taipei 101 has eight perimeter mega-columns, two per face; below level 26, sub-super columns and corner columns on each face are engaged through belt trusses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「八支巨柱的力偶」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eight-mega-column couple” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。若外伸桁架交給巨柱的彎矩 M_col = 12 GN·m，受拉側與受壓側巨柱群形心距 a = 40 m、每側 n = 4 支，ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力若為 350 MN，風作用時兩側分別為 275 MN 與 425 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n). If the outriggers deliver M_col = 12 GN·m to the columns, with a = 40 m between tension-side and compression-side group centroids and n = 4 columns per side, ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load, the two sides carry 275 MN and 425 MN under wind. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。若外伸桁架交給巨柱的彎矩 M_col = 12 GN·m，受拉側與受壓側巨柱群形心距 a = 40 m、每側 n = 4 支，ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力若為 350 MN，風作用時兩側分別為 275 MN 與 425 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n). If the outriggers deliver M_col = 12 GN·m to the columns, with a = 40 m between tension-side and compression-side group centroids and n = 4 columns per side, ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load, the two sides carry 275 MN and 425 MN under wind. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force", which statement holds?
options: 巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。
只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。
自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。
optionsEn: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n).
Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored.
Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed.
quiz.explanation: 巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「八支巨柱的力偶」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eight-mega-column couple” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在設計書中列出每一道外伸桁架的樓層、深度、所連接的巨柱與分擔比例，柱續接處標明最大淨上拉的載重組合，並要求鋼構製造圖保留這些標記以便現場查核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List in the design report each outrigger's level, depth, connected mega-columns and share of overturning, mark the governing net-uplift load combination at column splices, and require shop drawings to carry these marks for site checking.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。
knowledge.textEn: Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在設計書中列出每一道外伸桁架的樓層、深度、所連接的巨柱與分擔比例，柱續接處標明最大淨上拉的載重組合，並要求鋼構製造圖保留這些標記以便現場查核。

quiz.question: 要驗證「外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較。
阻尼器擺幅創紀錄，就代表大樓結構出了問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model.
A record damper swing means something is wrong with the building structure.
quiz.explanation: 在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「八支巨柱的力偶」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eight-mega-column couple” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為巨柱本身已承受很大的重力壓力，風或地震造成的軸力變化多半只是減少壓力，但柱續接仍須檢核少量的淨上拉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the mega-columns already carry heavy gravity compression, wind or seismic axial changes mostly reduce compression, yet column splices must still be checked for small net uplift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。
knowledge.textEn: Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。
若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection.
Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending.
quiz.explanation: 若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量」與「高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite mega-column section and axial capacity" and "High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。鋼箱提供模板、圍束與抗拉能力，混凝土提供大部分軸壓勁度並阻止鋼板向內挫屈，兩者合作的效率高於各自單獨使用。斷面隨高度逐段縮小，填充高度也分段結束（核心箱形柱與巨柱填至約 62 層），每一段的合成比例不同，計算必須逐段進行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, welded into boxes from 50 to 80 mm plates and filled with high-strength concrete of about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) design strength, with internal ties preventing the plates from bulging. The steel box provides formwork, confinement and tension capacity, while the concrete supplies most of the axial stiffness and stops the plates buckling inwards, so together they outperform either material alone. The section shrinks with height and the fill stops at different levels (core box columns and super columns are filled to about level 62), so the composite proportions change and must be checked segment by segment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：名目擠壓強度 N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：名目擠壓強度 N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c。2.4 m × 3.0 m、板厚 80 mm：A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m²、A_s = 7.20 − 6.36 = 0.84 m²；f_y = 414 MPa、f_c = 69 MPa，N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 347 + 373 = 720 MN。若混凝土只有 41 MPa，N₀ 約 569 MN，下降約 21%。數值為教學假設，未計長細比與強度折減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c. For 2.4 m × 3.0 m with 80 mm plate: A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m² and A_s = 7.20 − 6.36 = 0.84 m²; with f_y = 414 MPa and f_c = 69 MPa, N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 347 + 373 = 720 MN. With only 41 MPa concrete N₀ is about 569 MN, roughly 21% less. Teaching assumptions, ignoring slenderness and resistance factors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a segment-by-segment mega-column schedule (outer size, plate thickness, fill start and end levels, concrete strength), cross-check composite-column formulas with finite-element section analysis, confirm the axial-load ratio under gravity plus wind or earthquake is within limits, and check that splice and diaphragm locations match the shop drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a segment-by-segment mega-column schedule (outer size, plate thickness, fill start and end levels, concrete strength), cross-check composite-column formulas with finite-element section analysis, confirm the axial-load ratio under gravity plus wind or earthquake is within limits, and check that splice and diaphragm locations match the shop drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：巨柱斷面表要同時出現在結構圖、鋼構製造圖與混凝土澆置計畫，每一段標明填充起訖樓層與強度；每次澆置前由監造確認隔板排氣孔與灌注孔位置，列為停止點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show the mega-column schedule on the structural drawings, steel shop drawings and concrete placement plan, marking fill start and end levels and strength for each segment; before every pour the resident engineer confirms diaphragm vent and filling holes as a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若圖面上的填充高度與實際澆置高度不符，未填充段只能靠鋼板單獨受力，容量可能比計算值少兩成以上；混凝土收縮在隔板下方留下空隙時，該處的圍束與傳力也會局部失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the drawn fill level differs from the actual pour, unfilled segments rely on the steel plates alone and can fall more than 20% below the calculated capacity; shrinkage voids under diaphragm plates also locally defeat confinement and load transfer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若圖面上的填充高度與實際澆置高度不符，未填充段只能靠鋼板單獨受力，容量可能比計算值少兩成以上；混凝土收縮在隔板下方留下空隙時，該處的圍束與傳力也會局部失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the drawn fill level differs from the actual pour, unfilled segments rely on the steel plates alone and can fall more than 20% below the calculated capacity; shrinkage voids under diaphragm plates also locally defeat confinement and load transfer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斷面隨高度逐段縮小，填充高度也分段結束（核心箱形柱與巨柱填至約 62 層），每一段的合成比例不同，計算必須逐段進行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The section shrinks with height and the fill stops at different levels (core box columns and super columns are filled to about level 62), so the composite proportions change and must be checked segment by segment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Composite mega-column section and axial capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若圖面上的填充高度與實際澆置高度不符，未填充段只能靠鋼板單獨受力，容量可能比計算值少兩成以上；混凝土收縮在隔板下方留下空隙時，該處的圍束與傳力也會局部失效。

鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。

steps.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SM570M thick plates and column splices” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的主要鋼構使用 SM570M 等級鋼材，降伏強度約 60 ksi 以上，板厚可達 80 mm。厚板焊接時冷卻快、拘束大，容易產生氫致裂紋與層狀撕裂，因此規格同時限制碳當量（板厚 40 mm 以下約 0.44%、40 mm 以上約 0.47%）與降伏比（較厚的梁與斜撐約 80%、較薄者約 85%），確保焊接性與塑性變形能力。柱續接採全滲透焊，以抵抗風與地震下可能出現的少量淨上拉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's main steelwork uses SM570M steel with a yield strength of about 60 ksi or more and plates up to 80 mm thick. Thick plates cool quickly and are highly restrained during welding, inviting hydrogen cracking and lamellar tearing, so the specification limited both the carbon equivalent (about 0.44% for plates under 40 mm and about 0.47% for 40 mm and thicker) and the yield ratio (about 80% for thicker girders and braces, about 85% for thinner ones) to secure weldability and plastic deformation capacity. Column splices are full-penetration welds to resist the small net uplift that wind and earthquakes can produce. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “SM570M thick plates and column splices” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：碳當量 Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “SM570M thick plates and column splices”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SM570M thick plates and column splices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：碳當量 Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。取 C 0.16、Mn 1.45、Cr 0.02、Mo 0、V 0.04、Ni 0.02、Cu 0.02，Ceq = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.012 + 0.003 ≈ 0.42%，低於 0.47% 上限；降伏比 440/600 ≈ 0.73，低於 0.80。數值為教學假設，不是實際鋼廠成分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.45, Cr 0.02, Mo 0, V 0.04, Ni 0.02 and Cu 0.02, Ceq = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.012 + 0.003 ≈ 0.42%, below the 0.47% limit; the yield ratio 440/600 ≈ 0.73 is below 0.80. Teaching assumptions, not actual mill chemistry. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一爐號的鋼材證明書都要核對化學成分、降伏比與板厚方向性能（Z 向斷面收縮率），焊接程序以實際板厚做資格檢定；施焊時記錄預熱與層間溫度，完成後以超音波檢測全滲透焊並依規範判定合格與否。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check every heat's mill certificate for chemistry, yield ratio and through-thickness (Z-direction reduction of area) properties, qualify welding procedures on the actual plate thickness, record preheat and interpass temperatures during welding, and ultrasonically test every full-penetration weld against the code acceptance criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.45, Cr 0.02, Mo 0, V 0.04, Ni 0.02 and Cu 0.02, Ceq = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.012 + 0.003 ≈ 0.42%, below the 0.47% limit; the yield ratio 440/600 ≈ 0.73 is below 0.80. Teaching assumptions, not actual mill chemistry.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding", which statement holds?
options: 自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。
阻尼器擺幅創紀錄，就代表大樓結構出了問題。

optionsEn: Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed.
A record damper swing means something is wrong with the building structure.
Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15.
quiz.explanation: 碳當量 Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “SM570M thick plates and column splices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一爐號的鋼材證明書都要核對化學成分、降伏比與板厚方向性能（Z 向斷面收縮率），焊接程序以實際板厚做資格檢定；施焊時記錄預熱與層間溫度，完成後以超音波檢測全滲透焊並依規範判定合格與否。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check every heat's mill certificate for chemistry, yield ratio and through-thickness (Z-direction reduction of area) properties, qualify welding procedures on the actual plate thickness, record preheat and interpass temperatures during welding, and ultrasonically test every full-penetration weld against the code acceptance criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對厚板全滲透焊設定「冷卻 48 小時後才做超音波檢測」的停止點，保留每道焊道的焊工代號、預熱紀錄與檢測報告；任何補焊都要重新檢測，並經設計單位同意後才可覆蓋。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set a hold point of ultrasonic testing no earlier than 48 hours after cooling for thick full-penetration welds, keep the welder ID, preheat record and test report for each weld, and re-test every repair weld, covering it only after the designer approves.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對厚板全滲透焊設定「冷卻 48 小時後才做超音波檢測」的停止點，保留每道焊道的焊工代號、預熱紀錄與檢測報告；任何補焊都要重新檢測，並經設計單位同意後才可覆蓋。

quiz.question: 要驗證「高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding"?

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads.

steps.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “SM570M thick plates and column splices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：柱續接採全滲透焊，以抵抗風與地震下可能出現的少量淨上拉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Column splices are full-penetration welds to resist the small net uplift that wind and earthquakes can produce.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。
knowledge.textEn: Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。
只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection.
Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading. stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基」與「331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin" and "The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 基地上方約 30 m 為湖積粉土質黏土（上部約 20 m 很軟），其下為崩積層，岩盤（桂竹林層）約在地表下 40 至 65 m，頂部約 10 m 膠結不良。塔樓下設 380 支直徑 1.5 m、中心距約 3.96 m 的反循環鑽掘基樁，嵌入岩盤 15 至 33 m，上方為厚 3.0 至 4.7 m 的筏基，配合約 22 m 深的五層地下室開挖。基樁主要靠岩盤段的側摩擦承載，筏基則把巨柱與核心的集中力分配到整個樁群。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the Taipei 101 site the top 30 m or so is lacustrine silty clay, the upper 20 m very soft, over colluvium, with bedrock of the Kueichulin Formation at about 40 to 65 m below ground and a poorly cemented top 10 m. Under the tower, 380 reverse-circulation bored piles of 1.5 m diameter at about 3.96 m centres are socketed 15 to 33 m into rock, capped by a raft 3.0 to 4.7 m thick within an excavation about 22 m deep for the five-level basement. The piles carry load mainly by side friction in the rock socket, while the raft spreads the concentrated mega-column and core loads across the whole group. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin" is correct?
options: 只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。
塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。
