Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes.

At the Taipei 101 site the top 30 m or so is lacustrine silty clay, the upper 20 m very soft, over colluvium, with bedrock of the Kueichulin Formation at about 40 to 65 m below ground and a poorly cemented top 10 m.
quiz.explanation: 台北 101 基地上方約 30 m 為湖積粉土質黏土（上部約 20 m 很軟），其下為崩積層，岩盤（桂竹林層）約在地表下 40 至 65 m，頂部約 10 m 膠結不良。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At the Taipei 101 site the top 30 m or so is lacustrine silty clay, the upper 20 m very soft, over colluvium, with bedrock of the Kueichulin Formation at about 40 to 65 m below ground and a poorly cemented top 10 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。取 D = 1.5 m、嵌入長 L = 20 m、單位側摩擦 f_s = 0.30 MPa，Q = π×1.5×20×0.30 ≈ 28.3 MN，安全係數 2 時容許約 14.1 MN。樁距 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 倍樁徑，群樁效應會增加沉陷。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 1.5 m, socket length L = 20 m and unit side friction f_s = 0.30 MPa, Q = π×1.5×20×0.30 ≈ 28.3 MN, about 14.1 MN allowable with a factor of safety of 2. The spacing of 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 diameters means group effects increase settlement. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試驗樁做靜載試驗：公開論文記載壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN，並在塔樓區做生產樁驗證試驗；以應變計分段量測側摩擦、回推 t–z 曲線，再與群樁沉陷分析比較（計算長期最大沉陷約 65 mm，施工期間量得塔中心沉陷小於約 20 mm）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load-test trial piles statically; the published paper records compression tests up to about 40.6 MN and pull-out tests up to about 22 MN, plus proof tests on production piles in the tower area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。取 D = 1.5 m、嵌入長 L = 20 m、單位側摩擦 f_s = 0.30 MPa，Q = π×1.5×20×0.30 ≈ 28.3 MN，安全係數 2 時容許約 14.1 MN。樁距 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 倍樁徑，群樁效應會增加沉陷。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 1.5 m, socket length L = 20 m and unit side friction f_s = 0.30 MPa, Q = π×1.5×20×0.30 ≈ 28.3 MN, about 14.1 MN allowable with a factor of safety of 2. The spacing of 3.96/1.5 ≈ 2.6 diameters means group effects increase settlement. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin", which statement holds?
options: 岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。
雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。
帷幕牆只是外觀，不需要配合結構的變位來設計。
optionsEn: Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s.
In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone.
A curtain wall is cosmetic and need not be designed for structural movement.
quiz.explanation: 岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試驗樁做靜載試驗：公開論文記載壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN，並在塔樓區做生產樁驗證試驗；以應變計分段量測側摩擦、回推 t–z 曲線，再與群樁沉陷分析比較（計算長期最大沉陷約 65 mm，施工期間量得塔中心沉陷小於約 20 mm）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Load-test trial piles statically; the published paper records compression tests up to about 40.6 MN and pull-out tests up to about 22 MN, plus proof tests on production piles in the tower area. Measure side friction segment by segment with strain gauges, back-calculate t–z curves and compare with group-settlement analysis, which predicted about 65 mm long-term maximum while under about 20 mm was measured at the tower centre during construction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每支樁記錄鑽掘深度、入岩長度、孔底清理與穩定液性質，澆置前以測深與超音波檢查孔形；開挖期間同步監測鄰房與地下水位，任何異常即暫停開挖，由大地工程顧問判斷後才可續作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record drilled depth, socket length, base cleaning and drilling-fluid properties for each pile, sound and ultrasonically profile the hole before concreting, and monitor neighbouring buildings and groundwater during excavation, stopping work on any anomaly until the geotechnical consultant decides.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反循環鑽掘時若孔壁在軟黏土段坍落或孔底沉泥未清除，岩盤段的側摩擦與端承都會大幅下降；樁群中少數樁偏軟會讓筏基不均勻沉陷，使高聳結構傾斜，並在巨柱與核心之間產生附加內力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the borehole wall collapses in the soft clay or bottom slime is not cleaned during reverse-circulation drilling, socket friction and end bearing drop sharply; a few soft piles in the group cause uneven raft settlement, tilting the tall structure and inducing extra forces between mega-columns and core. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試驗樁做靜載試驗：公開論文記載壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN，並在塔樓區做生產樁驗證試驗；以應變計分段量測側摩擦、回推 t–z 曲線，再與群樁沉陷分析比較（計算長期最大沉陷約 65 mm，施工期間量得塔中心沉陷小於約 20 mm）。
knowledge.textEn: Load-test trial piles statically; the published paper records compression tests up to about 40.6 MN and pull-out tests up to about 22 MN, plus proof tests on production piles in the tower area. Measure side friction segment by segment with strain gauges, back-calculate t–z curves and compare with group-settlement analysis, which predicted about 65 mm long-term maximum while under about 20 mm was measured at the tower centre during construction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每支樁記錄鑽掘深度、入岩長度、孔底清理與穩定液性質，澆置前以測深與超音波檢查孔形；開挖期間同步監測鄰房與地下水位，任何異常即暫停開挖，由大地工程顧問判斷後才可續作。
knowledge.textEn: Record drilled depth, socket length, base cleaning and drilling-fluid properties for each pile, sound and ultrasonically profile the hole before concreting, and monitor neighbouring buildings and groundwater during excavation, stopping work on any anomaly until the geotechnical consultant decides.

quiz.question: 要驗證「台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以試驗樁做靜載試驗：公開論文記載壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN，並在塔樓區做生產樁驗證試驗。
外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Load-test trial piles statically.
The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most.
quiz.explanation: 以試驗樁做靜載試驗：公開論文記載壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN，並在塔樓區做生產樁驗證試驗；以應變計分段量測側摩擦、回推 t–z 曲線，再與群樁沉陷分析比較（計算長期最大沉陷約 65 mm，施工期間量得塔中心沉陷小於約 20 mm）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Load-test trial piles statically; the published paper records compression tests up to about 40.6 MN and pull-out tests up to about 22 MN, plus proof tests on production piles in the tower area. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反循環鑽掘時若孔壁在軟黏土段坍落或孔底沉泥未清除，岩盤段的側摩擦與端承都會大幅下降；樁群中少數樁偏軟會讓筏基不均勻沉陷，使高聳結構傾斜，並在巨柱與核心之間產生附加內力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the borehole wall collapses in the soft clay or bottom slime is not cleaned during reverse-circulation drilling, socket friction and end bearing drop sharply; a few soft piles in the group cause uneven raft settlement, tilting the tall structure and inducing extra forces between mega-columns and core. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：基樁主要靠岩盤段的側摩擦承載，筏基則把巨柱與核心的集中力分配到整個樁群。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The piles carry load mainly by side friction in the rock socket, while the raft spreads the concentrated mega-column and core loads across the whole group.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反循環鑽掘時若孔壁在軟黏土段坍落或孔底沉泥未清除，岩盤段的側摩擦與端承都會大幅下降；樁群中少數樁偏軟會讓筏基不均勻沉陷，使高聳結構傾斜，並在巨柱與核心之間產生附加內力。
knowledge.textEn: If the borehole wall collapses in the soft clay or bottom slime is not cleaned during reverse-circulation drilling, socket friction and end bearing drop sharply; a few soft piles in the group cause uneven raft settlement, tilting the tall structure and inducing extra forces between mega-columns and core.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。
反循環鑽掘時若孔壁在軟黏土段坍落或孔底沉泥未清除，岩盤段的側摩擦與端承都會大幅下降。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes.
If the borehole wall collapses in the soft clay or bottom slime is not cleaned during reverse-circulation drilling, socket friction and end bearing drop sharply.
quiz.explanation: 反循環鑽掘時若孔壁在軟黏土段坍落或孔底沉泥未清除，岩盤段的側摩擦與端承都會大幅下降；樁群中少數樁偏軟會讓筏基不均勻沉陷，使高聳結構傾斜，並在巨柱與核心之間產生附加內力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the borehole wall collapses in the soft clay or bottom slime is not cleaned during reverse-circulation drilling, socket friction and end bearing drop sharply; a few soft piles in the group cause uneven raft settlement, tilting the tall structure and inducing extra forces between mega-columns and core. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「爬升式塔吊支承點」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Climbing tower-crane supports” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 2002 年 3 月 31 日花蓮外海規模 6.8 地震時，施工中的台北 101 有兩部位於 56 樓的塔吊被震落，造成五人死亡。當時鋼構約施工到 53 至 56 樓、樓板混凝土約到 34 樓、柱內填充約到 32 樓，塔吊支承在 47 與 51 樓；未完成的結構缺少樓板隔膜與填充混凝土，比完工狀態更柔、更不均勻，高處又會放大地表加速度。塔吊及其支承與繫結屬於臨時工程，卻同樣需要以地震力檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「爬升式塔吊支承點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In the magnitude 6.8 earthquake off Hualien on 31 March 2002, two tower cranes at level 56 of the unfinished Taipei 101 were shaken loose, killing five people. Steel was then erected to about levels 53 to 56, slab concrete to about level 34 and column infill to about level 32, with crane supports at levels 47 and 51; the incomplete frame lacked floor diaphragms and infill, so it was more flexible and less regular than the finished building, and height amplified the ground acceleration. Cranes, their supports and ties are temporary works, yet they must be checked for seismic forces just like the permanent structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Climbing tower-crane supports” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：附近測站東西向尖峰約 193 gal，即 0.197 g；若施工中高樓層放大 2.5 倍，塔吊處約 0.49 g。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A nearby station recorded about 193 gal east–west, or 0.197 g; with 2.5 times amplification at the upper construction levels the crane sees about 0.49 g.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「爬升式塔吊支承點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Climbing tower-crane supports”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震
knowledge.titleEn: The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works
knowledge.text: 2002 年 3 月 31 日花蓮外海規模 6.8 地震時，施工中的台北 101 有兩部位於 56 樓的塔吊被震落，造成五人死亡。當時鋼構約施工到 53 至 56 樓、樓板混凝土約到 34 樓、柱內填充約到 32 樓，塔吊支承在 47 與 51 樓；未完成的結構缺少樓板隔膜與填充混凝土，比完工狀態更柔、更不均勻，高處又會放大地表加速度。
knowledge.textEn: In the magnitude 6.8 earthquake off Hualien on 31 March 2002, two tower cranes at level 56 of the unfinished Taipei 101 were shaken loose, killing five people. Steel was then erected to about levels 53 to 56, slab concrete to about level 34 and column infill to about level 32, with crane supports at levels 47 and 51; the incomplete frame lacked floor diaphragms and infill, so it was more flexible and less regular than the finished building, and height amplified the ground acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works" is correct?
options: 2002 年 3 月 31 日花蓮外海規模 6.8 地震時，施工中的台北 101 有兩部位於 56 樓的塔吊被震落，造成五人死亡。
塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。
自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。
optionsEn: In the magnitude 6.8 earthquake off Hualien on 31 March 2002, two tower cranes at level 56 of the unfinished Taipei 101 were shaken loose, killing five people.
Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes.
Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed.
quiz.explanation: 2002 年 3 月 31 日花蓮外海規模 6.8 地震時，施工中的台北 101 有兩部位於 56 樓的塔吊被震落，造成五人死亡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In the magnitude 6.8 earthquake off Hualien on 31 March 2002, two tower cranes at level 56 of the unfinished Taipei 101 were shaken loose, killing five people. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「爬升式塔吊支承點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Climbing tower-crane supports” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：附近測站東西向尖峰約 193 gal，即 0.197 g；若施工中高樓層放大 2.5 倍，塔吊處約 0.49 g。塔吊質量 120 t 時水平慣性力 F = m·a = 120,000×0.49×9.81 ≈ 579 kN，作用於支承上方 20 m 時彎矩約 11,580 kN·m，支承間距 4 m 時繫結力約 2,895 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A nearby station recorded about 193 gal east–west, or 0.197 g; with 2.5 times amplification at the upper construction levels the crane sees about 0.49 g. For a 120 t crane the horizontal inertia force is F = m·a = 120,000×0.49×9.81 ≈ 579 kN; acting 20 m above the supports it gives about 11,580 kN·m, or a tie force of about 2,895 kN for supports 4 m apart. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：塔吊基座、爬升框與繫結要以施工階段結構模型分析，輸入當地設計地震與颱風風速，並檢查支承樓層在該階段的實際強度（混凝土是否已澆置、構件是否已鎖固）；地震後由專業技師檢查繫結螺栓、焊道與爬升楔塊，確認無損後才可恢復吊裝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse crane bases, climbing frames and ties with a construction-stage model using the local design earthquake and typhoon wind, checking the supporting floors at their actual stage of completion (concrete placed or not, members fully connected or not); after any earthquake, have a professional engineer inspect tie bolts, welds and climbing wedges and confirm no damage before lifting resumes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 附近測站東西向尖峰約 193 gal，即 0.197 g；若施工中高樓層放大 2.5 倍，塔吊處約 0.49 g。塔吊質量 120 t 時水平慣性力 F = m·a = 120,000×0.49×9.81 ≈ 579 kN，作用於支承上方 20 m 時彎矩約 11,580 kN·m，支承間距 4 m 時繫結力約 2,895 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A nearby station recorded about 193 gal east–west, or 0.197 g; with 2.5 times amplification at the upper construction levels the crane sees about 0.49 g. For a 120 t crane the horizontal inertia force is F = m·a = 120,000×0.49×9.81 ≈ 579 kN; acting 20 m above the supports it gives about 11,580 kN·m, or a tie force of about 2,895 kN for supports 4 m apart. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器擺幅創紀錄，就代表大樓結構出了問題。
附近測站東西向尖峰約 193 gal，即 0.197 g；若施工中高樓層放大 2.5 倍，塔吊處約 0.49 g。
角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。
optionsEn: A record damper swing means something is wrong with the building structure.
A nearby station recorded about 193 gal east–west, or 0.197 g; with 2.5 times amplification at the upper construction levels the crane sees about 0.49 g.
Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads.
quiz.explanation: 附近測站東西向尖峰約 193 gal，即 0.197 g；若施工中高樓層放大 2.5 倍，塔吊處約 0.49 g。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A nearby station recorded about 193 gal east–west, or 0.197 g; with 2.5 times amplification at the upper construction levels the crane sees about 0.49 g. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「爬升式塔吊支承點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Climbing tower-crane supports” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 塔吊基座、爬升框與繫結要以施工階段結構模型分析，輸入當地設計地震與颱風風速，並檢查支承樓層在該階段的實際強度（混凝土是否已澆置、構件是否已鎖固）；地震後由專業技師檢查繫結螺栓、焊道與爬升楔塊，確認無損後才可恢復吊裝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse crane bases, climbing frames and ties with a construction-stage model using the local design earthquake and typhoon wind, checking the supporting floors at their actual stage of completion (concrete placed or not, members fully connected or not); after any earthquake, have a professional engineer inspect tie bolts, welds and climbing wedges and confirm no damage before lifting resumes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塔吊的地震與颱風作業限制、強制停機與吊臂放鬆迴轉程序要寫入施工計畫；每次爬升前後各設停止點，由結構設計者確認支承樓層的施工階段強度並簽認，未簽認不得爬升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write the earthquake and typhoon operating limits, mandatory shutdown and free-slew procedures for cranes into the construction plan; set hold points before and after each climb at which the structural designer confirms and signs off the stage strength of the supporting floors, with no climbing until signed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：公開資料指出，事故後檢方調查是否有疏失，工程停工約三個月並依委員會建議復工。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Public records state that prosecutors investigated possible negligence and that work stopped for about three months before resuming on a committee's recommendation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 塔吊基座、爬升框與繫結要以施工階段結構模型分析，輸入當地設計地震與颱風風速，並檢查支承樓層在該階段的實際強度（混凝土是否已澆置、構件是否已鎖固）；地震後由專業技師檢查繫結螺栓、焊道與爬升楔塊，確認無損後才可恢復吊裝。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse crane bases, climbing frames and ties with a construction-stage model using the local design earthquake and typhoon wind, checking the supporting floors at their actual stage of completion (concrete placed or not, members fully connected or not); after any earthquake, have a professional engineer inspect tie bolts, welds and climbing wedges and confirm no damage before lifting resumes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 塔吊的地震與颱風作業限制、強制停機與吊臂放鬆迴轉程序要寫入施工計畫；每次爬升前後各設停止點，由結構設計者確認支承樓層的施工階段強度並簽認，未簽認不得爬升。
knowledge.textEn: Write the earthquake and typhoon operating limits, mandatory shutdown and free-slew procedures for cranes into the construction plan; set hold points before and after each climb at which the structural designer confirms and signs off the stage strength of the supporting floors, with no climbing until signed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。
塔吊基座、爬升框與繫結要以施工階段結構模型分析，輸入當地設計地震與颱風風速，並檢查支承樓層在該階段的實際強度（混凝土是否已澆置、構件是否已鎖固）。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection.

Analyse crane bases, climbing frames and ties with a construction-stage model using the local design earthquake and typhoon wind, checking the supporting floors at their actual stage of completion (concrete placed or not, members fully connected or not).
quiz.explanation: 塔吊基座、爬升框與繫結要以施工階段結構模型分析，輸入當地設計地震與颱風風速，並檢查支承樓層在該階段的實際強度（混凝土是否已澆置、構件是否已鎖固）；地震後由專業技師檢查繫結螺栓、焊道與爬升楔塊，確認無損後才可恢復吊裝。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse crane bases, climbing frames and ties with a construction-stage model using the local design earthquake and typhoon wind, checking the supporting floors at their actual stage of completion (concrete placed or not, members fully connected or not); after any earthquake, have a professional engineer inspect tie bolts, welds and climbing wedges and confirm no damage before lifting resumes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「爬升式塔吊支承點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Climbing tower-crane supports” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出，事故後檢方調查是否有疏失，工程停工約三個月並依委員會建議復工。一般而言，塔吊繫結與爬升支承若只按吊重與風力設計，強震時可能在支承點或塔身斷面先破壞，墜落物又會撞擊下方樓板與人員。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Public records state that prosecutors investigated possible negligence and that work stopped for about three months before resuming on a committee's recommendation. In general, crane ties and climbing supports designed only for lifted load and wind can fail first at supports or tower sections in a strong earthquake, and falling parts then strike the floors and people below. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塔吊及其支承與繫結屬於臨時工程，卻同樣需要以地震力檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cranes, their supports and ties are temporary works, yet they must be checked for seismic forces just like the permanent structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出，事故後檢方調查是否有疏失，工程停工約三個月並依委員會建議復工。一般而言，塔吊繫結與爬升支承若只按吊重與風力設計，強震時可能在支承點或塔身斷面先破壞，墜落物又會撞擊下方樓板與人員。
knowledge.textEn: Public records state that prosecutors investigated possible negligence and that work stopped for about three months before resuming on a committee's recommendation. In general, crane ties and climbing supports designed only for lifted load and wind can fail first at supports or tower sections in a strong earthquake, and falling parts then strike the floors and people below.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 公開資料指出，事故後檢方調查是否有疏失，工程停工約三個月並依委員會建議復工。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。
optionsEn: Public records state that prosecutors investigated possible negligence and that work stopped for about three months before resuming on a committee's recommendation.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出，事故後檢方調查是否有疏失，工程停工約三個月並依委員會建議復工。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Public records state that prosecutors investigated possible negligence and that work stopped for about three months before resuming on a committee's recommendation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」與「兩級地震性能與非線性驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance" and "Two-level seismic performance and nonlinear checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隔板下方空隙檢測」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Voids under diaphragm plates” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 箱形巨柱內有水平隔板與繫材，混凝土必須流過狹窄孔口填滿每個角落，又無法振動搗實，因此採用高流動、自充填的配比。台北 101 的規格要求 90 天設計強度 10,000 psi、坍度約 250 ± 20 mm、坍流度約 600 ± 20 mm，隔板下方空隙不超過面積的 5%，並限制 90 天自體收縮約 300 × 10⁻⁶。隔板下的空隙最難避免，因為氣泡與泌水會集中在板底。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔板下方空隙檢測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A box mega-column contains horizontal diaphragms and ties, so concrete must flow through narrow openings to fill every corner without vibration, which calls for a highly fluid self-consolidating mix. Taipei 101's specification called for 10,000 psi design strength at 90 days, slump about 250 ± 20 mm, slump flow about 600 ± 20 mm, voids under diaphragm plates of no more than 5% of the area, and autogenous shrinkage limited to about 300 × 10⁻⁶ at 90 days. Voids under diaphragms are the hardest to avoid because air bubbles and bleed water collect beneath the plate. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Voids under diaphragm plates” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：隔板下淨面積 A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²，若檢測到空隙 0.25 m²，比例 = 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%，低於 5% 上限；自體收縮 300 × 10⁻⁶ 在 4.2 m 樓高內造成約 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm 的縮短，足以在板底拉開一道縫。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The net area under a diaphragm is A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²; a detected void of 0.25 m² gives 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%, below the 5% limit.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隔板下方空隙檢測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Voids under diaphragm plates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance
knowledge.text: 箱形巨柱內有水平隔板與繫材，混凝土必須流過狹窄孔口填滿每個角落，又無法振動搗實，因此採用高流動、自充填的配比。台北 101 的規格要求 90 天設計強度 10,000 psi、坍度約 250 ± 20 mm、坍流度約 600 ± 20 mm，隔板下方空隙不超過面積的 5%，並限制 90 天自體收縮約 300 × 10⁻⁶。
knowledge.textEn: A box mega-column contains horizontal diaphragms and ties, so concrete must flow through narrow openings to fill every corner without vibration, which calls for a highly fluid self-consolidating mix. Taipei 101's specification called for 10,000 psi design strength at 90 days, slump about 250 ± 20 mm, slump flow about 600 ± 20 mm, voids under diaphragm plates of no more than 5% of the area, and autogenous shrinkage limited to about 300 × 10⁻⁶ at 90 days.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance" is correct?
options: 自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。
箱形巨柱內有水平隔板與繫材，混凝土必須流過狹窄孔口填滿每個角落，又無法振動搗實，因此採用高流動、自充填的配比。
雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。
optionsEn: Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed.
A box mega-column contains horizontal diaphragms and ties, so concrete must flow through narrow openings to fill every corner without vibration, which calls for a highly fluid self-consolidating mix.
In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone.
quiz.explanation: 箱形巨柱內有水平隔板與繫材，混凝土必須流過狹窄孔口填滿每個角落，又無法振動搗實，因此採用高流動、自充填的配比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A box mega-column contains horizontal diaphragms and ties, so concrete must flow through narrow openings to fill every corner without vibration, which calls for a highly fluid self-consolidating mix. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔板下方空隙檢測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Voids under diaphragm plates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：隔板下淨面積 A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²，若檢測到空隙 0.25 m²，比例 = 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%，低於 5% 上限；自體收縮 300 × 10⁻⁶ 在 4.2 m 樓高內造成約 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm 的縮短，足以在板底拉開一道縫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The net area under a diaphragm is A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²; a detected void of 0.25 m² gives 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%, below the 5% limit. Autogenous shrinkage of 300 × 10⁻⁶ over a 4.2 m storey shortens the fill by about 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm, enough to open a gap under a plate. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以足尺模型柱試灌，硬化後切開量測隔板下空隙並調整配比與排氣孔；正式施工時以敲擊或超音波檢查隔板附近是否空洞，記錄每一車的坍流度與溫度並取圓柱試體，空隙超標處鑽孔注漿補強並重新檢測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: First cast a full-scale mock-up column and cut it open after hardening to measure voids under diaphragms, adjusting the mix and vent holes; during production check around diaphragms by tapping or ultrasonic testing, record slump flow and temperature of every truck with cylinders taken, and drill, grout and re-test wherever voids exceed the limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 隔板下淨面積 A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²，若檢測到空隙 0.25 m²，比例 = 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%，低於 5% 上限；自體收縮 300 × 10⁻⁶ 在 4.2 m 樓高內造成約 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm 的縮短，足以在板底拉開一道縫。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The net area under a diaphragm is A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²; a detected void of 0.25 m² gives 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%, below the 5% limit. Autogenous shrinkage of 300 × 10⁻⁶ over a 4.2 m storey shortens the fill by about 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm, enough to open a gap under a plate. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 帷幕牆只是外觀，不需要配合結構的變位來設計。
外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。
optionsEn: A curtain wall is cosmetic and need not be designed for structural movement.
The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most.
The net area under a diaphragm is A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²; a detected void of 0.25 m² gives 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%, below the 5% limit.
quiz.explanation: 隔板下淨面積 A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²，若檢測到空隙 0.25 m²，比例 = 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%，低於 5% 上限；自體收縮 300 × 10⁻⁶ 在 4.2 m 樓高內造成約 300×10⁻⁶×4,200 ≈ 1.3 mm 的縮短，足以在板底拉開一道縫。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The net area under a diaphragm is A_d = 2.24×2.84 ≈ 6.36 m²; a detected void of 0.25 m² gives 0.25/6.36 ≈ 3.9%, below the 5% limit. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔板下方空隙檢測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Voids under diaphragm plates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先以足尺模型柱試灌，硬化後切開量測隔板下空隙並調整配比與排氣孔；正式施工時以敲擊或超音波檢查隔板附近是否空洞，記錄每一車的坍流度與溫度並取圓柱試體，空隙超標處鑽孔注漿補強並重新檢測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First cast a full-scale mock-up column and cut it open after hardening to measure voids under diaphragms, adjusting the mix and vent holes; during production check around diaphragms by tapping or ultrasonic testing, record slump flow and temperature of every truck with cylinders taken, and drill, grout and re-test wherever voids exceed the limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一段巨柱澆置前確認排氣孔暢通與澆置管位置，並設「模型柱試驗合格」與「前一段空隙檢測完成」兩個停止點；檢測結果標註在巨柱斷面表上，成為竣工紀錄的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before each mega-column pour confirm clear vent holes and placement-pipe positions, with two hold points per segment, mock-up approval and completion of void checks on the previous segment; mark the results on the mega-column schedule as part of the as-built record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：坍流度不足或澆置速度過快會把空氣封在隔板下，形成大面積空洞；過度泌水則在板底留下弱化水膜，地震時巨柱局部的圍束與剪力傳遞降低，鋼板可能向內挫屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inadequate slump flow or too fast a placement traps air under diaphragms in large voids; excessive bleeding leaves a weak water film under the plate, so in an earthquake local confinement and shear transfer in the mega-column drop and the plate may buckle inwards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先以足尺模型柱試灌，硬化後切開量測隔板下空隙並調整配比與排氣孔；正式施工時以敲擊或超音波檢查隔板附近是否空洞，記錄每一車的坍流度與溫度並取圓柱試體，空隙超標處鑽孔注漿補強並重新檢測。
knowledge.textEn: First cast a full-scale mock-up column and cut it open after hardening to measure voids under diaphragms, adjusting the mix and vent holes; during production check around diaphragms by tapping or ultrasonic testing, record slump flow and temperature of every truck with cylinders taken, and drill, grout and re-test wherever voids exceed the limit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每一段巨柱澆置前確認排氣孔暢通與澆置管位置，並設「模型柱試驗合格」與「前一段空隙檢測完成」兩個停止點；檢測結果標註在巨柱斷面表上，成為竣工紀錄的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Before each mega-column pour confirm clear vent holes and placement-pipe positions, with two hold points per segment, mock-up approval and completion of void checks on the previous segment; mark the results on the mega-column schedule as part of the as-built record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance"?
options: 先以足尺模型柱試灌，硬化後切開量測隔板下空隙並調整配比與排氣孔。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。
optionsEn: First cast a full-scale mock-up column and cut it open after hardening to measure voids under diaphragms, adjusting the mix and vent holes.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 先以足尺模型柱試灌，硬化後切開量測隔板下空隙並調整配比與排氣孔；正式施工時以敲擊或超音波檢查隔板附近是否空洞，記錄每一車的坍流度與溫度並取圓柱試體，空隙超標處鑽孔注漿補強並重新檢測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: First cast a full-scale mock-up column and cut it open after hardening to measure voids under diaphragms, adjusting the mix and vent holes; during production check around diaphragms by tapping or ultrasonic testing, record slump flow and temperature of every truck with cylinders taken, and drill, grout and re-test wherever voids exceed the limit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔板下方空隙檢測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Voids under diaphragm plates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 坍流度不足或澆置速度過快會把空氣封在隔板下，形成大面積空洞；過度泌水則在板底留下弱化水膜，地震時巨柱局部的圍束與剪力傳遞降低，鋼板可能向內挫屈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inadequate slump flow or too fast a placement traps air under diaphragms in large voids; excessive bleeding leaves a weak water film under the plate, so in an earthquake local confinement and shear transfer in the mega-column drop and the plate may buckle inwards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：隔板下的空隙最難避免，因為氣泡與泌水會集中在板底。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Voids under diaphragms are the hardest to avoid because air bubbles and bleed water collect beneath the plate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自充填混凝土會自動填滿鋼箱，不需要開孔排氣或檢測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Self-consolidating concrete fills a steel box automatically, so no vent holes or testing are needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 坍流度不足或澆置速度過快會把空氣封在隔板下，形成大面積空洞；過度泌水則在板底留下弱化水膜，地震時巨柱局部的圍束與剪力傳遞降低，鋼板可能向內挫屈。
knowledge.textEn: Inadequate slump flow or too fast a placement traps air under diaphragms in large voids; excessive bleeding leaves a weak water film under the plate, so in an earthquake local confinement and shear transfer in the mega-column drop and the plate may buckle inwards.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
坍流度不足或澆置速度過快會把空氣封在隔板下，形成大面積空洞；過度泌水則在板底留下弱化水膜，地震時巨柱局部的圍束與剪力傳遞降低，鋼板可能向內挫屈。
雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Inadequate slump flow or too fast a placement traps air under diaphragms in large voids.
In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone.
quiz.explanation: 坍流度不足或澆置速度過快會把空氣封在隔板下，形成大面積空洞；過度泌水則在板底留下弱化水膜，地震時巨柱局部的圍束與剪力傳遞降低，鋼板可能向內挫屈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inadequate slump flow or too fast a placement traps air under diaphragms in large voids; excessive bleeding leaves a weak water film under the plate, so in an earthquake local confinement and shear transfer in the mega-column drop and the plate may buckle inwards. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 兩級地震性能與非線性驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Two-level seismic performance and nonlinear checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「減弱斷面梁與塑性轉角」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reduced beam sections and plastic rotation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的耐震設計以兩級地震檢核：約 100 年回歸期地震下結構保持彈性，約 950 年回歸期地震下維持穩定不倒塌，並以非線性時間歷程分析驗證。周邊抗彎構架須能獨立承擔規範要求的 25% 地震力，形成雙重系統；分析中梁端塑性轉角超過約 0.005 弧度的位置改用減弱斷面梁（狗骨頭切削），把塑性鉸從柱面移開，以保護焊接接頭。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「減弱斷面梁與塑性轉角」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's seismic design checks two levels: the structure stays elastic in an earthquake of roughly 100-year return period and remains stable without collapse in one of roughly 950 years, verified by nonlinear time-history analysis. The perimeter moment frames must independently carry the code-required 25% of the seismic force, forming a dual system; where analysis shows beam-end plastic rotations above about 0.005 rad, reduced beam sections (dogbone cuts) move the plastic hinge away from the column face to protect the welded joint. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Reduced beam sections and plastic rotation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塑性轉角 θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Plastic rotation θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「減弱斷面梁與塑性轉角」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Reduced beam sections and plastic rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 兩級地震性能與非線性驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Two-level seismic performance and nonlinear checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「減弱斷面梁與塑性轉角」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reduced beam sections and plastic rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塑性轉角 θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y。若層間變位角 1/90 = 0.0111 rad、梁降伏轉角 0.0060 rad，θ_p ≈ 0.0051 rad，超過 0.005 rad 門檻，需改用減弱斷面；雙重系統下若總基底剪力 V = 100 MN，抗彎構架單獨須能承擔 0.25×100 = 25 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Plastic rotation θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y. With a storey drift angle of 1/90 = 0.0111 rad and a beam yield rotation of 0.0060 rad, θ_p ≈ 0.0051 rad, above the 0.005 rad threshold, so a reduced beam section is needed; in the dual system, if total base shear V = 100 MN, the moment frame alone must carry 0.25×100 = 25 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多組符合場址條件的地震紀錄做非線性時間歷程分析，逐層輸出層間變位角與梁端塑性轉角分布，並與兩級性能目標比對；再把核心斜撐移除、只留抗彎構架做一次分析，確認 25% 的獨立承載要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several site-appropriate records, output storey drift angles and beam-end plastic rotations floor by floor and compare them with the two performance targets; then analyse the moment frame alone with the core bracing removed to confirm the independent 25% requirement, and support reduced-section cut dimensions with full-scale or published test data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 塑性轉角 θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y。若層間變位角 1/90 = 0.0111 rad、梁降伏轉角 0.0060 rad，θ_p ≈ 0.0051 rad，超過 0.005 rad 門檻，需改用減弱斷面；雙重系統下若總基底剪力 V = 100 MN，抗彎構架單獨須能承擔 0.25×100 = 25 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Plastic rotation θ_p ≈ θ_total − θ_y. With a storey drift angle of 1/90 = 0.0111 rad and a beam yield rotation of 0.0060 rad, θ_p ≈ 0.0051 rad, above the 0.005 rad threshold, so a reduced beam section is needed; in the dual system, if total base shear V = 100 MN, the moment frame alone must carry 0.25×100 = 25 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 兩級地震性能與非線性驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two-level seismic performance and nonlinear checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「減弱斷面梁與塑性轉角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reduced beam sections and plastic rotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多組符合場址條件的地震紀錄做非線性時間歷程分析，逐層輸出層間變位角與梁端塑性轉角分布，並與兩級性能目標比對；再把核心斜撐移除、只留抗彎構架做一次分析，確認 25% 的獨立承載要求。減弱斷面的切削尺寸以實尺寸試驗或文獻試驗資料佐證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several site-appropriate records, output storey drift angles and beam-end plastic rotations floor by floor and compare them with the two performance targets; then analyse the moment frame alone with the core bracing removed to confirm the independent 25% requirement, and support reduced-section cut dimensions with full-scale or published test data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：減弱斷面梁的切削尺寸、位置與表面粗糙度列為檢驗項目，以樣板量測並拍照紀錄；任何因管線而修改梁翼的現場要求，都必須回到設計單位重新檢核塑性鉸位置後才可施作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make reduced-section cut dimensions, location and surface roughness inspection items, measured with templates and photographed; any field request to modify beam flanges for services must go back to the designer to re-check the plastic hinge location before work proceeds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：1994 年美國北嶺地震中，許多鋼構抗彎接頭在梁翼焊道附近脆性斷裂，促成減弱斷面梁等改良接頭；若切削位置錯誤或圓弧加工粗糙，塑性鉸仍可能回到柱面，或在切削處提早斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the 1994 Northridge earthquake many steel moment connections fractured in a brittle manner near the beam-flange welds, prompting improved details such as the reduced beam section; if the cut is mislocated or its radius poorly finished, the hinge can migrate back to the column face or fracture prematurely at the cut. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多組符合場址條件的地震紀錄做非線性時間歷程分析，逐層輸出層間變位角與梁端塑性轉角分布，並與兩級性能目標比對；再把核心斜撐移除、只留抗彎構架做一次分析，確認 25% 的獨立承載要求。減弱斷面的切削尺寸以實尺寸試驗或文獻試驗資料佐證。
knowledge.textEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several site-appropriate records, output storey drift angles and beam-end plastic rotations floor by floor and compare them with the two performance targets; then analyse the moment frame alone with the core bracing removed to confirm the independent 25% requirement, and support reduced-section cut dimensions with full-scale or published test data.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 減弱斷面梁的切削尺寸、位置與表面粗糙度列為檢驗項目，以樣板量測並拍照紀錄；任何因管線而修改梁翼的現場要求，都必須回到設計單位重新檢核塑性鉸位置後才可施作。
knowledge.textEn: Make reduced-section cut dimensions, location and surface roughness inspection items, measured with templates and photographed; any field request to modify beam flanges for services must go back to the designer to re-check the plastic hinge location before work proceeds.

quiz.question: 要驗證「兩級地震性能與非線性驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 兩級地震性能與非線性驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-level seismic performance and nonlinear checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「減弱斷面梁與塑性轉角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reduced beam sections and plastic rotation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 1994 年美國北嶺地震中，許多鋼構抗彎接頭在梁翼焊道附近脆性斷裂，促成減弱斷面梁等改良接頭；若切削位置錯誤或圓弧加工粗糙，塑性鉸仍可能回到柱面，或在切削處提早斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: In the 1994 Northridge earthquake many steel moment connections fractured in a brittle manner near the beam-flange welds, prompting improved details such as the reduced beam section; if the cut is mislocated or its radius poorly finished, the hinge can migrate back to the column face or fracture prematurely at the cut. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：周邊抗彎構架須能獨立承擔規範要求的 25% 地震力，形成雙重系統；分析中梁端塑性轉角超過約 0.005 弧度的位置改用減弱斷面梁（狗骨頭切削），把塑性鉸從柱面移開，以保護焊接接頭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The perimeter moment frames must independently carry the code-required 25% of the seismic force, forming a dual system; where analysis shows beam-end plastic rotations above about 0.005 rad, reduced beam sections (dogbone cuts) move the plastic hinge away from the column face to protect the welded joint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「兩級地震性能與非線性驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

quiz.explanationEn: In the 1994 Northridge earthquake many steel moment connections fractured in a brittle manner near the beam-flange welds, prompting improved details such as the reduced beam section; if the cut is mislocated or its radius poorly finished, the hinge can migrate back to the column face or fracture prematurely at the cut. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查」與「颱風風壓下的帷幕玻璃與長期維護」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes" and "Curtain-wall glass under typhoon pressure and long-term upkeep": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「阻尼器事件擺幅紀錄」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damper event-swing records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的主擺錘在營運期間累積了一系列事件紀錄：2015 年 8 月蘇迪勒颱風時擺幅約 100 cm，為歷來最大；2019 年 4 月規模 6.1 地震時約 20 cm，是當時地震造成的最大擺幅。這些紀錄是結構健康的證據：擺幅、方向與持續時間可與同時段的風速及地震紀錄比對，判斷阻尼器是否仍在調頻範圍、緩衝系統是否被碰觸，並決定事件後的檢查深度。本單元把阻尼器當作監測儀器使用，不重複其調頻原理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「阻尼器事件擺幅紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's main pendulum has built up a record of events in service: about 100 cm of swing in Typhoon Soudelor in August 2015, the largest so far, and about 20 cm in a magnitude 6.1 earthquake in April 2019, then the largest earthquake-induced swing. These records are structural-health evidence: amplitude, direction and duration can be compared with concurrent wind and earthquake records to judge whether the damper is still in tune and whether the bumper system was touched, and to set the depth of post-event inspection. This unit uses the damper as a monitoring instrument rather than revisiting its tuning theory. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Damper event-swing records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：擺錘簡諧運動的最大速度 v = 2π·f·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For harmonic pendulum motion the peak velocity is v = 2π·f·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器擺幅創紀錄，就代表大樓結構出了問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A record damper swing means something is wrong with the building structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「阻尼器事件擺幅紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Damper event-swing records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「阻尼器事件擺幅紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damper event-swing records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：擺錘簡諧運動的最大速度 v = 2π·f·A。取 f = 0.14 Hz、A = 1.0 m，v = 2π×0.14×1.0 ≈ 0.88 m/s，660 t 擺錘的動能 ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×660,000×0.88² ≈ 256 kJ；若設計行程為 ±1.5 m，行程使用率約 1.0/1.5 ≈ 67%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For harmonic pendulum motion the peak velocity is v = 2π·f·A. With f = 0.14 Hz and A = 1.0 m, v = 2π×0.14×1.0 ≈ 0.88 m/s and a 660 t pendulum carries ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×660,000×0.88² ≈ 256 kJ; against a design stroke of ±1.5 m the stroke utilisation is about 1.0/1.5 ≈ 67%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：事件後先調出擺錘位移、樓層加速度與風速或地震紀錄，確認最大擺幅與行程限制之間的餘裕；接著目視檢查緩衝環接觸痕跡、阻尼器漏油、吊索與吊點，必要時以自由擺動量測頻率是否仍與基準值相符，結果寫入事件報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an event, retrieve pendulum displacement, floor acceleration and wind or earthquake records and confirm the margin between peak swing and stroke limits; then inspect bumper-ring contact marks, damper leaks, hangers and pick points, and if needed measure the free-swing frequency against the baseline, recording the results in an event report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: For harmonic pendulum motion the peak velocity is v = 2π·f·A. With f = 0.14 Hz and A = 1.0 m, v = 2π×0.14×1.0 ≈ 0.88 m/s and a 660 t pendulum carries ½·m·v² ≈ 0.5×660,000×0.88² ≈ 256 kJ; against a design stroke of ±1.5 m the stroke utilisation is about 1.0/1.5 ≈ 67%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes", which statement holds?
options: 外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。
擺錘簡諧運動的最大速度 v = 2π·f·A。
鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。
optionsEn: The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most.
For harmonic pendulum motion the peak velocity is v = 2π·f·A.
The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 擺錘簡諧運動的最大速度 v = 2π·f·A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For harmonic pendulum motion the peak velocity is v = 2π·f·A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「阻尼器事件擺幅紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Damper event-swing records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 事件後先調出擺錘位移、樓層加速度與風速或地震紀錄，確認最大擺幅與行程限制之間的餘裕；接著目視檢查緩衝環接觸痕跡、阻尼器漏油、吊索與吊點，必要時以自由擺動量測頻率是否仍與基準值相符，結果寫入事件報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an event, retrieve pendulum displacement, floor acceleration and wind or earthquake records and confirm the margin between peak swing and stroke limits; then inspect bumper-ring contact marks, damper leaks, hangers and pick points, and if needed measure the free-swing frequency against the baseline, recording the results in an event report. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立事件分級：擺幅或樓層加速度超過設定門檻即啟動詳細檢查；每次事件的擺幅、風速、處置與檢查結果累積成趨勢表，提供結構顧問年度審查並作為調頻複核的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set event tiers in which swing or floor acceleration above set thresholds triggers a detailed inspection, and accumulate each event's swing, wind speed, actions and findings into a trend table for the structural consultant's annual review and as the basis for re-checking the tuning.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若事件紀錄沒有時間同步，擺錘位移無法對應風速，就分不出大擺幅來自強風還是阻尼器失調；事件後若省略緩衝器檢查，隱藏的損傷可能要到下一次颱風才顯現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without time-synchronised records, pendulum displacement cannot be matched to wind speed, so a large swing cannot be attributed to strong wind or to detuning; skipping the post-event bumper inspection lets hidden damage surface only in the next typhoon. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 事件後先調出擺錘位移、樓層加速度與風速或地震紀錄，確認最大擺幅與行程限制之間的餘裕；接著目視檢查緩衝環接觸痕跡、阻尼器漏油、吊索與吊點，必要時以自由擺動量測頻率是否仍與基準值相符，結果寫入事件報告。
knowledge.textEn: After an event, retrieve pendulum displacement, floor acceleration and wind or earthquake records and confirm the margin between peak swing and stroke limits; then inspect bumper-ring contact marks, damper leaks, hangers and pick points, and if needed measure the free-swing frequency against the baseline, recording the results in an event report.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立事件分級：擺幅或樓層加速度超過設定門檻即啟動詳細檢查；每次事件的擺幅、風速、處置與檢查結果累積成趨勢表，提供結構顧問年度審查並作為調頻複核的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Set event tiers in which swing or floor acceleration above set thresholds triggers a detailed inspection, and accumulate each event's swing, wind speed, actions and findings into a trend table for the structural consultant's annual review and as the basis for re-checking the tuning.

quiz.question: 要驗證「颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes.
After an event, retrieve pendulum displacement, floor acceleration and wind or earthquake records and confirm the margin between peak swing and stroke limits.
quiz.explanation: 事件後先調出擺錘位移、樓層加速度與風速或地震紀錄，確認最大擺幅與行程限制之間的餘裕；接著目視檢查緩衝環接觸痕跡、阻尼器漏油、吊索與吊點，必要時以自由擺動量測頻率是否仍與基準值相符，結果寫入事件報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After an event, retrieve pendulum displacement, floor acceleration and wind or earthquake records and confirm the margin between peak swing and stroke limits; then inspect bumper-ring contact marks, damper leaks, hangers and pick points, and if needed measure the free-swing frequency against the baseline, recording the results in an event report. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「阻尼器事件擺幅紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Damper event-swing records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若事件紀錄沒有時間同步，擺錘位移無法對應風速，就分不出大擺幅來自強風還是阻尼器失調；事件後若省略緩衝器檢查，隱藏的損傷可能要到下一次颱風才顯現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without time-synchronised records, pendulum displacement cannot be matched to wind speed, so a large swing cannot be attributed to strong wind or to detuning; skipping the post-event bumper inspection lets hidden damage surface only in the next typhoon. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本單元把阻尼器當作監測儀器使用，不重複其調頻原理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This unit uses the damper as a monitoring instrument rather than revisiting its tuning theory.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器擺幅創紀錄，就代表大樓結構出了問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A record damper swing means something is wrong with the building structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若事件紀錄沒有時間同步，擺錘位移無法對應風速，就分不出大擺幅來自強風還是阻尼器失調；事件後若省略緩衝器檢查，隱藏的損傷可能要到下一次颱風才顯現。
knowledge.textEn: Without time-synchronised records, pendulum displacement cannot be matched to wind speed, so a large swing cannot be attributed to strong wind or to detuning; skipping the post-event bumper inspection lets hidden damage surface only in the next typhoon.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「颱風與地震後的阻尼器紀錄與檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Damper records and inspection after typhoons and earthquakes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若事件紀錄沒有時間同步，擺錘位移無法對應風速，就分不出大擺幅來自強風還是阻尼器失調；事件後若省略緩衝器檢查，隱藏的損傷可能要到下一次颱風才顯現。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
帷幕牆只是外觀，不需要配合結構的變位來設計。
optionsEn: Without time-synchronised records, pendulum displacement cannot be matched to wind speed, so a large swing cannot be attributed to strong wind or to detuning.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A curtain wall is cosmetic and need not be designed for structural movement.
quiz.explanation: 若事件紀錄沒有時間同步，擺錘位移無法對應風速，就分不出大擺幅來自強風還是阻尼器失調；事件後若省略緩衝器檢查，隱藏的損傷可能要到下一次颱風才顯現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without time-synchronised records, pendulum displacement cannot be matched to wind speed, so a large swing cannot be attributed to strong wind or to detuning; skipping the post-event bumper inspection lets hidden damage surface only in the next typhoon. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 颱風風壓下的帷幕玻璃與長期維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Curtain-wall glass under typhoon pressure and long-term upkeep: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「帷幕牆玻璃與層間變位」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curtain-wall glass and storey drift” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 位於颱風區，帷幕單元面積大，玻璃供應商指出必須使用比一般更厚的玻璃基板，單片面積平均約 40 平方英尺（約 3.7 m²），窗間牆部位則使用客製的陶瓷釉面玻璃。帷幕牆同時承受正負風壓與樓層間的相對變位：風壓使玻璃彎曲，層間變位則讓框架變成平行四邊形，必須靠框內間隙與可滑動的連接件吸收。長期維護的重點是密封膠、墊片、破損玻璃更換，以及外牆維護設備的可達性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「帷幕牆玻璃與層間變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101 stands in a typhoon zone with large curtain-wall units; its glass supplier states that thicker-than-typical glass substrates were needed, with individual units averaging about 40 ft² (about 3.7 m²) and custom ceramic-frit glass in the spandrels. The curtain wall must resist positive and negative wind pressure and relative storey movement at the same time: pressure bends the glass, while drift racks the frame into a parallelogram that edge clearances and sliding connections must absorb. Long-term upkeep centres on sealants, gaskets, broken-glass replacement and access for façade maintenance equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Curtain-wall glass and storey drift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：四邊簡支玻璃板最大應力 σ = β·p·a²/t²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Peak stress in a four-side-supported glass plate is σ = β·p·a²/t².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆只是外觀，不需要配合結構的變位來設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A curtain wall is cosmetic and need not be designed for structural movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「帷幕牆玻璃與層間變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Curtain-wall glass and storey drift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 颱風風壓下的帷幕玻璃與長期維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Curtain-wall glass under typhoon pressure and long-term upkeep: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「帷幕牆玻璃與層間變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curtain-wall glass and storey drift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四邊簡支玻璃板最大應力 σ = β·p·a²/t²。短邊 a = 1.5 m、厚 t = 12 mm、風壓 p = 4.0 kPa、β = 0.48，σ = 0.48×4,000×1.5²/0.012² = 30 MPa；層間變位角 1/200、樓高 4.2 m 時，框架水平錯動 4,200/200 = 21 mm，需由框內間隙與滑動連接吸收。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Peak stress in a four-side-supported glass plate is σ = β·p·a²/t². With short side a = 1.5 m, thickness t = 12 mm, pressure p = 4.0 kPa and β = 0.48, σ = 0.48×4,000×1.5²/0.012² = 30 MPa; a drift angle of 1/200 over a 4.2 m storey racks the frame 4,200/200 = 21 mm, which edge clearances and sliding connections must absorb. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸帷幕牆試體做風壓（含颱風循環）、水密、氣密與層間變位試驗，確認玻璃不破、密封不漏水；完工後定期以目視與望遠鏡檢查密封膠劣化與玻璃自爆，並記錄每片更換玻璃的位置、原因與規格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-scale curtain-wall mock-ups for wind pressure including typhoon cycles, water and air tightness and storey-drift racking, confirming no glass breakage or leakage; after completion inspect visually and with binoculars for sealant ageing and spontaneous glass breakage, recording the location, cause and specification of every replaced pane.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 四邊簡支玻璃板最大應力 σ = β·p·a²/t²。短邊 a = 1.5 m、厚 t = 12 mm、風壓 p = 4.0 kPa、β = 0.48，σ = 0.48×4,000×1.5²/0.012² = 30 MPa；層間變位角 1/200、樓高 4.2 m 時，框架水平錯動 4,200/200 = 21 mm，需由框內間隙與滑動連接吸收。數值為教學假設。

With short side a = 1.5 m, thickness t = 12 mm, pressure p = 4.0 kPa and β = 0.48, σ = 0.48×4,000×1.5²/0.012² = 30 MPa; a drift angle of 1/200 over a 4.2 m storey racks the frame 4,200/200 = 21 mm, which edge clearances and sliding connections must absorb. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.
