quiz.questionEn: For ‘Check channel gain and energy calibration’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 校準一次即可永遠不變
相同輸入應以校準後量比較
通道原始數字必然可直接比較
optionsEn: One calibration lasts unchanged forever
Compare calibrated values for equal inputs
Raw channel numbers are always directly comparable
quiz.explanation: 增益校準建立可比性；校準仍有漂移與不確定度。 溫度或電子學狀態改變可能讓通道增益漂移；校準的有效期間需以穩定性資料支持。
quiz.explanationEn: Gain calibration establishes comparability but still has drift and uncertainty. Temperature or electronics changes can shift gain; calibration validity periods need stability evidence.

steps.title: 辨識時間偏移與時鐘漂移
steps.titleEn: Identify timing offsets and clock drift
steps.objective: 區分固定差值與逐漸變化。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish constant offsets from changing drift.
steps.instruction: 建立兩條虛構時間戳序列；先加入固定差值再加入斜率差；用圖分辨兩種誤差並提出校正證據。
steps.instructionEn: Create two synthetic timestamp streams; add an offset then a slope difference; distinguish them graphically and propose calibration evidence.
steps.observation: 對齊一次不保證長時間同步。
steps.observationEn: One alignment does not ensure lasting synchronization.
steps.failure: 把所有時間差都當固定偏移會留下殘差。
steps.failureEn: Treating all timing error as fixed offset leaves residuals.
steps.check: 報告同時列偏移、漂移及觀測區間。
steps.checkEn: Report offset, drift and observation duration.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 時間同步影響符合配對與飛行時間定位，不只是檔案排序。
knowledge.textEn: Timing affects coincidence pairing and time-of-flight localization, not just sorting.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 時間戳的單位、解析度與共同時基必須一致；增加儲存位數不能修正不同時鐘的物理偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Timestamp units, resolution and timebase must agree; more stored digits do not correct physical clock differences.

quiz.question: 針對「辨識時間偏移與時鐘漂移」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Identify timing offsets and clock drift’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 一次零點重設能永久消除漂移
時間戳與成像位置無關
需分別評估偏移與漂移
optionsEn: One reset permanently removes drift
Timestamps cannot affect image localization
Assess offset and drift separately
quiz.explanation: 時間同步影響符合配對與飛行時間定位，不只是檔案排序。 時間戳的單位、解析度與共同時基必須一致；增加儲存位數不能修正不同時鐘的物理偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Timing affects coincidence pairing and time-of-flight localization, not just sorting. Timestamp units, resolution and timebase must agree; more stored digits do not correct physical clock differences.

steps.title: 建立符合事件的判別表
steps.objective: 理解配對条件與誤配問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand pairing criteria and false pairings.
steps.instruction: 產生帶通道與時間的虛構事件表；用任意教學窗口配對；比較窗口變寬後真配對與誤配對可能變化。
steps.instructionEn: Generate synthetic channel/time events; pair them using an arbitrary teaching window; compare possible true and false pairing changes when it widens.
steps.observation: 接受更多事件也可能接受更多誤配。
steps.observationEn: Accepting more events may admit more false pairs.
steps.failure: 窗口越大影像一定越好不成立。
steps.failureEn: A wider window does not guarantee better images.
steps.check: 明確標出窗口只作教學且非設備設定。
steps.checkEn: Label the window as a teaching value, not an equipment setting.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 符合條件需要時間與幾何相容；偶然同時事件也可能被誤配。
knowledge.textEn: Coincidences need temporal and geometric compatibility; unrelated events can pair accidentally.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 最佳參數依系統與測試任務，本課不提供臨床取得條件。
knowledge.textEn: Appropriate parameters depend on system and task; no clinical acquisition conditions are supplied.

quiz.question: 針對「建立符合事件的判別表」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a coincidence classification table’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應權衡保留事件與誤配
越寬窗口永遠越準
只要時間接近必然同一事件
optionsEn: Balance retained events against false pairs
Wider windows are always more accurate
Nearby times guarantee one physical event
quiz.explanation: 符合條件需要時間與幾何相容；偶然同時事件也可能被誤配。 最佳參數依系統與測試任務，本課不提供臨床取得條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Coincidences need temporal and geometric compatibility; unrelated events can pair accidentally. Appropriate parameters depend on system and task; no clinical acquisition conditions are supplied.

steps.title: 把時間差換成位置區間
steps.titleEn: Relate time difference to a position interval
steps.objective: 理解 TOF 提供的是有限精度約束。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand TOF as a finite-precision constraint.
steps.instruction: 畫一條響應線與兩端探測器；標時間差正負；以 Δx=cΔt/2 的理想式畫出含不確定度的位置區間。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a response line with two detectors; label time-difference sign; use ideal Δx=cΔt/2 to mark a location interval with uncertainty.
steps.observation: 時間解析度有限，所以位置是區間而非無誤差點。
steps.observationEn: Finite timing resolution gives an interval, not an exact point.
steps.failure: 把一個 TOF 事件當精準像素會過度解讀。
steps.failureEn: Treating one TOF event as an exact pixel overinterprets it.
steps.check: 公式中的秒、米與二分之一都有說明。
steps.checkEn: Explain seconds, meters and the factor of two.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 兩光子的路徑差隨事件位置變化兩倍，因此理想位置差含二分之一。
knowledge.textEn: The difference of the two path lengths changes twice as fast as position, giving the factor one-half.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 真實 TOF 還有校準、探測器和統計效應，這不是診斷定位計算器。
knowledge.textEn: Real TOF includes calibration, detector and statistical effects; this is not a diagnostic locator.

quiz.question: 針對「把時間差換成位置區間」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Relate time difference to a position interval’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 位置差必定等於 cΔt 而沒有除二
應報告位置區間與時間不確定度
飛行時間完全消除所有模糊
optionsEn: Position difference is always cΔt without halving
Report a location interval and timing uncertainty
TOF eliminates all blur
quiz.explanation: 兩光子的路徑差隨事件位置變化兩倍，因此理想位置差含二分之一。 真實 TOF 還有校準、探測器和統計效應，這不是診斷定位計算器。
quiz.explanationEn: The difference of the two path lengths changes twice as fast as position, giving the factor one-half. Real TOF includes calibration, detector and statistical effects; this is not a diagnostic locator.

steps.title: 評估事件吞吐與遺失
steps.objective: 把資料量與可追蹤完整性連結。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect data volume to traceable completeness.
steps.instruction: 建立假想每秒事件量；乘上每筆資料大小估算流量；加入緩衝溢出事件並比較輸入與輸出計數。
steps.instructionEn: Set synthetic events per second; multiply by record size for data rate; add buffer overflow and compare input/output counts.
steps.observation: 高靈敏度也增加資料處理需求。
steps.observationEn: High sensitivity also increases processing demand.
steps.failure: 檔案可打開不代表事件完全保留。
steps.failureEn: A readable file does not prove complete events.
steps.check: 保留丟棄計數、序號與時間區段。
steps.checkEn: Keep dropped counts, sequence numbers and time intervals.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 吞吐瓶頸可能位於電子學、網路或儲存；必須沿全鏈檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Bottlenecks can lie in electronics, networking or storage and need end-to-end checks.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 資料缺失若與事件率相關，可能引入非隨機偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Loss correlated with event rate can introduce nonrandom bias.

quiz.question: 針對「評估事件吞吐與遺失」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Assess event throughput and loss’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 儲存空間夠大就不會掉事件
遺失事件永遠都是無害的隨機樣本
需核對輸入輸出與丟失紀錄
optionsEn: Ample disk space guarantees no event loss
Lost events are always harmless random samples
Compare input, output and loss logs
quiz.explanation: 吞吐瓶頸可能位於電子學、網路或儲存；必須沿全鏈檢查。 資料缺失若與事件率相關，可能引入非隨機偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Bottlenecks can lie in electronics, networking or storage and need end-to-end checks. Loss correlated with event rate can introduce nonrandom bias.

stages.title: 校正與影像重建
stages.description: 理解量測偏差、統計與重建模型。
stages.descriptionEn: Understand measurement bias, statistics and reconstruction models.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 理解衰減與 CT 對位
steps.objective: 分開光子損失與位置對應。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate photon loss from spatial registration.
steps.instruction: 畫均勻教學物件中的兩條不同長度路徑；標相對穿透差；把衰減圖平移一格，觀察校正套錯位置的問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two path lengths through a uniform teaching object; mark transmission differences; shift an attenuation map one cell and inspect misapplied correction.
steps.observation: 同一發射強度可能因路徑而有不同偵測量。
steps.observationEn: Equal emission can yield different detections because of path length.
steps.failure: 把衰減差異直接解讀為生理差異不合適。
steps.failureEn: Attenuation differences should not directly become physiological interpretations.
steps.check: 分列衰減模型與影像對位兩種誤差。
steps.checkEn: Separate attenuation-model and registration errors.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: PET 校正需描述光子沿路徑的損失；CT 資訊的使用還需能量轉換與座標一致性。
knowledge.textEn: PET attenuation correction models path losses; using CT also needs energy conversion and coordinate consistency.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 衰減係數依光子能量與材料而變；影像座標一致仍不保證物理係數轉換正確，兩者需分別驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Attenuation depends on photon energy and material; aligned coordinates do not guarantee correct coefficient conversion, so both require verification.

quiz.question: 針對「理解衰減與 CT 對位」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Understand attenuation and CT registration’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 對位錯誤可能污染校正結果
衰減圖放任何位置都相同
CT 亮度直接等於 PET 放射強度
optionsEn: Misregistration can corrupt correction
Attenuation-map position never matters
CT brightness equals PET activity
quiz.explanation: PET 校正需描述光子沿路徑的損失；CT 資訊的使用還需能量轉換與座標一致性。 衰減係數依光子能量與材料而變；影像座標一致仍不保證物理係數轉換正確，兩者需分別驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: PET attenuation correction models path losses; using CT also needs energy conversion and coordinate consistency. Attenuation depends on photon energy and material; aligned coordinates do not guarantee correct coefficient conversion, so both require verification.

steps.title: 分開散射與隨機符合
steps.objective: 辨認不同污染來源需要不同模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize different contamination mechanisms.
steps.instruction: 畫一個轉向光子案例；另畫兩個無關事件的誤配；在事件表分別標真、散射、隨機三類教學標籤。
steps.instructionEn: Draw one deflected photon case and one pairing from unrelated events; label true, scattered and random cases in a teaching table.
steps.observation: 錯誤配對與路徑改變不是同一機制。
steps.observationEn: False pairing and path deflection are different mechanisms.
steps.failure: 把所有背景用同一常數扣除可能失真。
steps.failureEn: Subtracting one constant for all backgrounds can distort data.
steps.check: 以圖解說明兩種污染的差別。
steps.checkEn: Explain both mechanisms with diagrams.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 散射改變光子能量和方向；隨機符合把無關光子當成一對。
knowledge.textEn: Scatter changes photon energy/direction; random coincidences pair unrelated photons.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 實際事件真值不可直接觀測，校正依統計模型與驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Real event truth is not directly observable; correction depends on statistical models and validation.

quiz.question: 針對「分開散射與隨機符合」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Separate scatter from random coincidences’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 散射事件一定能憑照片肉眼辨認
不同機制需各自校正與驗證
所有背景都是同一種噪聲常數
optionsEn: Scatter is always visually identifiable in a photograph
Different mechanisms need appropriate correction and validation
All background is one constant noise term
quiz.explanation: 散射改變光子能量和方向；隨機符合把無關光子當成一對。 實際事件真值不可直接觀測，校正依統計模型與驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Scatter changes photon energy/direction; random coincidences pair unrelated photons. Real event truth is not directly observable; correction depends on statistical models and validation.

steps.title: 校準幾何響應與通道效率
steps.objective: 避免把探測器差異當物件差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid turning detector differences into object differences.
steps.instruction: 給均勻教學物件設定相同發射；讓某通道效率降低；比較未校正與校正後分布並標出殘差。
steps.instructionEn: Set uniform synthetic emission; reduce one channel’s efficiency; compare corrected and uncorrected distributions and mark residuals.
steps.observation: 假結構可能來自通道響應。
steps.observationEn: Apparent structure may come from channel response.
steps.failure: 一次校準不涵蓋所有配置與時間。
steps.failureEn: One calibration does not cover every configuration or time.
steps.check: 校準記錄含幾何版本、日期與測試條件。
steps.checkEn: Record geometry version, date and test conditions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 正規化補償系統響應差異，需要與實際偵測器配置一致。
knowledge.textEn: Normalization compensates response differences and must match detector configuration.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 壞通道、漂移與缺資料須顯式處理，不能任意補成理想數值。
knowledge.textEn: Bad channels, drift and missing data need explicit treatment, not invented ideal values.

quiz.question: 針對「校準幾何響應與通道效率」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Normalize geometry and channel efficiency’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 均勻物件出現條紋一定是物件真實結構
更換通道後可無條件沿用校準
校準需對應幾何與通道狀態
optionsEn: Stripes in a uniform object must be real structure
Calibration always remains valid after replacing a channel
Match calibration to geometry and channel state
quiz.explanation: 正規化補償系統響應差異，需要與實際偵測器配置一致。 壞通道、漂移與缺資料須顯式處理，不能任意補成理想數值。
quiz.explanationEn: Normalization compensates response differences and must match detector configuration. Bad channels, drift and missing data need explicit treatment, not invented ideal values.

steps.title: 比較死時間與隨機雜訊
steps.titleEn: Compare dead time with random noise
steps.objective: 理解高事件率的非線性。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand high-rate nonlinearity.
steps.instruction: 畫理想輸入對輸出直線；加入假想飽和彎曲；比較兩段事件率下比例是否一致。
steps.instructionEn: Draw an ideal input/output line; add hypothetical saturation curvature; compare proportionality at two event rates.
steps.observation: 輸入增加不保證輸出等比例增加。
steps.observationEn: More input need not produce proportional output.
steps.failure: 把所有低計數都當低來源強度會誤判。
steps.failureEn: Low recorded counts need not mean low source strength.
steps.check: 報告明確分開事件率損失與統計波動。
steps.checkEn: Separate rate losses from statistical fluctuation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 死時間是系統處理後暫時不能記錄另一事件的效應，可造成率相依損失。
knowledge.textEn: Dead time describes temporary inability to record another event, producing rate-dependent loss.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 率校正模型也帶入不確定度；接近飽和時，反推失去的事件資訊可能變得不穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Rate-correction models add uncertainty; near saturation, inferring lost events can become unstable.

quiz.question: 針對「比較死時間與隨機雜訊」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare dead time with random noise’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應檢查計數響應是否仍近似線性
輸入加倍輸出必定加倍
可用任意更大輸入克服所有雜訊
optionsEn: Check whether count response remains approximately linear
Twice the input always means twice the output
Arbitrarily increasing input overcomes all noise
quiz.explanation: 死時間是系統處理後暫時不能記錄另一事件的效應，可造成率相依損失。 率校正模型也帶入不確定度；接近飽和時，反推失去的事件資訊可能變得不穩定。
quiz.explanationEn: Dead time describes temporary inability to record another event, producing rate-dependent loss. Rate-correction models add uncertainty; near saturation, inferring lost events can become unstable.

steps.title: 建立前向模型與迭代重建
steps.titleEn: Build a forward model and iterative reconstruction
steps.objective: 理解影像是由量測估計而來。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand images as estimates from measurements.
steps.instruction: 畫四格教學影像與幾條投影；由影像預測事件量；比較預測與虛構量測，再做一次非負更新並保存殘差。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a four-cell image and projections; predict event counts; compare with synthetic measurements, make one nonnegative update and keep residuals.
steps.observation: 可見影像取決於模型與量測共同作用。
steps.observationEn: The visible image depends on model and data together.
steps.failure: 迭代次數越多必然越真實不成立。
steps.failureEn: More iterations do not guarantee greater truth.
steps.check: 提交初值、預測、殘差及更新後結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit initialization, prediction, residual and updated result.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 前向模型把候選分布映到觀測，重建則用差異修正估計。
knowledge.textEn: A forward model maps candidate distributions to observations; reconstruction updates estimates using disagreement.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 正則化與停止條件改變偏差—雜訊權衡；四格例子非臨床演算法。
knowledge.textEn: Regularization and stopping affect bias–noise trade-offs; the four-cell example is not a clinical algorithm.

quiz.question: 針對「建立前向模型與迭代重建」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a forward model and iterative reconstruction’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 影像每一格都是直接拍到的真值
重建需同時檢查模型與殘差
更多迭代永遠等於更正確
optionsEn: Every voxel is directly photographed truth
Examine the model and residuals during reconstruction
More iterations are always more correct
quiz.explanation: 前向模型把候選分布映到觀測，重建則用差異修正估計。 正則化與停止條件改變偏差—雜訊權衡；四格例子非臨床演算法。
quiz.explanationEn: A forward model maps candidate distributions to observations; reconstruction updates estimates using disagreement. Regularization and stopping affect bias–noise trade-offs; the four-cell example is not a clinical algorithm.

steps.title: 設計動態影像的時間分箱
steps.titleEn: Design time framing for dynamic images
steps.objective: 比較時間解析與統計精度。
steps.objectiveEn: Compare temporal resolution with statistical precision.
steps.instruction: 把同一虛構事件流切為短框與長框；繪出兩種時間曲線；比較短框波動與長框平滑的代價。
steps.instructionEn: Split one synthetic stream into short and long frames; plot both curves; compare short-frame variation and long-frame smoothing costs.
steps.observation: 較短時間框可看快速變化但事件較少。
steps.observationEn: Shorter frames resolve change but contain fewer events.
steps.failure: 曲線越平滑就必然越真實不正確。
steps.failureEn: Smoother curves are not necessarily truer.
steps.check: 說明選框長度與研究問題的關係。
steps.checkEn: Explain frame duration relative to the research question.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 動態 PET 的優勢包含同時觀察多位置的時間變化；時間分箱仍影響可辨識特徵。
knowledge.textEn: Dynamic PET can observe multiple locations over time; framing affects detectable features.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 不同時間框的計數可能受同一校準偏差影響；時間曲線比較需區分隨機波動與共享的系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Frames may share calibration bias; time-curve comparisons must separate random fluctuation from shared systematic error.

quiz.question: 針對「設計動態影像的時間分箱」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Design time framing for dynamic images’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 框越短所有性能都越好
平滑即可證明模型正確
框長度需權衡時間與統計
optionsEn: Shorter frames improve every metric
Smoothing proves model correctness
Frame duration trades timing against statistics
quiz.explanation: 動態 PET 的優勢包含同時觀察多位置的時間變化；時間分箱仍影響可辨識特徵。 不同時間框的計數可能受同一校準偏差影響；時間曲線比較需區分隨機波動與共享的系統誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic PET can observe multiple locations over time; framing affects detectable features. Frames may share calibration bias; time-curve comparisons must separate random fluctuation from shared systematic error.

stages.title: 品質驗證與研究資料
stages.description: 用可重現的非臨床證據檢查成像系統。
stages.descriptionEn: Evaluate imaging systems using reproducible nonclinical evidence.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 建立非人體測試物的品質計畫
steps.titleEn: Plan quality checks using non-patient objects
steps.objective: 讓性能主張對應可重現物件。
steps.objectiveEn: Link performance claims to reproducible objects.
steps.instruction: 用數位幾何建立均勻、點狀及不同大小三種教學物件；各配一項品質問題；保存物件定義與評估腳本。
steps.instructionEn: Define uniform, point-like and varying-size digital objects; assign quality questions; preserve object definitions and evaluation scripts.
steps.observation: 不同測試物揭露不同性能面向。
steps.observationEn: Different objects reveal different performance aspects.
steps.failure: 用單一精美影像代表所有性能會不足。
steps.failureEn: One attractive image cannot establish all performance.
steps.check: 每項結論連到測試物、條件及方法。
steps.checkEn: Link claims to object, conditions and method.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 模型測試可分開均勻性、空間響應與對比，但不能直接等同臨床效益。
knowledge.textEn: Phantom-like tests separate uniformity, spatial response and contrast but do not directly establish clinical benefit.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 數位物件有已知真值，適合檢查演算法；但無法單獨涵蓋硬體漂移與真實量測環境。
knowledge.textEn: Digital objects provide known truth for algorithm checks but cannot alone capture hardware drift and real measurement conditions.

quiz.question: 針對「建立非人體測試物的品質計畫」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Plan quality checks using non-patient objects’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 用合適物件評估不同主張
一張清楚圖就代表全部合格
數位測試直接等於臨床效果證明
optionsEn: Use suitable objects for different claims
One clear image proves total conformity
Digital tests directly prove clinical benefit
quiz.explanation: 模型測試可分開均勻性、空間響應與對比，但不能直接等同臨床效益。 數位物件有已知真值，適合檢查演算法；但無法單獨涵蓋硬體漂移與真實量測環境。
quiz.explanationEn: Phantom-like tests separate uniformity, spatial response and contrast but do not directly establish clinical benefit. Digital objects provide known truth for algorithm checks but cannot alone capture hardware drift and real measurement conditions.

steps.title: 比較對比恢復與背景變異
steps.titleEn: Compare contrast recovery and background variability
steps.objective: 理解看得清與量得準未必相同。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand visibility and quantitative accuracy as different.
steps.instruction: 在虛構影像設同濃度不同大小區塊；量中心平均與背景變動；比較平滑前後對小區塊的影響。
steps.instructionEn: Place equal-intensity regions of different sizes in a synthetic image; measure regional means and background variation; compare smoothing effects on small regions.
steps.observation: 小物件可能因空間混合被低估。
steps.observationEn: Small objects can be underestimated through spatial mixing.
steps.failure: 平滑降低噪聲也可能降低小物件對比。
steps.failureEn: Smoothing may reduce both noise and small-object contrast.
steps.check: 結果同時保留對比與變異指標。
steps.checkEn: Preserve both contrast and variability metrics.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 部分容積效應使有限解析度混合鄰近訊號；視覺輪廓不等於真實邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Partial-volume effects mix neighboring signals; visual contours are not exact boundaries.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 背景變異的估計取決於區域大小與取樣數；比較對比時也要固定同一種背景定義。
knowledge.textEn: Background-variability estimates depend on region size and sample count; contrast comparisons need consistent background definitions.

quiz.question: 針對「比較對比恢復與背景變異」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare contrast recovery and background variability’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 任何大小區塊都必須同樣恢復
應同時看對比與背景變異
平滑後沒噪點即量測完全準確
optionsEn: Every region size has identical recovery
Assess contrast and background variability together
No visible noise means perfect quantitative accuracy
quiz.explanation: 部分容積效應使有限解析度混合鄰近訊號；視覺輪廓不等於真實邊界。 背景變異的估計取決於區域大小與取樣數；比較對比時也要固定同一種背景定義。
quiz.explanationEn: Partial-volume effects mix neighboring signals; visual contours are not exact boundaries. Background-variability estimates depend on region size and sample count; contrast comparisons need consistent background definitions.

steps.title: 檢查運動與模態對位誤差
steps.objective: 辨識時間與空間不一致的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize temporal and spatial inconsistency.
steps.instruction: 將教學物件在兩時刻平移；疊加 PET 與衰減示意；比較未對位與對位後殘差並記錄插值。
steps.instructionEn: Translate a teaching object between two times; overlay PET and attenuation sketches; compare residuals before/after alignment and record interpolation.
steps.observation: 對位改善外觀仍需檢查量化影響。
steps.observationEn: Better-looking registration still needs quantitative checks.
steps.failure: 把所有邊界硬拉重合可能造成失真。
steps.failureEn: Forcing every boundary to match may distort data.
steps.check: 報告原始、轉換與未解決區域。
steps.checkEn: Report original data, transformation and unresolved regions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 不同模態可能在不同時間測得，運動會影響融合與校正。
knowledge.textEn: Modalities acquired at different times may mismatch through motion, affecting fusion and correction.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 配準演算法不能自動保證生理對應正確，需相應驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Registration does not automatically establish correct physiological correspondence; validation is required.

quiz.question: 針對「檢查運動與模態對位誤差」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Review motion and multimodality misregistration’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 圖像重疊即代表全部正確
可用任意變形消除任何差異
對位後仍要驗證量化影響
optionsEn: Visual overlap proves all correctness
Any deformation may erase any discrepancy
Check quantitative effects after registration
quiz.explanation: 不同模態可能在不同時間測得，運動會影響融合與校正。 配準演算法不能自動保證生理對應正確，需相應驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Modalities acquired at different times may mismatch through motion, affecting fusion and correction. Registration does not automatically establish correct physiological correspondence; validation is required.

steps.title: 建立研究資料與版本履歷
steps.objective: 讓結果可以重現且不混入身分資料。
steps.objectiveEn: Make results reproducible without identity data.
steps.instruction: 為合成事件檔建立隨機案例編號；記錄幾何、校準與軟體版本；匯出不含個人欄位的重現清單。
steps.instructionEn: Give a synthetic event file a random case ID; record geometry, calibration and software versions; export a reproducibility manifest without personal fields.
steps.observation: 相同資料用不同校準可能產生不同結果。
steps.observationEn: Different calibrations can change results from the same data.
steps.failure: 刪除姓名不一定足以去識別真實醫療資料。
steps.failureEn: Removing names alone may not de-identify real medical data.
steps.check: 清單能重現合成結果，且沒有個人資訊。
steps.checkEn: The manifest reproduces synthetic results and contains no personal data.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 可重現性需要輸入、演算法、參數與校準的完整關係。
knowledge.textEn: Reproducibility needs relationships among input, algorithm, parameters and calibration.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 醫療資料的身分線索可能出現在標頭、影像文字與時間資訊；研究資料治理需處理整個資料結構。
knowledge.textEn: Identity clues can appear in headers, image text and timing; research-data governance must address the full data structure.

quiz.question: 針對「建立研究資料與版本履歷」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build research-data provenance’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 版本與校準應連結到每個結果
刪名字即可公開全部醫療檔案
程式相同就不用記校準
optionsEn: Link versions and calibration to each result
Removing names makes all medical files public
Identical code removes the need to record calibration
quiz.explanation: 可重現性需要輸入、演算法、參數與校準的完整關係。 醫療資料的身分線索可能出現在標頭、影像文字與時間資訊；研究資料治理需處理整個資料結構。
quiz.explanationEn: Reproducibility needs relationships among input, algorithm, parameters and calibration. Identity clues can appear in headers, image text and timing; research-data governance must address the full data structure.

steps.title: 比較原始研究的測試條件
steps.objective: 避免拼湊出不存在的性能組合。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid inventing a composite performance claim.
steps.instruction: 從兩篇研究各摘記題名與測試範圍；分列幾何、重建與指標；標出不可直接比較的欄位並解釋原因。
steps.instructionEn: Record titles and scope from two original studies; separate geometry, reconstruction and metrics; flag incomparable fields and explain why.
steps.observation: 不同論文的最佳數值未必可同時達到。
steps.observationEn: Best values from different papers may not be simultaneously attainable.
steps.failure: 把各研究最佳值拼成一台新系統會誤導。
steps.failureEn: Combining best values into an imaginary system misleads.
steps.check: 所有比較都附來源及原始條件。
steps.checkEn: Attach sources and original conditions to comparisons.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 物理性能報告依標準、測試物與重建選擇而定，不能脫離條件使用。
knowledge.textEn: Physical performance depends on standards, objects and reconstruction choices.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 測試可重現性和可推廣性是不同問題；在同一物件重現結果，不代表所有樣本與用途都等效。
knowledge.textEn: Reproducibility and generalizability are different; reproducing a test object does not establish equivalence for all samples and uses.

quiz.question: 針對「比較原始研究的測試條件」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare conditions across original studies’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 有論文就代表對每個人效果相同
比較時保留各研究條件
可任意合併所有最佳數字
optionsEn: A paper guarantees identical benefit for everyone
Preserve study conditions when comparing
Arbitrarily combine all best numbers
quiz.explanation: 物理性能報告依標準、測試物與重建選擇而定，不能脫離條件使用。 測試可重現性和可推廣性是不同問題；在同一物件重現結果，不代表所有樣本與用途都等效。
quiz.explanationEn: Physical performance depends on standards, objects and reconstruction choices. Reproducibility and generalizability are different; reproducing a test object does not establish equivalence for all samples and uses.

steps.title: 完成 PET、CT 與科學儀器比較
steps.titleEn: Complete PET, CT and scientific-instrument comparison
steps.objective: 遷移偵測、校準與證據推理。
steps.objectiveEn: Transfer detection, calibration and evidence reasoning.
steps.instruction: 對照 EXPLORER、早期 EMI CT 與大型探測器；列相同的時間、幾何及校準問題；再分開粒子來源、用途與驗證界限。
steps.instructionEn: Compare EXPLORER, early EMI CT and large detectors; list shared timing, geometry and calibration questions; separate particle sources, purposes and validation limits.
steps.observation: 共通資料原理不表示設備或用途可互換。
steps.observationEn: Shared data principles do not make devices or purposes interchangeable.
steps.failure: 將高能物理探測器的條件照搬到醫療系統不成立。
steps.failureEn: High-energy detector conditions cannot simply transfer to medical systems.
steps.check: 審查包含物理鏈、資料鏈、品質與未決事項。
steps.checkEn: Review the physics chain, data chain, quality and open issues.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 科學儀器共用訊號轉換、校準與反問題，但量測物理與適用要求各異。
knowledge.textEn: Scientific instruments share transduction, calibration and inverse problems while differing in physics and requirements.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 反問題可有多個與量測相容的解；加入先驗會改變估計，必須交代來源與對結論的敏感度。
knowledge.textEn: Inverse problems may have several data-compatible solutions; priors alter estimates and need documented origins and sensitivity analysis.

quiz.question: 針對「完成 PET、CT 與科學儀器比較」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Complete PET, CT and scientific-instrument comparison’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有環形探測器都能互換用途
完成重建練習即具診斷資格
共同原理與用途界限需一起說明
optionsEn: All ring detectors are interchangeable
Completing reconstruction exercises qualifies one to diagnose
Explain common principles with use boundaries
quiz.explanation: 科學儀器共用訊號轉換、校準與反問題，但量測物理與適用要求各異。 反問題可有多個與量測相容的解；加入先驗會改變估計，必須交代來源與對結論的敏感度。

title: 矽晶圓線鋸切片
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解切縫、TTV、次表面損傷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore kerf, ttv and subsurface damage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 晶棒與切片預算
stages.description: 在「晶棒與切片預算」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for ingot and slicing budget, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 辨識晶向
steps.objective: 完成「辨識晶向」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify crystal orientation, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：辨識晶向。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify crystal orientation. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「辨識晶向」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for identify crystal orientation: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 辨識晶向的原理
knowledge.text: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。
knowledge.textEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

quiz.question: 評估「辨識晶向」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating identify crystal orientation?
options: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。
TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。
只量中心厚度即可代表全片形貌。
optionsEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance.
TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable.
Center thickness alone represents full-wafer geometry.
quiz.explanation: 晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。 可用片數的理想上限為可用長度除以每片厚度加切縫，實際還須扣除端損及不良片。
quiz.explanationEn: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Ideal slice count divides usable length by thickness plus kerf; real yield additionally loses end material and rejects.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for define usable ingot length, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：定義可用晶棒長。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：頭尾排除長度會改變可用片數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define usable ingot length. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Head and tail exclusions change usable wafer count. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頭尾排除長度會改變可用片數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Head and tail exclusions change usable wafer count. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define usable ingot length and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「定義可用晶棒長」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for define usable ingot length: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 切縫預算
steps.objective: 完成「切縫預算」的敏感度草圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for budget kerf, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：切縫預算。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：每片占用長度包含晶圓厚度與切縫。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂算例：可用晶棒長 100 mm、切片厚 0.8 mm、切縫 0.2 mm；先求理想片數，再將切縫改為 0.25 mm 比較整數片數，列出尚未納入的端損與不良片。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget kerf. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Length consumed per slice includes wafer thickness and kerf. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical exercise: usable ingot length 100 mm, slice thickness 0.8 mm and kerf 0.2 mm. Calculate ideal integer count, change kerf to 0.25 mm and list excluded end losses and rejects.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「每片占用長度包含晶圓厚度與切縫。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「切縫預算」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget kerf and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「切縫預算」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for budget kerf: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for reserve thickness allowance, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：厚度留量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：切片厚度還須支付損傷移除與拋光留量。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Reserve thickness allowance. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Sliced thickness must cover damage removal and polishing allowance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「切片厚度還須支付損傷移除與拋光留量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「厚度留量」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for reserve thickness allowance: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Eccentric mounting makes feed loading asymmetric. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

Interpretation: Pre-break tension spikes and slice order delimit affected material. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「斷線前的張力尖峰與片序能限定受影響區域。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for reconstruct wire breakage: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 斷線事件的原理
knowledge.text: 斷線前的張力尖峰與片序能限定受影響區域。
knowledge.textEn: Pre-break tension spikes and slice order delimit affected material.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 線網的機械耦合使單條線受力改變可能影響相鄰切面，進給穩定性需與導輪狀態一起看。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical coupling in a wire web means one load change can affect neighboring cuts; inspect feed stability with guide condition.

quiz.question: 評估「斷線事件」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating reconstruct wire breakage?
options: 晶圓表面外觀平整就可排除次表面裂紋。
切片厚度就是最終成品厚度。
斷線前的張力尖峰與片序能限定受影響區域。
optionsEn: A flat-looking surface rules out subsurface cracks.
Sliced thickness equals final finished thickness.
Pre-break tension spikes and slice order delimit affected material.
quiz.explanation: 斷線前的張力尖峰與片序能限定受影響區域。 線網的機械耦合使單條線受力改變可能影響相鄰切面，進給穩定性需與導輪狀態一起看。

stages.title: 片形與損傷證據

steps.title: 總厚度變異

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for measure total thickness variation, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：總厚度變異。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Measure total thickness variation. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「總厚度變異」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure total thickness variation and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「總厚度變異」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for measure total thickness variation: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 總厚度變異的原理
knowledge.text: TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。
knowledge.textEn: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: TTV 用兩面的局部間距計算；弓形用中面相對參考面計算，因此厚度均勻的片仍可能彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: TTV measures local separation of both faces while bow describes the median surface; uniform thickness can coexist with curvature.

quiz.question: 評估「總厚度變異」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating measure total thickness variation?
options: TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。
平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。
材料移除量不會影響可用晶圓數。
optionsEn: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness.
Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions.
Material removal cannot affect usable wafer count.
quiz.explanation: TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。 TTV 用兩面的局部間距計算；弓形用中面相對參考面計算，因此厚度均勻的片仍可能彎曲。

optionsEn: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions.
Material removal cannot affect usable wafer count.
Repositioning variation must be separated from wafer variation.
quiz.explanation: 重新放片的變異應先與片間差異分開。 TTV 用兩面的局部間距計算；弓形用中面相對參考面計算，因此厚度均勻的片仍可能彎曲。
quiz.explanationEn: Repositioning variation must be separated from wafer variation. TTV measures local separation of both faces while bow describes the median surface; uniform thickness can coexist with curvature.

stages.title: 良率與後段交接
stages.description: 在「良率與後段交接」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for yield and downstream handoff, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 材料利用率
steps.objective: 完成「材料利用率」的因果圖，把切縫、TTV、次表面損傷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for compute material utilization, connecting relevant limits in kerf, ttv and subsurface damage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：材料利用率。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：提高片數若同時增加報廢，未必提高有效矽利用率。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compute material utilization. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「提高片數若同時增加報廢，未必提高有效矽利用率。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「材料利用率」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compute material utilization and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「材料利用率」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for compute material utilization: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 材料利用率的原理
knowledge.text: 提高片數若同時增加報廢，未必提高有效矽利用率。
knowledge.textEn: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 切片端減少切縫的收益，若被後段新增的損傷移除量抵銷，整體矽利用率可能沒有增加。
knowledge.textEn: A smaller kerf may not improve overall silicon utilization if it requires more downstream damage removal.

quiz.question: 評估「材料利用率」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating compute material utilization?
options: 提高片數若同時增加報廢，未必提高有效矽利用率。
局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。
所有表面缺陷都能由後段拋光無代價消除。
optionsEn: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase.
One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement.
All surface defects can be removed by later polishing without cost.
quiz.explanation: 提高片數若同時增加報廢，未必提高有效矽利用率。 切片端減少切縫的收益，若被後段新增的損傷移除量抵銷，整體矽利用率可能沒有增加。
quiz.explanationEn: More slices may not improve usable silicon yield if rejects increase. A smaller kerf may not improve overall silicon utilization if it requires more downstream damage removal.

steps.title: 線耗追蹤

steps.instruction: 本步問題：線耗追蹤。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：線耗量需按合格片數正規化。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Track wire consumption. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Wire consumption should be normalized by accepted wafers. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「線耗量需按合格片數正規化。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Wire consumption should be normalized by accepted wafers. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：只要每批總線耗下降，即使合格片數下降更多，也可判定單位合格片的線耗改善。 應回到「線耗追蹤」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower total wire use per batch proves better wire use per accepted wafer even if accepted output falls by a larger fraction. Revisit assumptions and sampling for track wire consumption and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「線耗追蹤」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for track wire consumption: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

Wire consumption should be normalized by accepted wafers.
Wire-use comparisons need only the number of sliced wafers, without separating subsequent rejects from accepted wafers.
quiz.explanation: 線耗量需按合格片數正規化。 切片端減少切縫的收益，若被後段新增的損傷移除量抵銷，整體矽利用率可能沒有增加。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Plot slice-order trends. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Periodic slice-thickness errors can suggest guide-related causes. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for plot slice-order trends and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「切片序列圖」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for plot slice-order trends: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Transfer removal allowance. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Lapping needs estimated deepest damage, not just mean thickness. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for transfer removal allowance: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

Interpretation: Boundary-sample retests need original slice identity and measurement version. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

title: 矽磊晶層生長
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解膜厚、摻雜階梯、晶體缺陷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 基板與磊晶目標
stages.description: 在「基板與磊晶目標」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for substrate and epitaxy target, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 區分磊晶與沉積

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for distinguish epitaxy from deposition, connecting relevant limits in thickness, doping transitions and crystalline defects to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：區分磊晶與沉積。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Distinguish epitaxy from deposition. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Epitaxy requires a defined crystallographic relationship to the substrate. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「磊晶需要與基板有確定晶體關係。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「區分磊晶與沉積」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for distinguish epitaxy from deposition: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

title: 絕緣層上覆矽晶圓製造
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解頂矽均勻性、埋氧、鍵合空洞，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map top-silicon thickness. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Thickness nonuniformity can translate into threshold-voltage variation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「厚度非均勻可能轉成元件臨界電壓變異。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「頂矽厚度圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map top-silicon thickness and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「頂矽厚度圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map top-silicon thickness: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for inspect buried-oxide continuity: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for map bond strength, connecting relevant limits in top-silicon uniformity, buried oxide and bond voids to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：鍵合強度分布。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：局部強度不能由單一平均破壞值代表。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map bond strength. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: One mean fracture value cannot describe local bond strength. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「局部強度不能由單一平均破壞值代表。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: One mean fracture value cannot describe local bond strength. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「鍵合強度分布」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map bond strength and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「鍵合強度分布」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for map bond strength: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

knowledge.title: 鍵合強度分布的原理
knowledge.text: 局部強度不能由單一平均破壞值代表。
knowledge.textEn: One mean fracture value cannot describe local bond strength.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鍵合空洞改變局部機械支撐與熱路徑；即使頂矽厚度正常，局部空洞仍可能影響後續加工。
knowledge.textEn: Bond voids alter support and heat paths, so normal top-silicon thickness does not eliminate void-related processing risks.

quiz.question: 評估「鍵合強度分布」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating map bond strength?
options: 平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。
材料移除量不會影響可用晶圓數。
局部強度不能由單一平均破壞值代表。
optionsEn: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions.
Material removal cannot affect usable wafer count.
One mean fracture value cannot describe local bond strength.
quiz.explanation: 局部強度不能由單一平均破壞值代表。 鍵合空洞改變局部機械支撐與熱路徑；即使頂矽厚度正常，局部空洞仍可能影響後續加工。
quiz.explanationEn: One mean fracture value cannot describe local bond strength. Bond voids alter support and heat paths, so normal top-silicon thickness does not eliminate void-related processing risks.

Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Geometric integrity does not establish electrical interface quality. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「界面陷阱」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for assess interface traps: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.title: 自熱效應

steps.instruction: 本步問題：自熱效應。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：埋氧的熱阻可提高局部溫升。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Analyze self-heating. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Buried-oxide thermal resistance can increase local heating. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「埋氧的熱阻可提高局部溫升。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried-oxide thermal resistance can increase local heating. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：局部截面合格就能取代整片量測。 應回到「自熱效應」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One acceptable section replaces full-wafer measurement. Revisit assumptions and sampling for analyze self-heating and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「自熱效應」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for analyze self-heating: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 自熱效應的原理

knowledge.textEn: Buried-oxide thermal resistance can increase local heating.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 埋氧抑制電性耦合的同時也增加垂直熱阻，薄體電晶體的電性比較應包含自熱條件。
knowledge.textEn: Buried oxide reduces electrical coupling while adding vertical thermal resistance; thin-body comparisons should include self-heating.

所有表面缺陷都能由後段拋光無代價消除。
optionsEn: Buried-oxide thermal resistance can increase local heating.

All surface defects can be removed by later polishing without cost.

title: 晶圓表面清洗
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解去污效果、材料損失、再污染，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore removal, material loss and recontamination through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 污染與表面目標

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for contaminants and surface targets, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 污染分類

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for classify contaminants, connecting relevant limits in removal, material loss and recontamination to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：污染分類。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Classify contaminants. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「污染分類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify contaminants and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「污染分類」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for classify contaminants: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

title: 超純水供應系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解水質多指標、使用點、滯留，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 用水需求與污染
stages.description: 在「用水需求與污染」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for water demand and contaminants, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 界定使用點
steps.objective: 完成「界定使用點」的因果圖，把水質多指標、使用點、滯留中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define points of use, connecting relevant limits in water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：界定使用點。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define points of use. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「界定使用點」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define points of use and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「界定使用點」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define points of use: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 界定使用點的原理
knowledge.text: 沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。
knowledge.textEn: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 污染物質量流率為濃度乘流量；濃度相同時，大流量使用點可能接收更大的污染總量。
knowledge.textEn: Contaminant mass flow is concentration times flow, so a high-flow outlet can receive more contaminant at equal concentration.

quiz.question: 評估「界定使用點」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define points of use?
options: 沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。
粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。
未檢出代表污染濃度精確為零。
optionsEn: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality.
Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration.
Nondetection means exactly zero contamination.
quiz.explanation: 沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。 污染物質量流率為濃度乘流量；濃度相同時，大流量使用點可能接收更大的污染總量。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate peak and average flow. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Average demand misses coincident usage peaks. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

Interpretation: Concentration and flow jointly determine contaminant flux. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

Acceptance needs quality, supply stability, sampling and excursion traceability.
quiz.explanation: 品質、供應穩定、採樣及異常追溯須同時成立。 回收率提高通常降低排放體積，卻可能增加濃水負荷與純化難度，因此水量與品質需共同平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance needs quality, supply stability, sampling and excursion traceability. Higher recovery reduces discharge volume but can increase concentrate burden and purification difficulty, requiring joint quantity-quality balancing.

title: 晶圓廠微污染控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore sources, transport and defect maps through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 污染源與路徑
stages.description: 在「污染源與路徑」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for sources and pathways, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 建立污染源地圖

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map contamination sources, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：建立污染源地圖。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map contamination sources. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「建立污染源地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map contamination sources and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「建立污染源地圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map contamination sources: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.textEn: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 污染控制是來源、傳輸、表面沉積與器件敏感度的串聯問題；控制來源並不自動證明所有傳輸路徑已封閉。
knowledge.textEn: Contamination links sources, transport, deposition and device sensitivity; source control does not prove all transport paths are closed.

quiz.question: 評估「建立污染源地圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating map contamination sources?
options: 人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。
粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。
未檢出代表污染濃度精確為零。
optionsEn: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources.
Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration.
Nondetection means exactly zero contamination.
quiz.explanation: 人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。 污染控制是來源、傳輸、表面沉積與器件敏感度的串聯問題；控制來源並不自動證明所有傳輸路徑已封閉。
quiz.explanationEn: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. Contamination links sources, transport, deposition and device sensitivity; source control does not prove all transport paths are closed.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：尺寸與危害。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：相同尺寸的不同污染物未必有相同電性影響。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate size and hazard. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Equal-sized contaminants can have different electrical effects. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「相同尺寸的不同污染物未必有相同電性影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Equal-sized contaminants can have different electrical effects. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「尺寸與危害」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate size and hazard and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「尺寸與危害」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for separate size and hazard: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Particle filtration does not establish molecular-contamination control. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「粒子過濾不能自動證明分子污染受控。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for distinguish particles and molecules: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objective: 完成「暴露劑量」的故障判別表，把來源、傳輸與缺陷地圖中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for estimate contamination exposure, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：暴露劑量。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：表面負荷同時取決於濃度與暴露時間。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂暴露模型：先假設沉積通量與濃度成正比。案例甲濃度 2、時間 3，案例乙濃度 1、時間 8；比較相對暴露，再列使此線性模型失效的吸附飽和情況。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Estimate contamination exposure. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Surface burden depends on concentration and exposure duration. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical exposure model: deposition flux is proportional to concentration. Compare relative exposures for concentration/time pairs (2,3) and (1,8), then state how adsorption saturation could invalidate linearity.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「表面負荷同時取決於濃度與暴露時間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for estimate contamination exposure and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「暴露劑量」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for estimate contamination exposure: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：沉積與再懸浮。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：清潔表面的擾動可能重新釋出粒子。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace deposition and resuspension. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Disturbing a surface can resuspend deposited particles. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「清潔表面的擾動可能重新釋出粒子。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Monitor wafers need representative handling histories. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「監控片需要與實際搬運歷程一致。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

stages.title: 空氣與微環境

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for air and microenvironments, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 氣流方向

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map airflow direction, connecting relevant limits in sources, transport and defect maps to observable evidence.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map airflow direction. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Mean velocity does not identify local recirculation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平均風速無法取代局部回流辨識。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：高電阻率足以排除所有有機污染。 應回到「氣流方向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High resistivity rules out every organic contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map airflow direction and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「氣流方向」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map airflow direction: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 氣流方向的原理

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 粒子依慣性、擴散與重力等機制移動，分子污染則另受吸附平衡與化學反應影響。
knowledge.textEn: Particles move through inertia, diffusion and gravity, while molecular contamination also involves adsorption equilibria and reactions.

title: 晶圓廠自動搬運系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 搬運圖與產能
stages.description: 在「搬運圖與產能」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for transport graph and capacity, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：辨識載具與批號。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify carriers and lots. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「辨識載具與批號」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify carriers and lots and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「辨識載具與批號」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
knowledge.textEn: Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.

quiz.question: 評估「辨識載具與批號」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

optionsEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields.
Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task.
Handshake timeout means the carrier has not moved.
quiz.explanation: 載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：尾端延遲。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：中位搬運時間可能掩蓋少數嚴重逾時。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂延遲資料：九次任務均 20 s，一次 200 s；計算平均與中位數，保留最大值，再設計會揭露尾端問題的報表欄位。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Report tail latency. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Median transfer time can hide severe tail delays. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical latency data: nine tasks take 20 s and one takes 200 s. Compute mean and median, retain the maximum, and design a report exposing tail delays.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「中位搬運時間可能掩蓋少數嚴重逾時。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Median transfer time can hide severe tail delays. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：中位延遲合格就不會有嚴重逾時。 應回到「尾端延遲」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: An acceptable median excludes severe timeouts. Revisit assumptions and sampling for report tail latency and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「尾端延遲」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for report tail latency: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Audit event traceability. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Each handoff needs source, time and unique task identity. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build a discrete-event experiment. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Dispatch strategies need identical arrival traces for fair comparison. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.title: 搬運系統驗收

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Accept the transport system. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Acceptance needs throughput, misdelivery prevention, recovery and cleanliness evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「產能、錯送防護、故障恢復及潔淨度均需證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
