title: 熱氧化閘極介電層
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 界面與氧化目的
stages.description: 在「界面與氧化目的」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for interface and oxidation purpose, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 分辨成長與沉積
steps.objective: 完成「分辨成長與沉積」的因果圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate growth and deposition, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：分辨成長與沉積。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate growth and deposition. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「分辨成長與沉積」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate growth and deposition: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.text: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source.

knowledge.text: 熱氧化形成的氧化物同時向原表面上下延伸；截面預算需分開記錄矽消耗與外部厚度增加。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal oxide extends above and below the original surface; separate silicon consumption from outward thickness increase.

quiz.question: 評估「分辨成長與沉積」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。 熱氧化形成的氧化物同時向原表面上下延伸；截面預算需分開記錄矽消耗與外部厚度增加。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Thermal oxide extends above and below the original surface; separate silicon consumption from outward thickness increase.

steps.title: 界面位置移動
steps.objective: 完成「界面位置移動」的對照表，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for track the moving interface, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：界面位置移動。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：氧化後原表面不等於新的矽氧界面位置。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂幾何模型：假設氧化物厚度 100 個單位、矽消耗為其 0.44 倍；以原表面為零畫出新界面與外表面。0.44 是近似體積換算，非本課量測值。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Track the moving interface. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: The original surface differs from the final silicon-oxide interface. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical geometry: oxide thickness 100 units and silicon consumption 0.44 times that thickness. Mark the new interface and outer surface relative to the original surface. The 0.44 is an approximate volume conversion, not course measurement data.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「氧化後原表面不等於新的矽氧界面位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The original surface differs from the final silicon-oxide interface. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「界面位置移動」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for track the moving interface and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「界面位置移動」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for track the moving interface: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

quiz.question: 評估「電容等效厚度」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating infer electrical thickness?
options: 高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。
去除上層材料不需檢查下層損失。
介面層與量子效應可能使電容厚度不同於物理厚度。
optionsEn: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps.
Removing an upper layer needs no lower-layer loss check.
Interfacial and quantum effects can separate electrical and physical thickness.

quiz.explanationEn: Interfacial and quantum effects can separate electrical and physical thickness. Capacitance reflects an electrical stack while optical measurements depend on refractive-index models; agreement can test interfacial-layer assumptions.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Read leakage curves. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Leakage comparisons need matched area, field and polarity. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「比較漏電需控制面積、電場及量測極性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for read leakage curves and add discriminating evidence.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for accumulate thermal history, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：熱預算累加。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：長時間氧化會同時改變先前的摻雜輪廓。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Accumulate thermal history. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Long oxidation can also change earlier dopant profiles. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「長時間氧化會同時改變先前的摻雜輪廓。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Long oxidation can also change earlier dopant profiles. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「熱預算累加」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accumulate thermal history and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「熱預算累加」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for accumulate thermal history: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 熱預算累加的原理

knowledge.textEn: Long oxidation can also change earlier dopant profiles.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 氧化也消耗熱預算並改變摻雜輪廓，因此合格氧化層仍可能造成鄰近接面或短通道指標變差。
knowledge.textEn: Oxidation consumes thermal budget and alters dopant profiles, so an acceptable oxide can coexist with degraded junction or short-channel behavior.

quiz.question: 評估「熱預算累加」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating accumulate thermal history?
options: 長時間氧化會同時改變先前的摻雜輪廓。

較快成長永遠改善圖案選擇性。
optionsEn: Long oxidation can also change earlier dopant profiles.
Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance.
Faster growth always improves pattern selectivity.
quiz.explanation: 長時間氧化會同時改變先前的摻雜輪廓。 氧化也消耗熱預算並改變摻雜輪廓，因此合格氧化層仍可能造成鄰近接面或短通道指標變差。

steps.check: 交付「邊角氧化」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。

title: 高介電常數原子層沉積
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 介電層與電容
stages.description: 在「介電層與電容」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for dielectric and capacitance, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 物理厚度與 EOT

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate thickness and eot, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：物理厚度與 EOT。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate thickness and EOT. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「物理厚度與 EOT」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate thickness and eot and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「物理厚度與 EOT」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate thickness and eot: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 物理厚度與 EOT的原理
knowledge.text: 較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。
knowledge.textEn: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 串聯介電層滿足電容倒數相加；若介面層電容較小，單純提高上層介電常數的整體收益有限。
knowledge.textEn: Series capacitances add inversely; a small interfacial capacitance limits benefits from raising the upper-layer permittivity.

厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：串聯介面電容。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：薄介面層仍可能主導整體等效氧化厚度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂電容模型：令介面與上層電容分別為 2 與 8 個單位；算串聯總電容，再將上層增為 16。比較收益並說明瓶頸。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Calculate series interface capacitance. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: A thin interfacial layer can dominate equivalent oxide thickness. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical capacitance model: interface and upper-layer capacitances are 2 and 8 units. Calculate series capacitance, increase the upper layer to 16 and identify the limiting contribution.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for calculate series interface capacitance and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「串聯介面電容」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for calculate series interface capacitance: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Residual concentration needs measurement-depth and background metadata. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for electrical behavior and integration, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 介面偶極
steps.objective: 完成「介面偶極」的因果圖，把EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace interface dipoles, connecting relevant limits in eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：介面偶極。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：介面化學可能同時改變有效功函數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace interface dipoles. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「介面化學可能同時改變有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「介面偶極」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace interface dipoles and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「介面偶極」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for trace interface dipoles: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 介面偶極的原理
knowledge.text: 介面化學可能同時改變有效功函數。
knowledge.textEn: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 低 EOT、低漏電及低陷阱密度是不同目標；改變介面處理可能改善其中一項卻犧牲另一項。
knowledge.textEn: Low EOT, leakage and trap density are distinct objectives; an interface treatment may improve one while compromising another.

quiz.question: 評估「介面偶極」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

optionsEn: Interface chemistry can also change effective work function.
Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance.
Faster growth always improves pattern selectivity.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess mobility tradeoffs. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Capacitance gain must be compared with scattering and trap penalties. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高電容增益需與散射及陷阱造成的劣化比較。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher gate capacitance alone proves higher carrier mobility without checking scattering or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess mobility tradeoffs and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「遷移率代價」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess mobility tradeoffs: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget gate-cavity volume. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Thicker dielectric consumes available metal-fill volume. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「介電層變厚會消耗金屬可用填充空間。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「閘極填充空間」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget gate-cavity volume and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「閘極填充空間」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。

Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: A precursor change requires renewed coverage, impurity and reliability checks. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A precursor change requires renewed coverage, impurity and reliability checks. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「配方變更見證」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define change-control witnesses and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「配方變更見證」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for define change-control witnesses: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：高介電層放行。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：EOT、漏電、陷阱及三維覆蓋應共同審查。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Release the high-k layer. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Review EOT, leakage, traps and 3D coverage jointly. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「EOT、漏電、陷阱及三維覆蓋應共同審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for release the high-k layer: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

title: 金屬閘極功函數工程
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 能帶與閘極
stages.description: 在「能帶與閘極」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for band alignment and gates, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 定義真空功函數
steps.objective: 完成「定義真空功函數」的因果圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define vacuum work function, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：定義真空功函數。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define vacuum work function. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「定義真空功函數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define vacuum work function and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「定義真空功函數」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define vacuum work function: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 定義真空功函數的原理
knowledge.text: 金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 平帶及閾值由金屬、介電層、半導體與電荷共同決定，不能用單一金屬真空功函數直接替代整個堆疊。
knowledge.textEn: Flat-band and threshold depend on metal, dielectric, semiconductor and charge; vacuum work function cannot replace the whole stack.

quiz.question: 評估「定義真空功函數」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define vacuum work function?
options: 金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。 平帶及閾值由金屬、介電層、半導體與電荷共同決定，不能用單一金屬真空功函數直接替代整個堆疊。
quiz.explanationEn: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. Flat-band and threshold depend on metal, dielectric, semiconductor and charge; vacuum work function cannot replace the whole stack.

steps.title: 平帶條件

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for draw flat-band conditions, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：平帶條件。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：平帶電壓也受介面電荷影響。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw flat-band conditions. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Flat-band voltage is also affected by interface charge. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平帶電壓也受介面電荷影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Flat-band voltage is also affected by interface charge. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「平帶條件」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw flat-band conditions and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「平帶條件」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for draw flat-band conditions: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: NMOS 與 PMOS
steps.objective: 完成「NMOS 與 PMOS」的敏感度草圖，把有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for separate nmos and pmos targets, connecting relevant limits in effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：NMOS 與 PMOS。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：互補元件需要不同閾值設定策略。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate NMOS and PMOS targets. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Complementary devices need different threshold-setting strategies. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「互補元件需要不同閾值設定策略。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Complementary devices need different threshold-setting strategies. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「NMOS 與 PMOS」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for separate nmos and pmos targets: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：閘介電層串聯。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：相同金屬在不同介面堆疊可有不同有效功函數。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。

Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: The same metal can have different effective work functions in different stacks. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for include the dielectric stack: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

knowledge.textEn: A narrow gate cavity limits total stack thickness; adding one layer reduces space for others and can promote voids.

quiz.question: 評估「區域保護層」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

Removing an upper layer needs no lower-layer loss check.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：金屬閘極驗收。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Accept the metal gate. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「金屬閘極驗收」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept the metal gate and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「金屬閘極驗收」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for accept the metal gate: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 金屬閘極驗收的原理
knowledge.text: 功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 製程造成的初始閾值偏移與偏壓老化漂移需分開記錄，才能判斷改良來自材料設定還是可靠度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Separate initial process-induced threshold shifts from bias-aging drift to distinguish material tuning from reliability changes.

quiz.question: 評估「金屬閘極驗收」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating accept the metal gate?
options: 低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。
較快成長永遠改善圖案選擇性。
功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。
optionsEn: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance.
Faster growth always improves pattern selectivity.
Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging.
quiz.explanation: 功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。 製程造成的初始閾值偏移與偏壓老化漂移需分開記錄，才能判斷改良來自材料設定還是可靠度變化。
quiz.explanationEn: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging. Separate initial process-induced threshold shifts from bias-aging drift to distinguish material tuning from reliability changes.

title: 離子佈植摻雜
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解劑量、射程、損傷及活化，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore dose, range, damage and activation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 佈植目的與輪廓
stages.description: 在「佈植目的與輪廓」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for implant purpose and profiles, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 劑量與濃度
steps.objective: 完成「劑量與濃度」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate dose and concentration, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：劑量與濃度。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂積分題：假設一段厚 10 nm 的均勻區濃度為 10^19 cm^-3；先把厚度換成 cm，再求面劑量，並解釋此方盒輪廓不是實際佈植高斯輪廓。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate dose and concentration. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical integral: a uniform 10 nm region has concentration 10^19 cm^-3. Convert thickness to cm and compute areal dose; explain why this box profile is not a real implantation Gaussian.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「劑量與濃度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate dose and concentration and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「劑量與濃度」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate dose and concentration: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 劑量與濃度的原理
knowledge.text: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

quiz.question: 評估「劑量與濃度」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate dose and concentration?
options: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
quiz.explanationEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

steps.objective: 完成「摻雜種類」的對照表，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for choose dopant roles, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：摻雜種類。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：摻雜元素與晶格佔位共同決定電性作用。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose dopant roles. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Dopant species and lattice occupation jointly determine electrical behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「摻雜元素與晶格佔位共同決定電性作用。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Dopant species and lattice occupation jointly determine electrical behavior. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for choose dopant roles and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「摻雜種類」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for choose dopant roles: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Mean projected range does not represent the depth-distribution tail. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mean projected range does not represent the depth-distribution tail. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「投影射程」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.title: 能量與深度

steps.instruction: 本步問題：能量與深度。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：能量影響深度，也同時影響損傷分布。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Relate energy and depth. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Energy affects both depth and damage distribution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「能量影響深度，也同時影響損傷分布。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：接面位置。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：接面需由摻雜輪廓與背景濃度交會判斷。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。

Interpretation: Junction depth depends on profile intersection with background doping. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「接面需由摻雜輪廓與背景濃度交會判斷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for set mask-stopping evidence, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：遮罩止擋條件。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：遮罩厚度須考慮射程展寬與薄弱區。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Set mask-stopping evidence. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Mask thickness must account for range spread and weak regions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「遮罩厚度須考慮射程展寬與薄弱區。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Mask thickness must account for range spread and weak regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「遮罩止擋條件」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for set mask-stopping evidence and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「遮罩止擋條件」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for set mask-stopping evidence: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 遮罩止擋條件的原理
knowledge.text: 遮罩厚度須考慮射程展寬與薄弱區。
knowledge.textEn: Mask thickness must account for range spread and weak regions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

quiz.question: 評估「遮罩止擋條件」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating set mask-stopping evidence?
options: 峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
遮罩厚度須考慮射程展寬與薄弱區。
optionsEn: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
Mask thickness must account for range spread and weak regions.
quiz.explanation: 遮罩厚度須考慮射程展寬與薄弱區。 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
quiz.explanationEn: Mask thickness must account for range spread and weak regions. Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

stages.title: 束流與遮罩
stages.description: 在「束流與遮罩」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for beam and masks, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 質量分析
steps.objective: 完成「質量分析」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for trace mass selection, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：質量分析。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：電荷質量比選擇有助區分束流物種。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace mass selection. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Mass-to-charge selection helps distinguish beam species. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「電荷質量比選擇有助區分束流物種。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：片電阻下降就證明接面完全無損傷。 應回到「質量分析」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower sheet resistance proves a damage-free junction. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace mass selection and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「質量分析」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for trace mass selection: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for integrate beam dose: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assess scan uniformity: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess channeling. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Ions aligned with crystal channels can create deeper tails. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

title: 快速熱退火
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

title: 雷射尖峰退火
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes and add discriminating evidence.

steps.check: 交付「金屬圖案吸收」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：下層見證結構。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：只量表面活化無法證明下層未受損。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose buried-layer witnesses. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Surface activation alone cannot prove buried layers remain undamaged. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「只量表面活化無法證明下層未受損。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Surface activation alone cannot prove buried layers remain undamaged. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「下層見證結構」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for choose buried-layer witnesses and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「下層見證結構」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for choose buried-layer witnesses: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

knowledge.title: 下層見證結構的原理
knowledge.text: 只量表面活化無法證明下層未受損。
knowledge.textEn: Surface activation alone cannot prove buried layers remain undamaged.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 金屬與介電圖案的反射及吸收不同，代表性驗證應包含圖案晶圓而非僅有裸矽校準片。
knowledge.textEn: Metal and dielectric patterns differ optically, so representative validation needs patterned wafers beyond bare-silicon calibration.

quiz.question: 評估「下層見證結構」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating choose buried-layer witnesses?

相同雷射能量必定產生相同熱峰值。

Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity.
Equal laser energy must produce equal thermal peaks.
quiz.explanation: 只量表面活化無法證明下層未受損。 金屬與介電圖案的反射及吸收不同，代表性驗證應包含圖案晶圓而非僅有裸矽校準片。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace failed scan regions. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Defect maps should be registered to scan time and beam coordinates. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「失效區回溯」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for trace failed scan regions: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：雷射退火審查。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：活化收益需與熱峰值、均勻性及下層相容性一起評估。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Review laser-anneal evidence. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Assess activation gain with thermal peaks, uniformity and buried-layer compatibility. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「活化收益需與熱峰值、均勻性及下層相容性一起評估。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「雷射退火審查」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for review laser-anneal evidence: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

title: 擴散爐均勻性控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 爐管與邊界
stages.description: 在「爐管與邊界」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for furnace and boundaries, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 批次位置圖
steps.objective: 完成「批次位置圖」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map batch positions, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：批次位置圖。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map batch positions. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「批次位置圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map batch positions and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「批次位置圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map batch positions: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 批次位置圖的原理
knowledge.text: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。
knowledge.textEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

quiz.question: 評估「批次位置圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating map batch positions?
options: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

steps.title: 晶舟載量

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for specify boat loading, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：晶舟載量。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：裝片數量及間距改變熱容量與流場。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Specify boat loading. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Wafer count and spacing change thermal mass and flow. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「裝片數量及間距改變熱容量與流場。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for specify boat loading and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「晶舟載量」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for specify boat loading: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 爐溫與片溫

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for separate furnace and wafer temperature, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：爐溫與片溫。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：爐壁設定值不能直接當作晶圓瞬時溫度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate furnace and wafer temperature. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Wall setpoint is not instantaneous wafer temperature. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「爐壁設定值不能直接當作晶圓瞬時溫度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for separate furnace and wafer temperature: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

knowledge.title: 固定源與有限源的原理

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。

Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.

quiz.explanationEn: Source boundary conditions determine the diffusion solution. Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

knowledge.title: 加熱區校準的原理

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶舟和晶圓增加熱容量，也改變氣流與熱輻射遮蔽，因此空爐校準須經負載條件驗證。

options: 接面深度需與基底背景濃度一起決定。
降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。
所有光學表面可共用不變發射率。
optionsEn: Junction depth is determined with the background doping.
No diffusion can occur during cooling.
Every optical surface shares one constant emissivity.
quiz.explanation: 接面深度需與基底背景濃度一起決定。 Fick 模型的通量取決於梯度，均勻高濃度區可有低通量，而低濃度但陡梯度區可有顯著通量。
quiz.explanationEn: Junction depth is determined with the background doping. Fickian flux follows gradients: uniform high concentration can have little flux while a low but steep profile can have substantial flux.

steps.title: 濃度依賴擴散
steps.objective: 完成「濃度依賴擴散」的量測規劃，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify concentration dependence. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Constant diffusivity can fail at high doping. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高摻雜時常數擴散係數可能失去適用性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Constant diffusivity can fail at high doping. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「濃度依賴擴散」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify concentration dependence and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「濃度依賴擴散」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess defect-assisted diffusion. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Point-defect history changes effective diffusion behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「點缺陷前史會改變有效擴散行為。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for uniformity acceptance, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 徑向與軸向圖
steps.objective: 完成「徑向與軸向圖」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate radial and axial maps, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：徑向與軸向圖。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate radial and axial maps. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「徑向與軸向圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate radial and axial maps and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「徑向與軸向圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate radial and axial maps: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 徑向與軸向圖的原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate radial and axial maps principle
knowledge.text: 片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。
knowledge.textEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
knowledge.textEn: Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

quiz.question: 評估「徑向與軸向圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate radial and axial maps?
options: 片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。
空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。
相同雷射能量必定產生相同熱峰值。
optionsEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately.
Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity.
Equal laser energy must produce equal thermal peaks.
quiz.explanation: 片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
quiz.explanationEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately. Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

steps.check: 交付「片電阻映射」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for map sheet resistance: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objective: 完成「最差片位」的量測規劃，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for select worst-case slots, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：最差片位。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：中心片合格不代表端部片位合格。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Select worst-case slots. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Center-wafer acceptance does not prove end-slot acceptance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「中心片合格不代表端部片位合格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Center-wafer acceptance does not prove end-slot acceptance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。 應回到「最差片位」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for select worst-case slots and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「最差片位」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for select worst-case slots: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

knowledge.title: 最差片位的原理
knowledge.text: 中心片合格不代表端部片位合格。
knowledge.textEn: Center-wafer acceptance does not prove end-slot acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
knowledge.textEn: Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

quiz.question: 評估「最差片位」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating select worst-case slots?
options: 空載均溫就證明滿載各片均勻。
中心片合格不代表端部片位合格。
相同雷射能量必定產生相同熱峰值。
optionsEn: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity.
Center-wafer acceptance does not prove end-slot acceptance.
Equal laser energy must produce equal thermal peaks.
quiz.explanation: 中心片合格不代表端部片位合格。 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。
quiz.explanationEn: Center-wafer acceptance does not prove end-slot acceptance. Axial furnace and radial wafer variation reflect different boundaries; merging them into one deviation can hide fault causes.

steps.title: 批次擴散驗收
steps.objective: 完成「批次擴散驗收」的工程驗收單，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for accept batch diffusion, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：批次擴散驗收。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Accept batch diffusion. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for accept batch diffusion and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「批次擴散驗收」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for accept batch diffusion: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.
